Wir sind 10 begeisterte Spieler, von denen jeder ein oder mehrere Spielegeschäfte in Deutschland führt.
Als wir uns 2017 zum ersten Mal trafen, um die Aktion “Hoher Spielwert“ ins Leben zu rufen, verband uns sofort die Leidenschaft zum Spiel und die Begeisterung, davon auch andere überzeugen zu wollen.
2021 gründeten wir deshalb nicht nur den “Spieleallianz e.V.”, als Verein für SpielehändlerInnen, sondern auch den Verlag “10 Traders”, um die Spiele veröffentlichen zu können, die uns begeistern und unserer Meinung nach auf dem Spieltisch noch fehlen.

Die 100 Questen Gesellschaft e.V. steht für Rollenspiele, die auf Fertigkeitswürfen mit dem W100 basieren.

Hier könnt Ihr die Rollenspiele SCHAKALE - Bronzezeitliches Fantasy-Rollenspiel und BASIC ROLEPLAYING - Universelles Spielsystem und deren Ergänzungen erwerben.
Zudem könnt Ihr euch über dieses und weitere W100-Systeme der BRP-Familie informieren. Wir freuen uns auf Euch!

In Q4 2026, we plan to launch our next Kickstarter project, Ryugu.
At SPIEL Essen 2026, we will be exhibiting jointly with Uchibacoya, where we will be showcasing and selling our featured titles.

AILEVEN – Bring Your Fantasy Team to the Table
AILEVEN is a football strategy board game inspired by the world of Fantasy Football, where players build their squad, take it onto the pitch and compete in tactical head-to-head matches.
Designed for football fans, Fantasy League players and board gamers, AILEVEN brings the excitement of building and managing a team from the digital Fantasy experience to the tabletop.
Players create their squad through a draft and auction system, deploy their team on the board and compete using tactical positioning, player abilities, challenges and match events. Every decision can influence the game: movement, passing, attacking, defending and shooting all…

Asgaardian was created by a player who grew up in a local game store - and never forgot what the game is really about.
Through both highs and lows, we've seen a community that keeps showing up. Players, stores, judges, creators - people who hold this hobby together even when the industry doesn't always meet them with the same care.
Asgaardian exists to stand with that community.
To support local game stores.
To respect the players.
And to build products with honesty, intention, and responsibility.
Quality matters because the experience matters. Not for flash or trends - but because trust is built through details done right.

Wir schreiben das Jahr 1971, doch es ist nicht die Geschichte, die wir kennen.
Endlich ist es so weit! Du bist mit deinem Forschungsteam im ewigen Eis der Antarktis angekommen. Doch das ist erst der Anfang einer Reihe aufregender Expeditionen in dieser alternativen Ära. Eure Ziele sind klar vorgegeben: Erschafft ein hocheffizientes Netzwerk aus Stationen, erkundet die unbarmherzige Umgebung und stoßt als Erste zur Einsturzstelle des mysteriösen Meteoriten vor. Nutzt die knappen Ressourcen mit eurem technologischen Wissen, um euch für kommende Expeditionen auszurüsten und bahnbrechende wissenschaftliche Projekte umzusetzen. Selbst bei Temperaturen tief unter dem Gefrierpunkt müsst ihr die Ruhe bewahren. In dieser stürmischen Landschaft entscheidet das Abwägen von Risiko und Wagemut über…

Spiele als Alien … oder jage es!
Gerüchten zufolge ist ein brennendes Raumschiff vom Himmel gefallen … Nun, das kann ich so bestätigen. Nach einem kleinen Missgeschick bei einer geheimen Mission musste ich den Schleudersitz betätigen ... Wenigstens konnte ich noch die Tarnfunktion meines Schiffes aktivieren. Das Mutterschiff weiß bereits, dass ich in Schwierigkeiten stecke. Es kommt aber erst in ein paar Tagen, und wenn es hier ist, muss es schnell wieder verschwinden – die Menschen sind noch nicht bereit für den Kontakt mit Außerirdischen. Bis ich abgeholt werde, muss ich mich verstecken. Doch das wird nicht leicht, denn meine Ankunft wurde bemerkt – Agenten sind mir auf den Fersen! Sie kennen sich hier viel besser aus als ich, haben modernste Technik und keine Angst vor diesen Seen…

10 von 10 ist ein kooperatives Ratespiel, bei dem alle gemeinsam gegen das Spiel antreten. Eine Person muss eine geheime Zahl von 1 bis 10 erraten, während die Mitspielenden passende Begriffe zu einer vorgegebenen Kategorie nennen, die diese Wertung möglichst treffend widerspiegeln.

So funktioniert’s:

In jeder Runde kennen alle außer der ratenden Person die gezogene Zahl. Anschließend wird eine Kategorie aufgedeckt, zu der die Mitspielenden nacheinander jeweils einen passenden Begriff nennen, der die geheime Wertung auf einer Skala von sehr schlecht bis sehr gut widerspiegeln soll. Danach gibt die ratende Person einen Tipp von 1 bis 10 ab. Die Differenz zur tatsächlichen Zahl zählt als Strafpunkte. Nach 10 Runden gewinnt das Team, wenn es insgesamt höchstens 20 Strafpunkte gesammelt…

Start your engines and race to 1,000 km! In this fast-paced Mario Kart–style card game, speed ahead with distance cards, block your rivals, and strike at the perfect moment. Every turn is packed with strategy, surprises, and epic comebacks. Outsmart your opponents, dodge attacks, and keep your lead. Only one player reaches the finish line first!

In 17 Dice Bets, you combine your secret personal dice with a shared public pool to bet on high-scoring combos. But here’s the catch: players can force rerolls on the shared dice, changing the odds in real-time. Will you play it safe or manipulate the table to ruin your opponents’ bets? Bluff, bet, and roll your way to victory in this high-stakes casino showdown.

1880 Romania is an 18xx game for 2 to 6 players set during the rise of Romania's railway network from the mid 19th century through the communist era and into modern times. Players invest in railway companies, build track across the country's diverse landscape, and make strategic financial decisions to maximize their wealth.
The game introduces several unique twists, including changing economic systems, foreign investors, and multiple map variants for different player counts, while preserving the deep stock market and railway gameplay that defines the 18xx genre.

pr.d:
1902 veröffentlichte der Illusionist Georges Méliès mit Le Voyage dans la Lune einen der ersten Science-Fiction-Filme der Geschichte, dessen 13.375 Einzelbilder in aufwendiger Kleinstarbeit von Hand koloriert wurden. Fasziniert von den Möglichkeiten des Kinematographen der Brüder Lumière wurde Méliès zum Pionier des Kinos und legte mit seinen visuellen Effekten den Grundstein der modernen Filmtechnik.
Werde Regieassistent von Méliès und hilf dabei, ruhende Bilder zum Leben zu erwecken. Bereite das Filmset vor, setze spektakuläre Spezialeffekte ein, positioniere die Schauspieler, drehe Szenen und koloriere sie, um daraus Fantastisches zu erschaffen.
Lass dich von der Magie des frühen Kinos verzaubern und begib dich auf die Reise zum Mond!

1953: Everest transports players to one of the last great adventures of the twentieth century: the race to conquer the highest mountain on Earth. After decades of failed attempts through Tibet and years of geopolitical upheaval, a narrow window opens through Nepal. Nations mobilize resources, recruit climbers and sherpa teams, and prepare expeditions to reach a place no human has stood before.
Each player leads a national expedition with a single objective: become the first to reach the summit of Everest.
Throughout the game, players build their ascent step by step, transforming a growing mountain of cards into both the route to the summit and the infrastructure needed to sustain it. Resources must be transported upward, camps established, equipment secured, and key moments chosen…

Based on George Orwell's cult novel 1984, this game is about the pressure of totalitarian reign and the cost of resisting it. Where freedom and individuality are considered crimes, and the directives of the party, no matter how absurd they seem, must be fulfilled.
In the world shaped by machine, there is no place for personal ambition or independent choice — only collective need and collective responsibility. The player’s decisions will determine not only their character’s path but also their ultimate fate, whatever it may be. The game lasts for five rounds. At the beginning of each round, the Responsible Executor (the first player) reveals a Directive Card, which sets a common goal for all players.
Base game included Competitive and Solo game modes.

SIXSEVEN is a fast and addictive dice game where every decision matters.
Each round, players roll two dice and choose what to do with the result: keep a die, reroll, or push their luck to improve their combination. The goal is to score as high as possible… or achieve the coveted SIX SEVEN.
But be careful—taking risks can cost you a strong roll. Ability cards add unexpected twists, keeping tension high in every turn.
Win by scoring the most points… or instantly by rolling a double SIX SEVEN.
Quick, simple, and full of tense decisions, SIXSEVEN always leaves you wanting one more round.

7 Ages is Australian Design Group's ground-breaking game covering 6000 years of human history from 4000 bce to today.
You, as one of the greatest dynasties of all time, must chart a trusty course for each civilisation that is lucky enough to have you as their benign ruler. By advancing your culture, art, science, religion and architecture you will gain glory for yourself and, almost as importantly, your people. And of course you cannot ignore expanding the borders of your realm, not because of any personal greed, of course not, simply so that everyone in the world becomes lucky enough to have you in charge of their, from then on, glorious future.
Facing you is up to 6 venal weak lords who scandalously oppress their own people and snub your every reasonable suggestion. So it won’t be easy…

Face the judgment of the end times completely alone! Your goal is to break the seals of an ancient scroll and defy the wrath of a supreme being who has unleashed a horde of furious beasts and demons intent on annihilating humanity. Use your dice wisely and prove you can convince the Great Creator to grant humanity a second chance.
Designed by Julio Falagán and illustrated by Will Kirkby, 7th Seal is a solo game for players aged 10 and up, with sessions lasting 30 to 45 minutes. Your objective is to break the seven seals that enclose the book of the Supreme Being and face the apocalyptic judgment written within. To do so, you will have to overcome four waves; in each wave, you must defeat an Overlord and, if possible, the Minions that accompany him. If you fail to eliminate the Minions,…

An epic battle is unfolding, and players must choose a side! In 99x1, one legendary Swordsman faces off against a horde of 99 Demons in a one-vs-all card game of hidden information, tactical decisions, and shifting alliances.
Each round, both sides reveal a face-up card before secretly committing individual cards to add to their side’s total Power. The side with the lower total takes damage. The Swordsman must manage his limited resources, anticipate hidden plays, and exploit the Demons' rivalries without underestimating their combined strength.
But the Demons face a dilemma of their own. They must work together to bring down the Swordsman, yet only one Demon player can ultimately win. When the Demons win a clash, each player earns points from the cards they contributed. When they lose,…

To restore eternal harmony between nature and humanity, players must guide their characters across a treacherous river and through dense jungle, collect valuable treasures, and reach the mystical 3D pyramid in the mythical city of Akakor. Will you outsmart your rivals and climb to the very top, or will you get stuck in the mud of the rainforest?
Gameplay Overview:
On each turn, a player rolls 4 action dice, with the option to reroll any number of them once. They then choose the results of 2 dice to perform their corresponding actions:
Move: Move your hero 1 space on land, a raft, or a bridge.
Jump: Jump across the river or vault over another…

ANTgravity is a tactical game about a clash between space ants using the latest technology in the farthest corners of the cosmos. Your goal is to deliver flags, captured from the most distant regions of space, back to your base. To achieve this, you will move your ants across the board, play cards, and take advantage of asteroid formations. However, remember that your opponents are not just other players but also the ever—present gravity! Whether you use it to your advantage or let it become an obstacle will significantly impact the course of the game. Whoever captures the right flags the fastest will be the winner!

The cosmic clash between the ants not only continues - it reaches a whole new level! Out in deep space, one may occasionally encounter places that defy the understanding of ordinary ants. These are mysterious regions filled with a strange force - Anomaly - that causes many things to behave differently, unpredictably. But more chaos means more fun - and that’s exactly what ants enjoy the most!
The Anomalies expansion for ANTgravity introduces new cards (both Basic and Legendary), Anomaly cards, Asteroid tokens, Doom tokens, Anomaly tokens, and the Anomaly die.

The cosmic clash between the ants not only continues - it reaches a whole new level! This time, the interstellar pathways have led our insect astronauts into a region overflowing with raw energy. The space between the asteroids hums constantly with crackling discharges. But for seasoned warriors of the cosmos, that’s nothing they can’t handle!
The Energy expansion for ANTgravity introduces new cards (both Basic and Legendary), Asteroid tokens, and Doom tokens.

The cosmic clash between the ants not only continues - it reaches a whole new level! As the battles shift into a new region, the atmosphere on the battlefield intensifies dramatically - thanks to the presence of the element of fire in this sector, as well as new weapons added to the insects’ arsenal. Will you feel the new heat radiating from the battlefield?
The Fire Expansion for ANTgravity introduces new cards (both Basic and Legendary), Asteroid tokens, Doom tokens, and Fire tokens.

The cosmic clash between the ants not only continues - it reaches a whole new level! Even though space is unimaginably cold, the desire for fresh experiences in battle has led the six-legged warriors to a region filled with never-before-seen icy asteroids. The ants were a bit surprised at first, but they didn’t ponder it for long - immediately deciding to use these new conditions for yet another fight. The asteroids may be frozen solid, but the emotions on the battlefield are hotter than ever!
The Ice expansion for ANTgravity introduces new cards (both Basic and Legendary), Ice tokens, Asteroid tokens, and Doom tokens.

The cosmic clash between the ants not only continues - it reaches a whole new level! After a series of movie marathons (ants in space don’t just fight for flags, they also enjoy classic cinema!) featuring martial arts legends such as Chuck No Rest, Brass Line, and Jim-Clyde the Damned, the insects have awakened a new inner energy, eager to put it to use in their battles for cosmic flags. After all, who could possibly stand against the Fist of the Elusive Ant?
The Kung Fu expansion for ANTgravity introduces new cards (both Basic and Legendary), Asteroid tokens, and Doom tokens.

But his rage was not quenched, and he vowed to master dark magic so he could bring the bartender back to life and kill him anew every night until his thirst for vengeance was satisfied. Anyway, his wicked powers have led to his being proclaimed the Hellbilly Zombie Master, with his very own army of zombies ready to…

Setze die Segel und erkunde die Grenzen der bekannten Welt!
In Adamastor übernimmst du das Kommando über eine Expeditionsflotte während des Zeitalters der Entdeckungen. Im Auftrag deiner Krone stichst du in See, um unbekannte Küsten zu erforschen, neue Handelswege zu erschließen und die letzten weißen Flecken auf den Karten der bekannten Welt zu füllen.
Jede Partie stellt dich vor neue Herausforderungen. Du musst deine Mannschaft sicher durch gefährliche Gewässer führen, auf heftige Stürme und unberechenbare Winde reagieren und gleichzeitig die Moral deiner Crew aufrechterhalten. Die vielseitig einsetzbaren Handkarten helfen dir dabei, schwierige Entscheidungen zu meistern und deine Expedition erfolgreich voranzubringen.
Doch jede Reise fordert ihren Tribut. Strapazen, Entbehrungen und…

Create a shared fantasy adventure with adorable goblin-like heroes, building the story together one prompt at a time. The streamlined rules make sessions easy to start and flexible in length, from quick tales to longer journeys.

Abenteuer an unendlich vielen Orten!

Ziehe los Adorablin und betrete die Portale in andere Welten. Deine Aufgabe ist es Verlorengegangenes wiederzufinden und zurückzubringen. Doch lass dich nicht erwischen!

Adorablins ist ein supersüßes und leicht zu erlernendes Erzählspiel, bei dem du und deine Freunde als kleine koboldähnliche Kreaturen Abenteuer an unendlich vielen Orten erleben. Ein Spiel dauert etwa 30 Minuten, kann aber frei ausgedehnt werden. Die Erzählerin sollte mindestens 8 Jahre alt sein, die weiteren Spieler können problemlos auch etwas jünger sein. Alles, was man zum Spielen braucht, befindet sich in einer tragbaren Dose, die in jede Hosentasche passt!

Im Spiel erzählst du mit deinen Freunden gemeinsam die Geschichte. Wenn die Spieler versuchen, Herausforderungen zu…

pr.a: Phil Walker-Harding, Matthew Dunstan, Ute Wielandt
pr.d: September 2076: Why hasn’t a signal been sent from the Mars Base Alpha for years? The United Earth Government sends a rescue mission to the first settlement on Mars. The team: one to four players ages ten and up. The astronauts have special abilities that must be used during the missions. Step into exciting roles in this analog PC adventure and experience the story for yourself. Search for objects, combine them, and solve puzzles: Many challenges await over 100 million kilometers away. The thrilling sci-fi story is fully audible with the free Kosmos Explanation App.

pr.k: 932:ADVENTURE IN A BOX: DRACHENELFEN - HIMMEL IN FLAMMEN
pr.t: Adventure in a Box: Drachenelfen - Himmel in Flammen
pr.o: ADVENTURE IN A BOX: DRACHENELFEN - HIMMEL IN FLAMMEN
pr.a: Bernhard Hennen, Philipp Baas, Johannes Kaub
pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Dice Rolling
pr.d:
Im Kampf gegen die Menschen musst du in die Rolle eines Elite-Kriegers der Elfen schlüpfen! Infiltriere die goldene Stadt und finde die versteckte Geheimwaffe der Menschen. Kämpfe für die Elfen und wende das Blatt des Krieges in dieser epischen Mission!
„Himmel in Flammen“ ist ein kooperatives Storyspiel, bei dem ihr die Rolle der Protagonisten übernehmt, die sich auf eine waghalsige Mission wagen.
1) Wählt eure Charaktere!
2) Übernimm als Spielmacher die Kontrolle über die Feinde!
3) Erlebt taktische Herausforderungen und erringt den Sieg!

pr.m: Push your Luck, Set Collection, Others
pr.d:
In Adventurers Required, you can land your dream job! Who hasn't always wanted to be the HR manager of a guild? Assemble a team of sneaky adventurers, sneak into the wizard's tower, and snatch his treasures. But beware! Alongside their skills, you'll need to watch you team's noise rating. If things get too loud, you'll wake up the wizard. And that would be very bad...

At the start of each round, you reveal the first resp. next floor of the tower and draw four adventurer cards. But you can only peek at some of them. Now, its time to decide who makes the cut. A card from your hand, one from the market or will you trust your luck and recruit blindly from the draw pile?

From the bard to the druid, every adventurer brings their strengths - and also their noise level! But even the loudest can…

pr.m: Area Control, Bag Building, Dice Rolling, Trade
pr.d: Four Greek city-states — Athens, Sparta, Corinth, and Thebes — compete for dominance across the Aegean in the first phase of the Peloponnesian War (431–421 BC). Each has its own strengths — Athens' fleets, Sparta's army, Corinth's economy, Thebes' striking power — yet none is locked into a single path. Scoring happens in three categories — city-states you control, coins you collect, and mints of your own — each faction weighting them differently. Wealth comes from trade along the routes you establish; power from territorial control and combat. Coin scoring uses a hidden, simultaneous fist commit — everyone opens at once, and no one knows in advance how much the others will stake. Two modes: a competitive Sandbox and an event-driven Campaign.

pr.m: Area Control, Area Movement, Modular Board, Others
pr.d: Espansion for Ascending Fate

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Ressource Management, Tile Placement, Others
pr.d:
Build 3D Spires and Defend the Elemental Realm!
Where cooperative strategy rises above the table.
The realm of Elementis is under siege! Elemental Aether fiends are draining the aethercore, causing chaos to reign. You and your companions must work together as heroes, building towering 3D spires by stacking floor tiles strategically above the table.
Complete all four elemental spires to unleash devastating resurgences and restore balance. But beware - if the aethercore is depleted or you take too long, chaos will overtake your world forever!
What Makes It Special:
• Revolutionary 3D tile placement mechanics
• Cooperative tower defense with elemental strategy
• True vertical gameplay - strategy rises above the table
• Perfect for 1-4 players working as a team
• Innovative "3D Strategy"…

pr.t: Age of Comics: The Vault Collection
pr.o: AGE OF COMICS: THE VAULT COLLECTION
pr.m: Drafting, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Age of Comics: The Vault Collection is a modular expansion for Age of Comics: The Golden Years, bringing together four gameplay modules originally included in the Collector’s Edition. It adds new comic titles, wartime events, specialised creatives and additional objectives, giving players more ways to develop their publishing company and shape their strategy across the five rounds.
Combine the four modules freely to increase variety, create new card interactions and introduce fresh challenges without changing the core flow of the game. This content is now available in a dedicated expansion box for Standard Edition owners.

Season have arrived in Agent Avenue!
Enjoy brand new ways to play Agent Avenue and experience all Four Seasons.
The 4 new maps of spring, summer, fall and winter introduce new special spaces with tactical effects to spice up the game.
Also included are 2 new Agent cards and 8 unique Black Market cards, offering even more exciting paths to victory.

Central Europe, around 1670 A.D.
The Plague which has raged for centuries has finally been overcome.
The civilized world is revitalized. People are upgrading and extending their simple Wooden Houses. Fields must be plowed, sowed, and harvested. People are living off millet Grain, Bread, and Vegetables. The famine of the previous years has also encouraged them to eat more meat (a habit that we continue to this day as our wealth is growing).
In the end, the wealthiest player wins. Interestingly enough, animals that you do not eat contribute to your wealth.

The time for rivalries is over!
The Cities unite to build a grand Capital and honor the gods. Work together to erect Divine Altars and make the Capital shine across the ancient world.
Game Overview
In this cooperative expansion, players join forces to build the Capital and achieve the highest score possible. Choose a scenario, complete Architectural Challenges, place Divine Altars, and carefully plan every move.
End of the Game
When all tiles are placed, only Capital districts with Divine Altars score points. Coordinate your actions, manage your Stones, and work together to achieve victory.
Akropolis Pantheon is a cooperative expansion for Akropolis. The base game is required to play.

Al-Kahuf is an adventure detective game inspired by the works of Howard Phillips Lovecraft.
You’ll experience an engaging interactive story whose outcome depends entirely on you and your choices. You are about to set out in the footsteps of a missing expedition that had been exploring the area near the town of Al-Kahuf before vanishing in the scorching sands of Egypt. Talk to characters, explore locations, carry out excavations. The outcome of the story will depend on your actions, choices, and deductions.
The game features a "nonlinear communication" mechanic, allowing the player to interact with various in-game characters on different topics at their discretion.

pr.k: 209:ALEA LUMA - MAGIC DICE-DICE THAT LIGHT UP ONLY IN YOUR DICE TRAY, NO BATTERIES, NO CHARGING!
pr.t: Alea Luma - Magic Dice-Dice that light up ONLY in your dice tray, no batteries, no charging!
pr.o: ALEA LUMA - MAGIC DICE-DICE THAT LIGHT UP ONLY IN YOUR DICE TRAY, NO BATTERIES, NO CHARGING!
pr.d:
• Magnetic Induction Lighting Technology – Unique induction coil design, dice light up automatically only when rolled on compatible induction surface. No constant lighting during regular rolling, brings magical atmosphere to your D&D game nights.

• 7-Piece Complete Polyhedral Dice Set – Full RPG dice kit includes D4, D6, D8, D10, D10 Percentile, D12, D20. Crafted based on Bescon Moonstone semi-transparent glitter resin, with silver ink numbering and serif font.

• Premium Resin Dice Construction – Semi-transparent base with fine iridescent glitter, smooth rolling, well-balanced weight, sharp clear number inlay. Great visual effect once lit up on induction tray.

• Perfect for Tabletop Roleplaying Games – Ideal for Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder, MTG, and other tabletop RPG board games.…

Vibrant hybrid creatures and glowing neon colors: Alebrijes brings the fascinating world of Mexican alebrijes to the game table. Full of imagination and magic, featuring mysterious hybrid creatures. In Alebrijes, you try to outdo your opponents’ card combinations turn by turn and time the use of your wild cards—the Alebrijes—just right. Play with foresight and win this colorful climbing game. A real eye-catcher with simple rules that are easy to learn.
The extraordinary neon printing makes the colorful illustrations literally glow right out of the box, turning every game into a special experience. The two exciting game variants ensure varied gameplay and ever-changing tactical challenges. Developed by a team of Mexican designers and featuring their illustrations, Alebrijes combines…

Wer sichert sich die wertvollsten Gebäude für seine Alhambra?
Bei Alhambra Card Game sammelt ihr Edelsteine in vier verschiedenen Arten und nutzt sie, um wertvolle Gebäude zu erwerben. Insgesamt sechs Gebäudekategorien stehen zur Verfügung und bei den Wertungen kommt es darauf an, in den richtigen Kategorien die Mehrheit zu besitzen.
In eurem Zug entscheidet ihr euch zwischen zwei einfachen Aktionen: Edelsteine nehmen oder ein Gebäude kaufen. Ihr könnt eine einzelne Edelsteinkarte aus der Auslage nehmen oder sogar mehrere, solange deren Gesamtwert nicht höher als 5 ist. Wollt ihr ein Gebäude kaufen, müsst ihr es mit der jeweils geforderten Edelsteinart bezahlen.
Dabei lohnt es sich, genau zu planen: Bezahlt ihr mehr als nötig, bekommt ihr kein Wechselgeld zurück. Könnt ihr den Preis…

Build the strongest poker-inspired hand while predicting which player will come out on top. Across three rounds, manipulate the shared display, bluff, manage your hand and earn extra runes when your prediction is correct.

pr.k: 413:ALL SAINTS’ NIGHT TAROT – GOTHIC 78-CARD TAROT DECK
pr.t: All Saints’ Night Tarot – Gothic 78-Card Tarot Deck
pr.o: ALL SAINTS’ NIGHT TAROT – GOTHIC 78-CARD TAROT DECK
pr.d:
All Saints’ Night Tarot is a 78-card deck inspired by gothic folklore, moonlit cemeteries and the mysterious atmosphere of All Saints’ Night.
The illustrations combine traditional Tarot symbolism with dark romantic imagery: candlelit paths, ravens, old churches, wrought-iron gates, misty forests and spectral figures. The visual style is richly detailed and atmospheric, blending gothic elegance with a sense of mystery rather than horror.
The deck includes all 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana cards and is suitable for Tarot readings, reflection, seasonal use and collecting.
Includes: 78 illustrated Tarot cards · guidance for card meanings

Players: 2-6| Playing time: 15-30 min | Age: 8+ |
The most fearless chili eaters have gathered for a fiery challenge… and only iron stomachs will survive!
In All You Can Chili, every player secretly controls a character with a different tolerance for spice. Round after round, you’ll serve increasingly fiery dishes to your opponents, trying to push them past their limit and make them tap out, all without revealing your own identity too soon.
Because that’s the real game: your rivals are watching every dish you serve and every one you swallow, looking for clues about how much heat you can really take. Serve too aggressively and you’ll expose yourself; play it too safe and someone else will control the table.
A fast-paced game of bluffing, deduction, and risk management, where knowing when…

The table is set, now it’s time to clear it before it’s too late!
In All You Can Eat Buffet, each player has a deck of Mood cards, which they play to grab food from the table.
During a round, these cards are revealed simultaneously and then resolved in player order and according to their instructions.
But beware: if two players play the same Mood card, they must clink glasses and take a drink token.
Too many drink tokens might go to your head, and you may no longer be able to decide which card to play!
After 10 rounds, the game ends and points are tallied from the different food cards each player has collected.
Foods all score differently: meat gives you straightforward points, fruits reward you for collecting the most types, garlic will cost you points unless paired with parsley, and so…

Allegra ist ein semi-kooperatives Kartenablagespiel aus der weltweit bekannten Spielefamilie, die unter dem Namen "Golf" bekannt ist. Ziel des Spiels ist es, die Summe der eigenen Kartenwerte möglichst niedrig zu halten. Vor jedem Spieler liegt ein Kartenraster aus verdeckten und offenen Karten, das sich im Laufe der Partie ständig verändert. Durch geschicktes Aufdecken, Tauschen und Entfernen von Karten versuchen die Spieler, hohe Werte loszuwerden und günstige Kombinationen zu bilden.
Für einen spannenden Twist sorgt die Interaktion: Nicht nur die eigenen Karten stehen im Fokus, sondern auch ein Teil der Auslage des linken Mitspielers. Dadurch entsteht eine ungewöhnliche Spielsituation, in der Aufmerksamkeit, taktisches Denken und ein gutes Gespür für den richtigen Moment gefragt sind.…

Alles Gute - lasst die Feierlichkeiten beginnen!
In dem Chaos der Vorbereiungen kann man ja nichts finden - wo sind die Muffins, und wo die Geschenke? Eventuell sollte mal jemand für Ordnung sorgen…Platziere die Puzzleteile so in dem Spielfeld, dass Du nur noch die Gegenstände siehst, welche Du auch in der Aufgaben sehen kannst! Aber stimmt am Ende denn auch die Anzahl der Gegenstände?
60 partytaugliche Aufgaben in verschiedenen Schwierigkeitsstufen

You are a powerful and moody ancient god!
And YOU deserve the most offerings, the most belief, the most glory! Get it by creating, manipulating and smiting those puny mortals to win their worship in great festivals to your greatness.

Will the mortals lead full, prosperous lives, or suffer terribly by your hand?

​You decide...YOU are ALMIGHTY!
Get 25 wild and crazy new Mortals in this mini-expansion for Almighty, plus 10 mythological Creatures that add a new rules twist for experienced deities!

Alpaca – The Big Ranch is the Deluxe Box of the famous Alpaca board game, designed to hold the base game and up to 12 expansions in a single box, including sleeved cards!
A solution designed for those who want to keep their collection tidy, with exclusive content available only in this special edition.
What's inside The Big Ranch

• Special insert — The box contains an insert to organize the base game and up to 12 expansions (there is also space for sleeved cards).

• Mascot Alpaca Deck — 8 new special alpacas: each player receives one at the beginning of the game and can eliminate it for a large one-time bonus or put it in the pen, where it gives them a unique personal goal that will earn them bonus points at the end of the game if they manage to fulfill it

• Pasture Board — A new board…

Welcome to Alter Falter! This fast-paced folding quiz cleverly combines trivia questions with origami. Do you know the answer? Then fold your paper so that only the answer is visible! Hurry—the fastest player wins. But be careful: thanks to slanted lines, bright colors, and a jumble of numbers, you’ll be scratching your head faster than you can say “paper airplane.”

Level up your discs to score more points – but don’t get too comfortable. The tiles guide your discs... but beware: once used, they flip and change direction. Use them a second time, and they’re removed from the game – potentially disrupting your entire strategy. Who will outsmart the shifting board and find their way to victory?

Um Amarok, den Wolfsgeist, zu verstehen, reicht deine Logik allein nicht aus. Als Hüter der Wälder und Symbole ist er ein Spiegelbild deiner Instinkte. Du musst wie er denken und die Seelen deiner Gegner lesen!
In diesem kompetitiven Deduktionsspiel musst du aufeinanderfolgende Runden gewinnen, indem du die beste Kombination aus zwei Karten hast. Aber sei vorsichtig: Mit jeder Runde, die du gewinnst, nimmt dein Wissen über die Karten zugunsten deiner Gegner ab.

pr.m: Area Control, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Andromeda’s Edge: Genesis ist eine umfangreiche Erweiterung zu Andromeda’s Edge. Sie bringt neue Fraktionen, Sektoren und Bedrohungen an den Rand der Galaxis und erweitert die strategischen Möglichkeiten des Grundspiels. Neue Regionen und feindliche Technologien verändern Entscheidungen auf dem modularen Spielplan, Prophezeiungen und Schreine ergänzen das Spiel um weitere taktische Elemente.

This fantasy Advent calendar sends a solo hero through a winter adventure in the duchy of Greifenfrost, where snow monsters threaten the land. Each day reveals new story content, choices, battles, puzzles and rewards as you develop your character and uncover the secret behind the attack.

Complete the puzzle. Then start playing!
Animalia is a 2000-piece interactive jigsaw puzzle packed with animals, characters and tiny details to discover. Once completed, the puzzle becomes a huge game board featuring more than 160 hidden searches, quests and visual challenges to solve with the included booklet.
Explore the illustration, follow the quests and put your observation skills to the test as you discover all the secrets hidden in the world of Animalia.
A puzzle to build. A world to explore. A game to solve.

Apocalypse is a trick-taking game where the goal is to score the fewest points by playing cards and influencing Apocalypse tokens. If all tokens are flipped, the rules change and chaos ensues. It is a redesign of Saika Banrai featuring a 5th suit, a 2-player variant, and upgraded components.

“And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see. And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.” (Apocalypse 6:7-8)
Apocalypse is a trick-taking game where the goal is to score the fewest points. Each round, you play cards and influence the Apocalypse tokens at the center of the table. Watch them carefully: if they are all flipped, the rules change and the round descends into chaos!
Apocalypse is a redesign of Saika Banrai, adding a 5th suit, a 2 player variant and upgraded components.

Aqua Garden, the beloved fish-filled favorite featuring adorable little fish tokens, is back in a brand new edition!
Become the director of your very own aquarium, collect fish, and build a more captivating aquarium than anyone else. To create the perfect aquarium, you'll need to think carefully about eye-catching fish combinations for your advertisements, as well as the oxygen levels in each tank. Oh, and watch out — you can't put sharks in a tank with your other swimming fish!
By the end of the game, you'll have crafted an aquarium so beautiful you'll want to share photos of it. Enjoy the satisfying tension of each meaningful decision, paired with vibrant and gorgeous visuals.
Perfect for experienced gamers and beginners alike — a great first mid-weight game for newcomers to the hobby.…

pr.m: Area Control, Modular Board, Tile Placement
pr.d: Aquapark is a light, summer-themed family board game where you build a water park over five rounds. Each round randomly pairs players up to take simultaneous turns using an "I cut, you choose" setup. One player creates an offer of cards and tokens, their partner picks first, and the split-maker takes the rest. You'll link cards to build larger attraction zones and position visitors and lifeguards to score.

Welcome to the annual Aquarium Festival!
At this grand event, aquarium shops from all over showcase their finest collections, each trying to stand out among fierce competitors.
Observe how other shops present their displays, adjust the composition of your aquatic collection, and seize the right moment to take advantage of sponsor support to make your exhibit shine.
Among representatives from aquariums around the world, only the shop that demonstrates the most impressive collection will earn the prestigious title of “Aquarium Tycoon.”
"Aquarium Festival" is a ladder climbing game supported by shared dice.
During each competition, players take turns playing card combinations, gradually increasing the strength of the current play to gain the advantage. At key moments, players may also use…

pr.m: Deck Building, Engine Building, Set Collection
pr.d:
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Aquatica: Kalte Gewässer ist eine Erweiterung für Aquatica. Sie bringt neue Regionen und Meereswesen in das Unterwasserreich und erweitert das Spiel um zusätzliche Module. Enthalten sind Komponenten für einen fünften Spieler, neue Orte und Karten sowie eine alternative Mechanik, die die Ziel-Leiste des Grundspiels ersetzt. Damit steigt die Varianz und es entstehen neue Wege, das eigene Unterwasserreich auszubauen.

Im kooperativen Kinderspiel Archeo: Die große Dino-Ausgrabung werdet ihr zu echten Urzeitexperten. Ihr seid ein Team von Paläontologen, das Dinosaurier und andere Urzeittiere erforscht. Gemeinsam reist ihr zu einer Ausgrabung, um dort, tief unter der Erde, faszinierende Fossilien zu entdecken. Aber seid vorsichtig, denn die Arbeit eines Paläontologen ist nicht einfach! Nur wenn ihr zusammenarbeitet, wird es euch gelingen, alle 5 Fossilien-Puzzles zu vervollständigen und 10 verborgene Sterne zu sammeln, bevor eure Schaufeln kaputtgehen.Archeo bietet kooperativen Spielspaß, der dank der enthaltenen Saugnapf-Schaufel echten Entdeckergeist weckt und die Motorik schult. Der tolle 3D-Aufbau in der Schachtel lässt einen dieses Ausgrabungsabenteuer so schnell nicht vergessen.

pr.a: Volodymyr Kuznietsov, Yaroslav Kifor, Andrii Yanovskiy
pr.d:
Aridnyk is a family board game based on the stories and legends of the Carpathian highlanders of Ukraine, the Hutsuls. In this game, you play as shepherds: you will explore the Carpathians, trade with powerful spirits, fulfill intricate plots, and use magical trinkets. The player with the largest flock at the end of the game will be declared the winner!
Since the dawn of time, the Carpathian land has been known for its magic and wonders. The shepherds who tend their flocks in the vast polonyna meadows are ancestrally familiar with the local spirits, enchanted treasures, and powerful spells; hence, they always profit greatly from their craft. Their paths lead to the land where Drizd is herding his magical sheep, the giant Vovk is roaming around the cliffs, and, chained amongst the cloudy…

pr.a: Yaroslav Kifor, Volodymyr Kuznietsov, Andrii Yanovskiy
pr.d:
Aridnyk entführt euch in die mystische Welt der Karpaten. Als Hirten führt ihr eure Herden durch wechselnde Landschaften, begegnet uralten Geistern und nutzt mächtige Artefakte, um euren Weg zu beeinflussen.
Platziert Landschaftsplättchen, bewegt euren Hirten geschickt über das Spielfeld und nutzt Karten mit besonderen Effekten, um euch Vorteile zu verschaffen. Doch seid wachsam – Gefahren und rivalisierende Spieler machen euch das Leben schwer.
Wer am Ende die größte Herde besitzt, gewinnt das Spiel.
In der Box findet ihr Regeln für den kompetitiven Modus sowie für Familienrunden und erzählerische Solo- oder Koop-Partien.
Spielinfos:
• 1–4 Spieler

• 40–60 Minuten

• Ab 10 Jahren

The Festivities mini-expansion for Aridnyk board game allows the shepherds to bring some holiday cheer into their routine.
Every time a Spirit tile is placed on the Horizon, the players reveal and play a special Festivity card. Every Festivity is a small game with rewards for everyone. The expansion includes 10 unique cards that can be easily added to the base game.
When a Spirit appears on the Horizon, the player who placed that tile picks up the Festivity card with the icon matching that Spirit. This player will be Host. A Festivity card consists of 2 parts: mini-games for all players and rules for placing Sheep on specific game components (cards & tiles).
In this expansion, you will find traditional holidays, carefully preserved in the Hutsul region to this day. Some of these…

The Sacred Grounds expansion for Aridnyk board game invites shepherds on a journey guided by spirits.
In this expansion are some of the Carpathians’ famous natural wonders: the Uholka primeval beech forests, the Tustan Cliffs, the Synevyr Lake, the Shypit Waterfall, and the Borzhava Polonyna. Each sacred ground is represented by a special tile with a unique ability, and whoever finds the place first will gain its task card.
By adding Sacred Ground Tiles to the game, you will see the famous outlines of the ancient Tustan cliffs, the legendary Shypit Waterfall, the largest lake in the Carpathians, Synevyr, and the primeval beech forests of Uholka, which are included in the UNESCO World Heritage List. And if you want to dive even deeper into the history of the Carpathians, open the…

The Winter expansion adds a whole new season to the Aridnyk board game. Players place special Winter tiles on top of the regular ones, slowly covering the Carpathians with snow. Your Shepherds travel across the Winter board, collecting tokens with unique bonuses. And Aridnyk themselves will change with the first snow, becoming more powerful than ever!
As soon as the First Snow Tile appears on the Horizon, the player who revealed it must immediately place it on the board. From this moment on, a Winter Board and Winter Tokens are added to the game to count extra points when interacting with Spirits. In addition, with the first snow, while the rest of the Spirits weaken in anticipation of winter, Aridnyk takes on their power. By interacting with the Winter Aridnyk, the player can activate…

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR RPG – STARTER SET – HUNGERING ABYSS
pr.t: Arkham Horror RPG – Starter Set – Hungering Abyss
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR RPG – STARTER SET – HUNGERING ABYSS
pr.d: In Hungering Abyss, one game master and up to five investigators explore 1920s Arkham as empty graveyards and an ancient force signal a growing supernatural threat. The all-in-one starter set teaches the Dynamic Pool System through play and includes the adventure plus dice, maps, character portfolios and other components.

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME CORE SET
pr.t: Arkham Horror: The Card Game Core Set
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME CORE SET
pr.a: Nate French, Josiah Harrist, Nicholas Kory, MJ Newman
pr.d: The 2026 Core Set opens Chapter Two of Arkham Horror: The Card Game with a new introductory campaign, five new investigators and a fresh player-card pool. Set several months after a catastrophe in Arkham, it replaces the 2021 Revised Core Set while remaining fully compatible with previously released content.

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – ANDRÉ PATEL INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.t: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – André Patel Investigator Deck
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – ANDRÉ PATEL INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.d: This Investigator Deck provides a ready-to-play Rogue deck for film star André Patel plus upgrade cards. André thrives on versatility, extra actions and spectacular successes; the Arkham Horror: The Card Game Core Set is required.

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – CAROLYN FERN INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.t: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – Carolyn Fern Investigator Deck
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – CAROLYN FERN INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.d: This Investigator Deck provides a ready-to-play Seeker deck for psychologist Carolyn Fern plus upgrade cards. Carolyn combines strong intellect with horror healing and clue discovery; the Arkham Horror: The Card Game Core Set is required.

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – CHILDREN OF BLOOD SMALL CAMPAIGN EXPANSION
pr.t: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – Children of Blood Small Campaign Expansion
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – CHILDREN OF BLOOD SMALL CAMPAIGN EXPANSION
pr.d: Children of Blood is a three-scenario campaign that sends investigators through Arkham's streets, waterfront, hidden lairs, and a Northside party in pursuit of a new mystery. New blood tokens offer dangerous power while threatening to transform the investigators themselves.

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – MARIE LAMBEAU INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.t: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – Marie Lambeau Investigator Deck
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – MARIE LAMBEAU INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.d: This Investigator Deck provides a ready-to-play Mystic deck for showgirl Marie Lambeau plus upgrade cards. Marie draws on her family’s dark legacy and turns suffering into supernatural power; the Arkham Horror: The Card Game Core Set is required.

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – MIGUEL DE LA CRUZ INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.t: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – Miguel de la Cruz Investigator Deck
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – MIGUEL DE LA CRUZ INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.d: This Investigator Deck provides a ready-to-play Survivor deck for rancher Miguel de la Cruz plus upgrade cards. Miguel specializes in traps, tracking and bringing monsters down on his own terms; the Arkham Horror: The Card Game Core Set is required.

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – TOMMY MULDOON INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.t: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – Tommy Muldoon Investigator Deck
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – TOMMY MULDOON INVESTIGATOR DECK
pr.d: This Investigator Deck provides a ready-to-play Guardian deck for police officer Tommy Muldoon plus upgrade cards. Tommy specializes in firearms, fighting enemies and protecting innocents; the Arkham Horror: The Card Game Core Set is required.

pr.k: 870:ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – TRACES TO NOWHERE
pr.t: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – Traces to Nowhere
pr.o: ARKHAM HORROR: THE CARD GAME – TRACES TO NOWHERE
pr.d: In Traces to Nowhere, detective Aziza Steer investigates a string of disappearances in Arkham while an enigmatic force known as the Abductor closes in. The scenario can be played as a standalone adventure or inserted as a side story into an Arkham Horror: The Card Game campaign.

The sun is blazing, and Arnie & Barney need water! Collect water drops and fill their containers, but beware: more than 11 makes everything overflow and you get nothing. Rely on good timing, careful risks, and steady nerves. The first player to secure the most drops three times wins the game!

Arnie, Barney & Co. have gotten into a chaotic mix-up! Now everyone plays at the same time and as fast as possible to collect exactly the cards that show all the characters rolled on the dice. If you make a mistake, Hypnita gives you penalty points. Whoever has the fewest penalty points after five rounds wins!

pr.t: Arnie & Barney King of the Dice
pr.o: ARNIE & BARNEY KING OF THE DICE
pr.d: In your search for water, you’ll need to roll the dice to draw familiar characters from the world of Arnie & Barney. Over the course of up to three rolls, you’ll fulfill various conditions on the cards. Special cards grant advantages. But watch out for Hypnita and her accomplices—they’ll sabotage you at every turn! The player with the most points at the end wins.

In Arribada, players lay out turtles during a mass nesting event known as an arribada, “arrival by sea.” The goal of the game is to place turtles in groups (sequences or sets) to score points and to make sure as few of your turtles as possible are left stranded by the end of the game. Family means no turtle gets left behind!
Arribada is an approachable strategy game with surprising depth and layered interaction. It’s satisfying and easy to build sets and sequences of your turtles, but things get even more interesting when players begin to fight over the same turtle! Some turtles are better at scoring you quick points, while others are super effective for capturing opponent tiles or gaining bonus turns. When you capture an opponent turtle, it becomes a wild to help you build even more…

pr.k: 413:ART DECO TAROT – 78-CARD TAROT DECK WITH GUIDEBOOK
pr.t: Art Deco Tarot – 78-Card Tarot Deck with Guidebook
pr.o: ART DECO TAROT – 78-CARD TAROT DECK WITH GUIDEBOOK
pr.d:
Art Deco Tarot is a 78-card deck inspired by the glamour, geometry and sophisticated visual style of the Art Deco era.
The illustrations combine classic Tarot symbolism with elegant figures, strong compositions, decorative geometric details and the luxurious atmosphere associated with the 1920s and 1930s. The deck contains all 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana cards while maintaining the familiar structure of traditional Tarot.
Rich colours, stylised forms and vintage-inspired imagery give the deck a distinctive Art Deco character, making it suitable for Tarot readings, personal reflection and collecting.
Includes: 78 illustrated Tarot cards · Guidebook

pr.k: 413:ART NOUVEAU TAROT – 78-CARD TAROT DECK WITH GUIDEBOOK
pr.t: Art Nouveau Tarot – 78-Card Tarot Deck with Guidebook
pr.o: ART NOUVEAU TAROT – 78-CARD TAROT DECK WITH GUIDEBOOK
pr.d:
Art Nouveau Tarot is a 78-card deck inspired by the decorative elegance of the Art Nouveau movement.
The illustrations feature flowing lines, floral ornament, graceful figures and soft romantic compositions, while preserving the familiar symbolism and structure of traditional Tarot. The deck includes all 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana cards.
The visual style combines vintage charm with detailed botanical decoration and harmonious colour palettes, creating a deck that feels both classic and distinctive.
Includes: 78 illustrated Tarot cards · Guidebook

Artsy Hype is a strategic trick-taking game. The players step into the shoes of world-renowned art investors. You will travel across the globe’s major art capitals in search of the most promising masterpieces.
From Cubist treasures in Spain and Surrealist movements in Mexico to the evocative ink wash exhibitions of China, every piece of art has the potential to become a high-value centerpiece of your collection. Players must use keen insight and sharp judgment to time their acquisitions perfectly amidst fluctuating market prices, competing to secure limited editions for maximum profit.
However, the art world is ever-changing. Shifting trends, new exhibitions, and breaking auction news can all impact a painting’s value—where high risk often meets high reward. The player who best navigates…

pr.k: 311:ASCEND THE SHINRA TOWER: FINAL FANTASY VII
pr.t: Ascend the Shinra Tower: Final Fantasy VII
pr.o: ASCEND THE SHINRA TOWER: FINAL FANTASY VII
pr.d:
Ascend the swaying Shinra Tower and confront the crisis threatening the planet.
Inspired by Final Fantasy VII, this thrilling cooperative balance board game has you and your teammates working together to ascend the unstable Shinra Tower.
Stack “Floor Tiles” atop “Wall Tiles” of varying heights to build upward, level by level.
As the Shinra Tower rises, it gradually begins to tilt, becoming increasingly unstable…
Maintaining balance through teamwork and discussion becomes the key to success in this cooperative challenge.
Foes who stand in Cloud’s way will appear one after another within the Shinra Tower.
Borrow the strength of your allies to overcome these enemies as Cloud continues his ascent toward the top. If you can prevent the Shinra Tower from collapsing and help Cloud reach the 8th…

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Push your Luck, Set Collection

pr.t: Ascendia Seasons of Thargos - The Secrets Below
