pr.d:
The inevitable will come. Cities will fall.
Yet from their ashes, you may rise again.
Plan carefully. Endure wisely.
Preserve what truly matters.
Will your civilization be remembered as the one that left its mark?
· · · ◆ · · ·
Ashes & Amber is a competitive civilization tableau-building card game where cities are living stacks of cards: expand them, protect them, and rebuild them after devastating catastrophes.
- Build cities as stacks of cards and activate the top cards
- Protect your valuable cards or see them burn when the catastrophes strike
- Raise Wonders to show the world your accomplishments
- Achieve greatness by saving your Amber to the end but beware when the major event is triggered
· · · ◆ · · ·
The game unfolds across five eras, Prehistory, Antiquity, Middle Ages, Age of…

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Drafting, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d:
Ashes Ascendancy is the next era of the expandable card game Ashes; a new entry point for the series and a continuation of Ashes Reborn. Fully compatible with all of Ashes Reborn, Ashes Ascendancy marks the introduction of two new magic types for Phoenixborn to wield, the same competitive card play you know and love, plus a new type of foe for players to take down in solo or co-op battles.
Ashes is an expandable card game where players take on the role of Phoenixborn, demi-gods and protectors of the world of Argaia.

The war between Phoenix and Dragon intensifies as Indiri Aldair, an emissary of the ancient dragons, appears on Argaia, ready to hunt the foes of his masters! But this new threat is met by Kanna Galeheart and Maeve Luminvale, both practitioners of natural magic. Can these two Phoenixborn repulse the Dragonborn without fighting each other?
Manipulate the forces of nature with the Ashes Ascendancy: Natural Magic Expansion, containing two new Phoenixborn. Add a new magic type to your library of cards, increasing the tools at your disposal. Battle against a friend, or play solo or co-op against a unique new Dragonborn!

pr.a: Andrea Colletti, Diego Fonseca, Leonardo Romano, Michele Morosini, Marco Presentino
pr.d: With the issue #13 of Ashes you will get 2 stunning miniatures, plus a 40-page magazine, where you’ll discover exclusive content, new scenarios, and behind-the-scenes insights from the Nova Aetas Chronicles. This Special Edition celebrates creativity and community with fresh gameplay material, interviews, and a look at upcoming projects

Assemble! is a fast-paced, team-building card game where players take on the role of a strategist assembling the ultimate team of heroes inspired by classic archetypes across fandom. From fearless leaders to brilliant tacticians, heavy hitters, and wildcards, each hero brings a distinct role to your team. The fun comes from combining these familiar archetypes in new and unexpected ways.
On your turn, you’ll draft, play, and position cards to build your team while watching what your opponents are assembling. Each hero you add can unlock new abilities or enhance others, creating a web of interactions that grows as the game progresses.
To win, you’ll need to assemble the most effective team by the end of the game. Whether that means maximizing powerful combinations, completing key archetype…

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Astronavigators is a board game themed around real astronomy, historical instruments, and celestial navigation, blending scientific accuracy with an adventurous race from Earth to the Moon. You can play the base game in Astronomer Mode (without space race) or in full Astronavigator Mode.
1. Real Star Maps & Celestial Mechanics
The game uses an authentic star map that changes over time, reflecting the actual motions of stars and planets. Players must interpret these celestial patterns to plan observations and navigate effectively.
2. Historical Astronomical Instruments
The theme heavily features old astronomical tools like armillary spheres, orreries, telescopes, and other mechanical devices used throughout history to understand the heavens. These instruments influence gameplay and are…

pr.t: Auf Wilden Wegen (Neue Version mit Solomodus)
pr.o: AUF WILDEN WEGEN (NEUE VERSION MIT SOLOMODUS)
pr.d:
Jedes Jahr wird der angesehene Pokal der Gemeinschaft an das Jungtier verliehen, das seinem Dorf am meisten
zurückgibt. Diesmal ist es ein spannender Wettbewerb, denn außer dir nimmt nur noch ein anderes Jungtier teil!

Unterstütze deine Nachbarn und hilf ihnen bei ihren Vorhaben, dann werden sie sich erkenntlich zeigen. Sei
ein wertvolles Mitglied der Gemeinde, übertrumpfe deinen Rivalen und verdiene den Pokal sowie das Recht,
mit diesem anzugeben!
In unserem Dorf leben Krähen, Kaninchen und Frösche Seite an Seite. Eine jede Tierart bringt ihre eigenen Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten mit sich – so sind die Krähen ausgezeichnete Post- und Paketboten, die Kaninchen aber gewiefte Händler und die Frösche gar abenteuerlustige Gesellen.
Ihr, die ihr in die Rolle eines jungen Vertreters dieser drei…

Es ist Partyzeit! Die ganze Stadt ist dabei: Alle haben sich schick gemacht, bringen Geschenke mit und feiern die ganze Nacht durch. Wirst du die beste Party schmeißen – oder wird es dein Rivale sein?
Beim „Heiterkeit“-Themen-Kartensatz dreht sich alles darum, Karten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt, in der richtigen Reihenfolge und am besten alle auf einmal auszuspielen. Er enthält 24 neue Karten mit jeweils einzigartigen Illustrationen und Fähigkeiten und lässt sich mit dem Grundkartensatz von „Auf Wilden Wegen“ kombinieren, um neue Spielerlebnisse und Herausforderungen zu schaffen!

Es gibt nur eine Sache, die noch besser ist als spazieren zu gehen: danach nach Hause zu kommen. Schlendere durch Gassen und kleine Schleichwege, nur um zu sehen, was am Ende darauf wartet, und sei dann rechtzeitig zum Abendessen wieder zurück. Mit etwas Glück findest du eine bessere Beute als dein Rivale.

Das „Schleichwege“-Themen-Deck ist voll von Karten, mit denen du kleine Abenteuer erleben kannst – mit Effekten, die deine Starter-Karten verstärken und es dir ermöglichen, sie immer wieder einzusetzen. Es enthält 24 neue Karten, jede mit einzigartigen Illustrationen und Fähigkeiten, und lässt sich mit dem Grunddeck von „Auf Wilden Wegen“ kombinieren, um neue Erlebnisse und Herausforderungen zu schaffen!

Werdet der Star der Party, wenn ihr Freunde und Familie mit Auf die Elche fertig los auf einen unglaublich lustigen und wilden Ritt durch den hohen Norden mitnehmt! Im rasanten Reaktionsspiel von den Machern von Taco Katze Ziege Käse Pizza sammelt ihr Kartensätze von Elchen, Bären oder Eichhörnchen, aber müsst euch vor Yetis und Lawinen hüten – sonst verschwinden eure Paare in der Wildnis! Jeder Spieler nimmt eine Karte vom Stapel. Alle rufen „Auf die Elche, fertig, los!“, klatschen ihre Karte auf den Tisch und versuchen, die beste Karte zu ergattern, um ein Paar zu bilden. Der erste Spieler, der drei Sätze von Tieren gesammelt hat, gewinnt diese chaotische Kartenklopperei!

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Auction, Modular Board, Push your Luck, Others
pr.d: In Avalon: The Riven Veil, an Arthurian-based area-control and exploration game, you lead mighty factions through the misty veil to discover what awaits on the mystical isle of Avalon. Explore the mists, discover legendary items of power, bond mythic beasts, hunt for the grail, and prepare for war.

pr.k: 593:AVALON: THE RIVEN VEIL - MYTHS & MONSTERS EXPANSION
pr.t: Avalon: The Riven Veil - Myths & Monsters Expansion
pr.o: AVALON: THE RIVEN VEIL - MYTHS & MONSTERS EXPANSION
pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Area Movement, Auction, Modular Board, Push your Luck
pr.d: Adds a 5th playable faction - the Fey, making the game 2-5 player. Also adds a host of new content and upgrades. Expand your Core Avalon: The Riven Veil Game with the Core Myths and Monsters Box. This includes 1 Two-Tone Lord Miniatures, 10 large Mythical Beasts, 10 Faction Miniatures, 1 Double Sided Player Board, over 200 Unique Cards and over 50 other component upgrades including the Holy Grail and Excalibur Miniatures.

pr.a: Christian Lonsing, Michael Palm, Markus Plötz, Lukas Zach
pr.d: Aventuria – Beschwörer der Elemente ist ein Heldenset für die zweite Edition von Aventuria – Das Abenteuerbrettspiel. Es enthält das komplette Heldendeck des Konzilsmagiers Kilgor Hazenthag sowie eine alternative Heldenversion mit Beliseth sal Sadia. Mit 70 Karten und einem eigenen Erfahrungsschatz bringt dieses Set einen vielseitigen, zaubermächtigen Charakter ins Spiel – perfekt für alle, die Elementarkräfte und fintenreiche Spielzüge lieben.

pr.a: Christian Lonsing, Lukas Zach, Michael Palm
pr.d:
Over 1000 years ago, the magic sword Sevenstrikes was melted down and seven chalices were cast from it. This was supposed to protect the mighty sword from the Forces of Darkness.
But now, the Forces of Darkness have woken up from their slumber and lust for the seven magic chalices. In a race against time, the heroes must capture and protect the chalices before Sevenstrikes is reforged and brings great misfortune to the entire continent.

The campaign consists of 11 Adventures in 30 acts, with a total play time of about 60 Hours! Gain adventure points, treasures, companions, and new equipment, and improve your heroes.

Aventuria provides a true roleplaying experience in an outstanding, fresh board game system.

pr.a: Christian Lonsing, Lukas Zach, Michael Palm
pr.m: Area Movement, Deck Building, Dice Rolling, Modular Board
pr.d:
Sultan Hasrabal ben Yakuban- also known as the Wind King, the Mage Sultan, and the Master of the Six Elements- has kidnapped Nedime, the caliph’s daughter. Many other brave heroes have already tried to free her, and none of them were ever seen again! Can you stand against jinns, mythical beasts, and other strange creatures of the Tulamydian Nights to free Nedime?

Aventuria - Curse of the Desert is a Solo Adventure Board Game. Navigate a single hero through two exciting adventures set in the aventurian version of One Thousand and One Nights. Face dangerous opponents and mysterious encounters, to free the caliph‘s daughter and end the terrible curse of Archmage Borbarad. The total play time is about 30 hours.

This box contains all rules and game materials required for the game, including…

pr.a: Christian Lonsing, Michael Palm, Markus Plötz, Lukas Zach
Christian Lonsing, Michael Palm, Markus Plötz, Lukas Zach
pr.d:
Aventuria: Kelche der Macht ist eine epische, vollständig kooperative Abenteuerkampagne im Aventuria-Universum. In 11 großen Abenteuern mit über 30 Akten und rund 60 Stunden Spielzeit stellt ihr euch einem Wettlauf gegen finstere Mächte um die sieben magischen Kelche.
Wählt aus 12 einzigartigen Helden und Heldinnen, entdeckt neue Pfade, erlebt Entscheidungen mit Folgen und bekämpft eure Widersacher mit maßgeschneiderten Heldendecks voller Ausrüstung, Zauber und Fähigkeiten. Jede besiegte Bedrohung bringt neue Belohnungen: Schatzkarten, Begleiter und neue Fähigkeiten erweitern eure Möglichkeiten – ganz im Stil eines Rollenspiels, aber in Form eines erzählerisch starken Brettspiels.
Über 900 Karten enthalten – kein weiteres Spielmaterial notwendig.

pr.a: Christian Lonsing, Michael Palm, Markus Plötz, Lukas Zach
pr.d:
Aventuria – Meisterin des Schabernacks ist ein Heldenset für die zweite Edition von Aventuria – Das Abenteuerbrettspiel. Es enthält das komplette Heldendeck des Schelmin Xeledonia Zauberfunke sowie ihrem alternativen Alter Ego Stinki Lachsack und bringt damit zwei völlig durchgedrehte, aber taktisch raffinierte Charaktere ins Spiel. Ihr Deck kombiniert listige Zauber, chaotische Effekte und überraschende Manöver, die den Spielfluss aufmischen – perfekt für Spieler:innen, die Humor und unberechenbare Taktiken mögen.
Ergänzt wird das Set durch das Sidequest-Abenteuer „Verschollen in Ras Tabor“, das sowohl solo als auch im Kampagnenkontext gespielt werden kann.
Zum Spielen wird die Aventuria-Kampagnenbox benötigt.

Aventuria – Teamherausforderung: Insel der Mumienfürsten ist eine kooperative Teamherausforderung für bis zu 20 Spieler in der Welt von Aventuria. In diesem epischen Gruppenabenteuer tretet ihr parallel in mehreren Gruppen gegen Horden untoter Gegner an – geführt von mächtigen Anführern.
In 3er- bis 4er-Teams kämpfen die Helden in getrennten Arenen, während ihre Entscheidungen und Kämpfe den gemeinsamen Spielfortschritt beeinflussen. Nur durch clevere Taktik, gutes Timing und Teamkoordination kann der Sieg gegen die Mumienfürsten gelingen. Ob mit 3 Helden oder 20 – dieses vollständig kooperative Abenteuer bringt maximale Dynamik und Spannung an den Spieltisch.
Zum Spielen wird die Aventuria-Kampagnenbox benötigt.

Aventuria – Teamherausforderung: Tsulu ist ein kooperatives Gruppenabenteuer für bis zu 20 Spieler. In dieser voll-kooperativen Erweiterung treten mehrere Heldengruppen parallel gegen eine gewaltige Bedrohung an, die von einem gemeinsamen Gegner geführt wird.
Die Spieler agieren in 3- bis 4-köpfigen Teams, führen ihre Kämpfe gleichzeitig aus und beeinflussen dadurch den Ausgang der Gesamtmission. Koordination, Absprache und strategisches Denken sind gefragt, um Tsulus Rückkehr zu verhindern – bevor sich sein Fluch über ganz Aventurien ausbreitet.
Enthält 55 Karten und das Abenteuerheft „Tsulu“. Auch mit nur 1 Gruppe spielbar, aber für Events mit 8+ Helden empfohlen.
Zum Spielen wird die Aventuria-Kampagnenbox benötigt.

pr.a: Christian Lonsing, Michael Palm, Markus Plötz, Lukas Zach
pr.d:
Aventuria – Tochter des Mantikors ist ein Heldenset für die zweite Edition von Aventuria – Das Abenteuerbrettspiel. Es enthält das komplette Heldendeck der Kor-Geweihten Korianna al’Zuul, inklusive ihres individuellen Erfahrungsschatzes, sowie den alternativen Helden Viktor Ariman Vaulrus. Das Deck kombiniert aggressive Schlagkraft mit göttlich motivierter Kontrolle und bringt frischen Wind für Gruppen, die klare Kanten und direkten Spielstil lieben.
Ergänzt wird das Set durch das Sidequest-Abenteuer „Leute, die nicht spielen“, das sich solo oder eingebettet in Kampagnen spielen lässt.
Zum Spielen wird die Aventuria-Kampagnenbox benötigt.

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Set Collection, Tile Placement, Worker Placement, Others
pr.d:
Axia: Slayer Combo is a tactical card-placement and dice-management game where you take on the role of a Slayer, a legendary hunter tasked with restoring peace to the lands of Axia.
After the fall of the walls of Alakat, fearsome beasts and acolytes of ancient lineages roam freely across unknown regions. Only your strategic skill can stop them.
Over the course of 8 rounds, each Slayer builds a 3x3 territory of cards. On each turn, you will select dice from a shared pool, both physical and magical, to wound or defeat the creatures inhabiting your map.
The core of the game lies in its combo system: defeating certain beasts triggers immediate effects, allowing you to perform additional attacks, gain tactical tools, or chain multiple actions within a single turn.
Your score depends on your…

pr.m: Area Control, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Die Zukunft eures Clans – und der Inka-Zivilisation – liegt in euren Händen.
In Ayar - Die Kinder der Sonne schlüpft ihr in die Rolle eines der ersten Clans, der mit den Ayar durch die Anden zieht. Folgt ihren Lehren und verbessert eure Fähigkeiten in Landwirtschaft, Töpferei, Weberei und beim Binden von Schilf.

Ihr müsst nicht nur euren eigenen Clan voranbringen, sondern auch den Fortschritt der Ayar beeinflussen und das Überleben derjenigen sichern, die eure besten Fähigkeiten belohnen. Versucht durch langfristige Strategien die Gunst von Mama Quilla zu gewinnen und Inti mit taktischem Geschick zufriedenzustellen.

Passt auf, dass ihr euch keinen dieser eifersüchtigen Götter zum Feind macht, denn am Ende des Spiels entscheidet derjenige, der euch am wenigsten mag, über eure…

Azimath is an educational board game that helps children develop mental arithmetic through play.
Players solve additions, subtractions, multiplications and divisions while having fun.
Designed for families, schools and educational activities, the game combines learning, strategy and enjoyment.
The multilingual edition includes French, English and German rules.

Azimut XL is a large-format outdoor orienteering game designed for families, schools, youth groups and sports clubs.
Up to four teams compete using directional cards, movement challenges and strategic decisions to reach the correct destinations.
The game combines physical activity, teamwork and navigation skills in a fun and educational experience.
Rules are available in French, English and German.

Azul Kids adapts the colorful tile-drafting idea of Azul for younger players as they build their own mosaics. Players take tiles of one color, place what fits, and pass unusable leftovers to a neighbor, with the first completed mosaic winning the game.

pr.m: Area Control, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Tile Placement, Others
pr.d:
The Lung Mei, or dragon paths, are lines of energy that cover the Earth. They are derived from the Four Auspicious Beasts: the Azure Dragon of the East, the Vermilion Bird of the South, the White Tiger of the West, and the Black Tortoise of the North. When a path runs in a straight line, that energy builds in power, but these paths can be broken up by barriers such as mountains, which diffuse the energy. Invoke the power of the Four Auspicious Beasts, carefully channel their energy through the Earth, and triumph in this battle for qi and wisdom that will shape your destiny and intertwine it with the Beasts of legend.
In Azure, players position their stones to gather qi (cards) and wisdom (points) from the realm. They also compete to bring the Auspicious Beasts to their aid. The first…

BANGER – Das Musik-Partyspiel bei dem DU zum DJ wirst!
Hier wird nicht geraten – hier wird aufgelegt!
Bei BANGER schlüpft ihr in die Rolle des DJs und sucht den perfekten Song für verrückte, lustige oder knifflige Kategorien. Welcher Song passt am besten? Wer überrascht die Runde mit dem größten BANGER? Und wer trifft genau den Musikgeschmack der Mitspieler?
Jeder spielt seinen Song zur jeweiligen Kategorie direkt über Spotify, YouTube oder einen anderen Musikdienst ab. Anschließend bewertet die Gruppe die Songs und vergibt Punkte. Dabei geht es nicht um Musikwissen, sondern um Kreativität, den richtigen Riecher und jede Menge gute Musik.
Mit drei abwechslungsreichen Spielmodi, unzähligen Kategorien und jeder Menge Diskussionsstoff wird jede Runde zu einem neuen musikalischen Highlight.…

Collect 3 bees and win the game!
Each player starts with 5 cards, and the multicolor bee is placed in the center along with the decks. On your turn, place a card next to the hive without exceeding the value of the central bee. If it matches the color of another card, remove it! Complete the hive without going over and the bee is yours. If you can’t play, the last person who placed a card takes the bee. If you run out of cards, the bee escapes and no one scores. At the end of each round, refill your hand and reveal a new bee. Keep playing until someone collects 3 bees and becomes the champion!

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Ressource Management, Set Collection

pr.t: BIOlink - Gut vernetzt ist halb gefressen
pr.o: BIOLINK - GUT VERNETZT IST HALB GEFRESSEN
pr.d:
Who eats whom – and how well can you connect an entire ecosystem? In BIOlink, you build a food web one card at a time using plants and animals. Choose between two ecosystems: a European woodland edge and the African savanna.
New species are placed horizontally, vertically, or diagonally next to cards already in play. To add a card to the food web, it must have a valid predator-prey relationship with at least one neighbouring species. For every valid connection, you place an arrow pointing from prey to predator. Step by step, individual food chains become increasingly interconnected until they form a complex food web.
BIOlink can be played cooperatively or competitively and combines simple card-laying rules with real ecological relationships. This makes the compact card game equally suited…

pr.k: 428:BLACK TALES - ADVENTURES IN THE MEDITERRANEAN AND CONVERSION KIT
pr.t: BLACK TALES - ADVENTURES IN THE MEDITERRANEAN AND CONVERSION KIT
pr.o: BLACK TALES - ADVENTURES IN THE MEDITERRANEAN AND CONVERSION KIT
pr.a: Andrea Rossi, Atropo Kelevra, Errico Borro, Valentino Sergi, Tellers From The Crypt, Coboldo Channel
pr.d:
Black Tales is an expansion for the Roleplaying Game Odyssey – Black Tales, featuring new Adventures and conversions of the rules included in the core rulebook and in Troy – Black Tales for the world’s most popular game systems: 5e, Old-School Essentials and MÖRK BORG.
New dangers await Ulysses and his Raiders along the path of plunder, across 7 new chapters of the most celebrated journey of Classical Epic in its darkest reinterpretation: The Gaze of Medusa, The Song of the Reef, The Labyrinth of the Minotaur, The Bag of Winds, The Queen of the Harpies, The Pillars of Heracles, and The Worshippers of the Sun.
*BLOOOOOOM* is a very easy but very deep and fun path planning game. Focus and variate in your path to collect the best flowers.

Bloops ist ein lustiges Partykartenspiel für die ganze Familie. Tauche ein ins Spiel und merke dir drei deiner Karten. Fische nach guten Karten und wirf die zurück ins Wasser, die du nicht brauchst... ohne sie zu verwechseln!

Step into a packed stadium during football's golden age — mud, magic, fierce rivalries, and unforgettable players. Move around the board, roll the dice, and unleash bicycle kicks, nutmegs, sombreros, and free kicks. Bend a set piece like a specialist, save a penalty like a legend, and when the moment comes — put it in the back of the goal.
Choose your team and Tactic, play your Gold Cards to outwite and outscore your opponent to win. Easy to learn, impossible to put down.
Published in English and Italian, with digital rulebooks in 5+ languages.
Play Bold. Play Together.

Back to Back is a cooperative party game with simple and addictive rules.
Your goal: guess the mystery word, but that’s not all…
1) Write 5 Clue Words, then shuffle them.
2) Reveal them one by one.
3) Once the Mystery Word is found, your teammates must guess one of your remaining Clue Words.
Did you find the Mystery Word and a Clue Word? That’s a BACK TO BACK!

Backstab Heroes im hinterlistigen Team-Format!
In Backstab Heroes spielst du verdeckt Karten, um mit List und Trickreichtum den anderen Spielern die Schätze vor der Nase wegzuschnappen, während sie die Monster bekämpfen. In Zeit der Drachen lootet es sich nun gemeinsam am besten! Doch wer gehört eigentlich zu deiner Gilde und wen schubst du am besten vor die Monster? Gehe in den Dungeon und finde heraus, wer in diesem semi-kooperativen Kartenspiel Freund oder Feind ist. Denn nur die reichste Gilde gewinnt!
Zeit der Drachen funktioniert als Stand-alone. Für ein besonders hinterlistiges Erlebnis können die Karten aber zusätzlich mit anderen Backstab Heroes-Boxen gemischt werden.

Backstab Heroes – Zeit der Drachen is a treacherous semi-cooperative card game in which players must defeat a sequence of dangerous monsters while trying to claim the richest treasure for themselves. Face-down cards, changing guild allegiances and cursed loot keep alliances uncertain, and the set can be played on its own or combined with other Backstab Heroes titles.

More carrots, more rabbits, more chaos!
Lure new rabbits into your deck with carrots and use their abilities cleverly. But watch out: nasty foxes will thwart your plans and make life difficult for you. The first player to get ten Badass Bunnies into play wins!
An exciting card game with deck-building elements.

pr.a: Marco Castagna, Andrea Di Lorenzo, Marco Marini
pr.m: Action Selection, Push your Luck, Set Collection, Others
pr.d:
Bag Of Bugs is a real-time party game in which players try to collect the best set of colored bugs while trying not to go bust.
While one player draws bugs one at a time from the bag, the others will choose in real time a Grab token, which determines how many bugs they will get at the end of draw.
Try to get as many as you need to create the best bug collection, but don’t overshoot it!

The Battle of Bailén is a two-player historical simulation game that recreates one of the most important battles of the Spanish War of Independence. As part of the prestigious NAC History collection, it offers an accessible, dynamic, and deeply historical experience that will satisfy both new players and veteran military simulation enthusiasts.
Each game reenacts the decisive hours of the clash between Spanish and French forces, allowing players to take command of both armies and face the same strategic and tactical challenges that their historical commanders had to resolve.
Summer of 1808. The French imperial eagles dominate Europe. From the plains of Italy to the battlefields of Prussia and Austria, Napoleon Bonaparte’s armies have defeated the continent’s greatest powers one after…

10th Anniversary of Bandido
Limited Edition
Team up to help Bandido escape Alcatraz! Dig a single escape tunnel, use the right equipment, and manage your cards before they run out. Beware of the tide!

Bank or Bust is a "higher or lower" push your luck card game where players will take turns to draw cards of values 2-99 in an effort to score the most points.
During a players turn they will either bank their cards for points, or draw a card. When they draw a card they must place it in one of the ascending (starting at 1) or descending (starting at 100) rows.
Players bust if they cannot place it in either row.
Players score points:
• By scoring a point for each card they successfully bank

• If they manage to push their luck to a set of 3 cards(5 points), 4 cards (15 points) or 5 cards (50 points) in each row

• If they manage to get the longest run out of all the players on one row (5 points).

Midnight has fallen over Gotham City. Sirens echo through the streets, and shadowy figures vanish among the skyscrapers. In this story-driven, cooperative adventure game, players take on the heroic roles of Batman, Batgirl, Batwoman, and Nightwing. Together, they explore buildings, gather clues, and track down supervillains as the story unfolds piece by piece. The game board is open for exploration and allows players to move freely throughout Gotham City. Coordination is key to taking action in multiple locations simultaneously and stopping the threat. Thanks to a starter adventure, the gripping narrative begins right away. For two to four players ages 10 and up.

Battle Commander intents to recreate historical 18th-19th century battles. It features a fresh framework focused on providing two key aspects: command decision and maximum playability.
In this expansion, you get six more exciting Italian Campaign Battles to replay. Will you lead your troops to victory, or will fate prevail?

BattleTech Aces: Snowblind is the second BattleTech: Aces campaign expansion boxset, intended for use with the Alpha Strike Boxed Set. Snowblind is built around the theme of the Joiners vs. Deniers conflict from Dominions Divided.

When ilKhan Alaric Ward rejected the Rasalhague Dominion's membership to the ilClan, old feuds in the Dominion began to boil over. Thule is no exception. Caught between pirate raids on its BattleMech factory and the increasing political instability of its Ghost Bear garrison, the governor has called for mercenaries to keep the peace—if they can.
Answer that call, build your own force of BattleMechs, and take advantage of powerful pilot Edge Abilities. Command your force solo or cooperatively through the branching story campaign to discover how you'll shape this…

The BattleTech Core Box builds upon the successful “A Game of Armored Combat” boxed set to create a particularly immersive gaming experience. Despite targeted rule adjustments, BattleTech remains recognizable as the game that has captivated players for decades, without being marketed as a new edition.
A highlight is the Sagas Lore Booklet: This new primer opens the door to the BattleTech universe with stunning, newly created illustrations and helps you choose a faction, find your playstyle, and dive deeper into the world.
To get you started right away, the set includes high-quality, ready-to-play miniatures that span more than three decades of BattleTech lore. These include BattleMechs originating from sources such as Technical Readouts, video games, and the ilClan era.

BattleTech is the world's greatest game of armored combat, filled with a myriad of epic stories and gaming experiences to satiate any player: from miniatures to RPG play, hobby painting to fiction, and beyond.
The BattleTech Starter Box is the first step on that fantastic journey and includes everything you need to get started: two high-quality miniatures, quick-start rules, a mapsheet, cards to represent your MechWarrior's unique skills, dice, and more.

pr.k: 869:BEAN TO BAR – DIE WELT FEINSTER SCHOKOLADE
pr.t: Bean to Bar – Die Welt feinster Schokolade
pr.o: BEAN TO BAR – DIE WELT FEINSTER SCHOKOLADE
pr.d:
BEAN to BAR – Die Welt feinster Schokolade
In BEAN to BAR schlüpft ihr in die Rolle eines Chocolatiers und begleitet den gesamten Weg der Schokolade – von der Auswahl bester Kakaobohnen bis zur fertigen Tafel. Baut eure eigene Marke auf, bezieht hochwertigen Kakao, entwickelt Rezepturen und stellt Fachkräfte ein. Bringt eure Kreationen über Märkte, eigene Geschäfte und Wettbewerbe unter die Leute und macht euch einen Namen in der Welt der feinsten Schokolade.
Entwickelt vom japanischen Autor Masaki Suga (bekannt durch Airship City), verbindet BEAN to BAR ein cleveres Aktionsrondell mit einem 3×3-Raster aus Aktionsplättchen. Eure Position auf dem Rondell bestimmt, welche Aktionen euch offenstehen – Bewegung und Aktionen kosten Zeit, sodass ihr genau abwägen müsst, wo ihr Tempo herausnehmt…

Bear Necessities is a competitive tableau‑building game featuring simultaneous drafting with a reserve, in‑game scoring, and honeypots!
During each round, players draft two cards from their starting hand: one to add to their tableau and one to save for the next round, then pass the remaining cards to the player on their left.
The card you add to your tableau must be placed orthogonally adjacent to an already placed card, and it activates immediately, granting you victory points. It also triggers all of its adjacent neighbors, creating powerful combos and cascading effects.
The cards you receive from the other player are combined with the one you saved from the previous round, and you draft again until your hand is empty.
At that point, you replenish your hand and repeat the process until…

Who can resist the sweet scent of honey filling the woods? The bears of Bear Sting are certainly blown away by it and start their search for the liquid gold. The more bees surround them, the closer they get! But beware: Coming too close to the beehive will earn you quite a few stings!

pr.m: Drafting, Modular Board, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Beasts and Diplomacy
In Beasts and Diplomacy, players enter a fantasy world of majestic creatures, intriguing diplomats, and ambitious knights. It is a strategic card game where every decision matters: from choosing the beasts that will join your collection to welcoming diplomats who will have expectations of you, but will bring great prestige to your exhibition. Everything revolves around finding the perfect balance between managing short-term risks with long-term vision, all while maximising your efficiency.
Each game unfolds over three “days”, divided into phases: dawn, morning, noon, afternoon, and evening. These that set the pace of play. Every day you’ll exchange secret quests, send your workers to draft cards, and manage your ore resources to maintain your beasts and fulfill your…

pr.t: Beasts and Diplomacy: Almanac solo expansion
pr.o: BEASTS AND DIPLOMACY: ALMANAC SOLO EXPANSION
pr.m: Drafting, Modular Board, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d: The Almanac is an expansion for Beasts and Diplomacy that greatly enhances the solo experience, by adding rule bending challenges and a captivating story. Immerse yourself in the intriguing world of Aterra's history and learn about the empires, their characters, and the relationships among them over the century that preceded the last Solstice Festival. There are 18 chapters in the Almanac. Each chapter contains a piece of the story's puzzle, followed by a unique challenge with unique rules, which will put your skills to the test. Complete the challenge to unlock more of the story and proceed ever deeper in Aterra's past. Rumour has it that once you complete all 18 chapters there is a final challenge awaiting you. A great evil is about to plunge Aterra into eternal darkness... Will you be…

Are you ready to enter The Bonkers Battle of Wacky challenges ?
Get ready to throw, catch, stack, flip, launch, roll, and jump your way to victory in the craziest party game in the world!
Whether you are playing with family or friends, grab the accessories included in the box and take on the 160 wild challenges in Beat That!
Score as many points as possible by betting on your ability to complete a series of crazy challenges !

Simple and intuitive rules
160 challenges designed to highlight each player’s skills and strengths
The box includes all the accessories needed to complete the challenges

pr.k: 413:BEGINNERS TAROT – LEARN TAROT DIRECTLY FROM THE CARDS
pr.t: Beginners Tarot – Learn Tarot Directly from the Cards
pr.o: BEGINNERS TAROT – LEARN TAROT DIRECTLY FROM THE CARDS
pr.d:
Beginners Tarot is a 78-card learning deck designed to make Tarot easier to understand from the very first reading.
Each card combines traditional Tarot imagery with practical information printed directly around the illustration. Key upright and reversed meanings, keywords, elemental and astrological correspondences, timing indications and simple Yes/No guidance help beginners interpret the cards without constantly referring to a separate book.
The deck is designed for learning Tarot, practising readings and building confidence with card meanings. Clear visual guidance makes it easier to understand how symbolism, keywords and interpretations connect.
It is especially suitable for new Tarot readers, students and anyone who prefers a practical reference system directly on the cards.…

3 neue Welten, 3 neue Puzzle, 3 neue Bilder!
Es geht weiter mit Behind! Auch in der zweiten Box analysiert ihr Plättchen und setzt die einzelnen Teile logisch zusammen. Die drei neuen Puzzles kommen dabei mit spannenden neuen Ansätzen und Ideen daher.
In „Die infernalische Maschine“ versucht ihr eine Höllen-Maschine zusammenzusetzen. Nur um einen Ballon zum Platzen zu bringen?
In „Das Mahl“ hat eine Künstlerin ihr Essen vergessen, fasziniert von der Schönheit der Landschaft. Wie spät es schon ist!
Außerdem war in „Das Schulheft“ ein Grundschüler kreativ. Er hat geschrieben … und gemalt?!
Wenn ihr meint, das jeweilige Puzzlerätsel gelöst zu haben, dreht ihr die Plättchen um, und könnt das Ergebnis auf der Rückseite bewundern.

Beijing is a strategy game in which players aim to maximize the prosperity and prestige of their province. They must call upon diverse courtiers like scholars, monks, warriors, and craftsmen to help them manage their province and withstand various unfortunate events. After twelve rounds, which represent the twelve months of a year, the player who best manages their province and endures these challenging times will earn the most honor and victory points.
The game consists of exactly 12 rounds, symbolizing the 12 months in a year. After the event and any decay, players move their scoring marker forward for each of their streets, each musician, and each spiral on their scrolls. The game ends after the scoring phase of the 12th round.
Additional Victory Points are awarded person tiles, Monks,…

pr.a: Erik Haffner, Cornel Kriszan und Henneke Holst
pr.m: Action Selection, Deck Building, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Believe in me! (please)
You are a god. Unfortunately, nobody knows that yet.
In Believe in me! (please), 2 to 4 self-proclaimed deities compete for the devotion of gullible mortals. Volcanic eruptions, storms and suspiciously aggressive squirrel infestations are, of course, all your divine handiwork. At least that is what your Believers are supposed to think, and Believers are everything in this game: they are your only resource and your victory points at the same time.
Assemble your god from a head, a torso and a pair of legs (729 possible combinations), claim Phenomena as your own miracles, send out Monks, Missionaries and Battle Nuns, and issue Commandments that make life harder for your Fellow gods. A chaotic mix of tableau building, hand management, trick-taking and worker placement…

In Bella Vista, players are architects competing to shape a beautiful town by placing differently sized buildings in valuable neighbourhoods. Choosing where and when to build, fulfilling contracts and respecting city regulations are key to becoming the wealthiest architect.

These ultimate 100 sides dice have special treatment on surface. They are dazzling, high-polished, sparkling like artwork. They are really unique dice.
D100 cube has big size of 45MM face to face, with number 1-100. Every number can be sit very well. The die is well balanced and will randomly give you a number between 1 and 100. It is a great addition to any dice game arsenal.
The dice can be widely used for table RPG dice games, such as Dungeon And Dragon, Pathfinder, World Of Savage, Warhammer, etc. You can also use them for math games and education.

A party game that gets any group fired up and will be remembered for a long time to come!
A fast-paced, simple, and absolutely addictive game that relies on cleverness,
reflexes, and courage... not singing talent!
Go all in or play it safe-the choice is yours. Tap, sing, hum, and guess the most popular songs while laughing your head off with your friends. Once you start, you won’t want to stop!
· Lightning-fast rounds
· Music everyone knows
· A guaranteed dose of laughter
Simple rules, maximum excitement
Once you start, you won’t want to stop!

Erlebt euer eigenes Abenteuer auf dem Martinshof mit Bibi und Tina! In Falkenstein hat es kräftig geschneit und das große Weihnachtswettreiten steht an. Reitet um die Wette und genießt die Winterzeit auf Schloss Falkenstein!
Das Abenteuerspiel für die ganze Familie!

Bibi und Tina sind begeistert: Basteln für sich und die beste Freundin. Machst Du mit? In dieser Box findest Du Materialien und Anregungen für viele tolle Kreativ-Projekte. Ob Bilderrahmen, Anhänger oder geknüpfte Freundschaftsarmbänder: Hier ist Mal- und Bastelspaß garantiert.
Kreativer Bastelspaß für alle Bibi & Tina-Fans
Zum Sofort-Losbasteln
Pferdestark und kinderleicht

Stay focused amidst the chaos, count fast to build the cosmic grid and be the first to get rid of all your solar system cards to win!
• Boost your perception and reaction speed.

• Every newly placed card changes the result of the equations.

• Use the cards with wormholes cleverly to help you finish faster!

The Norse gods outdo one another in a battle for a legendary helmet. Whoever wears the “BigWig” commands space and time. The players eagerly join in this game of deception. Whoever collects the most victory points claims the super artifact!

Bing! Bang! Boom! is a fast simultaneous reaction game in which everyone searches their cards for the character shown in the centre. Players race to fill the BING!, BANG! and BOOM! firework spaces, and the player with the fewest misfires at the end wins.

Bei diesem Logikspiel mit Naturthema willst du alle deine Plättchen genau an die richtige Stelle legen. Dabei helfen dir die Hinweise auf den unterschiedlichen Arten: Bäume möchten immer neben Bäumen liegen, nur so entseht ja schließlich ein Wald. Die Schlange neben der Maus, das Schilf am Wasser und der Habicht neben einem Baum. Auf dich warten viele Level mit unterschiedlichen Schwierigkeitsstufen, die es zu meistern gilt!

pr.m: Action Selection, Dice Rolling, Engine Building, Ressource Management
pr.d:
The world of Biome just got bigger! Gather more friends around the table with the Biome 5-6 Player Expansion. This box contains everything you need to grow your thriving habitats and increase your game from 4 players up to a maximum of 6.
Discover fresh strategies, adorable new components, and exciting new ways to play!
Includes 9 brand-new cards featuring unique actions designed to seamlessly integrate and create powerful new synergies with your original Biome game.

Components:
2 player boards
6 nests
9 Cards
2 deluxe wooden animal meeples (point tokens)
32 wooden player cubes
20 wooden chicks
18 wooden rabbits
36 wooden resources: sun, fish, fruit, leaves, rodents, insects

Dive into the charming world of beavers in this delightful puzzle strategy game for the whole family.
In Bivì, you become part of a beaver community dedicated to constructing the most efficient and stable dam along a serene stream. Surrounded by lush forests, your task is to transform nature's resources into engineering masterpieces.
The game revolves around placing colorful polyomino tiles to optimize space and achieve stability. Each turn introduces new challenges, testing your planning skills and creativity. Rules are easy to grasp, but mastering the strategy will keep you coming back for more.
Highlights:
• Charming and immersive theme: Beavers are brought to life through beautiful art and thematic mechanics.

• Accessible strategy: Simple yet deep gameplay appeals to a wide audience.…

Badcome in the Entremonde!
This rather unique place has become an extremely popular tourist destination! To handle the influx of visitors and stand out from the competition, build unusual mansions by arranging your cards and cleverly designing the rooms. Meet the curious demands of the architect, the decorator, and the mystery guests to ensure your visitors leave positive reviews on Tok Tok Tok and Instacrame. Be careful, as negative reviews will damage your reputation!
• A clever, family-friendly card placement game

• 9 replayable scenarios for varied gameplay

• A somewhat dark but, above all, whimsical and humorous universe

pr.k: 847:BLACK CAT FILES: FALL 01 - UFOS UEBER EASTVIEW
pr.t: Black Cat Files: Fall 01 - UFOs über Eastview
pr.o: BLACK CAT FILES: FALL 01 - UFOS UEBER EASTVIEW
pr.d:
Ein Krimi-Ermittlungsspiel mit paranormalem Twist.
Ein rätselhafter Todesfall.
Ein verschrobener Podcaster mit Obsession für Aliens.
Militär, Kornkreise und eine ganze Kleinstadt am Rande der Panik.
Im ersten Fall der Black Cat Files schlüpfst du in die Rolle von Agenten einer streng geheimen Organisation, die verdeckt ermitteln müssen: Was ist mit Ethan Moore geschehen? Welche Wahrheit verbirgt sich hinter seinen letzten Recherchen?
Dieses packende Mystery-Krimispiel verbindet reale Beweismittel mit digitalen Recherchetools. Kombiniere akribische Detektivarbeit mit unheimlichen Phänomenen, durchleuchtet falsche Fährten und stoßt auf Dinge, die nie für deine Augen bestimmt waren.
Doch Achtung: Nicht alles, was du findest, lässt sich rational erklären.
Kannst du die Schatten durchdringen…

pr.k: 847:BLACK CAT FILES: MINIFALL - SPUK IM GRAND HOTEL ARCADIA
pr.t: Black Cat Files: Minifall - Spuk im Grand Hotel Arcadia
pr.o: BLACK CAT FILES: MINIFALL - SPUK IM GRAND HOTEL ARCADIA
pr.d:
Im verwitterten Grand Hotel Arcadia soll es spuken - haben die Geister den glücklosen Clown Beppo geholt, oder wieso hat er so unvermittelt das Zeitliche gesegnet?
Die Spiritistinnen, die nebenan angeblich mit dem Jenseits kommunizieren, wollen ausgerechnet diesmal nichts gehört haben.
Kannst du den Fall als Agent der streng geheimen Organisation der Black Cats lösen?

In the Caribbean, waves crash under cannon fire: Great Brittonia and the Kingdom of Ibberia battle for dominance of the seas. In disguise, pirates and privateers prepare to strike and seize victory.

A hidden-role game in which you must sink your opponents’ ships, accumulate doubloons, and do everything you can to claim the ultimate treasure. Are you on the side of the Ibberians or the Brittish? Or are you a sneaky pirate, interested only in getting your hands on the precious loot?
Hoist the sails and load the cannons: Rule the seas or go down with honor!

Glücksspiel war gestern – Black Jacky ist das taktische 17 und 4! In diesem nervenaufreibenden Kartenspiel seid ihr ständig auf der Hut. Sammelt Karten, täuscht die anderen und nutzt trickreiche Bonusaktionen, um zu gewinnen. Doch Vorsicht: Jede gesammelte Karte bringt euch näher an die tödliche Schwelle von 21! Wer zu viel sammelt und zu gierig ist, verliert wertvolle Leben! Wer sich allerdings nahe genug heranwagt, kann groß abstauben. Wird Black Jacky auch dich holen?
INHALT
45 Spielkarten, 30 Pappchips, Spielanleitung
Lizenz: White Castle

New Mage and fearsome creatures are exploring the Black Rose Lodge!
Mathemagics is the new expansion for the Black Rose Wars line.
A new Magister enters the Lodge, accompanied by two alternative rooms, a new Forgotten Spell, new Event cards, and alternative Nigredo summons.
And that’s not all… Mathemagics also expands the Constructed mode and competitive play with new rules and new talents designed for the most ambitious Magisters.
Are you ready for the next challenges within the Lodge?
ATTENTION: You need Black Rose Wars, or Black Rose Wars: Rebirth to use this expansion.
Language: Italian and English

MAKE BLANKET, HUMAN.
Weave the pattern quickly to collect a card. Get 3 cards to win.
- Weave the threads of your blanket to match the instruction
- Place a cat on your blanket and wait until there are no more cats.
- The player without a cat loses unless someone got their pattern wrong.

The citizens of London do not know.
Among the lords and ladies they admire, the clergymen who guide their faith, the scholars who pursue knowledge, and the dancers who captivate the crowds, there are those who carry darkness in their veins.
Hidden in the shadows for centuries, the vampire bloodlines are engulfed in a constant secret war to control London.
Tempt mortals into your embrace and welcome them into your bloodline.
Turn their influence into the strength of your family.
In the fog-shrouded nights of London, only the family that gathers the most influence will become the city’s true master.
And the citizens will live on, never realizing the truth.

Prosperous times in the kingdom! Round after round, you all simultaneously play one card from your hand into the shared display. The more cards of a character are in play, the more valuable they become.
However, some played cards significantly influence the layout, and only the two scoring cards you still have in your hand at the end of a round will score points for you. So, do you strengthen a character or steal their victory points? And are all of a character's conditions met for a particularly lucrative scoring opportunity?
Your goal is to score the most victory points overall with your scoring cards over three rounds.

It’s not the best hand that counts here, but the best bluff!
Place secret bids on the cards on display and challenge the others to snatch their points. Only those who play tactically and see through others' bluffs—without getting exposed themselves—can emerge victorious.
A unique card game where tactics meet thrills.

Bo Bo Bon - Der super einfache Einstieg ins Stichspiel. Durch unterschiedlich große Karten wird das Stichspielprinzip intuitiv und einfach erklärt: Versucht so viele Stiche wie möglich zu machen, indem ihr die größte Karte spielt. Doch Vorsicht! Manche Stiche wollt ihr gar nicht haben, wurde zuvor eine Ameise aufgedeckt und ihr bekommt den Stich, dann stibitzt sie sich einfach einen gewonnen Punkt. Bei diesem Stichspiel muss gut überlegt werden, doch eine Prise Glück gehört auch dazu.

Euer Ziel ist es die meisten Sterne zu haben. Vor jeder Runde deckt ihr einen Zucker-Chip auf und schaut, was es diesmal zu gewinnen gibt: Einen Stern, zwei Sterne oder eine fiese Ameise, die euch womöglich einen Zucker-Chip klaut, wenn ihr schon einen habt. Um die Sterne zu gewinnen, sammelt ihr Bonbons.…

Large Board Game Box Bands (9.4 inches)- Pack of 12
Now in stock!
This is a 12-pack of 9.4 inch board game bands, these are ideal for larger sized boxed games the size of Ticket To Ride. We sell these in several other sizes as well (HERE).
We are offering these reasonably priced, resilient and high-quality board game bands. These are NOT made out of rubber which will eventually lose its elasticity and absorb the colors off your boxes and possibly even stick to your boxes over time, these are made of 100% high quality silica gel for a superior band. We offer these in 3 sized and at actual reasonable prices too!

Unforgettable… but can you capture it?
Between concerts, food, the crowds and all the crazy festival moments, your mission is to tame the chaos and snap that one ultimate shot: the perfect group photo of your happy crew.
Boaromia brings the Festival Vibe straight to your tabletop. In this cooperative game you work together to keep your energy up, have fun, and reach the right stage at the right time. Only with meticulous planning, teamwork and a touch of festival magic can you claim victory.
So grab your coins, stick with your friends, and get ready for the most chaotic, fun festival ever!

New Muses have arrived—and some of them have four fur!
Meet Fritz, the mysterious mouse; Constance, the endlessly patient cat; and Tulsi, the wandering dog. These animal companions can become an unexpected part of your creative journey, sometimes helping you along the way and sometimes creating a little chaos.
But hardship is back—and this time, it’s darker.
New cards such as Depression, Paranoia, and Panic Attack bring a harsher side of the artistic life into focus, reminding you that creativity isn’t always about inspiration, recognition, and applause. Sometimes, simply getting through the day is an achievement.
And now, Events change everything!
At the beginning of each round, an Event card is revealed, introducing a new circumstance that affects every player. Whether it’s A Sunny Day…

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Push your Luck, Tile Placement
pr.d:
In Boktor, you and your team of heroes must navigate an ever-changing dungeon, battle monstrous creatures, and defeat the Tyrant before the Vortex devours the world.

With simple, intuitive rules, Boktor delivers epic, fast-paced gameplay where every choice matters. Uncover new tiles, battle fearsome creatures, and create powerful combos with your allies to emerge victorious together.

pr.m: Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Tile Placement
pr.d: Shadows of the Forest expands Boktor with new Monsters, Tiles, and mechanics that transform battlefield dynamics. Guardian Trees introduce vertical movement and additional tactical options, while Amphorae, Relics, and Poison effects add new layers of strategy.

pr.m: Area Control, Modular Board, Tile Placement
pr.d: Bologna combines the elegance of abstract strategy games with the atmosphere of medieval Bologna during the conflict between the Guelfs and the Ghibellines. Players represent competing factions, constructing houses and towers across the city’s districts, enclosing courtyards for influence and competing for dominance over key landmarks. With simple rules, deep tactical decisions, and no randomness, every move matters as you strive to secure your place in the city’s history. The stunning artwork of Mihajlo Dimitrievski (The Mico) brings medieval Bologna vividly to life.

Complete your gaming experience with the Bomb Busters Pro Kit! Enjoy 70 durable acrylic wire tiles that let you experience the base game’s missions in a whole new way. Cardboard wires and cable holders are a thing of the past—simply place the acrylic tiles in front of you! Streamline mission setup using the three cloth bags, perfect for storing and shuffling the wires.
Take on exciting challenges with eleven new missions and put a stop to the Heartless Queen. This expansion introduces brand new Star Wires, each with unique functions depending on the mission. You can also use these two Star Wires in many base game missions to ramp up the difficulty. This Heartless Queen wants a world with no games and no fun. Time to play… and outplay her plans.
This is the German edition of the Pro Kit for Bomb Busters. An English edition is sold separately.

In Bonbon, you are an elite chocolatier on a mission to craft the most exquisite box of bonbons ever seen, but you won't be the only one building it.
The box starts empty, but each turn every chocolatier draws two chocolate pieces and places them in the available spaces on the tray. Each chocolate is either white or dark, and each comes with a unique topping. Finding the perfect flavour combination is your challenge. You'll also need to secretly bid on specific objective cards, visible to all players, hoping to meet requirements such as specific compositions, groupings, toppings or majorities by chocolate type.
When your rivals play, watch closely which chocolate pieces they place and where, that's how you'll figure out their secret bets. But stay alert: you have the chance to ruin their…

The party’s in full swing! All the children have got out their best disguises: dragon, pumpkin, fairies... But who’s really hiding under the costumes?
If you are a Monster: Disguise yourself to avoid being caught by the Seer! Pay attention to which costumes appear in the Seer’s visions each turn to know which costumes not to use.
If you are the Seer: Memorize your visions and try to unmask the Monsters. Accuse the monsters if at least one of them is wearing a costume you’ve seen in your visions to win the game!

Bookshelf is the new game in Alley Cat Games' ever popular tin line.
Players must work together to cooperatively stack books on top of a tower of cards. Cards have instructions on which books to place on top of it, and restrictions of where most of the books need to be placed. Don't be fooled though, placing books one at a time is harder than it initially looks!

Disarm the bomb before it explodes
The bomb is about to go off! Only by working as a team will you be able to crack the codes and disable all its security systems. Put the numbers in the correct order, share your ideas, and think carefully about every move. But be careful: one mistake could jeopardize the entire mission. Will you be able to complete the sequence before you run out of cards?

A limited-comunication, cooperative game by Martin Nedergaard, the author of Bandido.
Rumors are spreading across the land: mysterious treasure chests filled with gemstones have appeared throughout the kingdom! There’s no time to lose, set out in search of these fabulous treasures!

pr.m: Area Movement, Drafting, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Die wahrscheinlich schönste Forschungsreise in die Arktis!
Führe ein wissenschaftliches Expeditionsteam in die unberührten Weiten des Nordens und halte die faszinierendsten Bewohner der Arktis mit deiner Kamera fest. In diesem strategischen Familienspiel kombinierst du geschickte Kartenzüge mit cleverer Planung, um möglichst viele Punkte für deine Forschung zu sammeln.
Spiele Karten aus deiner Hand an einen der drei Bereiche deines Spielplans, um Tiere zu fotografieren und deine Wissenschaftler über das Spielfeld zu bewegen. Dabei gleiten sie nach links oder rechts und eröffnen dir neue Möglichkeiten für den nächsten Zug. Jede Entscheidung will gut überlegt sein, um die besten Fotomotive zur richtigen Zeit zu erreichen.
Zusätzlich versuchst du, Fahrzeugsymbole geschickt…

Five powerful new Bosses from the perilous depths of the jungle lie in wait, ready to surprise you with novel attack strategies. Fortunately, the Jungle Fever expansion also introduces two versatile new Heroes: the cunning Goblin Tinkerer, capable of crafting wild inventions from scrap, and the mysterious Dryad, a shapeshifter and guardian of nature. Like the two new classes—Paladin and Shaman—they can also be used to battle the base game's Bosses, bringing their own unique strengths and abilities to the fight. New items such as the Machete and Torch prove particularly useful in the jungle, and over the course of the campaign, you can earn and utilize 20 new Loot cards.

Jungle Fever is an expansion for Boss Fighters QR that features a new, more challenging campaign. All the new Bosses…

With "Bounce it!" comes our first skill game, guaranteeing excitement, dynamism, and fun without a single dull moment. The score can change with every throw – and every decision brings new twists and turns.
At its core is a simple yet highly engaging game principle: balls are guided into the target to score points. After each successful hit, the crucial question arises: stop and secure the current score, or take the risk and continue playing for higher scores? A miss results in nothing – and gives the other player the very opportunity that was missed. This creates a constant interplay between risk, timing, and tactical considerations.
The difficulty level can be individually adjusted if necessary, thus ensuring a suitable challenge in every round of play.
This party game is for anyone…

Take a deep breath, aim for the hole and… let the balls roll! Every time you make a shot, you’re faced with a decision: Should you secure the point chip and stop, or keep playing for a more valuable chip? It’s not as easy as it sounds. Because if your last ball misses the target, you walk away empty-handed. And that’s not all: The next player in line gets to play for the chip you left behind. Who will be the first to reach 42 points in this exciting and fun game?

Brabbelkrabben von Noris ist das perfekte Sprachspiel für Kinder, Familien und Partyrunden. Wer schafft es, die Zungenbrecher fehlerfrei zu sprechen und dabei mit den beiliegenden Kastagnetten im richtigen Moment zu klappern? Das erfordert Konzentration, Sprachwitz und gutes Timing – denn wer patzt, bekommt ein Klammer-Krönchen. Einfache Regeln, aber große Wirkung: Mit jeder Runde steigt die Spannung und der Spaß. BRABBELKRABBEN ist ideal für Kinder ab 8 Jahren und sorgt in Familienrunden, auf Geburtstagen oder bei Spieleabenden mit Freunden für laute Lacher und schnelle Reaktionen. Sprachförderung und Spielspaß gehen hier Hand in Hand – für eine spielerische Förderung von Konzentration, Rhythmusgefühl und Teamgeist. Ob als Kinderspiel oder als witzige Party-Challenge – Brabbelkrabben…

Spannender Würfelspaß für gesellige Runden!

CRACK THE CLUES AND BE THE FIRST TO GUESS THE SECRET WORD!
Find the correct word before your opponents by carefully analyzing the clues and making logical guesses. Up to 9 Clue cards of different types are used to reveal letters of the word. The type of clue you get depends on the color of the card.
During each round, take notes of the clue on your player board and make guesses by cross-referencing it with the previous ones.
The fewer clues you need to find the correct word, the more points you score, but don’t be too greedy or you might not win anything at all!
You can adapt the difficulty of the game by using a different number of Clue card of each type.

KEY POINTS
• A competitive family word and guessing game

• Be the fastest to analyze the clues and pull your conclusions

• Clues of…

Die angeschrägte Tischplatte lässt den Tisch leichter wirken, betont den schwebenden Charakter und macht ihn noch wohnlicher. Der Spielkomfort bleibt gleich und die Abdeckplatten können weiterhin direkt im Tisch verstaut werden.
Unser ALTAR ist ein Brettspieltisch mit abgesenkter Spielfläche. Durch Abdeckplatten leicht in einen Alltagstisch umzuwandeln. Die Unterkonstruktion dient als integrierter Stauraum für Ablagen.
Vielseitige Aufbau- und Verwendungsmöglichkeiten. Mehr Beinfreiheit dank Säulenfuß. Holzwerkstoff Buche sorgt für eine besonders hohe Härte und Langlebigkeit. Oberfläche ist entweder stumpfmatt (nicht glänzend) lackiert, was dem Möbelstück sowohl optisch als auch haptisch einen natürlichen Holzeffekt verleiht. Alternativ lackieren wir die Oberfläche in seidenmatt (leicht…

Brettspieltisch mit vertiefter Spielfläche und integriertem 43 Zoll Touchscreen Display.
Besonders für Pen & Paper und Roleplay bietet das Display vielseitige Möglichkeiten für digitale Karten, Spielpläne und weitere Inhalte. Der Bildschirm kann einfach per Plug-and-Play mit dem Laptop oder Tablet verbunden werden. Dadurch kann man plattformunabhängig das bevorzugte Virtual-Tabletop-System nutzen.

Durch die Abdeckplatten lässt sich der Tisch leicht in einen Alltagstisch umwandeln. Die Abdeckplatten können trotz des Bildschirms direkt unter dem Tisch verstaut werden.

Der MAXIM Vision ist in Asteiche oder mit Farbupgrade erhältlich.
Auf Wunsch sind auch Displays bis 65 Zoll möglich.

pr.k: 228:BRING YOUR OWN BOOK – BOOKLOVE EDITION. DAS SPIEL IN DEM DEIN BUCH DIE HAUPTROLLE SPIELT!
pr.t: Bring your own Book – Booklove Edition. Das Spiel in dem dein Buch die Hauptrolle spielt!
pr.o: BRING YOUR OWN BOOK – BOOKLOVE EDITION. DAS SPIEL IN DEM DEIN BUCH DIE HAUPTROLLE SPIELT!
pr.d:
Das interaktive Partyspiel für Booklover – Hier spielt dein Lieblingsbuch die Hauptrolle!
„Bring your own Book” – Der Name ist Programm! Bring dein aktuelles Lieblingsbuch mit zum nächsten Spieleabend und entdecke das innovative Partyspiel, das Buchliebhaber:innen und kreative Köpfe gleichermaßen begeistert. In jeder Runde wird eine Situation vorgelesen, und die Spieler müssen die passendste Stelle aus ihrem Lieblingsbuch auswählen und vorlesen. Die humorvollen und unerwarteten Kombinationen sorgen für Lacher und spannende Diskussionen. Ideal für Spieleabende, Literaturkreise oder als Geschenk für Leseratten. Findet gemeinsam heraus, welches das beste Buch für jede Lebenslage ist!
Inhalt:
• 100 Karten

• 6 Lesezeichen

• 1 Anleitung

Spielprinzip:
Wer an der Reihe ist, zieht eine Karte…

You and up to 49 of your closest friends are going on a quest... a BRUMBLE QUEST!
1. Lay out quests!
2. Count to 3 then point at the quest you want!
3. Revel in glory or cry to your mama!
Brumble is a new line of games from Plaid Hat Games featuring minimalist design aimed at maximum fun. Brumble games are available exclusively during major game conventions.

DISCOVER THE FOREST!
Get points by observing wildlife and collecting berries and mushrooms. Get the most points to win.
- Choose the route for your hike by moving your meeple.
- Go for the most enjoyable hike by choosing the most abundant path.
- Laid back gameplay with nature theme.

To fulfill a wish, a Mortal makes a plea to the Magician. This time, the price is three silver coins — what will it be next?
In "Bubble and Shadow", players take turns acting as the Magician, forging pacts with each other, and engaging in transactions centered around varying prices.
The Magician offers to use 3 Silver Coins to buy 2 of your Wishes. Will you accept it or counteroffer to pay 3 Silver Coins for 2 of your Wishes?
But, do you have enough money?

Fins up! Get your scaly friends right in front of the laughing Buddha—before the others do or before he wanders off to another shore. Only those who trade smartly and keep a close eye on their fish will win. Can you line up your fish the fastest?
Alles ist besser mit Bingo!
Alles ist besser mit Bingo!
Alles ist besser mit Bingo!
Alles ist besser mit Bingo!

Count to 100? Easy-peasy, bunny-squeezy!

In Bunny 100, you and your friends will count numbers one by one… but of course, there’s a catch! You’ll need to follow crazy rules while counting. Whether it’s doing a squat, clucking like a chicken, or pinching your cheeks, counting to 100 has never been this fun!

• Shuffle the decks and place them in the center of the table.

• Count to 100 while following the card rules.

• Be careful—one wrong move and you’ll collect Poop tokens!

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Drafting, Ressource Management, Tile Placement, Worker Placement
pr.d:
ONLY ONE BUNNY CAN RULE THE BURROW!
Become the leader of one of the two most powerful families of the royal court, as you compete to build this new city and nurture it to greatness! In doing so, you will be awarded prestigious Golden Carrots, a sure way to outclass your eternal rival!
Purchase the buildings that best suit your strategy and place them in the best locations to grow your districts and earn more and more Golden Carrots.
Unless, of course, you choose the exact location your opponent had their eye on, thwarting all their expansion plans!
Finally, the inhabitants will send you their requests, which will guide you in your construction choices and can bring in a lot of a lot of extra Golden Carrots!
A high replayability awaits you, as not all buildings will be available and you…

In BurgerDraft, a Draft & Flip game, you take on the role of creative chefs designing the next signature burger for your restaurant's menu. Combine juicy patties, crisp vegetables, flavorful sauces, and many other ingredients to create unique burgers. Collect scoring cards that reflect the preferences of your taste testers and meet their requirements to earn as many victory points as possible.
Whoever creates the most irresistible burger wins the game!

pr.m: Action Selection, Push your Luck, Set Collection
pr.d:
Excavate forgotten relics, test your luck, and uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins of time! In Buried Memories, players become bold explorers searching the layered remains of long-lost civilizations. Dig through the excavation site, recover precious artifacts, piece together ancient statues, and decide exactly how far you're willing to push your luck before hidden creatures force your expedition to a halt.
Risk & Reward: How to Play
Fortune favors the brave, but caution keeps you alive. On your turn, you command the dig:
• The Excavation: Reveal as many accessible tiles from the dig site as you dare. Each uncovered artifact brings you closer to victory points.

• The Creature Threat: Don't get greedy! Collecting two matching creature tiles triggers an immediate bust, ending your…

“Revenge is sweet” is the motto of the new, fiery card game “Burning Cookies” from Piatnik. Players who skilfully use their hand cards and lure their opponents into traps with well-thought-out bluffs have a good chance of winning. However, special actions can quickly turn the tide and result in heaps of burnt cookies—which, of course, nobody wants. This keeps the cheerfully illustrated pocket game exciting right up to the end, delivering plenty of gleeful “take that” moments for 3–6 players ages 8 and up.
A little luck, good tactics, and the perfect poker face are crucial in this entertaining competition centred on burnt cookies—which you’ll want to pass off to the others as much as possible. As is typical for pocket games, “Burning Cookies” features simple gameplay. On your turn, you…

pr.m: Push your Luck, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d:
WHATS IT ABOUT?
You have come together to rob the museum. The alarm has sounded. Disguised as musicians you must race across town to the getaway van. If you run out of money you can always stop and busk to collect more cash. You are robbers, not friends, so the first to arrive leaves on their own and the others go to jail.
WHY IS THIS DIFFERENT AND FUN?
It's very simple but makes for good banter and "I told you so" moments. It has gorgeous little German playing pieces and charming 1960s style artwork by Andrew Higgins. Each turn you try to move and the other players have to collectively guess where you are going to try and stop you. The game is so simple the rules are printed on the back of the board

pr.a: Nikki Valens, Joe Klipfel, Isaac Childres
pr.d:
Buttons & Bugs is back with two all-new micro mercenaries and new cross-compatible campaign!
• Includes 2 all-new mercenaries with a micro miniature, character cards, 10 double-sided ability cards, and more

• 17 scenario cards with mini battle maps & 6 double-sided monster stat cards featuring 12 distinct foes

• 36 condition tokens, new dice, additional cubes, and more

pr.m: Push your Luck, Set Collection, Tile Placement
pr.d:
Book your Bug & Breakfast!
The autumn forest is abuzz with anticipation — a brand new inn is being built… exclusively for BUGS! Bouncing grasshoppers, merry ladybugs, busy bees, and even daydreaming spiders are already gathering in the clearing, waiting for the grand opening.
Buzz Inn is a charming tile-placement puzzle for 2–4 players. Search beneath the leaves for comfy straw pillows and colorful bugs, then build your inn tile by tile. Arrange your rooms carefully — every bug has its own shape and needs enough free pillows to settle in comfortably.
Decide whether to keep the tile you reveal or risk searching for a better one, accommodate as many bugs as possible, and earn decorative roofs by welcoming the right guests. Add Awards and Special Effects for extra challenges once you're…

Watch, flip, rotate… and race to complete the pattern before anyone else!
In Buzzle, all players compete to be the first to recreate the insect pattern shown on the central card. Sounds easy? Think again. You'll need to position your insects correctly, matching their orientation, sometimes flipping or rotating them—and even challenging your instincts with special rules and surprise effects.
When you think you’ve got it right, slap your hand on the central card and prove it! If you’re correct, you earn the card as a point and move one step closer to victory. If you’re wrong, you’ll have to wait while the others keep playing.
Some pattern cards hide tricky visual challenges or extra twists, so stay sharp, keep your eyes focused, and be the first to complete three patterns to win the game.

pr.a: Gautier de Cottreau, Eric A. Martin, Anthony Martin
pr.d:
Wer schnappt sich als erstes die Karte zum Sieg!
Sei der Erste, der eine Zahlenfolge von 1-8 bildet oder alle 4 Honigkarten erbeutet. Drehe klug, riskiere mutig und sichere dir die süßeste Beute!
Ein Memoryspiel für die ganze Familie für 2 bis 5 Spieler*innen ab 8 Jahren.

pr.m: Action Selection, Set Collection, Trick taking
pr.d: A strange storm is brewing, and animals start falling from the sky. You play a kid trying to catch them, in a clever mix of trick-taking, programming and set collection. Before each round you program your cards to anticipate the tricks to come, but the weather has other plans. Catch as many FAFROTSKIES as you can, and remember: winning too often puts you in danger and might cost you the game. Cheeky, tactical and full of twists, by two acclaimed Japanese designers.

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Drafting, Modular Board, Trade
pr.d:
Republic of Rome on a Tiny Epic scale with the diplomatic bite of Queen's Dilemma
You are the head of a Senatorial Family in the Roman Republic using daggers & diplomacy to claw your way to the top and become the most prestigious family in Rome.
Play Actions to add Busts to your Familia, appoint them as Governors to Provinces you have conquered or stolen in an Election. Tax your Provinces for extra Legions, Governor Busts or Prestige. But be careful that those behind you don’t stab you in the back!
At its heart, this is a game about dealmaking. Almost everything in this game is legitimate currency. So you are encouraged to do deals as much and as imaginatively as you can - just don’t be surprised to find a dagger in your back if you break your word too often.

Play any song you like. Listen. When you hear a word being sung, grab the card. Most cards wins.
That is the whole rule, so strangers can start playing thirty seconds after sitting down, and every song makes a new game. Six Moment cards score on things you hear rather than words, such as a handclap or a solo, so players who do not catch every lyric still compete on equal footing. Ten Mixtape cards add variants that turn the speed contest into a game of endurance.
CARU-UTA has been played in Japan since 2016. This is its first English edition, newly authored for English rather than translated. Bring your own playlist and try it at the stand.

Quick to learn, quick to play: The popular CATAN experience as a card game in a compact format. With 120 richly illustrated cards, the familiar CATAN gameplay comes to life: Roads are built, settlements grow into towns, which in turn can be expanded into metropolises, and the skillful trading of resources determines success. But watch out for the cunning robbers: If you want to protect your resources wisely, build up a strong force of knights. The card game’s gameplay comes very close to that of CATAN – The Game and offers entertaining, exciting rounds for three to four players ages ten and up.

Which player will manage to link together the most tomatoes by hand? First you need to safely cross the game board. For your move choose a tomato that can link up with another tomato on the opposite side of the board.
Remember! Only one tomato may stand in a single square. You may stop only on yellow squares. If you cannot move or link up you skip your turn.
· Encourages making basic tactical decisions
· Perception of 3D space

Contents:
20 tomatoes
1 double-sided board
1 dice
Rules

Sengoku era Japan, and you are a cat carpenter with ambitions. Win tricks, then slide the cards you captured under your castle board. Each wing takes one colour and one colour only, up to a strict limit: hit it exactly and you score big, go over it and your castle costs you points. Anticipate the colours, read your opponents, and build the finest castle in the land.
Preorder link : https://forms.gle/g7DHtFhCUp4B1j789
Chopstick Tightrope is a new dexterity game with meeples, a silicon tightrope and a lot of fun. Launching fully in 2027, we have a special supply made early for Essen only on our booth

pr.a: Inka & Markus Brand + Kaddy Arendt & Dirk A. Dudek
pr.d:
CODEWORDS – Knackt den Code vor dem anderen Team!
Köpfe zusammenstecken, um die Ecke denken und vor allem schneller sein als das gegnerische Team! Bei CODEWORDS treten zwei Teams gleichzeitig gegeneinander an und versuchen, die geheimen Codes zu entschlüsseln.
In jeder Runde warten drei unterschiedlich codierte Begriffe oder Sätze auf euch. Findet heraus, welche Codierungen sich dahinter verbergen, bringt die drei Codes in die richtige Reihenfolge und schnappt euch die Karte, bevor das andere Team seinen Code knackt!
Doch Geschwindigkeit allein reicht nicht: Liegt euer Code falsch, geht der Punkt direkt an das gegnerische Team. Wer zusätzlich alle drei verschlüsselten Begriffe richtig löst, kann sich sogar einen Extrapunkt sichern.
Mal fehlen sämtliche Vokale, mal versteckt sich die…

A game of quick thinking, maths and reflexes.
Observe, work it out and answer before the others do. Each round is a race to find the correct answer.
Colour, speed and fun for the whole family.

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Dice Placement
pr.d:
Compete for glory in the ultimate crab claw-down. Seize control of arenas, forge alliances, backstab combatants, and unleash your rage to win.

Every year, millions of salivating crustaceans from all over the world tune in for the wildest showdown on the planet! Five of the most legendary CRAB RAGE! teams will compete for the ultimate crown of decapod glory: THE GOLDEN CLAW.

CRAB RAGE! is a quick, cut-throat, zany area control game. Use your pent-up rage to perform devastating actions and execute stylish signature moves. Build, break, and leverage alliances in a fierce tug-of-war for control. Keep the action fresh and the crowd hyped to become the most adored crab crew this side of the archipelago.

Snip snap. It's rage time!

Players: 3-5
Ages: 14+
Playing time: 30-45 minutes
Contents:…

Café Barista: To-Go turns the café theme into a fast real-time card game in which players race to find ingredients and complete drink orders accurately. Memory and quick decisions matter as orders pile up, with variants for different difficulty levels and solo play.

pr.a: Antón Vega y Jose Carlos Carmona
pr.d:
Run out of cards by remembering how much you fed each animal… and how much it pooped.

CAGONES is a game where you'll repeatedly question whether what you remember with absolute clarity is true or not, and you just hope no one challenges you so you can finally find out. Your goal is to get rid of all your cards, and to do so, you'll have to feed a polar bear and a rabbit and remember how much they've eaten… and pooped.

Each turn, you can play a certain number of fish cards onto the polar bear. You can make it poop those fish or challenge someone to guess how many fish it's eaten, but be careful, because if that person has a challenge card, they can challenge you back. When the polar bear goes to sleep, you'll have to turn over all the cards in your hand to feed the rabbit, which has a…

pr.d:
ll this constant waving about with his arms and hands is getting on everyone’s nerves. On top of that, Cal goes on and on, extolling the virtues of the pirate life here on Leonera. Phew. No wonder everyone’s thoroughly annoyed. Especially the opponents, who feel distracted and provoked.
Cal C. Calman is a Mercenary . He will only fight for Debonn, the Goblins, the Cult, or Tianyu. Cal also is a Specialist for the Pirates.
