pr.d:
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Earthborne Rangers: Augenblicke erweitert den Pfadkartenstapel um 32 einzigartige Karten des neuen Typs „Augenblicke“. Die Karten bringen kleine, atmosphärische Ereignisse zwischen die größeren Abenteuer. Wird eine Augenblick-Karte gezogen, wird der kurze narrative Text gelesen, der Effekt sofort ausgeführt und die Karte abgelegt. Einige Ereignisse verlangen gemeinsame Entscheidungen und Proben, die Anzahl der beigemischten Karten skaliert mit der Spielerzahl.

pr.t: Earthborne Rangers: Das Vermächtnis der Ahnen
pr.o: EARTHBORNE RANGERS: DAS VERMAECHTNIS DER AHNEN
pr.a: Adam Sadler, Andrew Fischer, Andrew Navaro, Brady Sadler, Brooks Flugaur-Leavitt, Davi Paulino, Luke Eddy
pr.m: Area Movement, Deck Building, Dungeon Crawler, Ressource Management
pr.d:
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Das Vermächtnis der Ahnen ist eine Kampagnen-Erweiterung für Earthborne Rangers und führt die Geschichte in eine unterirdische Welt. Eine neue Karte der Arkologie ersetzt die reguläre Tal-Karte und teilt die Unterwelt in mehrere Tiefenabschnitte. Mechanische Hindernisse wie Überflutungen und Überwucherungen versperren Wege, die Dunkelheit wird zum Gegenspieler und Licht eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten. Neue Pfad-, Orts-, Belohnungs-, Wetter- und Missionskarten erweitern die Kampagne. Die Erweiterung kann an die bestehende Geschichte angeschlossen oder als neue Kampagne begonnen werden.

pr.t: Earthborne Rangers: Die Hüter des Tals
pr.o: EARTHBORNE RANGERS: DIE HUETER DES TALS
pr.d:
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Earthborne Rangers: Die Hüter des Tals ist eine reine Ranger-Erweiterung, die die persönliche Entwicklung und den Deckbau vertieft. Sie erweitert die Kartenpools der Vorgeschichten und Expertisen und führt neue Spielweisen ein. Eine neue Vorgeschichte und eine neue Expertise verändern, wie Ranger das Tal wahrnehmen und mit ihm interagieren. Persönliche Ziele funktionieren wie kleine Nebenquests mit narrativen Einträgen und eigenen Belohnungen. Neue Aspekte erlauben außerdem, Werte über die bisherige Grenze hinaus zu steigern.

pr.a: Thomas Favreliere, Alex Fortneau, Simon Moulard
pr.d:
Easy: On your turn, place a card on one of the two piles.
Smart: Play multiple bonus actions right in a row!
Mean: Slow down your opponents by changing the color or direction of the cards!
Here’s how it works: Get rid of all your cards and end the round when you think you have the fewest points... But be careful—you don’t know the value of some cards!
Will you take a risk or play it safe?

1943. Europa brennt.
Ihr seid eine Elite-Einheit von Vampir:innen.
Eure Mission: Adolf Hitler in Paris finden, austrinken und damit die Nazi-Kriegsmaschine aufhalten.

Ein schnelles, leicht zu lernendes und brutales Rollenspiel, in dem man sich als Vampire in einer alternierenden Vergangenheit durch das Paris des zweiten Weltkrieges metzelt, Nazis besiegt und letztendlich den Krieg beendet.

Ecogon - Kryptogam

Moose bedecken den Boden, bunte Pilze sprießen empor, und die Äste der Bäume sind dicht mit Flechten bewachsen. Erweitert euer Ökosystem um die faszinierende Welt der Kryptogamen!

Am Stand erhaltet ihr auch beim Kauf von Kryptogam eine Box für ALLE Erweiterungen (nur so lange der Vorrat reicht!)

Folgende Arten sind in der Erweiterung Ecogon – Kryptogam enthalten: Rothirsch, Schwarzspecht, Auerhahn, Braunkehlchen, Gottesanbeterin, Schmetterlingshafte, Schachbrettfalter, Warzenbeißer, Grüne Stinkwanze, Rosenblattlaus, Elsbeere, Blaubeere, Frauenschuh, Bergahorn, Aronstab und Fichte. Das Modul enthält: Dunkelvioletter Schleierling, Kirschroter Speitäubling, Riesenschirmpilz, Eichenrotkappe, Papageigrüner Saftling, Grünstängelmoos, Trompetenflechte und Blasenflechte.…

There? How!?
Eggsposed is a game full of conversation and deduction, where players try to hide their identities and scheme to keep their own eggs in the nest! Night Birds try to sneak their own eggs into someone else's nest. Bright Birds try to prevent that and remove suspicious eggs from their nest. But wait, before you know it, the Night Bird eggs have returned. Who can you believe? Find your fellow birds and make it through this battle for survival!

Das Partyspiel Einfach Ehrenlos von Exploding Kittens ist ein Teamspiel, bei dem ihr verrückte Aufgaben wie diese bekommt: Nehmt ein Foto von eurem Team in verschiedenen Yogastellungen auf.Stellt euch der Größe nach in einer Reihe auf.Der Boden ist Lava, haltet euch an den Händen und klettert irgendwo hoch.
Kinderleicht, oder? Aber! Ihr wisst nicht, wer in eurem Team ist, bis ihr eure Teamkarten aufdeckt. Schnell – findet euer Team und erfüllt die Aufgabe, bevor es die anderen tun, um zu gewinnen! Einfach Ehrenlos ist das lauteste und ehrenloseste Spiel aller Zeiten – denn die Teams ändern sich jede Runde …

pr.m: Area Movement, Pick-up and Deliver, Tile Placement
pr.d:
After eons of tranquility, the mighty volcano stirs from its long, peaceful slumber. Now, it must release pent-up energy as it has so often in the past; by expelling ash and lava. Thus, the natural cycle begins anew.
Unfortunately for the human settlements that have thrived in harmony with their dormant neighbor, this balance is about to be disrupted. A safe new home is needed, but fortunately, their brave explorers have just returned from a long journey, having discovered a fertile new island.
Now, the leaders of the settlements must set aside their differences and unite their efforts to safely evacuate their people, animals, and resources to the new lands before the volcano reclaims its dominance and enriches the soil with its fertile ash.
The challenge is to see whether the humans can…

pr.a: Rafael Campos, José E. Molina, Paloma Pérez
pr.d:
In the mythical realm of Elemental Dragons, players embark on a journey to harness the powers of the four elemental suits: earth, water, fire, and air. The goal? To amass a hoard of precious dragon gems, the coveted currency of this world. But beware, for amidst the riches lie hidden dangers in the form of dragon eggs, which bring negative scores to those unfortunate enough to acquire them.
In Elemental Dragons, players engage in a battle of wits, employing elemental powers to outmaneuver their opponents. Each round, players compete to win tricks by playing cards of higher value and utilizing the unique abilities of the powerful dragon cards.
At the outset, a dominant suit is randomly determined. Then, the first player to play a card sets the lesser dominant suit if their played card does…

You take on the role of a new student at Monster Elementary during their first day. It's lunch time and you're trying to encourage other students to sit at your table. From designer Manny Vega and artist Sandara, the game is a tableau builder with a Liar's Dice variant built in, because what better way to make friends in Elementary School than gambling? You'll use your dice to pay for Snax matching what your new friend's are in search of and place them at one of the seats at your table. Once a player has filled their tableau of 8 the end game is triggered and after everyone else has been able to spend the rest of their resources, players tally up their scores.

pr.m: Deck Building, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d:
As a magic engineer, you will construct Mana Forges that generate magical power from various elements
and supply that power to Elementica.
Hire workers, acquire rights, build bases, advance your research, and make full use of your plans
to increase your magical power output.
The method of producing magical power varies depending on the Mana Forges you choose, and at times,
Artifacts—ancient technologies—will also play an important role.
This is a game where you can enjoy competition with other players and the shifting balance of power.
Includes solo rules. Language-independent.

In einer parallelen Welt sind die chemischen Elemente als Monster lebendig geworden. Sie kämpfen gegeneinander oder bilden Allianzen. Nur ein Meister der Elemente kann sie bezwingen.
Das Spiel enthält insgesamt 3 verschiedene Spielvarianten: ein schneller Wettkampf (geeignet für größere Gruppen), ein strategisches Stichspiel und ein cleveres Sammelspiel.
Das Besondere: Alle Werte auf den Karten basieren auf wissenschaftlichen Fakten. Die Fähigkeiten der Monster spiegeln reale Eigenschaften der Elemente wider. So lernt man beim Spielen ganz nebenbei wichtige Grundlagen der Chemie.
Die zugehörige kostenlose App erweitert das Kartenspiel um eine Augmented Reality Funktion: Die Monster auf den Karten werden lebendig und fangen an sich zu bewegen. Zu jedem Element können weitere interessante…
Sei der mutigste Emberling.

pr.k: 368:EMERLAND – EIN SPIEL IN DER WELT VON EVERDELL
pr.t: Emerland – Ein Spiel in der Welt von Everdell
pr.o: EMERLAND – EIN SPIEL IN DER WELT VON EVERDELL
pr.a: James A. Wilson, Clarissa A. Wilson
pr.m: Drafting, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d: This is the German edition of Everdell: Emerland, originally published by Tycoon Games.

Take on the role of Ivy, the courageous new owner of a magical inn. Build your bewitching B&B to best suit your eccentric guests while cultivating the ivy covering your walls.
Each turn, carefully place each card in a grid. Assign guests, noting their preferences (things like "diagonally adjacent", "same row", "surrounded" etc.) to score them at the end of the game.
In Story Mode, earn rewards for meeting point goals and completing unique challenges.

pr.a: Antoine Bauza, Corentin Lebrat, Théo Rivière
pr.d:
A very special Encyclopedia!
Hello Globetrotters! In this cooperative memory game, you will travel around the world in search of the monsters, spirits, and legendary creatures that inhabit it.
The Encyclopedia of Monsters comes in 5 colourful Volumes - like a real encyclopedia - that represent the 5 Continents. Each Volume contains all the necessary components to visit that Continent’s 3 Countries. Each Country offers you new ways to play, with its own rules, challenges, and monsters.
Find all the Monsters! On your turn, play a Monster card and use its Special Rule to try to find the corresponding token. If you successfully find that Monster, it stays visible; otherwise, a Candle is blown out, all the Monsters flip face-down again... and you start over, and try to remember where each one…

As a science journalist hosting a symposium on the chambered nautilus, you're counting on a renowned expert to close the show. When they mysteriously fail to appear, you must balance running the event with searching the aquarium. Can you find the missing expert and save the symposium before time runs out?
Endangered Rescue: Chambered Nautilus is an 18Escape adventure created in partnership with Science Friday to support Cephalopod Week. Every game purchased supports independent science journalism. Stay connected to the awe and joy of science all year with Science Friday's flagship newsletter Week in Science.
This entry in the series takes about an hour to solve, and is rated 2 out of 3 in difficulty.

pr.a: Martin Biesheuvel, Joe Hopkins, Joshua Sprung
pr.d:
The environment is at a tipping point. Australia’s wildlife habitats face devastation, but with your leadership, their future can be rewritten. It's time for you to take action and restore balance before it’s too late!
Step into the most ambitious Endangered expansion yet, packed with Bold new characters, Immersive new scenarios, Groundbreaking mechanics, Strategy deeper than ever before. Every scenario is a battle for survival. Each one more intricate, more demanding, more thrilling than the last.
Endangered: Australia includes:
• The Great Barrier Reef – Defend one of the world’s natural wonders! Guard predator-prey chains, restore coral health, and protect an ecosystem in constant flux.

• The Giant Barred Frog – For the first time, you must remove animals to heal the balance. Stop…

pr.p: Burnt Island Games, Grand Gamers Guild
pr.m: Action Selection, Engine Building, Modular Board, Worker Placement
pr.d: In Endeavor: Deep Sea, players explore the vast depths of the ocean, hiring dedicated workers and completing objectives in an effort to chart the environment and help protect it. The Endeavor: Deep Sea Uncharted Waters expansion will push players to the edge with challenging new missions, undiscovered depths to explore, and a whole new team of specialists looking to join your crew and make an impact on the world. Players will also get to incorporate new mini-expansions tasking them with saving endangered aquatic wildlife, exploring deeper depths than ever possible, and restoring the fragile balance of the marine ecosystem.

Nachdem das Grundspiel dich bereit die Vielfalt des Meeres entdecken ließ, entflammt Am Meeresgrund deinen Entdeckerdrang auf’s Neue: Von den wimmelnden Untiefen bis in die Tiefe des Meeresgrund warten neue Spielinhalte auf dich.
Am Meeresgrund fügt dem Grundspiel Endeavor: Die Tiefsee mehr Inhalte hinzu, die deine Partien noch abwechslungsreicher machen.
Neue Szenarien
Das szenario-basierte Spielerlebnis wird durch weitere immersive und kreative Herausforderungen bereichert.
Neue Ozeankacheln
Der schönste Moment des Spiels wird noch schöner: Entdecke neue Meereszonen!
Neue Forschungsberichte
Wo es viel zu entdecken gibt, gibt es auch viele…

A streamlined trick-taking game played with numbered cards. Read your opponents and choose the perfect moment to strike. Even a low play can become a clever strategy. Use your cards wisely and claim victory!

Inside the Box : 72 cards (56 x 87 mm)

pr.a: Simone Luciani, Nestore Mangone, Tommaso Battista
pr.m: Action Selection, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:

Entropy ist ein anspruchsvolles Kennerspiel von Simone Luciani, Nestore Mangone und Tommaso Battista für 1 bis 4 Personen ab 10 Jahren. In einer hochmodernen Simulation versucht ihr, das perfekte Sonnensystem zu erschaffen und Planeten mit Leben zu füllen. Im Mittelpunkt steht eine Rondell-Aktionswahl. Über Karten und Aktionen entstehen Sterne, Planeten und weitere Himmelskörper, zugleich entwickelt ihr eine eigene Engine und optimiert eure Ressourcen. Das Spiel verbindet ein variables Weltraum-Thema mit einem verzahnten Eurogame-System und bietet auch einen Solomodus.

In the enchanted arena of Edera, champions battle for glory and loot. Choose your identity, play your cards wisely, and become a legend!
Epic Melee is an explosive card game where players throw their champions into a boiling arena to seize coveted loot in a merciless melee. Its key mechanic? You choose two cards… but only one will remain in play when the torch reaches you. Bluffing, strategy, and dirty tricks shape every confrontation. Get ready: here, only the most cunning will triumph.

In Era of Atlantis, you are a secret society seeking to expand the powerful nations you control during the mythical antediluvian age, 12000 years ago. You have two of these under your control and share each one with a rival. You also have a secondary goal trying to bring “light” or “darkness” to the world. Working with and against your rivals you must prove to be the most powerful secret society in the world before the Era of Atlantis ends either in glory or in cataclysm.
This is an area-control and worker placement game with a unique twist. You control two nations with the lower-valued one counting for your score at game end. This means you will usually try to balance the two. You also share control of each one with another player, who has the same interest in the success of that nation…

pr.m: Action Selection, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board
pr.d:
Deep beneath the mountain, the ancient dungeon stirs, and its silken webs sense every sound. Escape from the Silken Web is a cooperative game where success relies on teamwork and unspoken trust among Tang Sanzang and his disciples. With escalating dungeon levels, combine characters’ unique skills and your own equipment to pass wisely. Meanwhile, collect as many relics as possible for endgame reputation. Work together to get out now, or you die trying!
• Dynamic Difficulty

• Silent Tactical Co-op

• 5 Unique Characters

pr.t: Escape the Zone: A Backrooms Map
pr.o: ESCAPE THE ZONE: A BACKROOMS MAP
pr.d:
This is an immersive escape game inspired by the Internet creepypasta “The Backrooms”, combining a strong narrative element with ingenious puzzle-solving.
As the main feature, you will unfold a massive map of the creepy, labyrinthine location you must escape from, but you will also have access to other objects and even a pop-up recreation of the terrifying place.
Find a missing person, solve puzzle, and navigate rooms full of dangers to escape alive from this place that shouldn’t exist.

pr.m: Area Control, Deck Building, Engine Building
pr.d: You take on the role of a Noble Leader that has been bequeathed an estate with a team of workers. Your goal is to build an Estate that would be the envy of all the land. At its heart, Estate: Raise the Realm is a worker placement tableau building game in which players choose to use their workers on one of four actions performed in the course of each turn to develop their estate and score victory points.

pr.m: Drafting, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:
It is a time of rebuilding after the Great War. Do you have what it takes?
In Estate: Raise the Realm, players take on the role of a Noble Leader of a Great House who is bequeathed an Estate post war. Each Leader begins the game with resources, a special ability, a unique build of construction(s) and/or citizen(s) cards within their Estate, a Family Secret objective, and workers prepared to rebuild.
A worker placement reconstruction challenge, players must use their workers wisely to optimize their Estate’s growth over the five Eras of game play. Workers can be used to play cards, gather resources, produce on cards, and draw new cards. As the Eras progress and your Estate grows, worker actions become more powerful.
The Estate with the most victory points at the end of Era five wins the…

With the Eternitium Lost-Gen expansion, you can discover ancient enchanted artefacts amongst the technologies, which will enhance your Eternitium game with their powerful one-time effects.
6 new artefacts (3 basic technologies and 3 advanced technologies) will help you in the race to find the gem of eternal life. There are also 5 new solo missions to master.
The base game Eternitium is required to play Lost-Gen. Lost-Gen can be combined with the Next-Gen expansion.
At the Ornament Games booth you will only get the German version of Eternitium and all its expansions. Please visit the Haumea Games booth for all other versions.

In Ethnos: 2. Edition wetteifern 1 bis 6 Spieler darum, der nächste Kaiser von Ethnos zu werden. Sie kontrollieren Regionen, indem sie Verbündetengruppen rekrutieren, die verteilten Mitglieder der 12 Clans, und sie zusammen auszuspielen, um die Vorherrscha in der Region zu erringen. Doch Achtung! Allianzen können unbeständig sein. Karten, die nicht für eine Gruppe genutzt werden, müssen abgeworfen werden und können so eine gute Gelegenheit für Rivalen darstellen.
Die Spieler müssen außerdem geschickt wählen, wer der Anführer ihrer Gruppe wird, da nur dieser seine Spezialfähigkeit nutzen kann. Der Spieler, der über 3 Zeitalter das höchste Ansehen hat, wird zum Kaiser von Ethnos gekrönt und gewinnt das Spiel.

pr.t: Everrealms of Eterna - Chapter 1: The Beginning
pr.o: EVERREALMS OF ETERNA - CHAPTER 1: THE BEGINNING
pr.m: Area Control, Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board, Ressource Management
pr.d:
Everrealms of Eterna unfolds as an epic adventure spanning a total of 20 chapters, each offering around 50 hours of gameplay and guiding characters up to level 100 - precisely balanced using a proprietary balancing tool. The journey follows the “easy to learn, hard to master” principle and lets players experience a classic hero’s journey from humble peasant to mighty warrior.
At its core are a dynamic cover system with destructible environments and deep progression elements.
• Spells level up continuously and grow in power, while duplicate weapons can be forged to upgrade existing gear.

• Through alchemy, players can brew valuable potions and poisons from collected plants.

• Should fate strike during combat, the Realm of the Dead mechanic kicks in, allowing individual players to avoid…

pr.k: 44:EVERREALMS OF ETERNA – CHAPTER 2: THE SHADOWS OF LORRANT
pr.t: Everrealms of Eterna – Chapter 2: The Shadows of Lorrant
pr.o: EVERREALMS OF ETERNA – CHAPTER 2: THE SHADOWS OF LORRANT
pr.m: Area Control, Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board, Ressource Management
pr.d:
Everrealms of Eterna – Chapter 2: The Shadows of Lorrant
The journey continues—and the true secrets of Everrealms of Eterna begin to unfold.
IMPORTANT: Chapter 2 requires Chapter 1 of Everrealms of Eterna and continues the story seamlessly.
After the heroes have overcome their first dangers, their journey takes them on to the city of Lorrant. Here, the great mystery behind the world of Everrealms of Eterna slowly begins to unfold.
With 5 new maps, around 70 hours of new gameplay, 100 new enemies, 40 new spells, 80 new pieces of equipment, and an entirely new game mechanic, Everrealms of Eterna grows not only in scope but also in tactical depth.
What’s included in the package?
• Everything you need to play Chapter 2

• Fully prepared Foundry VTT port for version 9.269

• Plus, all base…

pr.m: Action Selection, Dice Placement, Dice Rolling, Engine Building
pr.d:
Get together to form your own boy band in the 90s and climb the ranks of the music industry together. Use your charm, your dancing skills and a bit of your singing talent to eventually reach the heights of the pop world. But watch out – challenges such as rival bands and gossip magazines will stand in the way of your big dreams. Will you make it before one of you embarks on a solo career or the record label drops you?
In Everybody Yeah, each of you plays a typical boyband archetype with different abilities, which you can activate by placing dice. Work together to complete the various challenges, support one another by manipulating the other players dice, and make sure that none of you gains significantly more fame than the others.

pr.t: Expedition Zetta What Happens in Warp...
pr.o: EXPEDITION ZETTA WHAT HAPPENS IN WARP...
pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Ressource Management, Set Collection
pr.d:
A fast-paced card game where romance is your ultimate strategy, between astronauts and even the most alluring alien minds.
All of it unfolds during idle warp jumps aboard a starship warping across the universe. Expect cosmic charm, clever tactics, and just enough drama to keep things thrilling!
In this mini-game version of Expedition Zetta, each player commands one of several crew aboard the Mothership, exploring distant planetary systems. Sharing knowledge sparks unexpected bonds, playful rivalries, and the occasional stolen heart. And when aliens join the mix, things get even more… intriguing.
Play your Crew cards to gather Knowledge, outwit opponents, and ignite interstellar love stories. Claim the most valuable mix of discoveries and happiness before the expedition ends. Choose…

pr.a: Matthew Inman, Elan Lee, Shane Small
pr.d: Mit Exploding Kittens: Fluch & Segen erhält das chaotische Kartenspiel einen zauberhaften Twist. Mischt neue Karten unter den Stapel und versucht, den Exploding Kittens zu entgehen, während ihr euch mit Segen stärkt und andere mit Flüchen belegt.Geheime Umschläge schalten dauerhaft zusätzliche Karten frei und erweitern das Spiel von Partie zu Partie.

Mit Exploding Kittens: Rage Mode erwartet dich eine besonders gemeine Ausgabe des beliebten Partyspiels. Zwischen Angriffen, Fallen und Explosionen versuchst du, deine Mitspielenden auszutricksen und selbst möglichst lange zu überleben. Mische Exploding Kittens in den Kartenstapel und zieht abwechselnd Karten. Nutze Aktionskarten und die Rage-Katze, um andere auszubremsen oder Karten zu stehlen. Wer als letzte Person nicht explodiert, gewinnt.

Express Zustellung - Erst richtig laden – dann schnell starten!
Chaos im Logistikpark – wer hat den Überblick und schafft die Express Zustellung am Schnellsten? Lade die Frachtstücke auf die richtigen LKWs und schicke sie dann direkt durch die Ausfahrten auf den Weg zur Lieferadresse!
Dieses faszinierende Knobelspiel fordert mit 80 voll beladenen Aufgaben dein ganzes Können heraus.

Saurez-vous vous arrêter au bon moment ?
À chaque lancer, le risque augmente. Il faudra connaître vos limites… ou les repousser !
Les œufs sont au cœur de toutes les convoitises ! Prenez des risques, accumulez-en un maximum... mais attention à ne pas tout perdre !
Dans Extra Roll, il faudra savoir jusqu’où aller pour repartir avec le plus gros butin !
Même après une élimination, les joueurs restent impliqués dans la partie.
Une mécanique universelle de prise de risques comprise en quelques secondes.
Chance, tactique et coups du sort s’enchaînent dans des parties rapides et dynamiques.

THINK YOU KNOW YOUR FRIENDS?
A player picks a subject and ranks answers from other players. Best and worst answers get higher points. Get the most points to win.
- Guess the preferences of other people.
- Learn about others, and perhaps yourself.
- Great for ice breaking.

A family party game testing skill and aim.
Throw the magnetic darts, pop the balloons and complete fun challenges. But watch out for the bombs and unexpected challenges.
Aim, throw and enjoy the POP!

Bounce, catch and discover new tricks: the FLIPPY Bounce Set combines a catching cone with a finger ring that rotates through 360°. Bounce the ball off a suitable hard surface and catch it with FLIPPY, then add spins and new trick combinations.
Includes one blue FLIPPY, one Bounce ball and sizing rings to adjust the fit to your finger. Practise solo or take turns with friends in skill challenges.
Simple to understand, but not mastered in a minute. Screen-free fun with movement, timing and coordination. Play for as long as you like; 10 minutes is only a guideline.

Catch, spin and discover your own tricks: the FLIPPY Classic Set combines a catching cone with a finger ring that rotates through 360°. Practise your first throws and catches with the Classic ball, then build new trick combinations step by step.
Includes one red FLIPPY, one Classic ball and sizing rings to adjust the fit to your finger. Play solo, improve your skills or take turns with friends in fun challenges.
Simple to understand, but not mastered in a minute. Screen-free fun at home and on the go. Play for as long as you like; 10 minutes is only a guideline.

Catch, spin and discover new tricks: FLIPPY combines a catching cone with a finger ring that rotates through 360°. Practise on your own or challenge family and friends – simple catches are just the beginning.
The Family Pack includes two FLIPPYs in red and blue, two Classic balls, one Bounce ball, sizing rings, a cotton pouch and a carabiner. The different ball types offer different ways to play: throw and catch with the Classic ball or explore dynamic floor-bounce tricks with the Bounce ball.
Simple to understand, with plenty of room to build your skills. Screen-free fun that gets you moving and playing together. Play for as long as you like.

FORMIQ is a creative click-construction system designed to stimulate imagination, problem-solving skills, and free, constructive play.
Every FORMIQ piece is made from NATURION™ – our proprietary, eco-engineered material that blends natural fibers with cutting-edge science. The result is a material that feels warm and premium, operates with high precision, and is built to withstand years of intensive play.
FORMIQ does not prescribe outcomes or instructions. Instead, it offers children the freedom to explore form, balance, structure, and creativity at their own pace.
Developed for families and educators (STEM fields) who value thoughtful play, FORMIQ proves that sustainable materials and high-quality performance can coexist – in a beautiful way.

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Area Movement, Deck Building, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
FOUNDATION – Isaac Asimov is a mid-weight strategic Euro game that brings Isaac Asimov’s legendary science-fiction saga to the tabletop, combining deep strategic gameplay with a strong thematic and narrative dimension.
Lead one of the great Factions shaping the future of the Galaxy. Expand your presence across different worlds, develop your capabilities and build your strategy through cards, Agents and the unique strengths of your Faction, as centuries pass and the balance of power continues to change.
At the heart of the game are the Seldon Crises, pivotal moments in history predicted by psychohistory. Players must decide how to face each Crisis, carefully managing their actions and the passage of Time. Resolving a Crisis can shape the future of the Galaxy, but sometimes allowing history…

Karte(n) ausspielen, Reihen vervollständigen, Punkte gewinnen. So einfach. So spannend.
120 Karten mit den Werten 3 - 7.
Jeder startet mit 3 Handkarten. Je Zug wird mindestens eine Karte und maximal drei in die Tischmitte gespielt.
Zahl auf Zahl. Ist eine Reihe voll (bei 3 dreien oder 4 vieren oder 5 fünfen usw.) darf der Spieler die Karten der Reihe nehmen. Diese zählen am Ende einen Punkt je Karte.

Furry Pawlitics
A light strategy card game of chaos, care, and cunning for 2–4 players.
Welcome to Furry Pawlitics, the most unpredictable day in a veterinary clinic!
From 9 AM to 10 PM, the clinic buzzes with wagging tails, anxious owners, and assistant vets competing to prove their skill and charm.
Each round post lunch, a new Clinic Hour Card is revealed, bringing fresh chaos — lunch breaks, surprise walk-ins, and shifting responsibilities that keep everyone on their toes.
On your turn, you will:
• Place, move, or swap Pet Cards into cubicles — but watch out, some pets just can’t stand each other!

• Fulfil Treatment Goals to score points and earn their trust.

• Spend your Waiting/Favour Tokens to call in favours, grab hard-to-reach patients, or navigate clinic politics.

• Build your…

In Fadenfroh, you place fabric cards in your display. You receive victory points for the colors and symbols on the fabric cards in your display. When and for what exactly you receive victory points depends on the scoring cards of the current round.
However, your opponents are competing with you for fabric cards and useful materials. So, every round you have to decide anew: How long can I take materials before someone snatches up the ideal fabric cards?
Whoever has the most victory points at the end of the game wins!

Fadenfroh ist ein taktisches Kartenspiel, in dem ihr aus Beeren, Tieren und Blumen ein farbenfrohes Stickbild zusammenstellt. Ihr platziert Stoffkarten geschickt in eurer eigenen Auslage und wählt Materialien oder Karten aus einem gemeinsamen Markt. Variable Wertungskarten sorgen dafür, dass sich die Schwerpunkte und Strategien von Partie zu Partie verändern.

pr.m: Drafting, Set Collection, Tile Placement, Others
pr.d:
In Fadenfroh, you place fabric cards in your display. You receive victory points for the colors and symbols on the fabric cards in your display. When and for what exactly you receive victory points depends on the scoring cards of the current round.
However, your opponents are competing with you for fabric cards and useful materials. So, every round you have to decide a new: How long can I take materials before someone snatches up the ideal fabric cards?
Whoever has the most victory points at the end of the game wins!

Welcome to FaeKin. A fast-paced, beautifully twisted game of social deduction, where everyone can lie but no one has to.
With the balance between Summer and Winter shattered, it’s up to you to uncover who truly serves which court. In true Fae fashion, mischief is encouraged, deception is expected— but nothing is required. The choice to lie, mislead, or stay silent is entirely yours.
Duel your fellow Fae. Play cards face down. Peek. Bluff. Expose.
Touch the Crown and Dagger to make a claim.
Convince, deceive, or be deceived. But once your decision is cast - the truth will be revealed.
Crown the right Heir AND dagger the right enemy - and your Court claims victory. But choose one wrong and the rival Court wins everything.

Die neue Ausgabe des Fairplay Magazins ist da – prall gefüllt mit spannenden Berichten, Rezensionen und kniffligen Rätseln! In Heft Nr. 157 erwarten euch wieder viele interessante Themen rund um Brettspiele und mehr.

Fairway 18 is a tactical golf card game that brings a full round of golf to the table.
Players choose the right clubs, manage distance, recover from hazards and plan each hole carefully from the tee to the final putt. Every card played is a decision: save a useful club for later, take a safer shot or risk a more ambitious play.
The game combines hand management, tactical decision-making, course planning and golf strategy in an accessible card-game format. Different Course Cards recreate complete 18-hole layouts, giving each round a different combination of PAR values and distances.
Players can play 6, 9 or all 18 holes, making Fairway 18 suitable for both shorter and longer sessions. The player with the lowest score wins.

Das bezaubernde Familienspiel Fairy Perfume entführt euch ins Land der Feen, wo ihr beim großen Parfüm-Wettbewerb gegeneinander antretet. Schüttelt Duftsteine aus euren Parfümflaschen, kombiniert sie geschickt und erschafft einzigartige Düfte, um die Blumenfeen zu begeistern. Wer die wertvollsten Duftkombinationen zusammenstellt und die meisten Siegpunkte sammelt, gewinnt den Wettbewerb.Jede Runde entscheidet ihr selbst, wie weit ihr beim Ausschütteln eurer Duftsteine gehen wollt – denn wer zu gierig wird, riskiert eine Explosion und sammelt wertlose Kohlesteine. Mit den erhaltenen Ressourcen kauft ihr neue Duftsteine, nützliche Fähigkeiten und wertvolle Ziele, verbessert eure Möglichkeiten Runde für Runde und entwickelt eure Parfümsammlung strategisch weiter.

Falklands-Malvinas 1982 Operacional is an Operational level board-wargame for 2+ players (by teams) that simulates the air-naval campaign during the war for the Falklands-Malvinas islands in 1982 between Argentina and United Kingdom.
The game runs within a hexagonal board (50 kms/hex), showing from an operational perspective the combat actions between ships and aircraft of both sides.
Its mechanics are realistic and very close to the tactical, trying to represent all decision levels. You must determine what type of units to attack, with what, and what weapons to do so or to defend yourself. The mechanics used make it possible to recreate all types of combat and operations (air-to-air, air-to-surface, anti-submarine warfare, detection, bombing...), even giving the British player the chance…

Wir schicken dir die Fallakte zu einem ungelösten Mordfall! Dabei erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Verdächtige zu verhören, die individuell auf deine Verhörmethoden und Fragen eingehen. Setzt du die Verdächtigen unter Druck oder versuchst du, dich mit ihnen anzufreunden? Finde jetzt heraus, ob du das Zeug zum echten Ermittler hast!

Eine Forschungsstation im ewigen Eis, ein verrückter Wissenschaftler und ein kaltblütiger Mord. Der renommierte Forscher Dr. Johan Fjellberg wird nach einem Stromausfall tot aufgefunden. Kannst du Licht die andauernde Dunkelheit der norwegischen Polarnacht bringen und den Mord aufklären?

Rettet ihr das Land vor dem Untergang?

Dunkle Kreaturen aus den Schatten bedrohen das einst friedliche Land. Die einzige Hoffnung seid ihr. Erhebt eure Waffen, sammelt eure Kräfte und vernichtet so viele Monster, wie ihr könnt. Seid dabei erfolgreicher als alle anderen und sichert euch am meisten Ruhm und Anerkennung.

Fame & Fable ist ein kompetitives Hand-Management und Deck-Construction- Spiel, bei dem ihr mit Taktik und Weitsicht vorgeht. In deinem Zug stellst du Verbündete zusammen, die möglichst gut gemeinsam kämpfen, rüstest dich mit starken Items aus und stürzt dich in spannende und waghalsige Kämpfe um den besten Loot.

Hast du gerade keine Lust, deinen Ruhm mit anderen zu teilen, kannst du dich im epischen Solomodus beweisen. Stelle dich einem gnadenlosen Ansturm von Monstern…

Mit der Erweiterung Fame & Fable: Legenden bekommst du noch mehr Monster, die du für Ruhm und Ehre niedermetzeln kannst.
Fame & Fable spielt in einer bunten und magischen Fantasy-Welt mit einer düsteren Seite. Sichert euch Charaktere und Gegenstände, vereitelt die Pläne der anderen, erfüllt Aufträge und besiegt Monster und Legenden. Mit jedem Sieg steigt dein Ruhm – wirst du zum Champion?
Dich erwartet ein kompetitives Hand-Management– und Deck-Construction-Spiel, das Taktik und Weitsicht verlangt: Plane deine Züge mit Bedacht, stelle miteinander agierende Verbündete zusammen, rüste dich mit starten Items aus und stürze dich in spannende, teils waghalsige Kämpfe!
Nutze deine Aktionen auf vielfältige Weise und schließe herausfordernde Aufträge ab – oder durchkreuze die Pläne deiner…

The grand fairytale castle is overrun by monsters. Set off with your familiars, cuddle other creatures along the way to join your undertaking and ultimately relieve the castle of the monsters with a large and powerful group, followed by a grand celebration.
Explore this extraordinary deck-building game with its increasing difficulty levels – and its exceptional cuddling factor!

How much fish will you catch when the catch is yours, but the fish stock belongs to everyone? In FangFrage, players form up to six competing fishing crews. During each fishing season, every crew decides how many fish to catch and secretly submits its catch record card to the game moderator. Only then does everyone discover how the sum of their individual decisions has affected the shared fish stock.
The game unfolds over three phases. At first, the crews act without coordinating; later, they are allowed to negotiate and cooperate. Yet in both phases, the sea is usually overfished. In Phase 3, the North Sea Council convenes: negotiations are structured around a set of existing agreement cards from which the crews can establish binding rules.
FangFrage turns the tragedy of the commons into…

"Fantastique!" is the exclamation you want to hear when you reveal your finest fan.
In each round, you play fans from around the world to earn medals. At the same time, you aim to gather suitable materials for future rounds and optimize the cards in your hand for the rounds to come.
Who among you will have the most medals after seven rounds and meet the scoring criteria of the "Grande Finale" fan on display?
"Fantastique" is a bidding game featuring hand optimization. Fan-shaped cards with intricate illustrations create a unique gaming experience. Despite simple rules, the game offers great depth thanks to changing scoring objectives.

A unicorn or a pirate? Who can put together the coolest fantasy story? In this imaginative game from the creator of “Sky Team,” two players compete to create the best fantasy characters for their book. Round after round, players take turns selecting a die from the shared die pool and placing it on a fantasy creature to bring it to life. Who will be the first to complete 20 chapters or collect 7 symbols of one color and score points with the coolest fantasy creatures? The lovingly illustrated cards and plenty of interaction keep the excitement going until the very last die. For two players ages 10 and up.

Get the most powerful troop and claim victory
Fantasy Troops, the Empire’s biggest festival, is here! The most renowned kingdoms have gathered to prove their worth by recruiting the best troops. Choose carefully from your rivals’ offers: some will bring you closer to victory... and others could turn into a total disaster. Will you manage to assemble the most valuable company at the festival?

Your travels through Alula have sharpened your senses. You are more attuned to the world of the Spirits—those who, immersed in their millennia-long slumber, watch over the world of the living. Aware of their presence, you strive to reestablish the connection so that you may live in harmony with them.
Beyond the Veil brings common objectives to Faraway, in the shape of 13 Spirit cards. The first player to complete an objective (or to expand on it, if they already met the requirements when the card was made available) slip the Spirit card underneath the last Region card they played, granting it new resources and scoring.

pr.k: 818:FAST OUT - STADT, LAND, FLUSS WAR GESTERN!
pr.t: Fast Out - Stadt, Land, Fluss war gestern!
pr.o: FAST OUT - STADT, LAND, FLUSS WAR GESTERN!
pr.d:
In Fast Out dreht sich alles um flinke Hände und schnelle Köpfe. Hier gibt es keine Wartezeiten – alle spielen gleichzeitig und versuchen, als Erste ihren Kartenstapel loszuwerden.
Zu Beginn wählt ihr sechs Kategorien aus – zum Beispiel Stadt, Land, Fluss, Promi, Film, Brettspiel, Songtitel oder sogar eine eigene Wunschkategorie. Danach erhält jede Person einen Stapel Buchstaben-Karten. In der Tischmitte liegt die aktuelle Kategorie bereit – noch verdeckt. Dann heißt es: „3, 2, 1, Fast Out!“
Sobald die Kategorie aufgedeckt wird, müsst ihr blitzschnell einen passenden Begriff finden, der mit dem Buchstaben eurer obersten Karte beginnt. Wer zuerst einen korrekten Begriff laut nennt, darf seine Karte in die Mitte legen – und legt damit sofort die nächste Kategorie fest. Ohne Pause geht es…

2 new heroes for Fate: Defenders of Grimheim - the cooperative tower defence adventure!
Either play Godin, the druid with the strong hands and expertise in mixing magic potions for himself and his friends.
Or discover Valkyria, an angelic warrior with no patience for just waiting for fallen soldiers to bring to Valhalla…
Godin and Valkyria brings more fun and replayability to the struggle for Grimheim…

Ich bin Walküre, eine himmlische Jungfrau, deren Aufgabe es ist, die Seelen gefallener Krieger zu ihrem ewigen Lohn zu führen. Hoffentlich stirbt jemand, damit mein Besuch in Grimheim nicht umsonst war …
In Godins Augen ist alles eine potenzielle Zutat und alles muss ausprobiert werden, bevor man es verwirft. So sind viele seiner experimentellen Mixturen entstanden – manche berühmt, manche berüchtigt. Eines ist jedoch sicher:
Wenn man ein Schmerzmittel braucht, ist seine Brauerei immer geöffnet und seine Mixturen betäuben alles … wochenlang.

Die Erweiterung Valkyria & Godin führt 2 neue Helden ins Spiel ein.
Valkyria ist eine Walküre aus Walhalla. Sie ist eine starke Heilerin und Nahkämpferin.
Godin ist ein Meister der Tränke. Er braut sie, um seine Gefährten auf verschiedene Weise zu…
Fauch & Fertig ist ein cleveres Kartenspiel, bei dem ihr Drachen sammelt, Kombos bildet und versucht, eure Eier schneller loszuwerden als alle anderen.

Faust muss der Versuchung Mephistopheles‘ widerstehen und versuchen, das Gleichgewicht innerhalb der vier Aspekte aufrechtzuerhalten. Falls er alle Karten einer Farbe erhält oder verliert, ist das Gleichgewicht gebrochen und Mephisto erhält die Kontrolle über diesen Aspekt. Bewahrt Faust das Gleichgewicht in mindestens 3 der 4 Aspekte, gewinnt er.
Wird Faust es schaffen, standhaft zu bleiben, oder wird Mephisto ihn ins Verderben reißen?

Fearsome Floors (Reanimated Version) is the completely revised and expanded new edition of the classic Fearsome Floors.
Under false imprisonment, you land foolishly and freezing in Prince Fieso's fortress. The only option you have is to flee as the master monster Furunkulus feverishly awaits you. Instead of feeling him out for friendship, you must freely act with fleet feet to fool Furunkulus and find freedom.
Try to move your figures through Prince Fieso's fortress without being captured by Furunkulus. Your figures will need to hide behind blocks of stone, slide across blood pools, and lure the monster from a safe distance to attack other figures — then the monster will move automatically to capture unfortunate figures in its path.
Plan your escape cautiously so that your figures will…

Die Jahreszeiten wechseln, und diese schrägen Vögel suchen ein neues Zuhause! Die eigensinnigen Uhus genießen bei warmem Wetter Gesellschaft, werden bei Kälte aber zu echten Einzelgängern. Stolze Eisvögel und entschlossene Spechte kommen bei reichhaltigem Nahrungsangebot bestens miteinander aus – doch was geschieht, wenn die Nahrung plötzlich knapp wird? Erschaffe über drei Jahreszeiten hinweg Zufluchtsorte, die ebenso reizvoll sind wie die Vögel selbst, in diesem Spiel, das auf simultanem Drafting und bonusorientiertem Sammeln von Sets basiert.
Erlebe eine neuartige Interpretation des Jahreszeitenwechsels: In jeder Runde rotierst du deine Inselkarten und kannst sie verbessern, um das schwankende Nahrungsangebot abzubilden, während du gleichzeitig geschickt verschiedene Boni abwägst – von…

Take turns placing fence tiles one by one to expand your territory. The only rule is that the touching points between tiles must match in color. Close off the fence and occupy the empty area before your opponent does. Naturally, the player who claims the most territory wins the game!
Inside the Box : 60 fence tiles, 21 area markers

🚗 SCHLUSS MIT REISE-LANGEWEILE: FensterForscher verwandelt jede Autofahrt in ein spannendes Such-Abenteuer. Die Kinder ziehen Karten, schauen aus dem Fenster und suchen die abgebildeten Dinge in ihrer Umgebung. Urlaub Must Haves für Kinder, ganz ohne Tablet und Handy.
🔍 SPANNENDES SUCHSPIEL FÜR KINDER AB 5 JAHREN: Wer zuerst 10 Lupen sammelt, wird Meister-Entdecker. Das Reise-Kartenspiel sorgt für 20 bis 60 Minuten Spielspaß, für 1 bis 4 Spieler, und ist ein tolles Geschenk für Jungen und Mädchen, das nebenbei Aufmerksamkeit und Konzentration fördert.
🎯 30 ENTDECKER-MISSIONEN FÜR ECHTE PROFIS: Wenn das normale Suchen zu leicht wird, warten 30 knifflige Missionen in drei Schwierigkeitsgraden. Findet bestimmte Kombinationen, löst Spezialaufgaben und kämpft euch vom Anfänger zum…

Ein kooperatives Kartenspiel in der idyllischen Natur
Schnürt die Stiefel, füllt die Wasserflaschen und macht euch bereit für eine gemeinsame Reise: In Fernweh begebt ihr euch als Gruppe auf eine Wanderung voller Herausforderungen, Überraschungen und Entscheidungen. Ziel des Spiels ist es, gemeinsam verschiedene Etappen zu meistern, Hindernisse zu überwinden und schließlich einen Aussichtspunkt zu erreichen. Dabei ist jede Wanderung wie eine kleine Kampagne aufgebaut, die sich aus zufällig zusammengestellten Szenarien zusammensetzt und so immer wieder neue Erlebnisse bietet.
Fernweh ist ein kooperatives Kartenspiel vom Kobold Spieleverlag für 2-5 Spieler ab 8 Jahren, bei dem ihr gemeinsam alle Karten abspielen wollte um neue Wandereungen und Hindernisse freizuschalten.

pr.a: Gary Kim, Hope S. Hwang, Yohan Goh
pr.d:
Festburg is buzzing! The festival is coming to town, and so are the guests — from traveling minstrels to mystical fortunetellers.
As stewards, you know every visitor has their own quirks. Will you accommodate everyone and create a harmony, or play favorites and risk causing chaos?
Festburg is a strategic card game where collecting and accommodating guests go hand in hand. Choose guests for your personal pile, then place new arrivals on the shared festival area according to their unique preferences. At the end of the game, your collected guests score based on how successfully their groups were accommodated — so every placement can help you or disrupt your rivals.

pr.a: A.J. Porfirio, Evan Derrick, Mike Martins, Ryan Jorjorian, Byron Jorjorian, Motti Eisenbach
pr.d:
This is the ultimate way to experience series 4 of Final Girl. The Ultimate Box includes all 5 of the series 4 feature films: Bad Times at Buddy Land, A Rotten Harvest, Demon in the Shadows, The Green Terror, and The Raptor Games. It also includes the Terror From Beyond vignette and all of the miniatures for all of the above. You will also get the Mausoleum box which includes special victim minis for each of the Feature Films from series 1 - 4, the Cast and Crew box to house the vignette and the Final Girls for this series and the Bonus Features box which includes the Gruesome Death Books to enchance your narrative immersion, and the Lore & Scenario book for additional challenges.

The Ultimate Box does not include the Core Box and one is needed to be able to play any of the Feature Films.

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Modular Board, Ressource Management
pr.d:
Discovered by accident, Isla Lagarto is home to the last living examples of prehistoric life on earth. A private consortium took control of the island, modified it for people’s entertainment, and The Raptor Games were born. Thrill seekers from around the globe join the event in hopes of being the sole survivor and taking home the billion dollar prize.

The Raptors who hunt as if with a shared brain, are the most formidable foes for these contestants. Their speed is blinding and many consider them the real stars of the show. As long as the Raptors stay together, not even highly trained soldiers stand a chance. Some contestants join the event to end the games for good, by clearing the island of every raptor — several have tried but no one has succeeded.

This new feature film for Final Girl…

Enter the arena of legends with Final Titan — a Draft Battler where the greatest heroes of all time clash in a fight for supremacy! Who will prove themselves as the "Greatest of All Time" and claim the title of the champion?
In this competitive game, players recruit legendary champions from across time, myth, and fantasy, each with unique abilities, stats, and powers. Once recruited, your champions are thrown into the arena, where they'll face off in intense dice duels.
Choose your matchups wisely, support your heroes with power-up cards, and outwit your opponents.
The last champion standing is crowned the final titan, and the player controlling them is victorious!
In addition, the Two-Player Mode will keep you on your toes as you’re always fighting!
The game also includes Solo & Coop…

Unleash the power of Ancient Gods! With this exciting expansion, we introduce powerful Gods and their legendary upgrades from mythology.
15 unique and oversized Champion cards and 11 Legendary Upgrade cards.
Just add them to your existing Champion deck. Compatible with base game and other expansions.

This Expansion features 15 unique characters from the Mindbug Universe, reimagined as Champions. Designed in collaboration with the original creators, these cards offer fresh tactical options and a unique twist for fans of both games.
15 unique and oversized Champion cards and 10 Legendary Upgrade cards.
Just add them to your existing Champion deck. Compatible with base game and other expansions.

Mit „Was tue ich?“, „Finde etwas!“ und „Mach es nach!“ präsentiert Noris drei abwechslungsreiche Kartenspiele für Kinder ab 4 Jahren. Die leicht verständlichen Spielideen laden zum Darstellen, Entdecken und Bewegen ein und eignen sich für zu Hause, unterwegs oder für Kita-Gruppen.

Bei „Was tue ich?“ stellen die Kinder Begriffe pantomimisch dar, während die Mitspieler erraten, welche Tätigkeit gesucht wird. „Finde etwas!“ macht die Umgebung zum Suchfeld: Passend zur gezogenen Motivkarte gilt es, einen entsprechenden Gegenstand zu entdecken. Bei „Mach es nach!“ werden kindgerechte Yogaübungen und Körperhaltungen betrachtet und nachgemacht. So fördern die Spiele Fantasie, Beobachtungsgabe, Konzentration und Körpergefühl.

Jedes Spiel enthält 39 farbenfroh illustrierte Motivkarten sowie eine…

An auction game you can play with just your fingers has arrived! On the count of “One, two, three!”, the number of fingers you reveal determines the order in which you choose ships—but if you get too greedy, you might just find yourself pushed to the very back of the line. Gathering plenty of treasure leads to victory, but collecting too many ghosts will get you eliminated. Watch for the perfect moment to turn the tables using the ‘Gun’, which can only be used once per game!
Inside the Box : 38 ship-shaped cards, 5 summary cards (56 x 87 mm), 5 gun tokens

This heavy infantry squad advances relentlessly in mordern mechanized armor. Their true strength lies in their flamethrowers: Using a size L template and dealing 2 area damage per model hit, they mercilessly burn enemy units out of any cover.
Fire grenadiers can be used as a squad or reinforcement.
Content:
• Unit card in German and English

• 3 finely detailed Marines miniatures

The Unicool-plastic figures are supplied unpainted and in individual parts. They still need to be assembled. Colours and glue are not included. The shown gaming terrain serves as an example and is also not included.

At the heart of the Vastwood stands a gigantic tree, whose immense branches stretch far up into the heavens. It is called the Heart Tree, and it holds within it the Crystal, source of all life. Nori and Tan are Sylvans, a people who live inside the Heart Tree. As secret guardians, they watch over the Tree and the Crystal. To light the countless tunnels that wind through the trunk, the Sylvans have tamed fireflies, whose natural glow lights their way. The inhabitants of the Vatswood call them “the firefly tamers.”
Fireflies is a cooperative game for two players that invites you to embark on a fantastic adventure: the epic journey of Nori and Tan to save the Vastwood from the Darkness. Guiding your partner across otherworldly and perilous landscapes, you’ll explore hostile lands, meet a…

Bei FIRST GIANTS schlüpft ihr in die Rolle von Paläontologen und sammelt beeindruckende Fossilien für euer Museum.
Entscheidet, welche Funde ihr erforschen wollt, und nutzt ihre Effekte, bevor ihr sie eurer Sammlung hinzufügt. Ihr müsst gut abwägen, wann ihr eure Fossilien der Öffentlichkeit präsentiert, denn ab dann profitiert ihr nicht mehr von ihren Effekten.
Wartet jedoch nicht zu lange, sonst wird euch ein anderes Museum die Show stehlen!

Fish' em Up – Catch, Compete, and Outsmart Friends
Age: 8+ | Players: 2–6 | Playtime: 25 min. | Languages: LT / EN
In Fish ’em Up, you and your friends take on the role of daring fishermen, casting a massive net in hopes of hauling in the biggest catch. Each player wants to prove their skill, outsmart their opponents, and impress the locals. Will you return with a legendary haul, or end up with nothing but a net full of trash and disappointment?
Players take turns adding cards to the shared Net, stacking them strategically on top of the existing cards. Each card type triggers special effects, such as gaining points, stealing points from rivals, or stealing cards. The more cards of the same type connected to the Net, the stronger their effects become. Players can also cover specific images…

“This is like Fishing, but completely different.” - Ordinary seaman Ronald after the first game
As before, your caught cards score points, then you use them to try to catch even more — but blowfish, two trump colors, and new buoys create a fresh game experience.
In Fishing 2, you try to catch as many tricks as possible in 8 rounds because each card you catch is worth 1 point. You use your caught cards as bait for the next round — but if you did not catch enough tricks to do so, you first fill your hand with fresh cards from the ocean stack.
You win Fishing 2 by scoring the most points. How many fresh cards will you need to succeed?
Fishing 2 is a standalone game, not an expansion for Fishing!

pr.m: Deck Building, Push your Luck, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:
The Dwar7s are back and this time, the city is burning.
Flame & Forge is a brand-new, completely standalone game for 1–4 players that blends worker placement, deck-building, push-your-luck combat, and boss-battler excitement into one fiery adventure.
March your dwarfs through a city under siege, gather gems, forge powerful weapons, upgrade your workers, and face monsters that may become valuable additions to your deck — if you survive the fight. Every battle is a gamble: push deeper for a chance at victory, or flee before your own deck turns against you.
But the dragon is not waiting. As the battle rages, fire spreads across the city, destroying locations and bringing everyone closer to defeat.
Before the game begins, choose your path: cooperate to save the city and slay the mighty red…

Dragons & Dragons erweitert Flamecraft um neue Drachen und Orte sowie zusätzliche Möglichkeiten, die Stadt weiterzuentwickeln und Verzauberungen zu verstärken. Besonders die Dualindwürmer verbinden jeweils zwei Drachenarten und bringen eigene Fähigkeiten ins Spiel. Zum Spielen wird Flamecraft benötigt.

In Flamecraft Duals treten zwei Drachenhüter in einem taktischen Puzzle-Duell gegeneinander an. Ihr legt Drachensteine, nutzt die besonderen Fähigkeiten der Drachen und bildet passende Muster, um wertvolle Läden zu gewinnen. Die Deluxe-Edition ergänzt hochwertige Komponenten sowie zusätzliche Spielmodi und eine Solo-Variante.

Das Dragons of the Past Promo-Pack bringt zusätzliche Inhalte für Flamecraft und lässt neue, wundersame Läden und Drachen in der Stadt auftauchen. Die Promoinhalte werden in das Grundspiel integriert und sorgen für zusätzliche Abwechslung. Zum Spielen wird Flamecraft benötigt.

Perform a passionate dance in a theater in Seville, Spain.
Flamenco is a simple yet captivating 'shedding game'.
Play stronger cards to empty your hand. Break the boundaries of the climbing genre using the 'Card Splitting' and the 'Ultimate Praise' like a breathtaking flamenco performance. Outplay your opponents with your own unique style.

200 originelle Fragen warten auf eure Antworten! Dabei gibt es für jede Frage 5 Antwortmöglichkeiten. Ihr müsst nur auf eurem Scoreboard einstellen, ob die Antwort korrekt oder falsch ist.
Einige Antworten sind gefährlicher, da man einen Spielstein verliert, wenn deine Einschätzung falsch ist. Aber genauso kann man dort mit einer richtigen Angabe auch zusätzliche Punkte gewinnen.
Wer mit Feuer spielt, sollte aufpassen, sich nicht die Finger zu verbrennen!
This is the German edition of Flamme Rouge – Champion Edition, originally published by Lautapelit.

Flicso is a brand new, magnetic table-hockey-game launching on Kickstarter.
Based on an innovative game mechanic!
Flicso offers an action-packed gaming experience players of all ages (8+) and can be placed on any table.
The goal of Flicso is simple: scoring goals!

Flicso can be played in many different variations and gamemodes and offers a brand new way to play: Players glide with two fingers over a see-through top that sits right above the playing field, controlling a magnetic hockey stick underneath.
Slide, flick and spin to score on your opponent!

This unique mechanism creates total freedom of movement and room for creativity.
Flicso is an immersive gaming experience that rewards fast reflexes, coordination, intuition and staying calm.
Come by our stand and try it yourself!
Secure…
Fliegen Kriegen ist ein chaotisch-witziges Reaktionsspiel, bei dem ihr eure Bar im Griff behalten müsst, während euch alle anderen mit Fliegen bombardieren.

Things are getting serious! Flip 7 shows its ruthless side and eliminates any second chances. Take turns collecting cards as the risk grows with every move - whoever draws twice is out. New, interactive action cards trigger nasty effects, while penalty cards result in negative points. And as if that weren’t enough, there are now 13 copies of the number 13 in the card set! Thrills, schadenfreude, and an escalating atmosphere are guaranteed! The question remains: Stop, or one more? A fast-paced, standalone, and devious card game with simple rules for three to eighteen players ages ten and up.

Audition an all-new cast of whimsical cartoon characters in this stand-alone sequel card game! Flip your way to fame as you hire and dismiss new Toons with new abilities and wild interactions, or combine this game with the original FlipToons to play with up to 8 at a time.

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Ressource Management
pr.d:
Welcome to Mountween, where nothing is quite what it seems. Here, it’s hard to tell monsters from trinkets — or peaceful folk from villains. A mystical power has created the Flipside, a twisted reflection of the world where anyone or anything that slips through a breach may emerge… changed.
Flipside is a cooperative story-driven adventure game for 1–4 players. Step into the shoes of a unique character with their own backstory, abilities, and personal quests, then explore Mountween together as a series of strange events unfolds around you.
Travel across the map, meet peculiar residents, gather useful stuff, develop your character, and embark on branching adventures where your choices and successes shape what happens next. Each scenario leads the group toward a cooperative Final Adventure —…

The classic game is now cooperative!
You probably love to play games from the “Golf” family, right? What? Haven‘t a clue?! Well, how about beating games together as a team?
Flixo offers you both experiences in a brand new game!
Try to shrink all card displays during the game to end up with few cards bearing low numbers, or ideally no cards at all! Sadly, some cursed numbers – the Flixos – have snuck into the displays, and you’ll need the help of normal numbers to cast them out. Are you clever enough together to win against the Flixos and collect as few points as possible?
As you improve, you can face the fevered Flixos in levels of increasing difficulty!

Flora Funga features two nature-inspired games in one elegant box with a magnetic wrap-around board. In FLORA, dandelions sprout, bloom, then scatter as shifting winds reshape the landscape while you race to complete mission cards. In FUNGA, mushrooms form intricate patterns as you place, connect, and disrupt using clever moves and unique powers to score the most points. Two distinct challenges, one striking package - grow, adapt, and outplay your rivals.

Entdeckt beim Tauchen neue Fischarten mit spannenden neuen Fähigkeiten und kümmert euch um die Korallenriffe an euren Tauchstellen.
Haie & Riffe lässt euch noch tiefer in das marine Ökosystem von Flossenschlag eintauchen. Diese Erweiterung bringt neue Korallenriff-Lebensräume und weitere fantastische Haie mit furchteinflößenden neuen Fähigkeiten in eure Ozeane.
Die Haie können eure Schwärme von Jungfischen zerstreuen (die an anderer Stelle noch mehr Schwärme bilden) und hinterlassen Futterreste, die jeder Fisch in eurem Ozean verzehren kann.
Außerdem könnt ihr farbenfrohe Korallenriffe an euren Tauchstellen pflegen, wobei gesunde Riffe es euch erlauben, die neuen (und starken) Rifffische auszuspielen sowie Boni bei Fischfähigkeiten und am Ende des Spiels zu erhalten.

Shyfinngames Oy is a Finnish indie game studio that designs small but big games. This year, we’re bringing Fluffypede – a card game for the whole family that’s been in development for 2.5 years – to Essen. In the game, players take on the role of toy makers, working together but competing to create Fluffypede plushie toys. Behind the game’s super-cute artwork lies a tactical game that challenges you to think about your cards in a whole new way. Make use of special tools and the toy makers’ unique abilities in a game where it’s not just the winner that’s remembered, but all the incredible moves made throughout the game. 2–5 players Playing time: 25 minutes Ages 8+ English, Spanish, Finnish Language-neutral components No Gen-AI art used!

A shedding card game between 2-6 players where the aim of the game is to release all of your cards, resulting in the rest of the table accruing points.
Shedding/racing: The aim is to “release” or shed all your cards before anyone else. The first player to empty their hand wins the round, while others score penalty points based on what they’re left holding.
Risk and reaction: Players must constantly judge whether to play safe or push their luck, reacting to what others lay down and managing the risk of being forced to pick up the central pile when they can’t follow.
Light, social, family-friendly: It’s marketed as an addictive, easy-to-learn party/family game with high replay value, suitable for 2–6 players and quick rounds.
• PREMIUM CARDS | 90 x high quality, poker-sized, thick…

In Fly Away sammeln sich fünf verschiedene Vogelarten am Himmel, um gemeinsam nach Süden zu ziehen. Im Verlauf des Spiels baut ihr euch eine eigene Formation aus 12 Vogelkarten auf.
Die Karten dafür liegen in einer gemeinsamen Auslage in der Tischmitte. Reihum nimmt sich jede Person 1 bis 3 angrenzende Karten aus dieser Auslage und legt sie – ohne die Anordnung zu verändern – in ihre eigene Formation. Dabei darf keine bereits liegende Karte überdeckt werden, und am Ende muss die eigene Formation genau wie die Auslage aussehen. Freigewordene Plätze in der Auslage werden sofort nachgezogen.
Wie viele Punkte die einzelnen Vogelarten am Ende wert sind, wird durch persönliche Wertungskarten bestimmt, ihr habt also jeder etwas andere Formationen als Ziel. Das Spielende wird eingeläutet, wenn…

Exclusive figure.**
Fear gives you wings! Borsti is out on the high seas and – “BOOM!” – a massive pirate cannonball hits the boat. Luckily, she’s prepared and manages to save herself at the last Moment.
* Flying-Borsti is a mercenary who can be hired by any crew if Sascha is part of the crew.

Click here for the character cards.

Pieces: 5, Total height: approx. 411 mm
The resin figure is supplied unpainted and in separate parts, and requires assembly.
** Available only at special events, trade fairs and tournaments - and only whilst stocks last.

Flying Spit is a fast-paced math card game for 2-7 players, ages 8+, with a playtime of 30+ minutes.
A tsundere alpaca has arrived at the royal court, and players must team up (and clash) to soothe its explosive temper.
On your turn, play Number Cards to add to the running total, or Action Cards to twist the total and pass messy spit penalties to your opponents.
Watch out for matching digits and totals of 100 or 0, or the alpaca will blast you with spit!
Each Character Card has a double-sided Side B super-ability that unlocks when your spit meter overflows.
With multiple game modes including a 2-player duel, chunky durable components, and vivid art, Flying Spit turns brain-boosting mental arithmetic into chaotic family fun.
Pre-Order Now!:…

Die vierte Erweiterung lässt euch die Vögel Mexikos, Mittelamerikas (inkl. Karibik) und Südamerikas entdecken.
Kolibris machen etwa ein Zehntel der Vogelarten Lateinamerikas aus und begeistern Vogelfans mit ihren schnellen Bewegungen und schillernden Federn. In dieser Erweiterung stehen sie mit einem speziellen Kartensatz im Mittelpunkt, der einen neuen Kniff zum bekannten Spielverlauf hinzufügt. Die Kolibris kommen mit ihrem ganz eigenen Material daher: einem neuen Tableau „Kolibri-Garten“, Kolibri-Auflagen für eure Spielertableaus, Kolibri-Punktetafeln und Kolibrimarkern.

Mit über 3000 Vogelarten, die in diesen artenreichen und vielfältigen Regionen beheimatet sind, gibt es aber natürlich auch jede Menge neue Vögel in dieser Erweiterung, die keine Kolibris sind, und die darauf warten,…

Neue Vogelfähigkeiten von Flügelschlag-Fans auf 150 Karten!
Flügelschlag-Autorin Elizabeth Hargrave hat in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Koordinator für Fan-Kreationen Travis Willse und einigen ausgewählten Autor*innen das offizielle Regionen Fan-Set 1 entwickelt. Diese Box enthält 6 Vogelkarten-Packs, die jeweils 25 völlig neue Vögel aus Kontinenten enthalten, die bereits in Flügelschlag vertreten sind, insgesamt also 150 neue Karten. Die enthaltenen 6 Regionen sind: Asien, Großbritannien, Kanada, Kontinentaleuropa, Neuseeland und USA.

Die Illustrationen passen zum allgemeinen Stil aller anderen Karten im Spiel und zeigen die Vögel wie immer in all ihrer Pracht.

"The battle for food truck supremacy has begun! Food Truck Fury is a deck-building battler where you will play as one of a variety of asymmetric food trucks adopting unique strategies to defeat the competition, complete jobs, deliver to customers, and earn points. You will be armed with incredible and wacky contraptions to dominate the city and secure your victory! Will you combat your fellow food truckers or will you tackle the solo mode to defeat the evil V.E.N.D.O. Corp, who is determined to replace good cooking with vending machines? In this flavorful game for 1-4 players, only one food trucker can be the greatest, will it be you?"

pr.a: Trevor Benjamin, Brett J. Gilbert, David Thompson
pr.d: In For the Gods! führt ihr eine Seefahrer- und Baumeisterfraktion durch die Inselwelt des antiken Griechenlands. Mit Steinen aus eurem Beutel segelt ihr zwischen Häfen, errichtet und erweitert Tempel und weiht sie den Göttern des Olymps, um deren besondere Kräfte zu nutzen. Wer in den Regionen die eindrucksvollsten Tempel errichtet, sammelt den meisten Ruhm.

pr.a: Trevor Benjamin, Brett J. Gilbert, David Thompson
pr.d:
Do you like board games, Greek Gods, easy to learn rules, tactical play and great looking components? For the Gods! is the game for you!
⏰ Learn in 5 minutes
⛵️ Sail the Archipelago
🏛️ Build the highest temple
⚡ Harness the power of the Greek gods
Designed by Trevor Benjamin, Brett J. Gilbert, and David Thompson.

pr.a: Molly Johnson, Robert Melvin, Shawn Stankewich
pr.d:
Forage is a puzzly tableau-building roll-and-write game for 1-6 players with gorgeous artwork by Beth Sobel! It is designed and developed by the team that brought you the Calico, Cascadia, and Point Salad series of games!
Rules are simple: Roll the forage dice and reveal a unique journey tile each round. Choose a combination of dice and carry out one of the actions: exploring, storing, or gift-giving. As you carry out actions, you’ll earn bonuses that allow you to power up your future actions or make additional moves to complete your goals! Use your time wisely – there are several journeys you can take to collect knowledge, experience, and prestige. Once you have completed your turn, you’ll choose one of the three types of cards to draw and add to your tableau giving you more ways to…

pr.a: Molly Johnson, Robert Melvin, Shawn Stankewich
pr.d: A micro-expansion for Forage

This expansion brings 55 new cards inspired by the flora and fauna of Exmoor National Park to Forest Shuffle: Dartmoor. The new species blend into the base game while adding fresh effects and challenges rooted in another protected British moorland habitat.

Forest Shuffle: Smoky Mountains is a standalone entry in the Forest Shuffle series set in the Great Smoky Mountains of North America. Build a thriving woodland ecosystem with local plants and animals, including aquatic species and the American black bear.

The journey continues: The third standalone in the Forest Shuffle series, Forest Shuffle - Smoky Mountains takes you to this popular North American National Park. Building on the beloved gameplay of the series, it introduces new species and clever twists in mechanics. This keeping the experience as fresh as the bubbling waters on the new terrain cards!

Heres what Forest Shuffle - Smoky Mountains is all about:
• New terrain types centered around water, playable solo or as a universal waters under trees.

• New synergies between flora and fauna, all revolving around the element of water.

• In addition to a variety of species around the water, the game is also home to various large animals, such as black bears or bobcats.

Bonus: like its predecessors, this family friendly card game works…

pr.m: Area Movement, Ressource Management, Set Collection
pr.d: The forest never sleeps. It grows, changes, and requires constant adaptation from those who manage it. Growing Forward expands Forestry with new asymmetric characters, additional harvesting and transport mechanics, and modules focused on infestation management and long-term planning. The expansion increases strategic variability through unique player abilities, asymmetric starts, and new ways to optimize forest development and resource flow.

Think fast and build in 3D... before time runs out! A creative building game where words turn into shapes! Build your word with the building blocks, while the others guess what you are creating. Choose the right challenge level and let your imagination run free. Reach the finish first to win! Includes 40 top-quality wooden pieces.

Where has the little mouse hidden? In which part of the forest is the fox waiting? And where is the nimble squirrel hiding? In “Hidden? Found!”, published by the Viennese game publisher Piatnik, children embark on an entertaining journey of discovery through four forest areas of varying sizes to track down the secret hiding spots of the cute animals.
Fifteen animal forest dwellers are hiding in the autumnal thicket, waiting to be discovered by two to four children (ages four and up). However, if the frog, hedgehog, or their other friends aren’t found, they’ll quickly scurry off to the next patch of forest to find a new hiding spot.
It’s all about finding the right balance: In “Hidden? Found!”, concentration and memory—along with a little bit of luck—determine the winner. The children try…

pr.m: Push your Luck, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d: Das Denkduell der Superhirne! Wer knackt denGeheimcode und wird zum Mastermind? In diesemspannenden Strategiespiel für Familien und Kinder ab 8Jahren treten Code-Setzer und Code-Knackergegeneinander an. Während der Code-Setzer einenraffinierten Geheimcode erstellt, nutzt der Code-Knacker Logik und Erinnerungsvermögen, um ihn zuentschlüsseln. Wer wird den Code zuerst knacken?​

Who has what it takes to be a dragon rider - and who would rather take on the role of a scribe? In this cooperative communication game, three to six players aged 16 and up ask each other exciting “Who would be most likely to…” questions set in the fascinating world of *Fourth Wing* and discuss their answers together. 180 beautifully designed cards featuring atmospheric illustrations of the Fourth Wing world invite lively conversations about the themes of the bestselling novel. With its elegant cover, the game fits perfectly among your favorite novels on the bookshelf. An ideal communication game for fans of the New Adult book series Fourth Wing who are looking for a sociable and imaginative gaming experience.

pr.k: 199:FOURTH WING - THE GAME: CHOOSING THE DRAGONS
pr.t: Fourth Wing - The Game: Choosing the Dragons
pr.o: FOURTH WING - THE GAME: CHOOSING THE DRAGONS
pr.d: The path to becoming a dragon rider begins at Basgiath War College. In three consecutive trials, players must demonstrate strength, courage, intelligence, and balance—each challenge requires different decisions and playstyles. After the trials, Impression tokens are distributed, which ultimately determine the dragon bond, as each dragon responds to different traits. Special dragon dice add excitement and unpredictable twists. Only those who excel in the trials will win a dragon’s trust and be chosen. An atmospheric fan game based on the “Flammengeküsst” New Adult book series for two to four players ages eight and up.

Im herbstlichen Fox Grove beginnt der Wettlauf um die besten Wintervorräte. Als Tiere des Waldes sammelt ihr Holz, Nüsse und Ahornblätter, um eure Ressourcen an drei Waldhäuser zu liefern und euch optimal auf die kalte Jahreszeit vorzubereiten. Doch nur wer die Stiche klug plant und seine Fähigkeiten effizient einsetzt, wird am Ende die meisten Punkte erzielen.
Das Herzstück des Spiels ist ein spannendes Stichspiel mit vier Farben – darunter gelbe Trumpfkarten. Jede Karte bringt beim Gewinnen eines Stichs oder beim geschickten Abwerfen wertvolle Belohnungen: Ressourcen für den Ausbau der Waldhäuser, Brombeeren als flexible Joker oder sogar direkte Aufstiege durch besonders starke Karten. Timing und Handmanagement spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle.
Nach neun ausgespielten Stichen folgt die…

pr.m: Engine Building, Pick-up and Deliver, Ressource Management, Tile Placement
pr.d: You are the founders of a new fox town, constructing buildings and connecting them with trails to create the most profitable settlement. The buildings you choose might create goods or turn them into points. Pick wisely and connect them efficiently to move your goods around your town to earn the most points
This is the German edition of Fragments – Solara, originally published by iello.

pr.m: Action Selection, Modular Board, Tile Placement, Others
pr.d:
Your brother is in danger! His pendant has been found in the heart of the ancient forest, where ancient spirits and shamans have lived in harmony for generations.
Will you dare to venture into the woods to search for him? Be careful: there are many secrets lurking in the shadows.
Fragments is a new line of narrative games with innovative mechanic and material consisting of jigsaw puzzle pieces.
Narrative will be the guiding thread of your adventure but it is through the use and manipulation of jigsaw pieces that the adventure will unfold.
The game can be played solo or in small groups of 2 to 4 players for optimal gameplay.
Fungataï is a 4 chapter campaign offering an experience around 7 hours long.
Ready to piece the story together?

pr.m: Action Selection, Modular Board, Tile Placement, Others
pr.d:
Right before you leave your settlement in the Solara desert, you notice your companion is nowhere to be found. How will you adapt to this inhospitable environment to reunite with your friend
Could it be beginning of a greater story?
Fragments is a new line of narrative games with innovative mechanic and material consisting of jigsaw puzzle pieces.
The narrative will be the guiding thread of your adventure but it is through the use and manipulation of jigsaw pieces that the adventure will truly unfold.
Fragments Solara is a short standalone adventure consisting of a single chapter. This is the introductory box to this new universe. It lasts around 90 minutes.
Ready to piece the story together?
The horrible Crawling Castles are about to invade the peaceful land of Freigard. Gather the most valiant defenders to defeat the mechanical monsters!

pr.a: Tina Schuster, Jens- Peter Schliemann, Karolina Schnelle, Lisa Besse
pr.d: Head out into nature—or bring the adventure into your living room! Together, you’ll build an extraordinary island, piece by piece, using leaves, twigs, stones, and much more. Everyone has secret missions and transforms the collected materials into boats, treasures, or even volcanoes. Indoors, Freiluftwelten provides creative play—outdoors, it becomes an experience like nothing you’ve ever seen before: an adventure that unfolds right in nature!

pr.t: Frische Fische - Erweiterung für "Fish n Flips"
pr.o: FRISCHE FISCHE - ERWEITERUNG FUER "FISH N FLIPS"
pr.d:
„Frische Fische“ – mehr Taktik, mehr Kombos, mehr Meer!

Diese Erweiterung für Fish ´n´ Flips bringt euch nicht nur 2 neue Aktionskarten, 4 knifflige Missionen und 2 mächtige Tierarten (Seesterne und Robben), sondern auch einen komplett neuen Spielmodus. Mit persönlichen Rettungsaufträgen und neuen Varianten aller alten Missionen wird jedes Spiel zur frischen Herausforderung. Bereit, die Meere zu retten?

Was ist “Fish n Flips” ?
