Das ist drin:
50 Aufgabenkarten
6…

Seltsame Geräusche wurden unter den Katakomben gehört … Wagt euch in die Höhlen der rätselhaften Sphinx, der versteinernden Medusa oder der furchterregenden Lebenden Statuen. Entdeckt vergessene Kammern, jede mit einer einzigartigen Kraft, die es sonst nirgendwo im Verlies gibt. Sammelt Trophäen eurer Abenteuer, um euren Ruhm wachsen zu lassen!
Neue Geheimnisse und Gefahren warten in KLONG! - Katakomben: Horte, Kammern & Trophäen!

pr.m: Action Selection, Deck Building, Drafting, Ressource Management, Trade
pr.d:
Expansion for Knarr.
In a few months, the assembly will take place, where important decisions will be made and judgments handed down. If you want your voice to carry weight at this grand assembly, you must increase your influence by expanding your village and participating in raids!

KNIFFEL® 8 bringt neue, spannende Elemente zum beliebten Würfelklassiker. Die vertrauten Grundregeln bleiben unverändert, so dass ihr sofort loskniffeln könnt. Acht Würfel sorgen für noch mehr KNIFFEL® Spielspaß: Mit den 8ern kann um neue Kombinationen und noch höhere Punktzahlen gekniffelt werden. Auf geht’s zur fröhlichen Punktejagd!
Vom Erfolgsautor Reiner Knizia
Mit 8 Sonderwürfeln
Knifflige Entscheidungen

In KNIFFEL® – DAS DUELL bleiben die vertrauten Grundregeln des Würfelklassikers KNIFFEL® unverändert, so dass ihr sofort losspielen könnt. Mit 5 Würfeln versucht ihr auch hier die verschiedenen Kombinationen zu erreichen. Seid immer wachsam, welche Bereiche wichtig werden und luchst dem Gegenüber wertvolle Scheiben ab. Wer entscheidet dieses spannende Tauziehen für sich

Knights of the Pond Table is an accessible abstract strategy game where frogs, spiders and dragonflies battle for control of the pond. Each creature moves differently, creating tactical opportunities to capture opponents, control key spaces and outmanoeuvre rival players.
Simple rules and short turns make the game approachable, while asymmetric movement, hidden scoring values and action cards provide considerable tactical depth and replayability.
2–4 players · Ages 8+ · 15–25 minutes · Strategy game
Successfully funded on Kickstarter in just 7 hours.

At the end of the city's most chaotic street sits a door with no sign, no hours, and no mercy. A Bouncer guards it, motionless and impeccable. To get in, you need an Invitation bearing a single word, but the word alone is worthless. You have to whisper the right Password, something the Bouncer finds meaningful. And hidden among the hopeful crowd is an undercover Detective, listening to every attempt, determined to crack the secret before anyone else does.
Each round, one player becomes the Bouncer, secretly linking a Password to the word on their Invitation card. The other players split into Customers, who can see the word and take turns calling out guesses, and a single Detective, who can't see the word at all and must piece it together purely from how the Bouncer reacts to each guess.…

Simple...or not.
Place your bets. If your hand is the highest, you win! However, watch out for the tricky "Kobayakawa" card. The number on the Kobayakawa is added to the lowest card's value, so even if you're holding the highest number, a win is not guaranteed. Despite its simple rules, this is a quick and exciting card game that will test your bravery and bluffing

What’s going on here? Alongside suitcases and bags, a crocodile and a cactus are also sitting on the luggage carousel?! It turns out Grandma Hilde has been on vacation again and brought back all sorts of things. Now, however, she needs to get this wild mix of luggage, gear, and souvenirs off the carousel in an organized way. That’s where you come in!
The goal is to collect as many items of luggage as possible—sorted by size and color—to score the most points. Whoever manages this best wins not only Grandma Hilde’s gratitude but also this unique card game.

pr.a: Rosaria Battiato, Massimo Borzì, Martino Chiacchiera
pr.d: A gentle lapping, the sun glistening on the water - magnificent koi swim leisurely in circles. In Koi, an artfully designed garden pond takes shape turn by turn, where elegant fish swim among water lilies and stones. Koi on transparent acrylic tiles are placed in the water, giving the pond a fascinating sense of depth. With skillful planning, players can choose the right pond cards, expand the pond, and create the ideal environment for prized carp. A variety of task cards ensures that every game presents new challenges. Whether playing solo or competitively, this beautifully illustrated game offers tactical variety and atmospheric relaxation for one to four players ages 12 and up.

pr.a: Frank Crittin, Grégoire Largey, Sébastien Pauchon
pr.d:
In dem Kennerspiel Krabbler-Chaos wurdet ihr ins Verlies gesperrt, doch ihr habt einen Fluchtplan. Das Ziel ist klar: Erklimmt die vier Stockwerke und erreicht das Dach. Dort erwartet euch die Freiheit. Ihr werdet allerdings kämpfen müssen!
Das Spiel verläuft über vier Runden. Jedes Stockwerk stellt eine Runde dar. Kauft Ausrüstung, schließt Missionen ab und stellt euch immer schrecklicheren Monstern! Oder überlasst das mühselige Kämpfen euren „Kumpanen“, führt nur den Todesstoß aus und sackt die Beute ein. Auf dem Dach könnt ihr weitere Siegpunkte erhalten. Wer die meisten Siegpunkte hat, gewinnt das Spiel!

pr.t: Krakel-Orakel Erweiterung – Neue Orakelkarten, neue Krakelstifte
pr.o: KRAKEL-ORAKEL ERWEITERUNG – NEUE ORAKELKARTEN, NEUE KRAKELSTIFTE
pr.d:
Es kann weiter gekrakelt werden!
Mehr Abwechslung mit 260 neuen Begriffen! Einfach in die bisherigen Karten einmischen – oder nur mit den neuen Begriffen spielen.
Und falls ihr schon ein paar Stifte leergekrakelt habt, keine Sorge: wir legen noch 4 Ersatzstifte dazu!
ACHTUNG: Grundspiel „Krakel-Orakel” wird benötigt!
Inhalt:
• 130 Begriffskarten mit 260 neuen Begriffen

• 4 Folienstifte

• 1 Spielanleitung

2–8 Personen | ab 10 Jahren | Spieldauer: 30 Minuten

pr.t: Krakel-Orakel Ü18-Erweiterung – Heiße Orakelkarten, neue Krakelstifte
pr.o: KRAKEL-ORAKEL UE18-ERWEITERUNG – HEISSE ORAKELKARTEN, NEUE KRAKELSTIFTE
pr.d:
Neues Gekrakel, jetzt extra heiß!
Mehr Abwechslung mit 260 nicht jugendfreien Begriffen! Einfach in die bisherigen Karten einmischen – oder nur mit den neuen Begriffen spielen.
Und falls euren Stiften schon der Saft ausgeht, keine Sorge: wir legen noch 4 Ersatzstifte dazu.
ACHTUNG: Grundspiel „Krakel-Orakel” wird benötigt!

Inhalt:
• 130 Begriffskarten mit 260 neuen Begriffen für Erwachsene

• 4 Folienstifte

• 1 Spielanleitung

2–8 Personen | ab 18 Jahren | Spieldauer: 30 Minuten

pr.k: 228:KRAKEL-SPEKTAKEL – DREH DIE SCHEIBE UND KRAKLE MIT 6 BRANDNEUEN CHALLENGES
pr.t: Krakel-Spektakel – Dreh die Scheibe und krakle mit 6 brandneuen Challenges
pr.o: KRAKEL-SPEKTAKEL – DREH DIE SCHEIBE UND KRAKLE MIT 6 BRANDNEUEN CHALLENGES
pr.d:
Aus dem Orakel wird ein Spektakel!
Die Botschaften des Orakels sind verworren und rätselhaft, aber mit ein bisschen Fantasie lassen sich die Bilder deuten … oder?
In diesem kooperativen Spiel erwarten euch 500 neue Begriffe, eine Drehscheibe für brandneue Spielmodi und ein Zufallstimer, der jede Runde dynamisch und überraschend macht. Eure Herausforderung: Begriffe zeichnerisch darstellen – aber nur entlang der gestrichelten Linien auf den Zeichentafeln! Sobald ihr fertig seid mit dem Gekrakel und die Zeit abgelaufen ist, wird orakelt. Könnt ihr die Prophezei(chn)ungen der anderen entschlüsseln?
Kompatibel oder eigenständig spielbar:
Das Krakel-Spektakel lässt sich perfekt mit dem Spiel „Krakel-Orakel” (nominiert zum Spiel des Jahres 2025) und den Erweiterungen kombinieren – oder als…
Diese Erweiterung enthält das Spielmaterial um Kreaturen-Karawane mit 5 und 6 Spielern zu genießen. Ebenfalls neu ist der Kartentyp Gegenstand und eine Variante für den Solo-Bot.

Nicht alle Schlachten werden von mächtigen Armeen auf großen Feldern oder in verschanzten Festungen gewonnen. In manchen Fällen braucht es subtilere und vielleicht sogar tödliche Taktiken. Von gefälschten Briefen und Verträgen über vorgetäuschte Rückzüge und Vorstöße hin zu vergifteten Wasserquellen, Ermordungen und Infiltration können in der Dunkelheit hinterhältige Dinge geschehen, die einen Gegner bloßstellen können, bevor die eigentliche Schlacht überhaupt beginnt.
In Kriegstruhe: Hinterhalt bekommt ihr mit spezialisierten Einheiten die Gelegenheit, euren Gegner zu beschränken oder daran zu hindern, seine Kräfte effektiv einsetzen zu können. Die Kunst des Betrügens zu meistern ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg!

pr.a: Vangelis Matthaiopouls, Stefanos Pagonidis,  David Pecorini Cancellario D' Alena, Sara Parsi di Landrone
pr.m: Dice Rolling, Pick-up and Deliver, Push your Luck
pr.d:
Bigfoot is real. Mothman is real. And they’re not your biggest problem.

Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit is a competitive PvE adventure game set in an alternative Art Deco world where the creatures of folklore are real, their power has reshaped society, and hunting them has become a path to fame, fortune and influence.
Choose your hunter. Fund your expedition. Cross North and Central America in pursuit of cryptids drawn from real-world folklore. Face unpredictable events, upgrade your gear and crew, and decide how far you are willing to push your luck.
Capture a cryptid and the danger is not over. You still have to make it home.
And as the hunt progresses, the greatest threat may no longer be the creatures. It may be the hunters sitting around the table.

Hunt. Capture. Secure. Outsmart.…

pr.k: 3:KRYPTOTHERA: THE CRYPTID PURSUIT – SOLO & CO-OP MODE
pr.t: Kryptothera: The Cryptid Pursuit – Solo & Co-op Mode
pr.o: KRYPTOTHERA: THE CRYPTID PURSUIT – SOLO & CO-OP MODE
pr.a: Vangelis Matthaiopoulos, Stefanos Pagonidis,  David Pecorini Cancellario D' Alena, Sara Parsi di Landrone
pr.m: Dice Rolling, Pick-up and Deliver, Push your Luck
pr.d:
One expansion. Two completely different hunts.

Kryptothera may have been built for rivalry. This expansion asks a very different question:
What happens when there is nobody else to beat?

SOLO MODE: THE DESCENT

Just you. The hunt. And a world that fights back.
The Descent transforms Kryptothera into a dedicated single-player challenge with its own Solo deck and new gameplay mechanics. Plan carefully, adapt as the situation changes and resist the growing influence of the Order.
There are no rival hunters to blame. Every decision is yours. So is every consequence.

CO-OP MODE: UNITED WE HUNT

This time, the other hunters are not your rivals. They are the people keeping you alive.
United We Hunt introduces a separate co-operative experience with its own Co-Op deck, new mechanics and a…

pr.m: Area Control, Bag Building, Dice Placement, Dice Rolling, Drafting, Modular Board, Push your Luck, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Welcome to KumoKumo Park, a magical sky amusement park that changes with every visit. Players compete for the best seats in a highly in-demand park where nothing stays available for long.
The game blends multiple mini-game mechanics, from set collection to push-your-luck and dexterity. Each attraction offers a dual-layer experience, from family-friendly to more tactical play. A lottery-driven endgame keeps tension high until the very last moment, in a vibrant, whimsical world with strong visual appeal.

pr.k: 228:KURZ GERATEN – OHNE VOKALE BIS ZUM FINALE!
pr.t: Kurz Geraten – Ohne Vokale bis zum Finale!
pr.o: KURZ GERATEN – OHNE VOKALE BIS ZUM FINALE!
pr.d:
Wortwitz, Teamgeist und clevere Hinweise – schafft ihr alle Level?
Mit „Kurz Geraten – Ohne Vokale bis zum Finale!” erlebt ihr ein kooperatives Ratespiel, das Kreativität, Kommunikation und Teamwork auf ein neues Level hebt. Gemeinsam gebt ihr Hinweise auf ein geheimes Bild – doch eure Buchstaben sind knapp und müssen strategisch eingesetzt werden. Formt Wörter oder stellt das Bild dar, aber nutzt dabei möglichst wenige Buchstabenplättchen. Mit jeder Runde steigt die Herausforderung und die Spannung wächst. Schafft ihr es als Team, sechs Runden zu überstehen und alle Leben zu behalten?
Dieses kooperative Spiel ist perfekt für Spieleabende mit Freund:innen und Familie, als Partyspiel und für alle, die kreative Wortspiele und kooperative Brettspiele lieben.
Das erwartet dich:
• kooperatives…

Königreich Legacy ist eine einzigartige Solo-Kampagne voller aufregender Entdeckungen und Abenteuer: Erkunde neue Karten und lerne, wie du sie zu deinem Vorteil nutzen kannst, um gegen schwere Umstände zu bestehen.
Manche Karten werden zerrissen, andere verbessert oder mit Aufklebern aufgewertet - was auch immer notwendig ist, um das ultimative Königreich zu erschaffen, dein Königreich!
Übrigens, wie wirst du es nennen? Schreib den Namen mit dem permanentesten Marker, den du finden kannst, auf die Seite der Schachtel. Deine Reise beginnt hier...

Diese Erweiterung für Königreich Legacy ist mit jedem Königreich kombinierbar.
Als du mit den Landkarten in deinem Studierzimmer hantierst, überkommt dich der Drang nach Abenteuern. In alle Richtungen um dein Königreich herum liegt weites Land. Dieses sollte selbstredend dir gehören - aber wo fängst du an?
In Erforschungen können über 150 neue Karten von bis zu 2 Königreichen erkundet werden. Jedes Königreich hat 4 Runden, um seine Erforschung zu starten, der Inhalt dieser Schachtel jedoch wird fortlaufend durch die Kampagne erkundet.

pr.m: Action Selection, Drafting, Set Collection, Others
pr.d:
Return to the garden of your childhood to build a tableau of Ladybird Cards! The roses are overgrown, the orchard is crawling with aphids, and only your old friends — the ladybirds — can help restore the garden to its former beauty. Over five summer days you’ll place cards to grow your tableau of ladybird types and rekindle old memories.
Each round, players simultaneously reveal a card, place it into one of five colored columns, then perform one of the available garden actions. Completing a full ladybird life cycle (egg → larva → pupa → adult) or clearing aphids from orchard cards boosts the value of your ladybirds. Tension builds as players compete for the right ladybird type and color before opponents snag them first.
Score bonus points by completing sets of all five colors, feeding…

Wer sind deine Freunde wirklich – und was würden sie nie zugeben?
LASS ES RAUS! knackt Oberflächen mit 148 grenzwertigen Fragen rund um Vorurteile, Gewalt und Drogen.
Das Spiel ist kombinierbar mit dem Original LASS ES RAUS!, aber auch eigenständig spielbar.
INHALT
• 148 Fragekarten

• Anleitung

pr.a: Pierrick Libralesso, Renaud Libralesso, Yoel Sayada
pr.d:
In the forgotten realm of Leda, the great species have awakened: cats, pandas, sharks, scorpions, and many more. Each animal clan has developed its own civilization, language, and ambitions. Through a strange energy grid pulsing in rhythm with the world, they build, evolve, clash — and seek to impose their vision of the future. In this world balanced on a knife's edge, war is not everything; cunning, adaptability, memory, and deep bonds with nature are the keys to triumph. Who will carve their name among the legends of Leda?
LEDA is an asymmetric card game for two players in which each player embodies an animal clan with its own rules, objectives, and playstyle. Each player begins with a 4x4 grid of basic tiles, which they will modify during the game by upgrading them and playing clan…

pr.a: Pierrick Libralesso, Renaud Libralesso, Yoel Sayada
pr.m: Engine Building, Modular Board, Ressource Management
pr.d:
Der Kampf der Tierclans
LEDA – In der vergessenen Welt von Leda sind die großen Spezies erwacht: Katzen, Pandas, Haie, Skorpione und viele mehr. Jeder Tierclan hat seine eigene Zivilisation, Sprache und Ambitionen entwickelt. Durch ein seltsames Energienetz, das im Rhythmus der Welt pulsiert, bauen, entwickeln und bekämpfen sie sich – und versuchen, ihre Vision der Zukunft durchzusetzen. In dieser Welt, die auf Messers Schneide balanciert, ist Krieg nicht alles; List, Anpassungsfähigkeit, Gedächtnis und tiefe Verbindungen zur Natur sind die Schlüssel zum Triumph. Wer wird sich einen Namen unter den Legenden von Leda machen?
LEDA ist ein asymmetrisches Kartenspiel für zwei Spieler, in dem jeder Spieler einen Tierclan mit eigenen Regeln, Zielen und Spielweise verkörpert. Jeder Spieler…

pr.a: Pierrick Libralesso, Renaud Libralesso, Yoel Sayada
pr.d:
Lurking in the shadows of the tall grass, the Snakes are making their entrance in LEDA with this clan expansion! Featuring 11 cunning creatures, this clan deploys face-down as eggs, waiting for the perfect moment to reveal themselves. When you activate an area of your grid, the eggs hatch and the Snakes burst forth, each unleashing its power. Some of them can manipulate the egg and snake sides of cards to weave combos that are as unexpected as they are devastating. The Serpents embody the art of cunning: hide your intentions, strike at the decisive moment, and gain the upper hand by surprise!
Spiel ESSEN is the official release of the LEDA : Snake expansion.

Team Detective Game
Someone at the fair sorted the sweets by color and ate all the red ones...
Someone took down and hid the underwear that was hanging out to dry...
Someone put up a sign on the city hall saying, “A dragon lives here.”
Who did it? Perhaps there are witnesses who saw something. The detectives will find out!
The game develops planning skills and attentiveness. Luck also plays a role.

Contents:
1 “City” game board
4 detective figures
1 “Criminal” figure
30 Suspect cards
8 Question cards
5 Answer cards
1 die
Rules

In Letter Up, your goal is to cleverly place words to reach the edges of the playing area and claim territories.
In the two-player mode, the first player to place all 6 of their territory tokens wins the game.
In solo mode, your objective is to achieve the highest score possible.

TRAVEL THROUGH TIME TO OUTCLASS YOUR OPPONENTS!
LOOP is a card-discarding game in which all hands are served only one time.

During your turn, you will play a single card or a combination of cards. After that, each player must play a better card or combo to stay in play. The goal is to get rid of all your cards as fast as you can.

The twist is that after each round, the card hands will shift from player to player. Every hand offers a diverse array of possible strategies and playstyles. It’s up to you to find the most suited one to achieve better results than your opponents!

At the end of the game, you will have played with every single served hand. But beware, are you ready to deal with the hourglass that can bend the time and flip the power hierarchy of the cards?

pr.a: Isra Cendrero, Sheila Santos,  Mike Keller, Andreas Odendahl
pr.d:
It’s harvest time on Mallorca.

In La Cosecha (Spanish for “the harvest”), you run your farm in the idyllic hamlet of Alpich near the town of Esporles. Each round, you harvest goods such as olives, grapes, and grain to mark boxes in different areas of your farm sheet. Fields need tending, the barn roof needs covering, and market carts want loading—your farm is full of opportunities!
Often, you’ll need upgraded goods such as food and wine, which you must first produce from harvested goods. You’ll have to balance short-term revenue against long-term planning. In addition, you can acquire tools and farm extensions with special abilities that may give you the decisive edge.
The player who manages to use their revenue most effectively, combine the strongest bonuses, and keep an eye on the…

pr.m: Push your Luck, Set Collection, Others
pr.d: This is the German edition of La Cuenta, originally published by 2Tomatoes Games.

The pack hunts. The pack fights. The pack is united. The pack needs a leader—a leader stronger than all the others, a leader more cunning than all the others, a leader who will prevail in every duel. Will you be worthy of leading The Pack?
Win duels in a row to take control of the pack. Every duel you win brings you closer to Alpha status. Win a duel as the Alpha to eliminate your opponent. Be the last Alpha left in the game to become the leader of the pack and win the game!

The pack hunts. The pack fights. The pack is united. The pack needs a leader—a leader stronger than all the others, a leader more cunning than all the others, a leader who will prevail in every duel. Will you be worthy of leading The Pack?
Win duels in a row to take control of the pack. Every duel you win brings you closer to Alpha status. Win a duel as the Alpha to eliminate your opponent. Be the last Alpha left in the game to become the leader of the pack and win the game!

________________________________________________________________________________

La meute chasse. La meute combat. La meute est unie. La meute a besoin d’un chef. Un chef plus fort que tous les autres. Un chef plus rusé que tous les autres. Un chef qui résistera à tous les duels. Serez-vous digne de prendre la tête…

Die fantastische Welt von „Labyrinth Chronicles“ braucht mutige Abenteurer, die sich in das magische Labyrinth wagen! Denn dort warten wertvolle Schätze darauf, gehoben zu werden – und nur mit diesen lässt sich das verwüstete Feental neu aufbauen. Allerdings lauern auch große Gefahren in den Tiefen des Labyrinths … Diese ultimative Sammler-Edition des Ravensburger Klassikers „Das verrückte Labyrinth“ bietet einzigartiges 3D-Spielmaterial und eine mehrstündige kooperative Kampagne.

Die spannende Geschichte rund um Feental wird im Laufe mehrerer Partien erzählt und erweitert sich ständig. Es gilt, 11 geheimnisvolle Schachteln zu öffnen und zu entdecken, was sich darin verbirgt. Für alle Fans des Ravensburger Gesellschaftsspiels kann mit dem Material von „Labyrinth Chronicles“ auch das…

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board, Push your Luck, Ressource Management
pr.d:
You’ve worked hard to earn your spot in the Adventurers Guild, but one last obstacle remains. You must build a devious dungeon for an opponent and run one built for you!​
Lairs is a game of duelling adventurers using cunning, guile, and luck to navigate an underground labyrinth.

Welcome to Landis! In this cooperative game, your international crew will travel between planets, performing perfect landings and exploring exotic worlds. With your intercoms broken, you’ll have to rely on your intuition and teamwork to uncover the mysteries of the universe.

Landmarks of the Lost Atlas introduces four new modules to expand your Railways of the Lost Atlas games. These modules can be included individually or in any combination:
Landmarks add new strategies as well as added flavor to maps that include them.
The Metropolitan Transit Department adds a neutral Corporation to the game that players can use to benefit their own interests and/or hinder others.
Events create temporary changes to the core rules of the game that players will need to adapt to.
New Minor Companies and Major Corporations add variety to the Company abilities available in the game.

New board game co-op / solo adventure experience for 1-4 players, with a story by Krzysztof Piskorski (ISS Vanguard, Tainted Grail). It creates a new generation of adventure gameplay with many innovative systems respecting players choices from the very character creation up to what equipment you will decide to carry.
With your character you will take part in many epic combats (in dungeon crawler style), where your equipments, skills and abilities will come in handy. But your character build will also play a strong role in story encounters.

Die 2 - 6 Spieler versuchen ihr Würfelglück in der bunten Glitzerwelt von Las Vegas. Sie besuchen verschiedene Casinos und müssen versuchen, dort möglichst viele Dollars zu scheffeln. Allerdings kommen sich die Glücksritter dabei immer wieder ins Gehege und machen sich gegenseitig die Kohle streitig. So entstehen viele interaktive Situationen, die immer wieder gerne zu Schadenfreude und Unterhaltung sorgen, gerade auch angesichts manchen nicht so geplanten Würfelwurfs.

Die einfachen Regeln mit einer pfiffigen Variante sorgen für noch mehr Spannung

The lemmings are on the loose! On their way to the cliff, they push and shove because everyone wants to be at the front. In this funny trick-taking game, every card played is crucial. Whoever wins tricks moves toward the cliff. However, if you run too fast, you risk falling down and experiencing a real trick-taking tragedy. This tactical card game for 3-6 players aged 10 and up is the perfect gift for daredevils and game fans.
This is the German edition of Last Minute, originally published by inPatience.

A thrilling duel between a sinister Cult and a pulp adventurer around the summoning of an Ancient OLd One from outer space. Will the cult succeed on bringing back this ancient creature or will the adventurer foil their intentions?

The volcano has erupted and the lava is closing in. Can you reach the ship before it is too late?
Lava Run is an exciting roll-and-write adventure in which players use dice and simple calculations to escape from a volcanic island. Choose how to use the results, plan your route and race towards safety while collecting diamonds and recovering the pieces of a mysterious talisman.
But every roll brings new danger: the lava continues to advance, and if it reaches a skull, the game is over!
With Basic and Advanced rules, Lava Run can be played solo or cooperatively. Children practise addition, subtraction and logical thinking naturally as they make strategic decisions together.
Run, calculate and escape before the lava catches you!

Twilight is falling in the rainforest. Life is gradually awakening among the swaying leaves of the dense canopy, and the first sleepy forest dwellers are peeking out from their hiding places. After building a wobbly tree out of cards, you carefully feel your way through the foliage to dismantle the jungle giant piece by piece. As you do so, you want to snag as many sleepy and valuable forest dwellers as possible. But be careful: If you’re too greedy, you’ll cause the canopy to collapse… and give away valuable points to the others!

Leaflings is a clever two-player strategy game where every move shapes your opponent’s next one. Place your Leaflings to create lines of three, while using their unique abilities to control where your rival can play. With simple rules, no luck and plenty of tactical twists, every tiny move can grow into a big problem for your opponent.

In Leafwork, there’s plenty to discover beneath the fallen leaves of this forest teeming with creatures scurrying and crawling everywhere! Use your magnifiers strategically and find as many matching forest creatures as you can under the leaves. You might even come across some fruits or mushrooms. Only with the right strategy you will master Leafwork!

We’re building the tallest pizza tower in the world! Stack one pizza slice at a time using the pizza saver. Whoever topples the tower loses — and the previous player wins!
Inside the Box : 8 Pizzas, Pizza Savers

pr.p: Play With Us Design Co., Ltd.
pr.d:
Quick to teach. Clever to solve. Always worth another round.
Leaves is a small-box visual puzzle race for players who want something quick—but not mindless.
Spot shared features, stack matching leaf cards, and race to turn scattered leaves into one perfect pile. The rules are simple, but every card changes your path, and the best move is not always the first one you see.
Play solo for a quick brain teaser, or compete with friends and family for that satisfying moment when the pattern finally clicks.
Easy to bring out between bigger games, while waiting for the next table, or anytime someone says, “Let’s play something short, but clever.”
Small box. Simple rules. Real puzzle satisfaction.

Legend in the Mist ist ein erzählerisches, folkloristisches Fantasy-Rollenspiel, in dem man Mitglieder einer Reisegruppe spielt. Einfache Dorfbewohner:innen machen sich auf, die Geheimnisse der Lande jenseits ihrer Heimat zu lüften, wachsen an ihren Aufgaben und lernen Dinge, die sie vorher nie für möglich gehalten hatten..

Dieser Schnellstarter bietet einen kurzen Blick in die Regeln und ein Abenteuer mit drei vorgefertigten Charakteren, damit man gleich losspielen kann.

pr.k: 132:LEGENDARY: GAME OF THRONES DECK BUILDING GAME
pr.t: Legendary: Game of Thrones Deck Building Game
pr.o: LEGENDARY: GAME OF THRONES DECK BUILDING GAME
pr.d:
In this competitive version of Legendary, players seek to claim the ultimate prize: the Iron Throne! Take control of one of the great houses of Westeros with fan-favorite characters and locations. Brand new game content including Masterminds, Heroes, Villains, and more! All cards will contain original art based on the characters from the Game of Thrones! 550 cards, a rule book, deluxe play mat, player boards and everything you will need to play!
Winter is coming, and the houses of Westeros are locked in a bitter battle. Experience a thrilling world of epic warfare with Legendary: Game of Thrones Deck Building Game, in which you play as one of the Great Houses, with your own heroes to recruit and masterminds to protect. No matter who you choose, be prepared! It will take more than brute…

Welcome to Morbidia, a realm ruled by Kadmon and his legions of the Dead. Legions of Kadmon is a competitive boss-rush card game, featuring an intricate mixture of hand-management and open-drafting.
In this race for Kadmon’s crown, you take on the role of a Death Summoner. You can channel the Death Esa to command the Dead of Morbidia. Every unit you destroy will succumb to your power and join you in the struggle to usurp Kadmon. Access their power by Summoning them as your Vassal or Cast them as a Spell.
In your journey, you will encounter powerful Sovereigns who command the Legion in Kadmon’s stead. They carry Kadmon’s Ichor. Collect those precious Ichor by dealing damage, slay these Sovereigns, and they too will become a part of your arsenal.
Kadmon awaits as the final Sovereign. Only…

Werde zum Ninja als Kai, Nya, Cole oder Zane und verteidige die Destiny's Bounty vor den Bösewichten, die das Schiff angreifen. Das Familienspiel Ninjago: Destiny's Bounty Adventures ist kooperativ. Ihr gewinnt oder verliert gemeinsam gegen die Bösewichte des Spiels. Euer Ziel ist es, den Flugsegler vor allen angreifenden Bösewichten zu beschützen. Dafür müssen die Ninja die Bösewichte in den verschiedenen Räumen des Schiffs besiegen. Die Ninja und die Bösewichte bewegen sich durch die 12 Räume des Flugseglers. Bösewichte bewegen sich entlang der goldenen Pfade und Ninja bewegen sich durch die Durchgänge von Raum zu Raum.
Die Abenteuer geben jeder Partie eine eigene Geschichte. Es gibt sechs einzigartige Abenteuer mit zunehmender Schwierigkeit. Alle Abenteuer können mehrfach und in…

Introduction:
Did you ever play the old computer game “Lemonade Stand” on the Apple IIe computer? Well we did and we loved it! It was a simple, fun, educational game that really influenced a lot of people growing up in the early 80s. We have been trying for a couple of years to recreate the simplicity yet realistic feel of this classic game. We wanted to recreate this experience in a card game, yet keep the supply and demand calculations and complex math to a minimum. Designer Trevor Cram was able to create what we hope you will agree is a simple, unique game that allows young and old alike to participate in their own business of setting prices, stocking inventory and making advertising decisions. Each of these decisions will affect the profits or losses each player realizes, coupled with…

Les Yeux Fermés is a cooperative game divided into ten chapters. Within each chapter, you move stones with your eyes closed to arrange them harmoniously in zones that match their colors. Work your way through all the chapters in order, finishing each chapter with as few dissonant stones as possible!
Move the stones with your eyes closed, but be mindful of the constraints. Discuss the best strategies. During each game (chapter),start by placing the requested stones on each page of the workbook. Then decide on the order of play. Take a stone from your page and place it on your starting area. Close your eyes and try to place your stone in harmony. At the end of the chapter, check the harmony of the stones. You’ll have ten chapters to play and replay. Plus: three bonus chapters to unlock and…

pr.m: Push your Luck, Set Collection, Others
pr.d:
You’re at a party full of laughter, friends, and great music; the atmosphere is buzzing with energy and fun. This is the perfect moment to show off your best moves on the dance floor and get everyone moving to your beat. The lights spin to the beat of the latest hits, while every step adds excitement to the night. Let your creativity flow and become the life of the party. Are you ready to show off your best moves, shine under the party lights, and make everyone envy your rhythm? It’s time to dance!
In Let’s Dance, you’ll dance with your cards. Play them in front of you to form your dance floor with different choreographed sequences. Play different dance moves, stomp on another player, draw new cards, or refresh your hand. The game nears its end when someone reveals the “End of the Party”…

Im humorvollen Partyspiel Let’s Match versucht ihr und euer Teampartner, das perfekte Paar zu werden. Anhand eines von hunderten spannenden Themen wählt ihr dazu aberwitzige Bildkarten aus euren identischen Kartendecks aus, von denen ihr glaubt, dass sie am besten zum Thema passen. Je ähnlicher eure Auswahl ist, desto mehr Punkte bekommt ihr. Was passt besser zum Thema „Albtraum“ als die traurige Braut – vielleicht doch das grinsende Clownsgesicht? Da sind Missverständnisse, Überraschungen und viele Lacher garantiert! Sammelt die meisten Punkte und rennt den gegnerischen Teams davon! Denn es kann nur ein perfektes Paar geben, und das seid ihr, oder?

pr.k: 647:LET´S LEARN - TOP TO BOTTOM - IQ BINGO
pr.t: Let´s learn - Top to Bottom - IQ Bingo
pr.o: LET´S LEARN - TOP TO BOTTOM - IQ BINGO
pr.d: Can you figure out the right order? Solve fun challenges, reveal your answer with a “rock–paper–scissors” gesture, and mark your points on the bingo board! Easy to learn and a lot of fun to play! Includes 100 unique tasks to test your mind. Combine two IQ Bingo games to create a super 4-player version!

All the strategy. All the wildlife. Packed into a small box.
This standalone travel edition gives the full Kavango experience into a streamlined card game that will slide into backpacks, ready to be taken on adventurous game nights anywhere. Ideal for family holidays - including a kids' rule variant (ages 6+).
Available in English only.

Mit welchen Problemen kämpfte Spock-Darsteller Zachary Quinto? Wie nennt man chinesische Astronauten? Wieviel Dollar brachte das teuerste Spielzeug der Welt bei einer Versteigerung ein? „Level Up! - Das Nerd-Quiz – 2026er Edition“ enthält erneut 99 Karten mit kuriosen Fragen aus der Nerd-Kultur: Von Science-Fiction bis Fantasy, von Computerwissen bis Geschichte, von Comics bis Wissenschaften - alles Bereiche, in denen sich ein Nerd auskennt. „Level Up!“ eignet sich am besten als Table-Quiz für größere Gruppen. Im Freundeskreis, auf Partys - oder einfach für die Raterunde zwischendurch.

Level Up! Das Nerd-Quiz (2026 Edition) ist das ideale Table-Quiz für Partys, Freundesrunden und Conventions. In Teams von 3–5 Personen beantwortet ihr kuriose, knifflige und überraschend lehrreiche Fragen aus allen Bereichen der Nerd-Kultur: Filme, Serien, Wissenschaft, Gaming, Technik, Geschichte, Comics und mehr.
99 Fragekarten sorgen für reichlich Abwechslung – von klassischen Multiple-Choice-Fragen bis hin zu cleveren Schätzaufgaben. Perfekt für Quizabende, Nerd-Events oder als Warm-up für Spieleabende.
Die 2026 Version liefert komplett neue Fragen und lässt sich auch mit anderen Editionen kombinieren.

THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Leviathan Wilds: Dunkelfels erweitert Leviathan Wilds um sieben neue Leviathane, einen neuen Hüter und eine neue Klasse. Die Erweiterung führt in die Katakomben unter den Wildnissen, wo eine Festung des Alten Königreichs verborgen liegt. Zu den neuen Leviathanen gehören unter anderem Flux, Verwüster und Plage. Mit dem neuen Kletterer Edge und der Klasse Harvester steigt die Zahl der möglichen Kombinationen. Das kooperative Abenteuer erhält damit neue Herausforderungen und zusätzliche Varianz.

Leviathans is a tabletop miniatures game that uses an innovative modular dice system consisting of color-coded dice and easy-to-read physical score cards, which allow for fast and simple gameplay while maintaining the depth of strategy that encourages repeated play. This expansion adds new abilities, ships, and factions to the original edition that go beyond what was included in the base game, while advancing the timeline directly into the era of World War I. Each game involves moving our pre-painted miniatures across a hex grid and attempting to outmaneuver the opponent. Players fire various weapons at each other’s ships until either an objective is achieved or the enemy is shot down. The base game includes German and French fleets; additional fleets are planned.

Eine magische Welt erwartet euch!
Deine Vorfahren leben seit Generationen im Wald und überleben, indem sie den Leylines folgen - verworrenen magischen Spuren, die sich zwischen den Kiefern hindurchschlängeln und zu den begehrtesten Schätzen des Waldes führen. Aber von Moos und Beeren allein kann man sich nicht lange ernähren. Zu jeder Sonnenwende rollen die Feenmärkte mit ihren Wagen voller Lebensmittel und Vorräte in den Wald. Sammelt alles, was ihr im Wald finden könnt, und besucht die Märkte, bevor sie weiterziehen.

Leylines - Auf mystischen Pfaden ist eine Neuauflage bzw. Aktualisierung des Klassikers Auf Achse von Wolfgang Kramer, angesiedelt in einer brandneuen Welt mit neuen Regeln von Daryl Andrews, mit wunderschönen Acryl-Standees und einem runden Spielplan voller magischer…

Fans of UNO will love this twist on the classic card game, where fibs fly and liars win! A "Liar's Card" is played FACE DOWN, and then the player announces what it is. Are they telling the truth or bluffing? If they are challenged and get caught lying, they must draw a card. But if they are telling the truth, the accuser has to draw a card. So keep a straight face, hide any tells, and, when down to one card, don't forget to shout "UNO"! Makes a great gift for card game fans 7 years old and older.

pr.k: 228:LIEBSCH'SE, DU GEISS? DAS SPIEL MIT DER APP, DIE RUECKWAERTS SPRICHT!
pr.t: Liebsch'se, du Geiß? Das Spiel mit der App, die rückwärts spricht!
pr.o: LIEBSCH'SE, DU GEISS? DAS SPIEL MIT DER APP, DIE RUECKWAERTS SPRICHT!
pr.d:
Rückwärts sprechen, vorwärts hören – oder ist es andersrum?
In diesem kooperativen Quizspiel ist nichts so, wie es scheint. Auf den 110 liebevoll illustrierten Karten stehen die Antworten bereits — doch nur wer sie richtig liest und in die, über einen QR-Code erreichbare Web-App spricht, erlebt die überraschende Auflösung: Die App spielt eure Stimme rückwärts ab und enthüllt, was ihr gerade gesagt habt. Das sorgt für spontane Lacher, Icebreaker-Momente und unvergessliche Runden bei Geburtstagen, Familienabenden oder Spiele-Nights mit Freund:innen.
Hinweis: Für das Spiel benötigt die Spielgruppe mindestens ein Smartgerät mit Internetzugang.
Neugierig? Probiert es hier aus! http://frech.de/geiss
Inhalt:
• 110 illustrierte Karten

• mit Web-App-Begleitung: Keine komplizierten Downloads,…

pr.k: 318:LIGHT SPEED ARENA - DICE TOWER SPONSORED ASTEROID
pr.t: Light Speed Arena - Dice Tower sponsored asteroid
pr.o: LIGHT SPEED ARENA - DICE TOWER SPONSORED ASTEROID
pr.d:
The Dice Tower enters the Arena as a sponsored asteroid!
During each initiative, the spaceships mining the most minerals from this asteroid gain the seal of excellence and score 2 extra points for it.

Welcome to the League 56! This expansion for Light Speed Arena includes 2 new factions, 8 new sponsored asteroids and 1 additional Destiny Ammo asteroid for even more spaceship battle action (and chaos)! Furthermore, you can now play with up to 6 players.

BlackHole pirate ships can damage nearby vessels without directly hitting them with a laser beam. Glyphon laser beams, on the other hand, deal damage even if they narrowly miss the target. While this doesn't earn any points, the crowd in the arena still cheers wildly when things go boom! Fun and chaos are guaranteed.

A new unified packaging for the BlackHole and Glyphon expansions! Play up to 6 players and unleash 8 new sponsored asteroids and 1 additional Destiny Ammo for extra mayhem.
BlackHole pirate ships can damage nearby vessels without directly hitting them with a laser beam.
Glyphon laser beams, on the other hand, deal damage even if they narrowly miss the target.

pr.k: 318:LIGHT SPEED: ARENA - MEEPLE KING SPONSORED ASTEROID
pr.t: Light Speed: Arena - Meeple King sponsored asteroid
pr.o: LIGHT SPEED: ARENA - MEEPLE KING SPONSORED ASTEROID
pr.d:
Meeple King enters the Arena as a sponsored asteroid!
Regular subscribers are the best: Each time a spaceship mines this asteroid, it extracts 1 extra mineral for every earlier initiative in which the same player already mined it.

pr.t: Light Speed: Arena - The Space Banana
pr.o: LIGHT SPEED: ARENA - THE SPACE BANANA
pr.d:
The Arena goes bananas with the first expansion for a board game available in all fruit and vegetable shops!
Place a banana in the arena to activate Banana Mode and make yellow lasers fire backwards! They do not hit the ship that fired them.
It works with any banana. With the official one, though, you still have one to eat.

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Push your Luck, Roll'n'Write
pr.d:
LIGHTNING CITY: TOKYO is a strategy-based roll-and-write game. Step by step, players expand Tokyo’s skyscrapers with new leisure facilities while striving to best meet the city’s needs. The player with the most points at the end wins.
A round consists of two phases. During the construction phase, each player draws two new rooms in a building based on the roll of the die. Depending on the color of the die, players choose between shops, karaoke bars, restaurants, and arcades to match the setting. The scoring and task cards chosen at the start are crucial for placement. Each room type is scored differently, and in addition, each player pursues a secret personal task to earn bonus points.
The construction phase is always followed by the thunderstorm phase. As time goes on, an increasingly…

pr.m: Bag Building, Engine Building, Tile Placement
pr.d:
Im Bag-Building-Spiel Lightning Train steuert ihr eure Eisenbahngesellschaft durch eine Welt voller strategischer Möglichkeiten. Mit jedem neuen Chip in eurem Beutel wachsen eure Mittel, um Bahnhöfe zu errichten und Strecken in acht Regionen Nordamerikas zu bauen. Es wartet ein Vermögen auf euch, wenn ihr die Städte mit den Waren beliefert, nach denen sie verlangen. Doch ihr seid nicht allein auf den Schienen. Nutzt clever die Strecken eurer Rivalen oder fahrt ihnen im richtigen Moment in die Parade. Welche Bahnhöfe ebnen euch den Weg zum Sieg? Und mit welchen Zügen setzt ihr euch entscheidend von der Konkurrenz ab?
Lightning Train bietet komplexen Spielspaß und spannende Möglichkeiten, die eigene individuelle Strategie in jeder Partie neu auszubauen!

LIGRETTO® jetzt mit massig Torchancen! Zwei Mannschaften treten in einer turbulenten Partie gegeneinander an. Wer legt die Karten am schnellsten ab, bleibt am Ball und schießt die meisten Tore? Geschwindigkeit, gute Kombinationsgabe und schnelles Reaktionsvermögen sind hier gefragt. Auf die Karten, fertig, los

pr.t: Line of Fire: Mond in Asche
pr.o: LINE OF FIRE: MOND IN ASCHE

pr.d:
Every night, the fluffy Kringels wake up in the house and start doing their daily chores: gathering dust, collecting fluff and nibbling on crumbs. But recently, a serious threat has emerged: a machine that wreaks havoc every night, collecting the precious dust with a soft hum and beep. There is only one solution: a clan of Kringels must be elected to stand in the monster’s way. Will you gather enough supporters and votes to win the election?
Kleine Clans is a unique blend of a deck-building and a flip-and-write game, in which you must skilfully expand and manipulate your deck to unlock the best combinations and effects on your sheets. And so, hopefully, you’ll fulfil the most requests and secure the most votes for your own little clan.

Four playful dinos have just hatched - and they’re starving! Players collect leaves, berries, worms, or bugs to feed their dinosaurs. But watch out: these dinos are picky eaters! The dice decide what they’ll accept. The first player to grow their dino big and strong wins the game.

Some little butterflies are twirling around the garden. You’ll need a keen eye and a fast hand to catch the right butterfly!The dice shows a combination of colours.
The first player to catch the butterfly that matches the colour combination wins a token.

NEW REINFORCEMENTS HAVE LANDED ON THE TABLE
Reinforcement Packs expand your Little Soldiers’ units with new recruits with unique abilities, as well as extra content to help you create your battlefields!
With Machine Gunner, discretion is out the window. Fortify your positions with sandbags and unleash a hail of fire on the battlefield with the machine gun!
Roll the ammo cubes and deal heavy damage to your opponents.

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Dice Rolling
pr.d:
NEW REINFORCEMENTS HAVE LANDED ON THE TABLE
Reinforcement Packs expand your Little Soldiers’ units with new recruits with unique abilities, as well as extra content to help you create your battlefields!
Take the enemy by surprise with the Paratroopers! Hide in plain sight using the camouflage tokens and deploy your parachute to ambush your opponents.
Launch the parachute onto the battlefield and wreak havoc behind enemy lines!

Dust Devils is a story-rich competitive game set in the dying days of the Wild West. It tells the story of four outlaws chasing fortune and fame.
But greed has a way of bringing out the devil.
Play as The Preacher, The Gunslinger, The Bandit, or The Kid.
Every Living Stories game can be played in two ways:
Action Mode
Jump straight into the action. Randomized Conflict and Aftermath cards create a different story each time you play.
Playing time: About 45 minutes
Cinema Mode
Each Living Stories title includes a special experience: a curated storyline presented through a deck of cinematic scenes.
Think of it as the movie version of the game. An extra treat to enjoy with friends or on your own.
Playing time: About 2 hours
Dust Devils is the first title in the Living Stories series.

Pulse is a story-rich competitive game set in the grunge era.
It tells the story of four youths forming a band and trying to make it big.
But breaking through comes at a price.
Play as the Lead Singer, the Bass Player, the Drummer, or the Lead Guitarist.
Every Living Stories game can be played in two ways:
Action Mode
Jump straight into the action. Randomized Spotlight and Aftermath cards create a different story each time you play.
Playing time: About 45 minutes
Cinema Mode
Each Living Stories title includes a special experience: a curated storyline presented through a deck of cinematic scenes.
Think of it as the movie version of the game. An extra treat to enjoy with friends or on your own.
Playing time: About 2 hours
Pulse is the second title in the Living Stories series.

The Void is a story-rich competitive game set in a future controlled by mega-corporations.
It tells the story of four crew members assigned to a beacon retrieval mission.
But empty space is not always what it seems.
Play as the Commander, the Mechanic, the Pilot, or the Data Analyst.
Every Living Stories game can be played in two ways:
Action Mode
Jump straight into the action. Randomized Crisis and Aftermath cards create a different story each time you play.
Playing time: About 45 minutes
Cinema Mode
Each Living Stories title includes a special experience: a curated storyline presented through a deck of cinematic scenes.
Think of it as the movie version of the game. An extra treat to enjoy with friends or on your own.
Playing time: About 2 hours
The Void is the third title in the Living…

Build the wildest cows you can! Collect heads, middles and tails to score big with Holy Cows, Robot Cows and even Franken Cows. Meanwhile, tornadoes and alien abductions can scatter your herd. The longer your cow, the more points you earn! Round up the biggest bovines and take home the Longest Cow Prize!

pr.k: 541:LONGUE VIE AU ROI - LONG LIVE THE KING
pr.t: Longue Vie au Roi - Long live the King
pr.o: LONGUE VIE AU ROI - LONG LIVE THE KING
pr.d:
In Long live the King, your hand of cards represents your kingdom.
Hide your units cunningly to protect your King efficiently; do not let the Wrath of the people rise and destroy the opposing kingdoms.
If you lose your last Crowned head, you are out of the game.
Be the last standing kingdom to win the game!

Loony Clues is a lively party word game where players hide behind secret identities and try to guess who’s who. Use clever hints, uncover the masks, and score points by figuring out the identities of your fellow players.
At the start of the game, players are randomly assigned one of the 12 secret identities on the game board. Each round, players ask one another a simple question using cards. "Are you colorful?" "Are you flat?" Yes or no answers help players find the right identity! Will you be courageous and guess quickly, or would you rather wait for more clues? And is sushi washable, really? The interpretation is entirely up to the players, but don't try to be sneaky, as you also score points when someone guesses you correctly!
With simple rules and a variety of word cards, every round…

Collect. Connect. Make your play.
The numbers 1 to 40 loop around and around. The first number that is played determines the strength for the round. You want to completely empty your hand, but if you win you need to add cards from the table to your hand. In other words, you want to get rid of your cards, but if you win you get more. However, if the numbers on the cards you collect connect, you have a chance to play a huge sequence next time! Should you get more cards? Or pass and let someone else collect them? As the strength keeps changing, you are constantly forced to make tough decisions!

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Worker Placement
pr.d:
In Lords of Heaven, every choice matters. Expand cities, forge alliances, lead crusades, or betray your companions in the name of faith and dominion. Command your armies, invoke divine powers, and write your own history in a land torn between heaven and earth. Will your faction ascend to glory, or fall to ruin?
Lords of Heaven is a grand strategy board game for 2–4 players set during the time of the Crusades. Players take command of one of four rival factions, the Crusaders, Byzantines, Seljuks, or the Caliphate, each striving to dominate the Holy Land through faith, diplomacy, and warfare.
The game combines card-driven action management with layered systems of influence, development, and conflict. Each faction has unique abilities that shape its playstyle — from the wealth of Byzantium…

pr.p: Medium Brow Games, Lone Shark Games
pr.m: Area Control, Dice Rolling, Tile Placement, Trade
pr.d:
Welcome to Vegas.
Wheel, deal, gamble, and backstab your way across the Strip.
Tempt your family and friends down the path to gambling debt and degeneracy with one of the greatest board games of all time.

pr.m: Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Lords of Waterdeep ist ein strategisches Worker-Placement-Spiel für 2–5 Spieler ab 14 Jahren, angesiedelt im beliebten Dungeons & Dragons-Universum. Als geheime Lords der Stadt steuert ihr eure Agenten, um Ressourcen zu sammeln, Abenteurer anzuheuern und Quests zu erfüllen, die euch Ruhm und Einfluss bringen.
Jede Runde platziert ihr eure Agenten auf verschiedenen Orten der Stadt, um Aktionen auszuführen: Abenteurer rekrutieren, Gold verdienen, Intrigen ausspielen oder neue Gebäude errichten, die zusätzliche Aktionsmöglichkeiten für alle schaffen.
Geheime Zielkarten verleihen jedem Spiel eine individuelle Strategie und sorgen für hohe Wiederspielbarkeit. Nach mehreren Runden gewinnt, wer durch geschicktes Ressourcenmanagement, kluge Planung und taktisches Timing den größten Einfluss auf…

pr.t: Lords of Waterdeep - Missetaten in Schädelhafen
pr.o: LORDS OF WATERDEEP - MISSETATEN IN SCHAEDELHAFEN
pr.a: Chris Dupuis, Peter Lee, Rodney Thompson
pr.m: Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Lords of Waterdeep – Missetaten in Schädelhafen ist eine Erweiterung zum beliebten Worker-Placement-Spiel Lords of Waterdeep und erweitert das Grundspiel um zwei vollständige Module: Unterberg und Schädelhafen.
Beide Module bringen neue Spielpläne, zusätzliche Lords, Gebäude, Intrigen- und Questkarten ins Spiel und eröffnen neue strategische Möglichkeiten. Während Unterberg größere Quests und stärkere Belohnungen bietet, führt Schädelhafen die neue Mechanik der Korruption ein: Mächtige Aktionen bringen kurzfristige Vorteile, können am Ende aber wertvolle Punkte kosten.
Die Erweiterung kann flexibel gespielt werden, mit einem oder beiden Modulen gleichzeitig und erhöht zudem die Spieleranzahl auf bis zu 6 Personen.
Für alle, die mehr Tiefe, mehr Interaktion und neue taktische…

Where did those keys go? And has anyone seen my glasses?
Lost & Found is a cooperative card game that puts your memory and teamwork to the test. Join forces to restore order to a chaos of misplaced keys, glasses and other everyday objects. The key to success? Working together!
With multiple difficulty levels, several variants and ten increasingly challenging scenarios, there’s plenty to discover—whether you’re playing solo or with friends and family.
Developed by Gam’inBIZ for the nonprofit organisation Team Alzheimer, Lost & Found supports a meaningful cause: all net proceeds go towards dementia research.
1–4 players • Ages 8+ • 10 minutes

pr.t: Lost Ruins of Arnak: Surprise Shipment
pr.o: LOST RUINS OF ARNAK: SURPRISE SHIPMENT
pr.m: Deck Building, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:
A package with no sender—what could be inside? It appears there are still treasures to be unearthed and secrets to be unveiled. Gear up with new items and head back into the jungle. The island of Arnak is expecting your return.
Lost Ruins of Arnak: Surprise Shipment is the final addition to the vast and mysterious world of Arnak. The expansion is packed with 50 new cards (30 artifacts, 20 items), two new sites, and an updated site. It comes in a beautifully illustrated box that will complement every player's Arnak collection.

pr.t: Lost Ruins of Arnak: Upgraded Components
pr.o: LOST RUINS OF ARNAK: UPGRADED COMPONENTS
pr.d:
Let’s face it: the humidity of an island is an absolute disaster for cardboard pieces. If you’re going to overcome the guardians or search the jungles for mysterious artifacts, you need equipment that won't warp in your backpack.
Level up your game of Lost Ruins of Arnak with Upgraded Components, because your expedition deserves modern durability.

INCLUDES:
• 27 Metal Coins

• 27 Metal & Resin Compasses

• 2 Plastic Containers

pr.k: 413:LOVE IS… PLAYING CARDS – ROMANTIC ILLUSTRATED PLAYING CARD DECK
pr.t: Love Is… Playing Cards – Romantic Illustrated Playing Card Deck
pr.o: LOVE IS… PLAYING CARDS – ROMANTIC ILLUSTRATED PLAYING CARD DECK
pr.d:
Love Is… Playing Cards is a romantic illustrated playing-card deck celebrating the small moments that make relationships special.
Each card features a different affectionate scene or short “Love is…” message, from spending time together and making someone feel special to simply being happy side by side. The illustrations use a light, playful hand-drawn style with couples, cats, hearts and everyday romantic moments.
The deck combines the familiar structure of traditional playing cards with a warm love and relationship theme, making it suitable for classic card games as well as a charming gift for couples, anniversaries, Valentine’s Day or collectors of unusual playing cards.
Suitable for: classic card games · gifts for couples · Valentine’s Day · collecting

Schnappt euch eure Lightsticks und feuert eure liebsten K-Pop-Idols an!
Im rasanten Deduktionsspiel Kpop Demon Hunters: Battle for the Spotlight (Ein Love Letter™-Spiel) für 2 bis 6 Personen wetteifern HUNTR/X und die Saja Boys auf der Bühne, um das Publikum für sich zu gewinnen.
Aber habt kein Lampenfieber: Ihr müsst einfach nur eine Karte ziehen und eine Karte spielen! Und wenn eure Lieblingscharaktere aus KPop Demon Hunters dann noch ihre einzigartigen Fähigkeiten einsetzen, wird euer Team die Fans ganz bestimmt überzeugen und gewinnen! Arbeite mit den anderen zusammen und halte die Bühne genau im Blick – denn nicht alles ist so, wie es scheint.

How far can you go down?
Swap, match, and take risks! On each turn, you'll have to make decisions to lower the points on your grid. Form trios to clear columns, activate powerful special effects, and seize the right moment to end the round. Will you take a chance to get an even lower score, or will you end the round before your opponents get ahead of you?
A number card game based on the classic Golf.

pr.m: Dice Placement, Modular Board, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Im antiken Rom sind die Götter mächtig, launisch und voller Intrigen. Als ehrgeizige Senatoren ist es eure Pflicht, den Pax Deorum - den heiligen Frieden mit den Göttern - aufrecht zu erhalten. Dazu entsendet ihr eure Boten in die Tempel des Pantheons, um ihnen zu huldigen und um ihre Macht für euch zu nutzen. Doch eure Rivalen verfolgen das gleiche Ziel - Zwist, Neid und falsches Spiel beherrschen das politische Parkett.

Und so wird derjenige Senator siegen, der am cleversten von den Aktionen seiner Mitspieler profitiert oder diese im perfekten Moment sabotiert.

Loyalty - Rome ist ein strategisches, interaktives Spiel. Die Basis bilden Götterkarten, die im Pantheon ausliegen. Es müssen Mehrheiten gebildet werden, um die Karten zu werten. Da dies obligatorisch ist, führt es dazu, dass…

pr.m: Area Control, Dice Placement, Dice Rolling
pr.d:
The number 8 is considered the luckiest number in Chinese culture. You will compete with others to accumulate the most wealth and fortune.
Place your dice on one of the 4 bet mats to steadily earn coins while blocking opponents to do the same. Change your dice fortunes by purchasing yun cards or go for the big payout by playing the jackpot.
There are limited koban coins in the pot so it's a race against time to be the richest person at the table!

Lucky Cat
500 Teile | 34 × 48 cm
Lucky Cat ist eines von 10 neuen Motiven der Sunshine Puzzles Collection, die diesen Herbst erscheinen.
Im Mittelpunkt steht eine farbenfrohe Glückskatze, umgeben von traditionellen Glückssymbolen wie goldenen Münzen und Sternen. Klare Linien, kräftige Farben und zahlreiche grafische Details machen Lucky Cat zu einem modernen und charaktervollen Puzzlemotiv.

A basket full of balls of wool?
It’s the perfect place for kittens to play!
Use your paw to pull on the most enticing thread and be the first to complete their collection... but don’t get knotted up, or else your plans for victory will unravel!

pr.m: Action Selection, Hidden Roles, Push your Luck, Roll'n'Write, Traitor, Trick taking, Others
pr.d:
Not all resurrections are holy.
Not light. Not salvation. Not grace.
It is power.
A power that demands a price:
your memories, the years of your life, or something far more intimate…
Step into the Coven. Answer the call.
Lust Sabbath awaits you.

Lust Sabbath is an erotic and ritual tabletop RPG based on the Last Sabbath — the Witches’ RPG System where power demands a price and the story is driven by Tarot reading, with no Game Master.
• Play as Succubuses, Desire Witches, Sanguine Sisters, or Gothic Nuns.

• Shape the narrative through Rituals, Divinations, and Temptations.

• Sacrifice memories, years of your life… or something more intimate.

• Playable solo or cooperatively (perfect for couples).

Players are called to write the story of their Coven in a shared Diary. The rules are…

Welcome to the most luxurious birthday party of the year aboard the yacht "Eclipse Noir". Then the unthinkable happens: blood is found on the sun deck, one of the guests has vanished - and the captain is missing too.
Every player takes on a role, dresses up and plays it all evening. No app, no game master, no preparation: open the box, hand out the character booklets and start. For 4 to 6 players aged 16 and up.

pr.a: Matthias Jünemann, Hannes Bonzheim, Stephanie Heyl
pr.d:
Länder toppen!
In diesem spannenden Stichspiel tretet ihr mit 180 beeindruckenden Ländern auf der ganzen Welt gegeneinander an!
Vergleicht in jeder Runde Fläche, Einwohner, höchste Erhebung, Temperatur und Lebenserwartung – und staunt, welches Land den höchsten Berg hat! Das Clevere daran: Auch mit kleinen Werten könnt ihr groß abräumen! Nur wenn ihr die gewonnen Stiche klug ablegt, könnt ihr ordentlich Punkte abstauben.
Mit faszinierenden Fotos, spannenden Fakten und verblüffenden Zahlen entdeckt ihr spielerisch die Weltt.
Das ist drin:
180 Tierkarten
5 Match-Streifen
Spielanleitung

Im ransanten Partyspiel Lückenfüller von Exploding Kittens ist es euer Ziel, die Lücke auf der Karte so zu vervollständigen, dass ihr exakt dasselbe sagt wie euer Buddy.
Klingt einfach? Du und deine Buddies glaubt, ihr denkt immer dasselbe – bis ihr ein Dutzend Karten durchgeht und es trotzdem nicht schafft, gleichzeitig „Käse“ zu sagen …
So funktioniert’s: Startet den Timer, der zufällig zwischen 20 und 75 Sekunden läuft. Schau dir mit deinem Buddy die Karte an und vervollständigt gleichzeitig die Lücke. Versucht, exakt dasselbe zu sagen, und gebt die Verantwortung schnell an die nächsten weiter. Denn steht der Kartenhalter noch vor euch, wenn der Timer abläuft, verliert ihr beide ein Leben! Wer keine Lebensmarker mehr hat, scheidet aus. Spielt so lange weiter, bis nur noch eine Person…

MANIPULATION - ALLIANCES - DECEPTION.
The friendliest treason game!
The enigmatic Cuckoo Island, lost in the middle of the Pacific Ocean, is ruled by the 7 members of the Council of the Wise.
As evil spirits of the Island, you must tighten your grip and the influence you hold over the Council members in order to accomplish your darkest plans. Beware, for you cannot act alone... nor directly...
MAD is a game of influence, alliances and treason. Players try to influence 3 council members but need to do so through other players' actions.
On a turn, a player chooses an Influence card and gives it to another player. They order which Council Member should receive that card. If that player agrees, they place the card face-down on that character... or they can place it on any other character…

pr.k: 870:MCA01 MARVEL: CRISIS PROTOCOL ALLIANCES: NIGHT OF THE GOBLIN
pr.t: MCA01 Marvel: Crisis Protocol Alliances: Night of the Goblin
pr.o: MCA01 MARVEL: CRISIS PROTOCOL ALLIANCES: NIGHT OF THE GOBLIN
pr.d: Marvel: Crisis Protocol Alliances – Night of the Goblin is a cooperative adventure game for up to four players. Players work together to thwart each of the Green Goblin's sinister plots throughout the city, but stopping this nefarious villain won't be easy. Players will have to fight their way through hordes of minions including the numerous Goblin Army goons, robotic Spider-Slayers, and deadly War Goblins. As players defeat enemies and complete each encounter, they will earn valuable experience, allowing them to level up and customize their hero with new and more powerful abilities. Abilities they will certainly need in order to triumph in their ultimate showdown with the Green Goblin himself!

pr.m: Area Control, Auction, Modular Board, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Microlonies is an asymmetric strategy game in which each player controls a unique ant species, striving to ensure the survival and dominance of its colony.
The game is played on a modular map representing the insect micro-world: hunting grounds, strategic areas, environmental bonuses, and a highly contested central termite mound. Each player begins with their own anthill, the core from which their colony expands.
The game features 16 ant species, all fully asymmetric, each with its own rules, strengths, limitations, and playstyle. Mastering your species while understanding the behavior and threats of others is key to success.
Throughout the game, players will:
Deploy ants to claim hunting zones
Take advantage of environmental bonuses
Complete species-specific objectives
Adapt to the…

pr.m: Area Control, Push your Luck, Others
pr.d:
TOSSIT Mini Darts: big fun, small format
The full TOSSIT feeling in a format that fits in any pocket. Same game principle, same addictive fun, just smaller and always within reach.
The best part: anything becomes the Jack, the target you aim at. The beer bottle on the table? Target. The fridge door? Target. And whoever throws the furthest off pays for the next round. The Mini Darts turn any object into a playing field and bring their own game variant.
Perfect as a party game on the go and just as good at home at the dinner table with the whole family. The suction cup darts stick to any smooth surface, just like their big siblings, safe, no sharp tips, no scratches. Explained in 30 seconds, set up in seconds, for every skill level.
Highlights

Mogeln macht Spaß und hier ist es auch noch erlaubt! Deshalb gibt es unsere Mo gel Motte jetzt in der Deluxe-Version mit Holzwanze und spannenden Zusatzkarten. Das Ziel bleibt: Durch geschicktes Schummeln und cleveres Ablegen zuerst alle Karten loswerden!

Mit „Was tue ich?“, „Finde etwas!“ und „Mach es nach!“ präsentiert Noris drei abwechslungsreiche Kartenspiele für Kinder ab 4 Jahren. Die leicht verständlichen Spielideen laden zum Darstellen, Entdecken und Bewegen ein und eignen sich für zu Hause, unterwegs oder für Kita-Gruppen.

Bei „Was tue ich?“ stellen die Kinder Begriffe pantomimisch dar, während die Mitspieler erraten, welche Tätigkeit gesucht wird. „Finde etwas!“ macht die Umgebung zum Suchfeld: Passend zur gezogenen Motivkarte gilt es, einen entsprechenden Gegenstand zu entdecken. You've Built Your City, Now Build Your Life
You’ve built the perfect town. Now it’s time to build the perfect life! Chase big dreams, invest in hobbies, throw parties, change careers, and see where your choices take you. Every card you add shapes the story of your life as you try to create something truly fulfilling.
On your turn, roll one or two dice to see which of your cards earn you hearts. Hearts are your money, and you’ll use them to buy new Life cards that generate income and Dream cards that bring you closer to winning. Some cards help you. Some cards affect everyone at the table. The first player to collect 8 VIP points from Dream cards wins and proves they’ve built the most successful life.

pr.d:
Roll with your paws but think with your claws!
Mad Cat Sad Cat is a dice game with barely any downtime. Either it is your turn to roll the dice and create poker combinations. Or you try to mooch off of the dice roller's success by predicting which dice they will set aside.
In both cases, you want to play to your own outs as much as you want to outwit your opponents.

Erlebt den erbitterten Wettstreit zwischen Leonardo da Vinci und Michelangelo
In den italienischen Stadtstaaten des frühen 16. Jahrhunderts bedeutete Kunst nicht nur Schönheit, sondern auch Macht.

Die Ateliers konkurrierten heftig um Ansehen, während die Künstler unermüdlich daran arbeiteten, Meisterwerke – von großartigen Fresken bis hin zu Marmorstatuen – zu erschaffen, wobei jedes Werk ein Ausdruck ihres Könnens und ihrer Vision war.

Ihr unterstützt die konkurrierenden Ateliers von Leonardo da Vinci und Michelangelo Buonarroti, um Ruhm und Aufmerksamkeit des Adels an verschiedenen Höfen und in Galerien auf der gesamten italienischen Halbinsel zu erlangen.

pr.o: MAFIA – EXPANDED PARTY GAME WITH ADDITIONAL ROLES
pr.d:
Mafia is a social deduction party game of hidden roles, bluffing, accusations and strategy for large groups.
Players secretly receive different roles and must discover who can be trusted. The Mafia works together in secret, while Citizens try to identify and eliminate them before it is too late.
This expanded version adds extra characters and special abilities, creating more unpredictable rounds and giving experienced players new ways to bluff, investigate, protect, manipulate and deceive.
Roles include the Mafia Boss, Mistress, Sheriff, Maniac, Citizens and other special characters, each with a different objective or ability.
The game is designed for large groups and works especially well for parties, events and game nights where discussion and player interaction are the main focus.

pr.d:
Carry your Commander deck and accessories in one compact sideloading box.
The budget-friendly Soft Crate 100+ XL Sideloading combines a Commander-size deck box with an integrated token box. Both are equipped with a unique smart click-lock mechanism, keeping their contents securely stored.
The Soft Crate holds up to 100 double-sleeved cards in extra Thick Inner Sleeves for the Commander format, alternatively it can fit up to 120 single-sleeved cards. The additional included token box stores dice, counters, and other small accessories.

pr.k: 739:MAGIC: THE GATHERING | REALITY FRACTURE SOFT DYNACRATE 100+ XL - FACE YOURSELF
pr.t: Magic: The Gathering | Reality Fracture Soft Dynacrate 100+ XL - Face Yourself
pr.o: MAGIC: THE GATHERING | REALITY FRACTURE SOFT DYNACRATE 100+ XL - FACE YOURSELF
pr.d:
The FIRST EVER deck box that fully adapts to your deck!
The ingenious Soft Dynacrate 100+ XL is a unique product on the market: It includes our successful Sizemorph® Divider that perfectly adapts to the amount of cards inside the box. This makes it perfect for players who want to store standard size decks with token cards and sideboard, OR players with a double-sleeved Commander deck of 100 cards. On top of that, the Soft Dynacrate 100+ XL has an innovative self-lock mechanism, keeping cards securly locked in during transportation. It is fully printed with vibrant, officially licensed artwork from the game.

pr.t: Magic: The Gathering | Reality Fracture Squire PLUS 100+ XL - Overwrite the Multiverse

pr.d:
The Art Squire PLUS 100+ XL is a premium deck box featuring officially licensed artwork from the game, showcased on a full-color printed Refractifyber surface with high visual impact.
It offers a clear innovation: display your Top Card or Commander without opening the box. The included Slide Card Case keeps your card UV-protected, easily visible for deck recognition, and can be detached for use during gameplay — keeping your card protected at all times. The box holds 100 double-sleeved cards, even with extra thick inner sleeves, or 100 regular double-sleeved cards with additional space for token cards. Equipped with our highly rated Convertible System, the removable cover clips onto the bottom of the box, saving table space and allowing easy card access during play.
