They aren't fast. They aren't clever. They just keep coming – out of basements, out of sewers, out of apartments where nobody has turned on a light in weeks. For every one you drop, two more come shuffling.
And while you're still swinging, the one thing you really need is…

NONSTOP CARDS – The modern card game with an app
If you love classic categories games, you'll love NONSTOP CARDS: a fast, funny and creative word game with letter cards, the classic categories game reinvented with an app.
Instead of reading long rules or playing the same questions over and over, you just open the app, deal the cards and go. The app guides you through the game, reads out fresh topics automatically, and keeps things moving with a timer and playful twists that bring speed, surprises and plenty of laughter to the table.
Your task: find words that match the topic and start with the letters on your cards. Think fast, get creative, come up with the right words – and you'll be the first to get rid of your cards and win.
Quick to learn, different every time
NONSTOP CARDS is…

In Nacht im Zoo sind die Tiere nach Einbruch der Dunkelheit ausgebüxt und brauchen Hilfe, um zurück in ihre Gehege zu finden, bevor die Tierpfleger etwas bemerken. Die Spieler wählen Plättchen aus und legen sie an, um Wege zurück nach Hause zu bauen. Dabei hat jedes Tier seine eigenen Bewegungsregeln und Wertungsbedingungen.

Nachzügler erweitert Nacht im Zoo um vier neue Tierarten: Krokodile, Affen, Erdmännchen und Schildkröten, die jeweils neue Bewegungsrätsel mit sich bringen. Die Erweiterung lässt die Grundregeln unverändert, sorgt aber für mehr Abwechslung und zusätzliche Herausforderungen. Zum Spielen wird das Grundspiel Nacht im Zoo benötigt.

Nakasendo is a strategic tile-laying game inspired by the historic route that connected Edo (modern-day Tokyo) to Kyoto during Japan’s Edo period.
Build your own journey between Tsumago and Magome by placing path tiles, adding discoveries, and shaping the most harmonious route through mountains, cedar forests, and ancient post towns.
Along the way, seasonal events will bring snow and bears onto the trail, forcing you to adapt your plans and rethink your scoring opportunities. Careful planning is essential, as intermediate scoring conditions change throughout the game and every decision can influence the final outcome.
At the end of the journey, only the most rewarding path will lead to victory.

Nameless Land: Apocalypse Box is a post-apocalyptic tabletop role-playing game set three centuries after nuclear war devastated the planet, forcing humanity to rebuild among the ruins of the Old World.
Inspired by the brutal wastelands of Fallout and Mad Max, Nameless Land takes players to the year 2365, where survival means facing raiders, mutants, radiation, scarce resources and the terrifying biomechanical armies threatening what remains of humanity.
Explore the ruins of the Old World, scavenge forgotten cities, modify your weapons, build and customize vehicles, establish trade agreements between settlements, join factions and religions, and venture into radioactive wastelands where every expedition can become a fight for survival.
Powered by a percentile-based system, Nameless Land…

The engines are starting to roar! At the starting line, the drivers are getting ready to push the limits of the track, aware of the danger that lies in every turn and knowing that courage is their most valuable asset. In this race, the drivers must balance and manage tire wear and fuel consumption, juggling speed with the conservation of resources.
Designed by Ferran Renalias and Guillem Coll and illustrated by Meeple Foundry, in Nascard, 1 to 6 players drive a vehicle in a NASCAR race over two laps, with the goal of crossing the finish line first and winning the race.
To move their vehicle, drivers will use cards from their hand. If they play the trump suit (which is revealed at the start of each round), they’ll engage in aggressive driving, burning rubber and advancing several spaces…

pr.m: Area Control, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Set Collection
pr.d: NATERA ist ein strategisches Aufbau- und Erkundungsspiel, in dem intelligente Tierstämme die Ruinen der Menschheit erforschen und um die Vorherrschaft in einer neuen Welt konkurrieren.

In the Nature Scenario Module “Amazon Rainforest,” a surprise lurks behind every leaf. Here, species conceal their traits until they strike with deadly poison or powerful jaws. But those who can climb will find shelter and fruit in the canopy. For everyone who likes to bluff and loves surprises!

The Arctic Tundra habitat module in Nature is bitterly cold. Sparse vegetation and extremely low temperatures push species to their limits. A number of new features give them at least a chance to survive in the unforgiving tundra. For anyone looking for a real challenge!

In the Nature expansion module Climate, the various species must adapt to temperatures ranging from scorching heat to freezing cold. A climate change once again puts the resilience of each individual species to the test. For epic stories about life on Earth!

In the Nature expansion module, Flight, players take to the skies! Protected by their ability to fly and equipped with additional new features, they set off for the “Distant Place” and may soon return with offspring. For everyone who prefers to avoid conflict!
In the Nature: Jurassic module, players create giant dinosaurs with new (hunting) traits. For anyone who prefers an aggressive playstyle.

In the Nature expansion module, Natural Disasters, players must brace themselves for disasters of epic proportions! At the end of each round, dangers such as volcanic eruptions, floods, or even the next ice age lurk. For everyone who loves games that give rise to stories!

pr.a: Benyi Heider, Markus Springer, Christian Sedlmeier, Kevin Probst
pr.d:
Ahoi, ihr Landratten! Wagt ihr das Abenteuer, durch die sieben Weltmeere zu segeln?
Die Winde stehen günstig, doch keiner weiß, welche Überraschungen hinter dem Horizont warten.
Welche Crew bringt ihre Flotte zuerst in den sicheren Zielhafen? Auf hoher See beginnt ein spannendes Wettrennen: Ihr steuert eure Schiffe Richtung Hafen, tauscht geheim Karten mit eurem Crewmember und setzt Aktionskarten ein, um die Überfahrt der anderen so stürmisch wie möglich zu machen.
Doch nehmt euch in Acht: Stürme wirbeln die Karten durcheinander, trügerische Untiefen lauern hinter jeder Welle – und über allem zieht Moby Dick seine Bahnen. Ein falscher Zug, und der Wal schickt euer Schiff zurück an den Anfang.
Der Ozean ist voller Gefahren und stellt eure Navigationskünste auf die Probe. Nur wer seine…

Near – Echoes of Civilizations invites you to write 3,000 years of antiquity… Or rather, to rewrite them, drawing inspiration from real-world civilizations, discoveries, and significant historical events. All of this in just 3 eras of 4 turns!
The game’s mechanics revolve around its cards. Play two per turn to trigger the following effects:
– Develop five Domains (Transportation, Trade, Military, Religion, Production).
– Make history with an event or a discovery (card effect).
– Build your structures on the World board and maximize their effects.
In addition to the points earned during the game, scoring phases will take place at the end of each age and at the end of the game, based on your civilization and its achievements.
It’s up to you to make history!

Near – Echoes of Civilizations invites you to write 3,000 years of antiquity… Or rather, to rewrite them, drawing inspiration from real-world civilizations, discoveries, and significant historical events. All of this in just 3 eras of 4 turns!

The game’s mechanics revolve around its cards. Play two per turn to trigger the following effects:
– Develop five Domains (Transportation, Trade, Military, Religion, Production).
– Make history with an event or a discovery (card effect).
– Build your structures on the World board and maximize their effects.

In addition to the points earned during the game, scoring phases will take place at the end of each age and at the end of the game, based on your civilization and its achievements.

It’s up to you to make history!

Gather the power of the entire universe to create a new star! Play cards in sets and runs, aiming to reach 5 points before your opponent in each round. The winner of the round claims a star fragment, and the first to collect 4 fragments wins.
Inside the Box : 52 cards, player aid cards (56 x 87 mm), 7 star fragments

Four hourglasses with different running times are hidden under cups. On their turn, a player uses a colored die to identify one of them and guesses whether its sand has run out. If they think it's still running, they say "No," do nothing, and pass the die. But... they could be wrong!
Doubters who "sense the end of time" shout "Yes!" and prove that this hourglass has already run out of sand. To do this, they lift the cup and... "Ohh!"... only time is ever right!
The hourglasses are turned over after each "test"—even if they are still running. The colored die also ensures that the hidden timers constantly change positions. This blurs the lines between space and time in some players' minds. True time management is rewarded with victory at the end of the game.

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board
pr.d: Nemesis: Retaliation puts a squad of battle-hardened marines into a cinematic science-fiction horror mission against overwhelming alien forces. Players must complete objectives and survive the Xeno threat while never being completely sure whether their comrades can be trusted.

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board
pr.d: The Stretch Goals box expands Nemesis: Retaliation with three additional modules: the Neoflesh Cult, the Insider storyline, and Contractors. Together they add new enemies, narrative twists, and returning characters that broaden the game's scenarios and replayability.

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board
pr.d: The Sangrevores expansion introduces a cunning new alien species led by the ominous Sangrevore King, supported by Blood Spirits and hordes of ghouls. Infection and Blood Gift mechanics create hidden dangers and tempting powers, increasing paranoia throughout the mission.

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board
pr.d: The Support Squad expansion adds two new marine characters: the UAV Operator and the Sharpshooter. Their specialized reconnaissance and long-range combat abilities give a Retaliation team new tactical options.

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board
pr.d: The Xyrians expansion adds a sophisticated alien faction that acts as a dangerous third party in Nemesis: Retaliation. Camouflage, mimicry, event manipulation, and sabotage make it difficult to know who or what can be trusted.

Welcome to Nenuphar Jazz, the board game where you become the manager of a talented frog band! Every night, the swamp transforms into a vibrant stage where the finest jazz talents improvise their melodies. In the mysterious wetlands of Louisiana, your frogs are ready to embark on an exciting quest for instruments and form the most spectacular jazz band ever to conquer New Orleans.

Fire is the ultimate cleansing tool: everything that has come into contact with sickness must burn. These pyromaniacs and extremists purify the cities by burning away disease and eradicating corruption. They travel from city to city, laying waste to the streets with their ruthless flames. If there is any sign of contamination, they will not hesitate to set cars ablaze—or even buildings full of people—because in their eyes the sick are already dead, and they are doing humanity a favour by stopping the spread. The Purifiers are devoted to their goal, and if anyone or anything gets in the way, it will burn too.
Neuroshima Hex: Purifiers is a new faction expansion to the best-selling Portal Games evergreen title Neuroshima Hex. The strength of this army is its ability to blanket the board in…

The city of Berlin is looking for the best architect to optimize its transport network. Develop your different lines by making the best use of your interchanges. Connect the two sides of the city by linking your lines together to accumulate as many points as possible!
This is the German edition of Next Station Berlin, originally published by Blue Orange.

The vampires and werewolves are fighting to rule the night.
To win, get 3 of your tiles in a horizontal, vertical or diagonal line.
• Improves your forward thinking and strategic switching.

• Each turn, you must choose between flipping or eliminating an opponent’s tiles!

• Engaging graphic design for deep thrilling gameplay.

You have wandered into a world of dreams, and now you must escape from the Dream Phantoms!

Night Parade is a thrilling card game where you must trust your luck and probability as you flip cards.

On your turn, you choose whether to add cards or take a chance and flip cards.

If you reveal a Golden Lantern Card, it's a huge success! You can pass the Phantoms to another player. But if you fail, the Phantoms stay with you...

Avoid collecting too many Phantoms and being eliminated, and try to survive until the very end by passing them on to others!

The animals have secretly escaped the zoo for a night-time adventure—but now they must find their way back before the keepers notice! Guide them through the darkened zoo by drafting and placing tiles, creating the best routes home and making clever use of each animal's unique abilities. Every game offers new tactical choices and fresh challenges.
Night at the Zoo is an accessible strategy game by Tomáš Holek (SETI, Tea Garden, Galileo Galilei), featuring beautiful artwork by Tereza Kovandová.

The Latecomers expansion adds variety to the Night at the zoo game with 4 new animals — a crocodile, meerkat, monkey, and turtle — each bringing its own unique movement pattern. The core gameplay stays the same while offering fresh new challenges and combinations.

In Night at the Zoo, animals have slipped out after dark and need help finding their way back before the keepers notice. Players draft and place tiles to build routes home, with each animal following its own movement rules and scoring conditions.

Latecomers adds four new animals to Night at the Zoo: crocodiles, monkeys, meerkats and turtles, each bringing new movement puzzles. The expansion keeps the base rules intact while increasing variety and challenge; Night at the Zoo is required.

Unfold the ghost ship pop-up!
A terrifying legend circulates among pirate crews: a ghost ship keeps sailing the seas, carrying a huge treasure. You might try to claim it but if you fail the trials and can’t solve the enigma, you will join the crew… as one of the dead. Do you dare unfold the map?

Each fox begins with one tail. If a fox gains a total of nine tails, it ascends and becomes a kami. The first player to have helped three foxes ascend wins the game. During your turn, you can either reveal new cards that will form a village, or pick up one of these cards (which will give the foxes a tail or make them wiser by giving them extra traits). At the end of your turn, other players will have the possibility to play Trickery cards, to interfere with your plans or allow them to play some abilities outside of their own turn.

Selbstsicher und eloquent tänzelt ihr durch jeden Partyspiele-Abend?
Ihr seid Experten in Sachen Erklären und Erraten? Na, wenn ihr meint …
In NIX DA! verbieten wir euch nur einen einzigen Buchstaben - und schon verhaspelt ihr euch wie beim ersten Date!

In this hard-fought duel, you build magnificent towers by offering each other Building cards. But beware: if someone slips you a card that causes one of your towers to overshoot its target, a seemingly secure round can quickly be lost.

No Shelf Control - The Book Lover’s Game
Do you love books, but your shelves are bursting at the seams? With the card game No Shelf Control, you can tackle the chaos in a playful way! Stack your bookshelves by matching colours and collect decorative items for bonus points. But be careful: if you stack too high, you risk making the whole shelf collapse. With its clever mix of strategy and humour, this game brings together book lovers who know the never-ending space problem only too well.
• Book love: A creative game that presents the challenges of stacking books in a fun way

• For 2 to 5 players: Ideal for small groups and sociable game nights

• Fun for the whole family: Perfect for children aged 8 and up, teenagers and adults who love books

• Playing time of 15 minutes: Quick, exciting…

Wer bei „Nobody is perfect Music Edition“ merkwürdige und skurrile Fakten über Musik und Bands glaubwürdig erklärt, kuriose Ereignisse überzeugend weiterspinnt und Zitate von Musikerinnen und Musikern genial vervollständigt, hat die besten Chancen auf den Sieg. Das witzige Musik-Quiz-Partyspiel eignet sich perfekt für 3 bis 6 Spieler.

Wer weiß schon, was mit "Dizi" gemeint ist? Welche Sängerin hat 13 Geschwister? Und welches Instrument hat jedes Jahr im April einen Feiertag? Welcher Musiker hatte einen Puma als Haustier? Wer keine Ahnung hat, dafür aber auf alles eine Antwort aus dem Ärmel schüttelt, ist hier genau richtig. Denn auch hier gilt: Wer besser spinnt, gewinnt. Kreativ sein und einen tollen Musik-Spieleabend mit Freunden haben.

Das geniale Spiel mit Suchtfaktor bekommt zum 10-jährigen Jubiläum „NOCH MAL!®“ Nachschub! Wer schafft es zuerst seine 10 Chips loszuwerden? Dies ist über das bewährte vervollständigen von Spalten und Zeilen möglich. Aber auch über ganz neue Bereiche sowie die innovative Pass-Leiste. „NOCH X-MAL!®“ bleibt in den Grundregeln einfach wie das Original, aber bietet viel Neues zum Entdecken. Für alle „NOCH MAL!®“-Fans ein absolutes MUSS
This is the German edition of Can of Worms, originally published by FoxMind.
This is the German edition of Nokosu Dice, originally published by EnGames.

In 19th-century North America, players take on the roles of wealthy entrepreneurs investing in the dawn of the railway industry. As each company’s rail network expands to reach the remote corners of the continent, players seek to maximize their profits by purchasing shares. Experience an economic game that combines simple rules with profound strategic depth.

Inside the Box : 30 share cards(44 x 67 mm), 41 city cards(44 x 67 mm), paper money(44 x 67 mm), 10 company tokens, starting player marker

pr.m: Engine Building, Tile Placement, Worker Placement
pr.d: In our new expert-level game, we’re taking you to Iceland: You’ll lead an exciting reforestation research project. To do so, you’ll need to effectively manage your own settlement next to the growing forest: Plant cabbage and tomatoes, and raise sheep and Icelandic horses. Invest in research and launch promising projects. Find the best way to balance agriculture with forest growth.

Per-Order NOW!!
Dump the problem before the Llama gets you!

Play a bigger combo or PASS. Sounds easy... until passing forces you to draw. The stronger the combo you pass on, the more cards you must draw. Somewhere in the deck are deadly Llamas. Draw one, and you're instantly out! Simple rules, zero mercy. Slam huge combos onto your friends and watch the chaos unfold. As players get dragged out one by one, can you be the last one laughing?

The gate to the vegetable patch has been left open! Did someone say free food?! The race is on, but not so fast—the early bird won’t necessarily catch the worm! Keep your team color hidden from your opponents and look out for the right moment to break away from the pack! Slow and steady scores the points!

pr.a: Patrick Saber, Ryan Chedrawi, Anthony Attieh, Edmond Rizk
pr.m: Action Selection, Drafting, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d:
MAKE THE HANGRY PENGUIN THEIR PROBLEM.
Not This Penguin is a card game of strategy, sabotage, and bluffing. Every round, scheme, read other players, and redirect the chaos so hangry penguin ends up with the other team.

Each round is played in 3 phases:
- Phase 1 - Choose your giveaway card: pick 1 secret card to give to the player on your left. Will it be the hangry penguin?
- Phase 2 - Play penguin powers: take turns playing cards to peek, steal, swap, bounce, and mess with where the Hangry Penguin ends up.
- Phase 3 - Pass the cards - giveaway cards move left. Whoever ends up with the hangry penguin feeds it a fish or faces its wrath.

How to win: when someone who no longer has a fish ends up with the hangry penguin, they lose and the other team wins.

Hier wird‘s richtig bunt: 480 Farben warten bei „Nuancen“ darauf, möglichst genau beschrieben und erkannt zu werden. Der Wiener Spieleverlag Piatnik bringt mit der deutschen Ausgabe des interna­tionalen Bestsellers „Hues and Cues“ Farbe selbst in graue Herbst- und Wintertage und kurbelt Kreati­vität und Sprachgewandtheit an.

Wie beschreibt man Farben in nur einem Wort? Bei „Nuancen“ kommen die Gehirnzellen ganz schön in Fahrt, denn die vielen Schattierungen zwischen Rot, Grün, Blau und Gelb machen das farbenfrohe Ratespiel von Autor Scott Brady zu einer besonderen Herausforderung. Die individuelle Wahrnehmung und Zu­ordnung von Farben steht im Mittelpunkt und verlangt gleichzeitig präzise sprachliche Assoziationen.
Auf die Farbe, fertig, los! Die Regeln von „Nuancen“ sind schnell…

pr.m: Engine Building, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Under the bright Andalusian sun stands Níjar, a town in Almería with a pottery tradition dating back to the Bronze Age that flourished during the Muslim period.
In the 1920s, before the tourism boom, the local economy revolved around pottery and the production of esparto and jarapas, colorful woven fabrics that remain a symbol of the area.
Experience the charm of rural Andalusia, with its whitewashed streets, the sound of pottery workshops, and the skilled hands of artisans who bring the traditions of Níjar to life.

Each constellation tells a story — its distinctive arrangement of stars reflecting the mythology, values, and imagination of the civilization that defined it.
Modern astronomers refine our star maps with advanced technology, while continuing that timeless quest to understand our place in the cosmos.

pr.a: Atropo Kelevra, Andrea Rossi, Atropo Kelevra, Errico Borro, Valentino Sergi, Tellers From The Crypt, Coboldo Channel
pr.m: Action Selection, Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler
pr.d:
The Siege Pack includes all the handbooks and exclusive game materials from the Black Tales series, ensuring a truly epic gaming experience!
• Odyssey - Black Tales + Map Pack

• Troy - Black Tales + Map Pack

• Black Tales – Adventures in the Mediterranean & Conversion Kit + Maps

• Set of 10 flat character minis

• 3D miniature of the Trojan Horse [4 inches / 10 cm.]

• Set of 36 Tokens

• Velvet pouch

• Dice tray

• Game Master Screen

• Set of 4 Dice

Odyssey - Black Tales is a rules-light tabletop RPG for 1, 2 or more players. You will be part of Ulysses' crew, the greatest liar in history, and rank in his small army of marauders. Will you partake in the pillaging of the Mediterranean or will you risk your life in an attempt to protect the peoples of the Great Sea? The choice is…

Oracles - Soothsayers is a tactical and psychological card game for 2 to 5 players, inspired by the Major Arcana of the tarot. Each player manipulates cards to lead a suit or follow, capture tarot cards, and increase the power of the Minor Arcana to influence the course of the game.
The unique powers of the Arcana allow players to manipulate hands, control the pace of play, and disrupt their opponents’ strategies. Each turn presents critical decisions: play to capture, set up a sequence, or wait for the perfect moment to reveal a decisive card.
Easy to learn yet deeply strategic, Oracles offers fast-paced games where reading the table, timing, and bluffing make all the difference. The fate is written in the cards… but only the most skilled will know how to interpret it.

What you see is not what you build!
Puzzlide: Oz is a 1000-piece interactive puzzle game where completing the jigsaw is only the beginning. Once assembled, use the included 40 game cards to search for characters, objects and hidden details throughout the illustration.
But there is another surprise: some areas of the completed puzzle are different from the image shown on the box. Discover what has changed, explore the unexpected scenes and solve all the search challenges hidden in the wonderful world of Oz.
Build the puzzle. Search the image. Discover the unexpected.

pr.k: 748:OAKSPIRE: THE BUILDERS OF THE SUNLEAF GROVE
pr.t: Oakspire: The Builders of the Sunleaf Grove
pr.o: OAKSPIRE: THE BUILDERS OF THE SUNLEAF GROVE
pr.m: Action Selection, Drafting, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d:
It's time to build, Architect!
Welcome to Sunleaf Grove, where a community of animal residents work paw-in-paw/fin/hoof/claw to build a home in harmony with nature – and they need your help!
As a Grove Architect, you’ll plan projects, organize supply lines, and transform timber into beautiful, sustainable structures. Gather fallen wood from the forest floor, float it downstream, shape it into sturdy planks, and raise buildings of every size – from snug burrows to towering treetop apartments.
Collect, craft, build: it's a peaceful, puzzle-y cycle!
Oakspire is a cozy tableau-building game where you'll carefully select Project Cards that represent different stages of wood crafting. These cards can be used in a multitude of ways: Turn them into Reclaimed Wood to fuel your production chain,…

In Octobuns, you serve hungry guests using fresh ingredients and luxury buns to fulfill their orders. Gather the right ingredients, turn them into delicious sandwiches, and complete the harbor guests’ orders this way. Just make sure the ingredients are served in the correct order — otherwise your guests won’t like them. For every completed order you earn coins, which will lead you to victory as the most successful octopus!
The goal of Octobuns is to complete orders as quickly as possible. As soon as someone has completed 5 orders, the game ends. On their turn, players may choose one of four different actions and perform it.
First, a player can take an ingredient from the market in the center of the table and add it to their bakery. If you take an ingredient that can be combined with one…

Odd Logic is the family party game where everyone sees the same picture cards but makes their own connections, making it perfect for entertaining game nights. Players create their own picture pairings and explanations based on the same five cards, then identify the card that doesn’t belong. Players score points when their logic matches. Super easy to learn and simple to play, Odd Logic is guaranteed to spark hilarious debates and plenty of laughter.

After ten long years of war against the Trojans, the victorious Odysseus hopes at last to return home and reunite with his loved ones in Odysseus.
But the gods have decided otherwise.
On his journey back to Ithaca, a thousand trials await him: sirens, cyclopes, angry gods, and enchanting goddesses... With the help of Athena, guide and protect Odysseus through the obstacles. Each trial is a challenge, each victory a step closer to home.
Your choices will determine his fate.
Become the hero of the most legendary epic of all time.

pr.m: Ressource Management, Set Collection, Tile Placement, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Go treasure hunting with the Coalition of Courageous Critters! Explore the crypt of the legendary pharaoh Mewesess, open secret chambers, gather riches, and assemble the finest expedition.
Place your paws on entrance cards to create paths into the crypt, then remove them to trigger powerful card effects. Manage your food, torches, and pickaxes, hire helpful assistants, and open new chambers to earn glory. Build a diverse expedition and leave your mark on the history of the Coalition!
• Gather resources — Use card effects to collect food, torches, and pickaxes for your expedition.

• Dig into the crypt — Place paws at the entrances and use their intersections to reach new chambers.

• Build your expedition — Open chambers, hire assistants, and earn the most glory!

pr.m: Action Selection, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Take control of an expanding oil company; step into the shoes of a determined leader set on dominating the market, optimizing every phase of the refining chain, and building your reputation to enhance your abilities.
Carefully consider every action you take: position yourself strategically on the action wheel to activate the most effective moves at the right time.
Expand your influence on the map, positioning yourself in key areas to gain exclusive advantages and new development opportunities.
Meanwhile, build new drilling rigs, develop increasingly efficient turbines, and enhance your refineries to increase production efficiency.
Every action you take contributes to your company's growth, transforming your choices into concrete advantages turn after turn.

The restaurant’s kitchen is a disaster and customers keep ordering different kinds of omelettes! In Omelette Express, you have to cook your omelette so that it will be exactly as ordered when you flip it over. Will you be able to complete the challenge before the other players?

In this crazy restaurant, players must be the first to collect 5 or more Order cards to win the game.

All players simultaneously try to correctly cook the omelette shown on their Order card as quickly as possible, placing the required Ingredient tiles into their pan from their own perspective. But be careful! You must visualize how the Ingredient tiles will look once the pan is flipped.

On Point is a game of intuition, visual association, and precise communication.
Five images are placed on a target-shaped board, each connected by sixteen hidden positions. The Clue Giver secretly discovers one of those positions and gives a single-word clue that links two nearby images.
The rest of the team must determine exactly which position was chosen—not just which images the clue refers to, but how strongly it connects them.
Simple clues often lead to surprisingly deep discussions, as every word can suggest different interpretations and subtle nuances.
Play in competitive teams or work together in the cooperative mode, where communication and shared intuition become the key to achieving the highest score.
Every clue is a balancing act between precision, creativity and understanding…

pr.k: 332:ONE CARD DUNGEON ADVENTURE PACK: HELL'S DOOR
pr.t: One Card Dungeon Adventure Pack: Hell's Door
pr.o: ONE CARD DUNGEON ADVENTURE PACK: HELL'S DOOR
pr.m: Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler
pr.d:
In the deepest pits of the underworld, the gates of Hell creak open.
Rivers of fire surge and shadows twist, as the Lord of the Inferno rises to claim his dominion, threatening to engulf the realm in endless torment.
Only those brave enough to descend into the abyss and face him in a final battle can hope to seal Hell’s Door forever.
One Card Dungeon: Hell’s Door is a standalone adventure that follows the same setup and rules as the base game and the M’Guf-yn Returns expansion, with some unique new features.
This expansion adds a dungeon card, a boss level dungeon card, 1 new class, 5 new item cards, and the Stone of Perdiction.

Eigenständige Erweiterung für One Card Dungeon
Das Tor zur Hölle ist geöffnet. Feuerstürme wüten, Schatten winden sich und der Herrscher der Unterwelt erhebt sich, um seine finstere Herrschaft anzutreten. Du musst in den Abgrund hinabsteigen und dich ihm in einer letzten Schlacht entgegenstellen, um das Tor zur Hölle für immer zu versiegeln.

Hell's Door ist die neue Erweiterung zum kompakten Dungeon Crawler One Card Dungeon für 1 Held ab 10 Jahren.
Mit dieser Erweiterung kommen zwei neue Module ins Spiel:

Feuerstürme
Es gibt in jeder Ebene ganz besondere Felder, auf denen Feuerstürme toben. Befindet ihr euch auf einem davon, wenn die Monster an der Reihe sind, dann bekommen sie bestimmte Boni auf ihre Basiswerte!

Der Stein der Verdammnis
Bei dieser Erweiterung gibt es in jedem Level…

Woran denkst du bei Party, Nougat und Paris? Vielleicht Essen oder Tanzen? Hatte jemand denselben Gedanken wie du? Dann gibt es funkelnde Edelsteine! Jede Runde kommt ihr euch gedanklich immer näher, bis ihr am Ende hoffentlich alle an dasselbe denkt

In One Piece: Das Merkspiel versucht ihr, zusammenpassende Paare der ikonischsten One Piece-Charaktere zu finden, bevor es eure Mitspieler tun. Aber Achtung, versucht es den anderen nicht zu einfach zu machen, indem ihr ihnen versehentlich Vorlagen liefert. 50 Karten mit den beliebten Charakteren aus One Piece stellen euch dabei auf die Probe. Mit 2 unterschiedlichen Schwierigkeitsstufen, die euch so richtig herausfordern.

One Word Away ist ein Wortspiel für Partys und Pärchen.
Im Team-Modus bildet ihr zwei Teams und versucht, möglichst viele geheime Wörter zu erraten. Schreibt drei Tipps auf, die helfen, das geheime Wort zu erraten. Doch bevor ihr raten dürft, löscht das andere Team einen Tipp bis auf den Anfangsbuchstaben.
Im kooperativen Modus versucht ihr gemeinsam, acht geheime Wörter zu erraten. Schreibt drei Tipps auf. Die Tipps helfen euren Mitspielenden, eines der geheimen Wörter zu erraten. Aber Achtung: Ein Tipp wird gelöscht.
Gemeinsam den Highscore knacken oder dem anderen Team die Punkte wegschnappen. Ihr seid nur ein Wort von der richtigen Antwort entfernt!

The wolf wants to play with the farm animals, but he knows that they are scared of him. So he has put on his new ‘farm animal’-onesies to trick them… Make the right animal sounds and collect the most cards to win.
• Boost your reaction speed and perception speed.

• Make funny animal sounds or … howl like a wolf!

• When you spot a wolf in onesie card, react differently depending on whether the other open card shows day or night!
This is a German compilation box set of the Onitama base game and all expansion as well as an assortment of promos.

Onsen is a 1–4 player tile-drafting and set-collection game where you race to build the most beloved hot spring resort in Japan — one carefully timed placement at a time.
As the resort's manager, your job is simple: keep every guest happy. Each round, players draft a trio of : tiles – a scented water tile to fill the pools, a guest tile to seat around the edge of your onsen pool, and a special item that provides different abilities. Guests score based on the scents arranged along their row or column, but there's a catch: each guest only arrives on a specific turn. Place them too early, and they show up to an empty pool. Too late, and the moment's already passed.
Marking the passage of time is the shishi-odoshi — a beautifully crafted bamboo deer scare that tips and clacks with every…

Onward: Twisted brings solo and co-op play to Onward, the MOBA board game.
Face up to 32 Twisted heroes and the Twisted Outsiders in a mode compatible with every hero and expansion you own. Onward base game is required to play.

Florence, 15th century.
The greatest cathedral of the Renaissance is under construction, and only the most skilled master builders will leave their mark on history.
Take part in the construction of the Opera Magna and become the most renowned master builder of the Renaissance.
Travel across the markets of the Mediterranean to acquire precious goods, refine them in your workshop, and deliver them to the grand construction site. Every decision shapes your path to glory.
PLAN, BUILD, AND LEAVE YOUR MARK.
Balance workshop upgrades and deliveries to become the most prestigious builder of your age.
AN ELEGANT AND DYNAMIC MARKET SYSTEM
Where the value of resources changes with every action.
Opera Magna is the result of a collaboration between two of the most respected names in the Italian board…

pr.t: Opera Magna: The Eagle & The Lion
pr.o: OPERA MAGNA: THE EAGLE & THE LION
pr.d:
Two new Operas, two new ways to play:
Piazza dei Miracoli and St. Mark's Basilica each introduce a different Worksite layout, dedicated rules, and unique gameplay.

Ihr habt von der Weltraumagentur den Auftrag erhalten, das Sonnensystem mit Lasern zu vermessen. Die Signale werden jedoch reflektiert und verfälscht. Doch Vorsicht! Weltraumphänomene wie Schwarze Löcher und Rotverschiebung können diesen Auftrag verzwickter machen, als es zunächst erscheint.
Nur wer klug kombiniert, Muster erkennt und die richtigen Schlüsse zieht, wird sie am Ende exakt bestimmen können.

pr.m: Action Selection, Dice Rolling, Push your Luck, Set Collection
pr.d:
Orbit Master is a tactical card game in which players choose one of the signs of the Zodiac to restore the celestial order.

The first player to bring the other 11 signs under their house, wins the game and becomes the new orbit master!
The Celestial Orbit that contains the 12 signs of the Zodiac has been ripped apart by the corrupt power of the 13th sign. It is up to you to choose a Sign to master the orbit and bring back order.

Beware, the 13th sign otherwise known as Ophiuchus has the power to poison players and cause a black hole!

In this trick-taking game for two players, you compete for various planets whose influence grows or wanes depending on their distance in orbit.
The twist in this head-to-head game: It’s not the biggest lead that counts, but the smallest. Whoever has the most points at the end wins.

Here's the plan: stack your bumbling orcs up a castle wall and reach the top.
Easy peasy.
Except your opponents had the exact same idea, and they've got boulders, tricks, and a competitive streak a mile wide.
Welcome to Orcs Up!, where controlled chaos is the name of the game.
Every round throws you into a tornado of frantic card plays, stacking, and climbing your way to victory while your tower constantly threatens to crumble.
Victory loves the bold.

Orkney – The Scottish Islands

You sail through the waters off northern Scotland, exploring rugged cliffs and wild coastlines. Place your island tiles carefully, gather valuable resources and build farms, villages and mighty castles. Connect your buildings with trade routes to earn valuable victory points, but in the end, the best strategy will come out on top. Who will keep track of everything, use wool, stone and wood wisely, and complete their secret mission along the way?
• Atmospheric setting: Settle the Scottish Orkney Islands, build trade routes and fish along the coast

• Strategy meets the spirit of exploration: Gather resources, build wisely and connect your buildings with important trade routes

• Family game for 2 to 5 players: Ideal for relaxed game nights with two players or…

pr.a: Abraham Sanchez Hermida, Paloma J. Pascual
pr.d: Component upgrade accessory for Orloj: The Prague Astronomical Clock.

Inspired by the famous Japanese short story The Spider’s Thread (Kumo no Ito) by Ryūnosuke Akutagawa.
Buddha gives a sinner in Hell a chance to escape with a spider’s thread, in return for a small act of kindness: he once spared a spider. But when other sinners climb up behind him, greed takes over. He tries to keep the thread for himself, and it breaks, sending him back to Hell.
OSHAKA Trick is a trick-taking game where every choice matters. Score your cards or take a small penalty to avoid a bigger one later. Winning a trick is not always a good thing!
If you are too greedy, it might be ruined...

pr.t: Oshi Push: Hidden Links TCG Expansion
pr.o: OSHI PUSH: HIDDEN LINKS TCG EXPANSION
pr.d:
Oshi Push is a one-of-a-kind trading card game that puts you in the spotlight as a VTuber competing for online fame. Choose your Persona and build a deck full of unique Content, Action, and Upgrade cards to boost your influence and dominate Platforms.
Your goal? To amass 1,000,000 Subscribers and become the ultimate online sensation!
Each Persona is inspired by the vibrant world of VTubing, with gameplay mechanics that reflect the creativity, strategy, and energy that make VTubers so beloved. Whether you’re producing viral Content, battling for control of Platforms, or upgrading your Persona’s abilities, every turn feels like a new step in your journey to digital stardom.
Hidden Links is the new expansion for Oshi Push, featuring Indie Vtubers and fun new game mechanics, such as Collab…

Wie gut kennt ihr Filme, Musik und euch gegenseitig?
Bei Out of Words: Music & Movies dreht sich alles um Schauspieler, Filmtitel, Künstler und Songs. Doch einfach erklären wäre viel zu leicht: Für jeden Hinweis müsst ihr einen Buchstaben aus der Auslage wählen und genau ein Wortnennen, das mit diesem Buchstaben beginnt.
Ein Spieler kennt den gesuchten Begriff, der Rest des Teams muss ihn erraten. War der erste Tipp daneben? Dann muss ein neuer Buchstabe her und damit auch ein neuer Hinweis. Jeder verwendete Buchstabe bringt euch dem Ende des Spiels näher, weshalb gute Hinweise und ein eingespieltes Team Gold wert sind. Nach spätestens fünf Hinweisen ist die Runde vorbei.
Dabei entscheidet die jeweilige Kategorie, ob ihr einen Schauspieler, einen Filmtitel, einen Künstler oder einen…

pr.a: Mikhail Alexandrov (Candidate of Historical Sciences), Stanislav Krasnov, Olga Ilchenko
pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Area Movement, Ressource Management
pr.d:
The year is 1099. The Crusader armies capture Jerusalem, and new Christian states emerge in the Levant. Twelve years later, the Crusader states are still struggling to secure their lands. The Saracen threat looms over their borders, while rival rulers compete for the favor of the Holy See, control of valuable trade, and influence across the region. Their struggle is far from over…
Outremer is a strategy game for 2–4 players set in the early 12th-century Levant. Take control of Jerusalem, Antioch, Tripoli, or Edessa and lead your state through political rivalry, religious influence, economic development, and war.
Plan your orders, develop and fortify your cities, manage valuable goods, raise armies, employ spies, and expand your influence across the Levant. But every decision must account…

A stifling day in the big city. A lone P.I. prowls the mean streets, trying to keep one step ahead of the cops and rival shamuses. Keep asking questions and trying to piece the evidence together.
P.I. (Second Edition) is a new remake of the legendary deduction classic by Martin Wallace. After 15 years, this classic returns with brand-new artwork, a dedicated two-player mode, and a solo time-attack mode powered by the companion app. Can you uncover all the clues before time runs out?
1. Select the card and get the clue.
2. Place the investigator and find multiple clues.
3. Solve the case faster than others.

In PAC-MAN: Craze Maze, each player builds their own maze over the course of the game, gradually shaping a network of paths filled with dots, power pellets, fruit, and ghosts.
On your turn, draw a tile and either replace one in your grid or reveal a hidden tile. As the maze evolves, you must plan carefully: at the end of the game, only one continuous path from PAC-MAN to a single exit will score.
Items along that path grant points, while ghosts create a risk–reward challenge. Place ghosts after a Power Pellet to score increasing bonuses — but any ghost without protection will cost you points. Multiple scoring combinations can be created along a path, rewarding careful timing and placement.
When all tiles have been revealed, players choose their best exit, trace one path, and total their…

Baue dein eigenes Labyrinth und finde den wertvollsten Weg nach draußen. Ein rasantes Kartenspiel für 2 bis 5 Spieler ab 7 Jahren, in 10 bis 25 Minuten gespielt.
In PAC-MAN: Craze Maze legt jeder Spieler sein eigenes Labyrinth aus Karten, gefüllt mit Pac-Punkten, Kraftpillen, Früchten und Geistern. In deinem Zug ziehst du eine Karte und ersetzt damit eine Karte in deinem Labyrinth oder du deckst eine verdeckte Karte auf. Gelegte Karten bleiben liegen, also will jeder Zug gut überlegt sein.
Am Ende bringt nur ein einziger durchgehender Weg von PAC-MAN zu einem Ausgang Punkte. Jedes Symbol auf diesem Weg zählt, Geister dagegen sind riskant. Folgt ein Geist direkt auf eine Kraftpille, darfst du ihn fressen, und bei vier Geistern in Folge gibt es bis zu 30 Punkte. Ungeschützte Geister kosten…

In Padventures: Paddy entdeckt den Wald begleiten die Spieler Paddy auf einem Abenteuer durch den Wald und entdecken und sammeln dabei verschiedene Pflanzen, Tiere und andere Schätze. Das Besondere dabei: Das Spiel wird direkt auf einem Blatt Papier gespielt, das im Laufe des Abenteuers nach und nach zerschnitten wird.
In jedem Zug machen die Spieler zwei Schnitte und trennen dabei Felder vom Rand ihres Blattes ab. Dabei müssen sie darauf achten, dass der verbleibende Teil des Blattes zusammenhängend bleibt. Auf den abgetrennten Bereichen befinden sich verschiedene Waldmotive, die die Spieler im Laufe des Spiels sammeln. Die Wahl der richtigen Schnitte ist entscheidend: Die Spieler müssen überlegen, welche Motive sie sammeln möchten, und gleichzeitig vorausschauend planen, damit sie…

pr.m: Action Selection, Deck Building, Dungeon Crawler, Push your Luck
pr.d:
Pandora Celeste: Pirates & Salvage takes the winning formula of Action Cards, Agendas and Emergency Protocols which made the original so much fun and adds yet another chaotic twist as an anarchic team of Pirates board the Ship to pursue a whole new set of Missions in this Expansion to Pandora Celeste.
3 new Pirate characters: Wekka Wabbit, Androidgyna and The Whistler enter the Ship via their Pirate Shuttle (which is formed from the box they come in) and lets you turn Pandora Celeste into a PvP team game which pits the Pirates against (some of) the Crew, or simply play fully-co-op as the Pirate Crew. Are they on a mission to rescue the Crew, steal the Company's secrets or simply loot anything that's not nailed down?
And an expansion wouldn't be an expansion without NEW NASTIES to…

pr.k: 438:PANIC STATIONS! THE PANDORA CELESTE CARD GAME
pr.t: PANIC STATIONS! The Pandora Celeste card game
pr.o: PANIC STATIONS! THE PANDORA CELESTE CARD GAME
pr.m: Action Selection, Deck Building, Dungeon Crawler, Modular Board
pr.d:
Big drama. Small box. Your movie, your way.
PANIC STATIONS is a cut-down, streamlined version of Pandora Celeste played out on a map of cards instead of a 3D Boxboard. Designed to be quick and brutal, it’s compact, travel‑friendly, and packed with spaceship Deck Cards, Agendas, four Crew, and three classic Big Nasties in a 1980s VHS cassette.
​Plus you can swap in any of your favourite Crew from the original Pandora Celeste and play them in this card game.
If Pandora Celeste is like living through a movie, then Panic Stations is the high-octane chase sequence you see in all the trailers!

PAW Patrol - Dropple
Keep the pups of PAW Patrol from tumbling down in this fun twist on a classic game. Start by randomly inserting the sticks through the PAW Patrol Tower and then add in the figures. Take turns carefully pulling sticks out without letting any of the pups inside fall — if any do, add them to your pile.
Once all of the sticks have been removed, the player with the least amount of pups collected wins.

As you solve puzzles while enjoying beautiful scenery, your very own calendar comes together. Discover stunning views from cities around the world! A daily puzzle game where a new challenge awaits every day.
Inside the Box : 1 frame, 12 building blocks from various cities

pr.m: Hidden Roles, Modular Board, Push your Luck
pr.d: They have just put the food to all the pets and they want to get there first. During your turn, you will choose two of the three animals you have, and turn a card to see who pets advance. If it´s the same pet you choosen, It will advance as many spaces as the card said. Besides, you can disguise your pets to cheat another players and advance faster. Will you be the owner of the pets that arrive first? A game of prediction, deception and luck.

Have you ever wanted to photograph a wild animal when you saw one? So, let's photograph the animals in our natural spaces and… shh! Don't make any noise, they are very timid and the picture might be ruined…
Photograph the most animals and win the game.
The guide draws the top card from the deck and looks at the pictured animal (lynx, deer, wolf, owl, or turtle).
They announce aloud the action indicated on the back of the top card of the deck. This is the action they will perform.
They give the players a few seconds to observe the animals, then ask them to close their eyes.
With the players' eyes closed, the guide performs the action on one of the tokens representing the animal on their card
As soon as a player gives a correct answer, they take the Photo card and begin creating their album…

A team-based party game involving drawing and word association.
Draw, give the best clue and get your team to guess correctly before the opposition.
Creativity, speed and teamwork.

pr.t: PLAY THAT SONG! KIDS HITS Edition
pr.o: PLAY THAT SONG! KIDS HITS EDITION
pr.d: Musikquiz für Kinder und die ganze Familie! Die Kids Hits Edition enthält 250 Playcards mit 1.500 Fragen aus fünf beliebten Kategorien: Kinderlieder, Zeichentrick, Animationsfilme, Familienfilme und Kinderserien. Einfach QR-Code scannen, Song starten und gemeinsam raten. Mit kurzen Spielrunden, spannenden Punkteinsätzen und der PLAY-Taste sorgt das Spiel bei Kindern ab 6 Jahren und Erwachsenen für jede Menge Musik, Wissen und Spaß.

pr.t: PLAY THAT SONG! – Deutsche Playlist Edition
pr.o: PLAY THAT SONG! – DEUTSCHE PLAYLIST EDITION
pr.d: Eine musikalische Reise durch die Hits, die Deutschland liebt! Die Deutsche Playlist Edition enthält 250 Playcards mit insgesamt 1.500 Fragen zu nationalen und internationalen Songs, Künstlern und Musikgeschichten, die in Deutschland besonders beliebt sind – von zeitlosen Klassikern bis zu aktuellen Chart-Hits. QR-Code scannen, Song starten und zeigen, wer die deutsche Lieblingsplaylist wirklich kennt. Punkteinsätze, A/B/C-Cards und die PLAY-Taste sorgen für Spannung, Überraschungen und echte Partyatmosphäre.

Exciting, intense, and with even more possible combinations: The 10 dice from the 99-Upgrade and the 30 dice from any PLUxINUS base game now let you calculate all two-digit numbers from 10 to 99. Play together, compete, or play solo. With PLUS times MINUS = PLUxINUS, mental math is simply fun for all ages!
The 99-Upgrade can only be played in combination with the 30 dice from a PLUxINUS dice game!

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Ressource Management, Trade, Others
pr.d:
The official tabletop adaptation of the global battle royale phenomenon, PUBG Board Royale brings the tension and chaos of the digital battlefield to the table.
Developed by Arvis Games and published by Nodwin Gaming in partnership with Krafton.
Players drop onto the island, scavenge for weapons and gear, craft items, and adapt to an ever-shrinking Blue Zone. In this survival card game, your resources also represent your hit points; manage your hand wisely, outmaneuver opponents, and be the last player standing!
• Players: 2–6
• Time: 30–90 mins
• Age: 14+
• Status: Upcoming Kickstarter / Tabletop Preview

Palace Quest is the new cooperative adventure for 1–6 players from Emanuele Ornella (designer of Ronin) and Dirk Henn (designer of Alhambra). The Sultan has bestowed upon you the monumental task of constructing his dream palace, but his vision is exacting. You must work together as a team to assemble the perfect Alhambra.
Palace Quest is played over 8 rounds. At the beginning, each player receives a stack of gems used to finance the construction of the buildings. Each round the role of the master builder changes, and this player decides which 3 buildings can be placed that round. Together, players may reveal 5 gem cards one after another — they decide whether to try their luck again and discard the previous card to draw a suitable one. If the team runs out of gem cards, they lose the…

All too often, your brave tribe has been struck by misfortune. The elders suspect that dark forces are at work and seek guidance from their ancestors. You establish ritual sites and create sacred artefacts to help you avoid danger and plan ahead.
An expansion for the game “Paleo”. In this 2021 ‘Kennerspiel des Jahres’ co-operative game, you work together as a Stone Age tribe to brave dangers and ensure your survival.

Look! Your friend Lino the mammoth has found wood, stones, berries and even rare crystals! It clatters and clinks as he rolls everything down the hill.
Paleolino is a cooperative game for up to four children. Shake the hand axe to get resources. Throw the resource tokens down the mountain and remember where they land. Can you work together to build ten inventions before the hand axe is empty?

Im kooperativen Kinderspiel Paleolino können schon Kinder in die spannende Welt von Paleo eintauchen, dem Kennerspiel des Jahres 2021.
Euer Dorfplatz hat zu Beginn des Spiels 10 freie Bauplätze. Baut dort gemeinsam 10 Erfindungen, bevor Lino, das Mammut, sich schlafen legt und das Spiel zu Ende ist.
Schüttelt dafür die Materialien Holz, Stein, Beeren und Kristall aus dem Faustkeil und lasst sie den 3D-Berg hinunterrollen. Es klappert und scheppert … Merkt euch, in welcher Schublade eure Chips gelandet sind. Sammelt sie ein und gebt sie ab, um eine passende Erfindung zu bauen. Schafft ihr es zusammen, alle 10 Bauplätze im Dorf zu füllen, bevor Lino zu müde ist, gewinnt ihr das Spiel!

Be the master of your own luck!
Look at the card to predict which symbol will appear on the next card: Panda or Clover. Will the next number be higher or lower? Then flip the card to see if you were right! Sounds easy… but will you know when to stop and claim your points?

Sucht, vergleicht und schnappt euch die Pandas! Der Würfel gibt in jeder Runde vor, welche Bedingung gerade gefragt ist: Soll der Panda möglichst klein, groß, leicht oder schwer sein bzw. sein Bambusstab kurz oder lang? Ihr spielt gleichzeitig und nehmt jeweils eine Panda-Karte aus der Kartenauslage, die euch passend erscheint. Danach dreht ihr eure Karten um und vergleicht die Angaben auf den Rückseiten miteinander. Wer die Bedingung tatsächlich bestmöglich erfüllt hat, behält seine Karte als Punkt. Ihr spielt so lange, bis jemand sich eine bestimmte Anzahl Panda-Karten schnappen konnte.

pr.m: Deck Building, Dice Rolling, Drafting, Push your Luck
pr.d:
Noch mehr Würfel - noch mehr Spaß! Gleich drei neue Clans erwarten euch jeweils in den beiden Erweiterung zu PANDA ROYALE. Ob Jokerwürfel für das eigene Glück oder Würfel, mit denen man anderen zum erneuten Werfen zwingt! Es wird belohnt, wer viele unterschiedliche Farben sammelt und wer unzufrieden ist, kann nun endlich auch die eigenen Würfel neu werfen! Alle 6 kleinen Erweiterungen können einzeln oder in beliebiger Kombination in das Grundspiel integriert werden.

Leider wird die Lieferung nicht rechtzeitig zur Messe da sein - bitte in unserem Shop unter www.spiel-das.de/shop bestellen. Versand nach der Messe!

pr.m: Deck Building, Dice Rolling, Drafting, Push your Luck
pr.d:
Noch mehr Würfel - noch mehr Spaß! Gleich drei neue Clans erwarten euch jeweils in den beiden Erweiterung zu PANDA ROYALE. Ob Jokerwürfel für das eigene Glück oder Würfel, mit denen man anderen zum erneuten Werfen zwingt! Es wird belohnt, wer viele unterschiedliche Farben sammelt und wer unzufrieden ist, kann nun endlich auch die eigenen Würfel neu werfen! Alle 6 kleinen Erweiterungen können einzeln oder in beliebiger Kombination in das Grundspiel integriert werden.

Leider wird die Lieferung nicht rechtzeitig zur Messe da sein - bitte in unserem Shop unter www.spiel-das.de/shop bestellen. Versand nach der Messe!

Legends says that a panda bear sat among bamboo plants, chewing on leaves with relish, spinning on itself when they were all eaten.
Looking up at the starry night sky, it felt it had to join the 12 animals of the zodiac. Thus «Panda Spin» was born...
Designer Carl Chudyk who lived and worked in China was inspired by the traditionnal card game of «Chu Da Di», to create this original
combination.
The aim of the game remains to discard your cards faster than the others by winning tricks.
But there is a unique twist. If you lose a trick, you can create an advantage: The cards go back into your hand rotated 180 degrees and stronger.
In this game, the path to victory often requires to lose the right trick at the right time!
Are you ready to Panda Spin?

pr.a: Patrick Saber, Ryan Chedrawi, Anthony Attieh, Edmond Rizk
pr.m: Action Selection, Push your Luck, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Others
pr.d:
Fifteen minutes. Three to Six players. Escape the Arctic or be the last one standing.
Panic Zones: Arctic Edition is a fast, take-that card game where survival means outwitting your friends before the cold, or they, eliminate you.
There are two ways to win: Collect all 3 different Rescue Cards to escape, or outlast every other player as they get eliminated.
The game is turn-based, played with two decks: Discovery and Advantage Decks.
You end your turn by drawing from the Discovery Deck: it could hand you the card you need to escape or other pleasant surprises, but it could also throw a Polar Bear or other obstacle to eliminate you, or a Panic event stirring chaos for everyone at the table.
Shift the odds to your favor by playing Advantage Cards to steal the card you need from opponents or…

Discard cards and either enter a number yourself or have someone else do it. Sounds simple.
However, the counter "bursts" at a random number between 21 and 30—resulting in penalty cards. So, the panic level rises once you pass 20. Play strategically and use special cards to make the counter burst for your opponents. To play this clever mix of tactics and luck, one of you needs the free Panika app.
Panika—a card game that delivers thrills via an app where you either enter a number or have someone else do it—comes from acclaimed designer Haim Shafir, who previously delighted generations of players with *Halli Galli*.

A wide view is guaranteed - with your very own panorama! With each tile, a piece of the landscape takes shape: mountains give way to meadows, and forests stretch out. Players take turns placing a landscape tile to the left or right of their own layout, expanding the picture. Where does it fit best? Animals feel at home where their favorite flowers bloom - and that’s how you earn valuable points. You’ll also need to keep an eye on the bonus scores: Who has the fewest clouds? Who has the longest river? These scores change from round to round, making every game unique and full of variety. A calm and tactical family game with a feel-good factor for two to four players ages eight and up, inviting you to plan and marvel.

THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Paper Tales Ultimate ist ein taktisches Kartenspiel von Masato Uesugi für 1 bis 7 Personen ab 10 Jahren. Ihr übernehmt die Krone eines Reiches voller Fabelwesen, Helden und Artefakte und baut eure Auslage durch Drafting auf. Einheiten altern und verschwinden nach einigen Runden, wodurch langfristige Planung besonders wichtig wird. Gleichzeitig konkurriert ihr um Ressourcen und müsst eure Armee für Konflikte vorbereiten. Die Ultimate-Box bündelt das Grundspiel mit beiden Erweiterungen und bietet damit ein umfangreiches, variables Kartenspielerlebnis. Die zweite Erweiterung war bisher auf deutsch noch nicht erhältich.

pr.d:
History:
The “Eduba” is an institution for training scribes for administrative temple duties and a place of learning. Clay tablets were produced and inscribed here, and Sumerian was taught.
Preparation:
Shuffle the 5 new Landscape Tiles with all the others.
Gameplay:
Each time you cross the “A”-stand and discard Papyri for knowledge, you gain an additional knowledge point per symbol.

If you’re not satisfied with the cardboard game board, you can use the high-quality neoprene play mat with “laser-cut” indentations instead.
The Papyria neoprene map, which is included in the second US/FR version, is available separately.

pr.d:
Impersonate a paraglider racing to reach three antennas before landing on the central target. Victory points are earned for flying above those antennas and other landmarks as well as performing stunts during your race. Always be prepared to adjust your navigation strategy in response to the changing weather and the terrain configuration.

This game could be classified as a navigation puzzle. During your turn you just need to move your pawn, while managing your unique precious resource: your altitude. Moving fast will make you lose altitude but let you take the lead of the race, while taking a detour to move above mountains or under clouds will make you gain altitude but avoid landing prematurely. With a smart map setup procedure generating unique maps, and a random weather forecast, the…

Pasteles is a solo game where you’ll face 12 unique recipes, each one a puzzle to be mastered. Every game unfolds over a series of 4 to 7 rounds, with each round representing a full day at your pastry shop.
Each round is divided into three main phases:
Preparation
Start the day by organizing your bakery. Employees arrive—or leave—according to the schedule, ingredients are readied, and equipment is checked for potential breakdowns. You may also choose to invest in marketing to attract more customers, if you can afford it.
Open
The doors open and customers start pouring in based on your current Market Level. This is the heart of the game: bake the featured recipe and serve customers as efficiently as possible, following the unique rules of each recipe.
Closing
As the day winds down, you’ll…

In Pax Hispanica - Sea of Lies you take the role of a pirate navigating the Caribbean islands trying to claim the victory through 1 of the 4 paths. It is simple, play a card, do the action stated on the card. The twist is that you play it facedown, and you may lie about what the action card really is. As a real pirate, you should trust no one. Challenge your opponents' action cards at the right time and trick them while playing your cards to become the winner or Sea of lies.

pr.m: Area Control, Area Movement, Drafting, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Erkunde Regionen und schare mächtige Verbündete um dich, um der erste König von Schweden zu werden!

Ihr seid alle ein Jarl - ein Anführer in der nordischen Kultur und eure Familien sind im Laufe der Jahrhunderte gewachsen und mächtig geworden. Endlich ist ein entscheidender Punkt in der Geschichte gekommen; eine Gelegenheit, um die vielen verschiedenen Reiche unter der Herrschaft eines Königs zu vereinen. Dafür müsst ihr neue Handelswege und Regionen im Osten entdecken und erschließen. Außerdem könnt ihr euch die Hilfe der Götter holen und mächtige Verbündete im Westen finden, die euch helfen. All dies, um genug Einfluss und Macht zu erhalten, damit ihr euer größtes Ziel erreicht - der erste König von Schweden zu werden!

Pax Viking ist ein historisches Strategiespiel im Kennerbereich…

In den Bergen ist Zusammenarbeit gefragt. Daher müsst ihr in PEAK TEAM die 5 verschiedenen Level auch kooperativ bewältigen. Dabei ist gute Planung gefragt, aber auch gegenseitige Hilfe. Findet die besten Pfade, erfüllt eure Missionen und beobachtet die heimischen Tiere.
Dabei werden die Missionen von Level zu Level anspruchsvoller. Weitere Elemente wie Wetter, blockierte Wege und erholsame Pausen sorgen für neue Herausforderungen am Berg.

Little dinos play hide-and-seek with their sweet moms all day long, sneaking under their bellies and dashing from one to another. But it’s getting dark and it’s time to go home — and the babies are still too caught up in their game!
Peek-a-saurs is a playful memory game for young children. Hide the baby dinosaurs under four colorful dinomoms and try to remember who is hiding where. On your turn, roll the die, choose a dinomom to lift, and see if you can find the baby dino you’re looking for. Find the right one and take it — the player who gathers the most dinos wins!
But the dinos won’t always stay put! Special die results let players secretly move baby dinos from one mom to another or take one while everyone else closes their eyes, keeping the hiding places changing throughout the game.

Command birds from your own and other players’ flocks to compete for the best locations around a country estate. Control spaces for points and abilities, manipulate woodland troublemakers and adapt to a different mix of locations each game.

It’s grotesque, bloated, repulsive. A huge, rotting shark.
It sits broadly atop a vast pile of gold. Grinning, baring rows of razor-sharp teeth, it guards it.
Was that your gold? Are you ruined now?
A real nightmare, I tell you!

Perdiciòn is a mercenary for Assassin, Debonn, Goblins, Pirates, or Shadows.

He can also be used as an NPC in the expansion The Lost Valley as one of 4 final bosses.
Book: Tales of Longfall 10 'The Lost Valley’
Hire Fee: 145 Doubloons
Max. Number per Crew: 1
Parts: 11
Height: approx. 90 mm
The resin miniature comes with all character cards needed to play Freebooter’s Fate. It is supplied as an unpainted kit and requires assembly. Glue and paints not included.

A murder rocks the villa - but who is behind it? In this two-player game, one player takes on the role of the murderer, while the other plays the detective. At the start, the murderer secretly decides which of the nine suspects committed the crime, which of the twelve weapons was used, and through which of the eight rooms the villa was entered. The detective has eight rounds to uncover all three secrets by playing cards, skillfully combining information, and ruling out red herrings. Meanwhile, the murderer actively works against the detective, covering their tracks and providing misleading clues. The result is a suspenseful deduction game full of bluffing and logic for two players ages ten and up.

pr.d:
This is a new Agenda Card that can be shuffled into the deck and used in games of Galactic Cruise.
Like other promo Agenda Cards, instead of having a resource discard ability, this card features an Ad discard ability instead.

Geht auf eine aufregende Reise rund um den Globus und knipst Erinnerungsfotos vom sonnigen Strandurlaub bis zum Nightlife in der Stadt. Gleiche Motive, Zahlen oder Wetterfarben auf Kontinenten und Flugrouten bringen euch wertvolle Punkte. Gelingt es euch, alles perfekt zu verbinden? Mit dem richtigen Timing und einem Quäntchen Glück sichert ihr euch die goldenen Kameras! Einfache Regeln, spannende Entscheidungen und knifflige Varianten sorgen dafür, dass jede Partie aufs Neue Lust auf eine Perfect Tour macht.
Einfache Regeln
Keine Wartezeit – alle spielen gleichzeitig
Mit Varianten für langanhaltenden Spielspaß

Persona 3 Reload TCG accessories
Deck boxes, playmats, binder, and foil card sleeves featuring your favorite Persona 3 Reload characters built for players who actually care what's on their table. Premium materials. Innovative design. The kind of quality that survives every duel, every Dark Hour, every bad matchup.

pr.d:
Welcome to Pet Avenue, where every window hides a clue and every resident could be the culprit!
Pet Detective is a family-friendly deduction game in which players observe the building, gather information and use logic to solve a mysterious case. Follow the clues floor by floor, identify the guilty resident and check your answer using the QR code.
Pet Detective is available in two standalone versions. In Pet Detective Day, someone has used far too much detergent and covered the building in foam. In Pet Detective Night, a mysterious trombone player has awakened the entire neighbourhood in the middle of the night.
Look carefully, connect the clues and discover which mischievous pet is responsible!

Welcome to Pet Avenue, where every window hides a clue and every resident could be the culprit!
Pet Detective is a family-friendly deduction game in which players observe the building, gather information and use logic to solve a mysterious case. Follow the clues floor by floor, identify the guilty resident and check your answer using the QR code.
Pet Detective is available in two standalone versions. In Pet Detective Day, someone has used far too much detergent and covered the building in foam. In Pet Detective Night, a mysterious trombone player has awakened the entire neighbourhood in the middle of the night.
Look carefully, connect the clues and discover which mischievous pet is responsible!

The rooms are ready, the guests are arriving, and it’s time to get to work! In Pet Hotel, all kinds of guests are checking in with their pets. As a hotel manager, you are responsible for several floors of the hotel. It’s up to you to organise all the pets as cleverly as possible. While they are all welcome, some pets don’t get along very well when they are placed too close to each other. Can you create the perfect layout and become the best hotel manager?
In Pet Hotel, you try to fill your hotel floors as effectively as possible. The longer a floor is, the more points it earns. Placing multiple pets of the same species on one floor earns you additional points. On top of that, each hotel manager has two secret objectives that can earn extra points during the game. The player who combines…

Four animal friends are setting off on the greatest adventure of their lives: a journey to Mars! Of course, the snack machine, the alien translator, and the mobile gym have to come along. But the rockets’ cargo holds are limited, and overloading costs valuable fuel. Only with smart planning can you bring everything important into space and complete the mission in the end.

Faster fun with the Phase 10 Tiles game—two games in one! Players can enjoy the classic Phase 10 gameplay they know and love, completing the 10 phases in order, or try the fast-play mode. In this mode, players complete one of three randomly selected phases each round, each worth a different number of points. The first player to reach 10 points wins!

pr.d:
In Picante, the more sweet cards you collect, the more points you score. But watch out! In each round, one color becomes your personal Picanté—and it might just make you sweat! Keep a cool head and balance the heat, because your opponents will do everything in their power to serve you exactly the cards you dread the most.
Balancing the Heat: How to Play
At the start of each round, every player chooses their own Picanté color. This is the one color you absolutely do not want to win:
• The Spicy Trap: Any card of your designated Picanté color that you collect will inflict negative points equal to its face value.

• Sweet Rewards: Cards of all other colors are perfectly safe, granting you 1 valuable point each.

Chili Trophies & Victory
At the end of each round, it is time to tally up the…

In “Pick a Chicken,” the new card-matching game from the Viennese game publisher Piatnik for children ages six and up, things get truly wild. To keep all the chicken coop’s residents happy and score as many points as possible, you’ll need to pay attention to their preferences and needs: The rooster, of course, likes to rule alone; chicks always feel most comfortable in pairs; sick chickens need a veterinarian by their side; and so on. Whoever optimizes their own chicken coop as best as possible through skilful card swapping has a good chance of winning. Various ways to score points and the humorous illustrations make this fast-paced pocket game particularly appealing.

Among the 55 playing cards are healthy and sick hens, mother hens, chicks, eggs, roosters, and the veterinarian. At the…

PICTURES Violet erweitert PICTURES um 110 neue Fotos, zwei kreative Material-Sets und drei violette Holzwürfel. Mit einer sensorischen Kugel und farbigen Schnüren formst du Motive auf ganz neue Weise.
Neu sind auch Acrylringe, die du auf Fotokarten legst, um damit auf passende Details, Farben, Formen oder Motive hinzuweisen.
Natürlich ist alles mit den bisherigen PICTURES-Versionen kombinierbar und sorgt für noch mehr Abwechslung und Rätselspaß!

Pietenpolonaise is a cheerful family card game where you try to build a colorful parade of seven Pieten behind Sinterklaas. Match colors, extend your polonaise and watch out for slippery bananas that send your last Piet tumbling away! Rainbow cards can save the day in this quick, easy-to-learn game full of laughter, luck and festive fun.

Die neue, verrückte und extra-scharfe Edition des europäischen Blockbuster “Pili Pili”. Neue Missionen, heiße Sonderkarten und verrückte Regelanpassungen sorgen für jede Menge neuem Spielspaß und vergrößern das Suchtpotential!
• 2-8 Spieler, ab 8 Jahren

• Inhalt: 110 Spielkarten, 1 Anleitung

• Format: 15 x 10,5 x 2,7 cm

• UVP: 15,99 EUR

Scharf, schärfer, Pili Pili: Extra Spicy! Die kleinen Pili-Chilis bringen ordentlich Feuer an den Spieltisch – und diesmal wird es noch heißer. Bleib cool, während um dich herum das Chaos ausbricht, behalte einen kühlen Kopf und pass auf, dass du dir nicht die Finger verbrennst. Denn mit jeder Runde kann die Stimmung aufs Neue kippen – feurig, überraschend und herrlich unberechenbar.

Pillow Fight, is a cushion-easy and lightning-fast card game where your only goal is to knock out your foes and be the last one standing! It’s the perfect way to fluff up the mood at family gatherings, parties, or on vacation. Rest assured, it's going to be a blast!

Wollt ihr Landlubber auch mal legendäre Seeungeheuer jagen und uralte Schätze heben? Dann kommt und schnappt euch euer Deck!
Besiegt legendäre Monster und erbeutet sagenumwobene Schätze, um Kronen zu erhalten.
Wer am Ende der Partie die meisten Kronen hat, herrscht fortan über die Sieben Weltmeere!

Und so wird gespielt:
Der Käpt’n zählt laut bis 3. Bei 3 deckt ihr ALLE GLEICHZEITIG die oberste Karte eures Piratendecks auf und legt sie offen vor euch in euren Spielbereich.
Hat eine aufgedeckte Karte einen Effekt, handelt ihn ab, bevor ihr weiter macht. Alle Effekte treten sofort ein. Manche Effekte wirken sich auf andere Personen aus.
Habt ihr alle Effekte der aufgedeckten Karten abgehandelt, zählt der Käpt’n erneut bis 3 und ihr deckt wieder jeweils 1 Karte auf. Ihr dürft so lange…

pr.m: Engine Building, Modular Board, Tile Placement
pr.d:
Proviant, die Crew und vor allem haufenweise Schätze: all das braucht Platz an Bord. Jetzt ist es an der Zeit, dein Boot allen Herausforderungen anzupassen und schließlich mit einem prachtvollen Schiff die Karibik zu durchkreuzen!
Mit Pirates of Maracaibo: Shipbuilders lässt du neue Schiffe vom Stapel und verzierst sie mit zwei neuen Galionsfiguren. Ein schmucker Startspielermarker rundet diese dritte Erweiterung für Pirates of Maracaibo ab.
Und wieder heißt es: Leinen los, die Schätze rufen!

pr.a: Luca Bellini, Luca Borsa, Carlo Emanuele  Lanzavecchia, Walter Obert
pr.d: Welcome to the Magic Academy! In six fast-paced challenges, teamwork is essential. Together, you must catch the playful, cheeky Pixies using powerful spells before time runs out. Good timing and quick decisions are the key to success.
This is the German edition of Pixies: Little Giants, originally published by Bombyx.

Pixies Little Giants booster of 14 new cards, still designed by Johannes Goupy and illustrated by the artist Sylvain Trabut, will now allow you to play with a larger board!
New cards, picked up like the others, can be placed on the top or on the left of your playing area.
Each of these colored cards will add a new effect for all cards in the column or the line.

Thin-crust pizza masters battle in this fast-paced card game of bluffing and quick calculation!
Every turn, all chefs secretly select an action card and reveal at the same time. Actions trigger in a fixed priority order, so you’ll need to guess what your opponents plan to play before committing your move. Grab pizza slices from the shared table, snatch the final piece of a pizza group to earn valuable pizza tokens, and race to assemble complete pizzas before your rivals.
Careful planning is key: if multiple players pick the same numbered action, nobody gets to carry it out! Manage your limited hand of action cards wisely, use the powerful Observe ability to peek at others’ plans, or play Rest to recover your spent cards for future rounds.
Once you have two fully assembled pizzas, you are…

Pioneers, you have been chosen for a mission of vital importance: to develop a prosperous and thriving ecosystem on this new, barren planet.
In Planet Bee, a strategic tile-placement game, your goal is to place the Ecosystem tiles at your disposal optimally to generate new life inside your geodesic dome. To win, you must make the most of your oxygen and water resources!
An effective tile placement strategy will allow you to house all kinds of plants and animals in your dome and earn points.
But be careful! Pay attention to bees, the true keepers of the new ecosystems here, just as they are on Earth. Meet their needs and they will reward you with plenty of points.
Your mission starts now: bee smart, bee victorious!

Planet Pioneer Meteora is a cooperative quiz game where players try to guess the answer based on 3 clues.
The Hint Team creates clues using limited information such as "3 Letters," "Number + unit," and "○△□ shapes."
The Answer Team makes guesses based on those clues, and if they are correct, the exploration is successful.
If the Teams successfully completes six explorations, they win the game.

PLAY! Your soundtrack. Your party, your music game! From rock to hip-hop, R&B, and rap, to international hits from the ’90s, 2000s, and 2010s, and the latest chart-toppers—here, guessing is more important than knowing. Put together your own playlist from over 12 music categories and more than 4,000 songs, and play in four different game modes, such as “Walk the Timeline” or “Sooner or Later.” Just get started with your favorite streaming service—Spotify, Apple Music, or YouTube Music. And best of all: You don’t even need an extra app—just launch the game and start the party! The perfect music party game for everyone who loves great beats and wants to share unforgettable moments together.

PLAY THAT SONG! FILMMUSIK Edition Musik-Quizspiel mit App für Film- & Serienfans. Erlebt die bekanntesten Songs und Soundtracks aus legendären Filmen und unvergesslichen Kino-Momenten! Die Filmmusik Edition enthält 250 Playcards mit insgesamt 1.500 abwechslungsreichen Fragen. Scannt den QR-Code, startet den Song über die kostenlose PLAY THAT SONG! App und stellt euer Wissen über Filme, Stars und Soundtracks unter Beweis. Mit Punkteinsätzen, A/B/C-Cards und der PLAY-Taste für schnelle Antwortdiebe wird jeder Spieleabend zum musikalischen Kinoerlebnis.

SAGA is not a game — it's the board game platform that lives at your table. Built by board gamers, for board gamers.
Open it during any real session: it tracks the games you actually play, answers rules questions on the spot, and does the scoring for you. Along the way you can send emoji across the table, drop in fun ad-hoc jingles, keep your stats, and stay connected with your group.
Everything that happens at the real table. Played, not entered.
Play with SAGA — Hall 4.

Das Musik- und Partyspiel, das euer Musikwissen der 70er und 80er in 4 Runden von Quizfragen bis zum Karaoke Battle testet.
Mit mehr als 500 Liedern verteilt auf 18 Playlisten und über 200 Karten.
Ideal für alle – egal, ob Musikfan oder nicht. Perfekt für Familien, Freunde, Jugendliche und Erwachsene.

In Deutschland entworfen und in Europa auf FSC-zertifiziertem Papier gedruckt.Inhalt: 110 Spielkarten, 1 Anleitung
• 2-10 Spieler, ab 16 Jahren
