The football game that turns every match into a Champions League final
If you love intense matches, unexpected twists, and friendly rivalry, Player 12 turns any table into a stadium.
Attack, defend, take risks… and score the winning goal at the last moment.
Every decision counts, and any play can change the course of the match.
Play any big game, anytime, anywhere — with ease. Level up your scoring with the premium chip set!

This is a game rack that allows you to neatly organize and use various board game components. It can be used as a stand by holding cards and tiles, and by connecting the sides, it can also be used as a dice tray.

Inside the Box : 6 gaming racks that can be used as stand or die trays

Each player tries to collect as many cards as possible in two colors and to avoid the cards in the other two colors. Only cards in two of the colors will be counted towards the score. The player who plays the highest card in the leading suit has first choice when a trick is split, while the player who played the lowest card in another suit takes the rest. The two winners of a trick share the cards, but it is naturally an advantage to have first choice and leave the wrong colors to the second player.
Inside the Box : 84 cards (56 x 87mm)

This treasure won’t steal itself!
Plunder Blunder is a 20–30 minute game of greed and treachery for 1-7 paranoid pirates and their “friends."

A compact, portable box contains a wobbly, rocking platform on which 2-4 players take on the roles of "high-flyers." As the game progresses ever higher, the "builders" decide whether to opt out of the lofty endeavor early to collect some "star points"—or whether to continue contributing to the thrill of a "total crash" for the lure of higher rewards.

Those who act with excessive recklessness ensure that gravity brings the entire structure—and their own ambitions—down. But those who lack courage will hardly reach for the promising stars with any profit.

Poko Pop! is a simultaneous-selection bluffing card game in which three to five rival thieves compete for treasures inside a sleeping museum.

In each round, Score Cards are placed beside a row of numbered Poko Cards, with the final treasure kept face down. At each Poko, all remaining players secretly choose Wait!, Poko!, or Snatch!, then reveal their cards together. A single player who chooses Poko! claims the current treasure and leaves the round, while multiple Poko! choices cause a clash and penalties. A well-timed Snatch! can steal the treasure from players who chose Poko!, but multiple Snatch! cards cancel one another.

As players claim treasures, the final remaining player receives the hidden treasure at the last Poko. Unclaimed treasures may carry over to the Final Round, where…

pr.k: 413:POLITICAL POKER – ALLIES VS RIVALS PLAYING CARDS
pr.t: Political Poker – Allies vs Rivals Playing Cards
pr.o: POLITICAL POKER – ALLIES VS RIVALS PLAYING CARDS
pr.d:
Political Poker – Allies vs Rivals is a satirical playing-card deck inspired by contemporary world politics, international rivalries and the personalities that dominate today’s headlines.
Traditional playing cards are reimagined through colourful caricature-style illustrations of political leaders and public figures, with visual references to power, diplomacy, elections, trade, technology, international alliances and geopolitical competition.
Each card turns current affairs into playful visual satire while keeping the familiar structure of a standard playing-card deck. The result is a deck that works both for Poker and other classic card games and as an unusual conversation piece or collectible.
With its bold illustrated style and humorous approach to global politics, Political Poker is…

In POPOPOP, players compete to win the discs placed in the center of the table.
On their turn, players flick one of their dice, trying to land it on a disc—or dislodge an opponent's die off its target!
If a die lands on a disc showing its "Instant Win" face, that disc is claimed immediately. And if two of a player's dice show the same face, they must shout "POPOPOP!!!" to retrieve one of their dice.
The game ends as soon as a player has collected 4 discs.
The "dexterity element" is balanced by the unpredictable roll of dice, making POPOPOP accessible and enjoyable for players of all ages and skill levels.
An optional variant introduces rule changes during the game, for more tension and unexpected twists.
A team-play variant brings an extra layer of strategy to the game, for players…

pr.t: Ports of Call: The Board Game
pr.o: PORTS OF CALL: THE BOARD GAME
pr.m: Action Selection, Pick-up and Deliver, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d:
Ports of Call: The Board Game is based on the classic computer game from 1987 created by Rolf-Dieter Klein and Martin Ulrich.
In the board game, players compete to build and expand their own shipping empires. They do so by buying, transporting, and selling containers filled with goods across the globe.
As the game progresses, players grow their fleets, establish factories in major port cities, and produce goods for the world market, while dealing with pirates, rats, hard weather, closed harbours, and smuggling.
The winner is the player who, by the end of the game, has managed to build the most valuable shipping company.
Portus ist ein strategisches Wirtschafts- und Aufbauspiel im antiken Rom, in dem ihr Handel treibt, Produktionsketten entwickelt und euren Einfluss im bedeutendsten Hafen des Imperiums ausbaut.

The party game where you're totally faking it.
Each round, everyone draws a card. Normies all get the same secret word and act it out by striking a pose. But one player is the Poser — and their card is blank. With no idea what the word is, they have to bluff, improvise, and out-confidence the room to blend in. Pull it off, score big. Get caught, and whoever exposes you steals the points.
No reading, no setup, no downtime — just fast rounds, terrible acting, and a lot of "wait, was that you?!"
This is the German edition of Positano, originally published by SlugFest Games.

A fully cooperative trick-taking game by Petr Čáslava, set during Catherine the Great’s journey to Crimea. Use your character’s unique abilities to rebuild villages along the Dnieper River and create the illusion of prosperity. Only through teamwork can you deceive the Empress and win.

Zarin Katharina die Große unternahm 1787 eine Reise auf dem Dnepr, um die Provinzen ihres Reiches zu inspizieren. Der Legende nach ließ Fürst Potjomkin entlang der Route Dörfer bauen, um den Eindruck von Wohlstand zu vermitteln. In Potemkinsche Dörfer müsst ihr in aller Eile gemeinsam diese prächtigen Fassaden errichten. Jede Person übernimmt dabei ein Rolle wie Pionier, Kulissenschieber, Kanzler oder Kundschafter, die jeweils mit besonderen Fähigkeit ausgestattet ist. Setzt diese klug ein und plant voraus, damit die Täuschung Katharinas scharfer Beobachtung standhält. Denn sollte der Schwindel auffliegen, fällt der gesamte Hof in Ungnade. Wer einen Stich gewinnt, nutzt die Fähigkeit seiner Rolle um Dörfer zu bauen, zu versetzen, den Trumpf zu bestimmen oder Katharinas Schiff…

Das Stichspiel voller fieser Finten und despotischer Haushaltsgeräte!
In Power Vacuum übernehmt ihr die Rolle machthungriger Haushaltsgeräte, die mit List, Taktik und Verrat um die Oberhand kämpfen. Dein Ziel: Den leeren Thron für dich zu beanspruchen und eine Statue zu deinen Ehren zu errichten. Doch Achtung: Alle verfolgen ihre eigenen, geheimen Agenda-Ziele, und nicht jeder Stich führt zum Sieg!

Power Vacuum ist ein strategisches Stichspiel mit Wendungen, in dem du durch das Ausspielen von Karten Machtpunkte sammelst oder durch den raffinierten Einsatz des Kontrollplans die Machtverhältnisse neu ordnest.

Verfolge deine Agenda, indem du die Machtstufen deiner Mitspielenden geschickt manipulierst, um am Ende der Runde Belohnungen zu kassieren und der Errichtung deiner Statue…

pr.a: Jindřich Pavlásek, Michal Peichl, Petr Vojtěch
pr.d:
In diesem Euro-Worker-Placement-Spiel erschafft ihr gemeinsam neue Aktionsfelder und nutzt die besondere Aktionen der verschiedenen Nachbarschaften, die die sagenumwobene Geschichte Prags neu erzählen. Erlangt einzigartige Fähigkeiten und kämpft um Einfluss in den vier Nachbarschaften.
Faszinierendes Kennerspiel für 1 bis 4 Spieler*innen ab 14 Jahren.

pr.a: Petr Vojtěch, Jindřich Pavlásek, Michal Peichl
pr.d: Step into mythical 19th-century Prague, where legendary creatures roam the streets. Use their unique abilities to rebuild the flooded city, shape its future, and compete for influence. This euro-style worker placement game lets players create their own action spaces, master unique powers, and explore Prague's magical legends.

Pressed is a set collection, drafting card game where you play as competing botanical artists, planting, picking, and pressing flowers to craft a beautiful collection.
On your turn, play your flower and score. At the end of the round, pick flowers that will go into your personal collection for pressings. After three rounds, score your pressings to achieve a final score and the player with the highest score wins!
Flower art by Beth Sobel.

Prestige ist ein anspruchsvolles Worker-Placement-Spiel, in dem ihr als Schlossbesitzende Rohstoffe beschafft, Handwerker entwickelt und euer Anwesen innen wie außen zu einem beeindruckenden Rokoko-Schloss ausbaut.

From the Probably Illegal People who brought you… Probably Illegal - comes:
The ANARCHY DECKS.
You wanted more did you? Well… Careful what you wish for!
The Anarchy Decks, Volumes 1 and 2, are rule modifying decks that add an extra layer of chaos to any game night. Shuffle them into your main Probably Illegal deck for a wild fever dream of roleplay madness! Rules such as “you must use your sexiest voice this round“, or “every story must include aliens!“, appear at random to spice up your gameplay and make your friends go… “Did you REALLY just say that?“
These can be found in various bundles at the Probably Illegal wares table, which includes even more ways to make your game night a little more illegal… probably.

pr.t: Probably Illegal - The Big Black Deck
pr.o: PROBABLY ILLEGAL - THE BIG BLACK DECK
pr.d:
From the Probably Illegal People who brought you… Probably Illegal - comes…
THE BIG BLACK DECK.
This is the expansion pack your parents warned you about. 80 cards of filth, fury, and fun that crank the chaos of Probably Illegal to unholy levels. Expect more s*x, more sin, and ZERO shame.
Shuffle into the main deck to add some extra spice, or play separately for a consensual crime spree!
(17+)

pr.k: 642:PROBABLY ILLEGAL - THE WORLD'S MOST DANGEROUS CARD GAME... PROBABLY
pr.t: Probably Illegal - The World's Most Dangerous Card Game... Probably
pr.o: PROBABLY ILLEGAL - THE WORLD'S MOST DANGEROUS CARD GAME... PROBABLY
pr.d:
Probably Illegal - The World's Most Dangerous Card Game.. Probably is the storytelling card game of chaos and betrayal. Win over the Judge - or torch your rivals and watch it all burn 🔥
This is the party game that goes beyond party games - built around wild scenarios, crazy objects, and ridiculous skills that players combine on the fly. If you can’t win, backstab your loved ones! Your friendships will never be the same again…
Dark humor. Bad decisions. Great parties. That's Probably Illegal (17+)

Professor Bertram K. Boom has a special final exam for his students: To fill their laboratories with as many dangerous experiments without blowing it up as possible!
Players draft experiment tiles from a central display and place them in their laboratories according to different placement rules for all types of experiment. As the laboratories start filling up, it becomes more and more difficult to place them without infringing those rules... luckily, there are four one-time use powers that can help delay the inevitable. As soon as a player cannot place a tile without violating a rule, that player's lab blows up and whoever has the most points wins!

The skyscrapers of New York City and Tokyo soar high into the sky. An impressive skyline characterizes both cities, whose real estate markets have always been fiercely competitive. The buildings keep growing taller and taller, their value often determined by their proximity to central landmarks. This is also the case in the innovative deck-building game “Project Skyline” from the Viennese game publisher Piatnik, which features a strategic competition centred on building skyscrapers and developing attractive neighbourhoods on a large game board.

In “Project Skyline,” designed by Florian Maas, players who build smartly are always a step ahead of the competition—and often even a floor ahead. Floor by floor, players shape the city and can also make use of existing buildings. But true pros…

pr.k: 789:PROJEKT G – DAS SPIEL, IN DEM IHR EIN GEHEIMES TREFFEN AUFDECKT
pr.t: Projekt G – Das Spiel, in dem ihr ein geheimes Treffen aufdeckt
pr.o: PROJEKT G – DAS SPIEL, IN DEM IHR EIN GEHEIMES TREFFEN AUFDECKT
pr.d:
Eure Mission:
Ein anonymer Brief landet in der Redaktion. Darin: eine Einladung zu einem Treffen mit bedrohlichen Absichten. Die CORRECTIV-Journalistin Jara Veldkamp sichert erste Spuren – doch dann fällt sie aus. Ihr übernehmt die Recherche.
Folgt den Hinweisen, verknüpft Fakten und findet heraus, wer hinter dem Geheimtreffen steckt – bevor es zu spät ist. Arbeitet wie echte Investigativ-Journalisten: Ihr braucht Teamgeist, Recherchegeschick und einen klaren Kopf.

Das Spiel:
Ihr bekommt einen Umschlag mit Hinweisen und den bisherigen Recherche-Ergebnissen der Journalistin. Kombiniert alles und findet heraus, was hinter dem Treffen steckt. Könnt ihr die Chefredaktion mit eurer Recherche überzeugen und die Meldung an die Öffentlichkeit bringen?
Das Spiel beruht auf einer echten Recherche.…
53 new cards: Including an expansion to 15th Stamp, cards to Perdition's Mouth and Mine 77. Contains all language-dependent cards in English and German.

pr.a: Molly Johnson, Robert Melvin, Shawn Stankowski
pr.d: Die Spieler schlüpfen in die Rolle konkurrierender mittelalterlicher Bienenvölker und setzen in Spielzügen Arbeiterbienen ein, um Pollen zu sammeln und Strukturen zu bauen, um den schönsten Bienenstock für die Königin zu schaffen. Der Spieler mit dem prächtigsten Bienenstock im Land gewinnt!

pr.m: Engine Building, Modular Board, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Worker Placement
pr.d:
In a distant galaxy, PuffiNova is on the brink of destruction!
A massive meteor has shattered the planet and hurled its adorable inhabitants into space. Rescue them, rebuild PuffiNova, and collect the most stars to win the game!
At the start of the game, during setup, players decide what type of game they want to play. As many decks are included as there are players. In the family game version, only the easy family decks are used. For a more challenging game mode, the number of family decks is reduced, and players may choose to add the construction deck, which brings victory point multipliers to the game, the lightning deck, which adds immediate effects, or the buddy deck, which introduces player interaction.

PuzzleMyst is a brand-new game that combines the joy of jigsaw puzzling with an exciting mystery investigation.
Step into a fantastical version of Brittany and investigate the theft of the prestigious baking competition trophy!
Complete the first puzzle, then use the Clue Cards to uncover what really happened. Continue your investigation by solving the remaining puzzles, expose the culprit, and recover the stolen trophy!

pr.m: Dice Rolling, Push your Luck, Others
pr.d: Chaotisch-lustiger Stapelspaß für die ganze Familie! Die Spieler helfen Oma dabei, ihre Kätzchen geschickt zu einer wackeligen Katzenpyramide zu stapeln. Dabei sind Geschick, Konzentration und einfache Rechenaufgaben gefragt, um die besten Spielzüge zu planen. Fördert motorische Fähigkeiten und den spielerischen Umgang mit Zahlen. Wer als Erster alle seine Kätzchen unterbringt, gewinnt.​

Pálinka is a strategic Eurogame about the traditional Hungarian craft of fruit brandy making. Collect and process fruit, manage its sugar level, distill your pálinka and fill your shelves with valuable bottles. Careful planning and timing are essential to create the finest collection and score the most points. 2–4 players, 60–90 minutes, ages 10+.

【Not for sale at SPIEL Essen, demo play available】
Try to guess the answer by predicting what the question, divided into four parts, might be!

Game Setup
Shuffle the question cards face down and place four buttons on the table.
Once you' ve decided who will go first master, the game begins!

Aim of the Game
The player who answers three questions correctly first wins!

Game Flow
①The Master turns over the first question card.
②Respondents press a button to hear the question.
The master will read aloud twice the part of the diagram that corresponds to the shape that was pressed.
③Respondents, try to figure out the question as quickly as possible and give the correct answer!
④If the answer is correct, the master should read aloud the question and the answer, then hand the question card to…

QUICKY – Wer pokert und erklärt am besten?
Schnell denken, clever einschätzen und unter Zeitdruck die richtigen Worte finden: QUICKY ist das rasante Wortspiel, bei dem ihr selbst bestimmt, wie schwer es wird!
In jeder Runde muss ein Begriff erklärt und erraten werden. Der Clou: Alle schätzen vorher geheim, wie schnell sie den Begriff erklären können. Wer die niedrigste Zeit nennt, darf zuerst ran – und muss jetzt beweisen, dass die Ansage nicht zu mutig war. Scheitert der Versuch, bekommt der nächste Spieler seine Chance.
Mit über 600 Begriffen, einfachen Regeln und kurzen, spannenden Runden sorgt QUICKY für jede Menge Unterhaltung, überraschende Erklärungen und den ein oder anderen gewagten Zeit-Poker.
Einfach erklärt. Schnell gespielt. Und garantiert nicht so einfach, wie es klingt!

Im abstrakten Duell-Spiel Qomet müsst ihr wortwörtlich dafür sorgen, dass eure Sterne günstig stehen. Platziert eure Sterne auf dem Spielbrett und bewegt sie so, dass ihr euren Gegner überrascht. Wer zuerst ein Quadrat aus vier seiner Sterne bilden kann, gewinnt.

Denke schnell, reagiere schneller! Nur wer auf Zack ist, wird Qork gewinnen. Würfelt der Korken-Kraller eine 7 oder ein Pasch, gilt es, seinen Korken möglichst rasch in Sicherheit zu ziehen, bevor er mit dem Becher gekrallt wird. Verliere aber nicht den Faden bei billigen Täuschungsmanövern, denn Strafpunkte lassen nicht lang auf sich warten. Sei gewarnt: Dieses Spiel verursacht unkontrollierte Zuckungen und laute Schreie. Informiere vor jeder Partie deine Nachbarn - oder lade sie gleich ein zu einer Partie Qork!

Quantum - Verknüpfe Farben, kombiniere Zahlen!
Das ultimative Logikspiel mit doppeltem Spielspaß! Verknüpfe entweder gewieft gleiche Farben oder tüftele einfach nach Herzenslust, während du Punkte zu Zahlen zusammen kombinierst. Und sollte das noch nicht genug sein: gestalte selbst Tausende individuelle Knobeleien – jede mit einer garantierten Lösung!
60 vorgebene Aufgaben in verschiedenen Schwierigkeitsstufen und über 400000 verschiedene Legevarianten

Experience an exhilarating space adventure through a trick-taking game! Compete in three tricks simultaneously and develop masterful strategies, as victory depends on how well you can read your co-players aims and outsmart them to get the right amount of tricks. Engage in dynamic player interactions and beat your opponents in an exciting battle of wits while avoiding space debris and navigating the quantum universe.

Quartermaster General: West Front is the third entry in the Quartermaster General two-player line. It is played over 23 seasonal game rounds, from Fall 1939 through Spring 1945, with one player controlling the Allies' forces — United Kingdom, United States, and France — and the other playing the Axis: Germany, Italy, and other associated countries (the "Pact", so called after the Tripartite Pact).
Each player has a unique deck of cards that reflects the capabilities of that side throughout the course of the war: the invasion of Western Europe, the Battle of the Atlantic, and eventually — if the Allies hang on! — D-Day and liberation.
West Front also includes components and rules to create massive, combined games with Quartermaster General: East Front and South Front.

Quashars is a trick-taking game where every Trick you win can help—or hurt—your prediction.
At the start of each game, four Condition Cards are revealed, each rewarding different ways of winning Tricks. Before play begins, every player predicts how many times they will meet those conditions. During the game, you return a Chip each time you satisfy a condition. The challenge is to return exactly all of your Chips by the end of the game.
Because multiple conditions can be met with a single Trick, every victory becomes a puzzle. Should you win now, avoid winning, or save the perfect card for later? Read the table, adapt to the changing conditions, and make your prediction come true.

pr.a: David Heras Pino and Héctor Carrión
pr.m: Action Selection, Deck Building, Engine Building
pr.d:
Queen Alice is a Mid-Heavy Eurogame all about building engines to improve your actions.
Alice has received a strange call for help. Some words written backwards have appeared on the mirror in her living room: “Alice, we need a new queen”. Surprised, but without hesitating for a moment, she touches the mirror and realises that her hand can pass through it. Following her hand, the rest of her body is pulled to the other side of the mirror…
In Queen Alice, you belong to the ‘Court on the Other Side of the Looking-Glass’ and your mission is to prepare Alice's coronation banquet. Whoever does the best job will become the new Queen's right-hand person and therefore win the game. To achieve this, you must convince the different chess pieces that inhabit this world to help you with the…

Draft cards & craft legends in this fast-paced stratey card game set in the world of Cartographers & Roll Player. In Questline, assemble a hand of 7 sequential cards, claiming and discarding cards as you refine your selections. Take cards from the face down decks, or steal them from your neighbors’ discards! Gather up cards with compatible story elements and effects to earn the most reputation. Then, tally up and tell the tale of heroic adventure formed by your final hand of cards!

Quietbell is a story-driven mystery adventure inspired by the works of Howard Phillips Lovecraft. You’ll experience an engaging interactive narrative whose outcome depends entirely on your choices and actions. As you play, you will assemble a picture step by step and unravel the tangle of fates and events that once shook the enigmatic town of Quietbell.
The game features a "nonlinear communication" mechanic, allowing the player to interact with various in-game characters on different topics at their discretion.

Quint-X gibt es nun auch in klein und die Murmeln haben wir durch Stecker ersetzt. Das hilft auch dabei, den Überblick zu behalten. Denn immer der vorherige Zug des Mitspielers bestimmt, in welches Quadrat man seinen Stecker platzieren darf. Solange es dort freie Löcher gibt, hat man die freie Wahl. Ist alles belegt, wird ein Stecker ausgetauscht. Man muss also gut aufpassen, wo man den Mitspieler hinschickt, um selbst ins richtige Quadrat zu kommen und eine der Gewinnoptionen zu erfüllen.

Die 1608 von Samuel de Champlain gegründete Stadt Québec ist zweifellos eine der historisch bedeutendsten Städte Nordamerikas. Im Laufe ihrer über vierhundertjährigen Geschichte wurde ihr Schicksal von jenen menschlichen Bestrebungen gelenkt, die das Fundament der westlichen Welt bilden. Ob Religion oder Politik, Wirtschaft oder Kultur. All diese Bereiche haben die Entwicklung der Stadt, die heute zum UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe gehört, entscheidend geprägt.

In Québec seid ihr für die Entwicklung und den Ausbau der Stadt verantwortlich. In jedem der vier Jahrhunderte ringt ihr um die Mehrheit in den fünf Einflusszonen Zitadelle, Religion, Politik, Wirtschaft und Kultur . Dazu eröffnet ihr mit eurem Architekten neue Baustellen und entsendet Arbeiter, um den Bau dieser Gebäude voranzutreiben.…

QWIXX EXPRESS is a new base game variant of QWIXX that brings a breath of fresh air to the established game mechanics with its head-to-head format and unique dynamics.
The first major change: There are no longer any colored dice. Instead, each player uses two white dice and a third die on which the standard game colors are arranged in place of the usual pips. The second major change: Both players roll the dice simultaneously – until one player is satisfied with the result and calls out “Stop!” Whatever is on the table at that moment is available to that player for scoring. The other player can adjust their result with additional rolls, but this will cost negative points in the long run. The Qwixx score pad, the rules for crossing out the numbers, and the scoring system remain unchanged…
Seek glory by pleasing Ra, the Sun God and creator of the pantheon of Egyptian deities. Roll and reroll dice to get valuable combinations, but be careful — you might hasten the day of Ra’s judgment!

pr.m: Dice Placement, Dice Rolling, Push your Luck
pr.d:
SPIEL ESSEN 2026 Pre-order:
Pre-orders for pickup at SPIEL ESSEN 2026 are now open!
You can purchase items in advance through the official Saashi & Saashi website and pick them up at the Saashi & Saashi booth (6C300) at the event.
https://saashiandsaashi.com/en/products/railway_porters_event

Railway Porters is a push-your-luck dice game for 2 to 4 players. You play as a porter, placing luggage dice onto station boards, but deciding when to keep rolling and when to stop is the key. There are 6 different station boards to place your dice on, each with its own unique scoring system, so there is an abundant variety of things to enjoy. This is a family game, that is also highly recommended for people brand new to dice games.
A push-your-luck dice game about getting passengers' luggage to the…

pr.m: Dice Placement, Dice Rolling, Push your Luck
pr.d:
SPIEL ESSEN 2026 Pre-order:
Pre-orders for pickup at SPIEL ESSEN 2026 are now open!
You can purchase items in advance through the official Saashi & Saashi website and pick them up at the Saashi & Saashi booth (6C300) at the event.
https://saashiandsaashi.com/en/products/rp_newdestinations_event

This expansion for Railway Porters includes 4 new Station Boards, 6 Additional Rule Tiles, and more. Enjoy the expanded world of Railway Porters! (This expansion cannot be played on its own. You will need the Railway Porters base game.)
The new Station Boards are played together with the Station Boards from the base game. Each features its own new scoring system and rules, offering a different kind of enjoyment from the base game's Station Boards.
The Additional Rule Tiles bring a fresh feel to…

Das rasante Duell, bei dem alles spiegelverkehrt ist
Beide Personen sehen dasselbe Labyrinth vor sich, doch ist ihr Blick auf den Weg durch den Spiegel verdreht. Wer findet am schnellsten den Ausgang und kann das Duell für sich entscheiden? Ein unterhaltsamer Wettlauf, bei dem (fast) nichts ist, wie es scheint.
Hinweis: Du kannst REFLECT als Training auch alleine spielen und deinen persönlichen Highscore knacken!
Inhalt:
• 2 Blöcke mit je 100 Aufgaben

• 2 Klarsichthüllen

• 2 abwischbare Stifte

• 1 beidseitiger Spiegel

• 2 Standfüße

• 2 Sichtschirme

• 1 Spielanleitung

Spielprinzip:
In jeder Runde wartet ein neues Labyrinth auf die Spielenden und der Wettlauf beginnt. Beide Spieler:innen versuchen möglichst schnell und natürlich fehlerfrei den Weg durch den Irrgarten zu finden. Doch…

pr.a: Gary Kim / Hope Hwang / Yohan Goh
pr.d:
Looking for the next high-margin, fast-turnover 2-player hit?
Meet RESTORE, a premium tactical tile-placement duel designed by renowned authors Gary Kim, Hope Hwang, and Yohan Goh.
RESTORE combines an elegant ecological theme with an innovative cross-intersection drafting mechanism and variable modular boards. Packed into a fast 20-minute play time, it delivers intense depth with zero downtime.

Centuries ago, the rich lands around the Rhine formed the heart of Europe. Powerful dukes controlled their duchies from fortified castles along the river, gaining wealth from the prosperous cities they ruled. Conflict between duchies was common and often settled by intervention from the church.
Now is your chance! Can you expand your influence and outmaneuver your opponents to rule the Rhine?

ROAD RAGE ist ein chaotisches Kartenspiel, bei dem es nicht ums Ankommen geht – sondern darum, sich über alles und jeden so richtig aufzuregen.
Wer schafft es, auf der Straße komplett auszurasten, ohne sich von Snacks, Pillen oder einer netten Beifahrerin beruhigen zu lassen?
SPIELZIEL
Über 6 Runden sammelst du so viele Wutpunkte wie möglich. Wer am Ende die meisten Wutpunkte hat, gewinnt.
SO FUNKTIONIERT‘S
Alle Fahrer decken gleichzeitig Karten von ihrem Kartenstapel auf. Du entscheidest selbst, wenn du keine weiteren Karten mehr aufdecken willst. Falls sich zwei Entspannungskarten in deiner Auslage befinden, bist du tiefenentspannt und kriegst keine Wutpunkte.
INHALT
• 1 Spielanleitung und 1 Wertungsblock
• 6 Übersichtskarten
• 147 Spielkarten

Bei ROLLYMPICS tretet ihr in sechs verrückten Challenges gegeneinander an – in einer Olympiade mit Würfeln, bei der es gar nicht so sehr auf das Würfelglück ankommt! Stellt eure Geschicklichkeit, euer Timing und manchmal auch eure Nerven auf die Probe, sammelt Applaus und kämpft um den Sieg. Jede Challenge bringt neue Aufgaben, jede Menge Gelächter und spannende Wettkämpfe. Doch Vorsicht: Im großen Finale kann sich alles noch einmal wenden!
Mit bis zu 5 Personen erlebt ihr die spannenden Wettkämpfe. Das farbenfrohe Spielmaterial und die leichten Regeln sorgen für Spielspaß bei der ganzen Familie – und das nicht nur für Würfelfans!

The legendary auction game, RA, has returned.
The artwork was recreated by Ian O’Toole, who brought a modern look to this classic bestseller.

This edition includes both the German and Korean rulebooks.
The Traders expansion is not included.

An expansion to the auction game RA, Traders adds a new tile type to your experience.
Leverage the Nile River to send vessels around the region to grow your Dynasty through trade and communication. Bring back precious treasures and rare goods to extend your reach and solidify your place among the Gods.

pr.m: Action Selection, Drafting, Modular Board, Set Collection
pr.d: This is the German edition of Raas, originally published by Arcane Wonders.

pr.m: Dice Placement, Drafting, Engine Building, Set Collection, Others
pr.d:
Have your dance troupe learn to dance like the performers from the Gujarat region of India in this joyful game of dice drafting, set collection & engine building!
Immerse your troupe in the heart of the celebration by learning from skilled dancers on the central dance floor. Outfit them in traditional, eye-catching attire and equip them with vibrant dandiya sticks to dazzle the crowd. Inspire love to blossom between dancers during performances to unlock powerful bonuses. Balance these competing objectives, all while trying to match them to the dance skills acquired throughout the game. Does your dance troupe have what it takes to become the best on the dance floor?

pr.k: 903:RAGNAROK THE BOARD GAME: CEREMONY OF PRONTERA
pr.t: Ragnarok the board game: Ceremony of Prontera
pr.o: RAGNAROK THE BOARD GAME: CEREMONY OF PRONTERA
pr.m: Action Selection, Deck Building, Dice Rolling, Dungeon Crawler, Others
pr.d:
Ragnarok the Board Game: Ceremony of Prontera is a thematic strategy board game that recreates the beloved world and sense of adventure of the classic MMORPG, Ragnarok Online.
Players begin by creating their characters and choosing their favorite first job classes before setting out to explore the lands surrounding Prontera. Along the way, they will undertake quests from familiar NPCs, advance to second job classes, collect valuable equipment and resources, and eventually challenge powerful MVP monsters.
Designed as an accessible adventure RPG, the game combines dungeon-crawling combat with card-based skill mechanics inspired by the iconic abilities from *Ragnarok Online*. Each monster features its own unique behaviors and mechanics, while every scenario introduces different objectives…

Bietet, baut und erforscht - profitiert vom Railway Boom im historischen Japan!
Zur Anfangszeit der Meiji-Periode im späten 19. Jahrhundert weihte Japan seine erste Eisenbahnstrecke zwischen Shimbashi und Yokohama ein. Die Einführung dieses neuen Verkehrsmittels entfachte einen landesweiten Eisenbahnrausch. In der Hoffnung, von diesem „Railway Boom“ zu profi­tieren, gründeten Unternehmer überall neue Eisenbahngesellschaften. Diese kleinen, regionalen Firmen wurden während der Taishō- und Shōwa-Perioden nach und nach von den größeren Eisenbahngesellschaften einflussreicher Magnate geschluckt.
Nun seid ihr an der Reihe, eure eigenen Eisenbahnimperien aufzubauen. Lenkt die Geschicke eures Unternehmens, indem ihr Züge kauft, das Schienennetz ausbaut und Werksentwicklungen erforscht. Über…

pr.m: Auction, Modular Board, Tile Placement, Others
pr.d:
Railways of the Lost Atlas is an 18xx-style game set in a shifting landscape. The map, built by players as part of set-up, is different for each play. Players take on the role of individual investors who launch minor companies, build infrastructure, and generate revenue to increase their stock value or reinvest in the company. Minor companies eventually merge into major ones that have more freedom to expand their operations.
The twelve minor companies have distinct abilities that persist even after merging into a major to make for different combinations and unique company identities.
Enjoy multiple game modes and modular options that allow groups to tailor the game to their needs.

In Raindrops, players observe drops sliding down a window and identify their patterns, as their mind drifts to forgotten memories to be reconstructed.
Raindrops is a tile-collection and pattern-recognition game for 2–4 players. On their turn, players select a continuous downward path of matching symbols on a shared window board, starting from the top row and moving to adjacent spaces below or diagonally. All tiles in the path are collected, the remaining tiles slide downward, and the board is refilled from a bag.
Collected tiles are used to complete personal Memory cards, which require specific symbol patterns. Use bonus tile to help complete your Memory cards, while reaching the bottom row can award hidden-value Thunder tokens. Completing Memory cards scores points and may allow players…

pr.a: Inka Brand, Markus Brand, Lukas Wiechens, Verena Wiechens
pr.d:
Rank my Denk! is a cooperative party game where it’s not just what you perform – but how well you do it!
Act, draw, describe or make sounds to help your team guess a word. But there’s a twist: you secretly have to perform on a specific level from 1 (terrible) to 5 (brilliant).
Can your team guess the word and figure out how good – or hilariously bad – you were trying to be?
The better you can read each other, the more points you score together!

Was wäre der Herbst ohne leckere Äpfel ? Anders als beim „kleinen“ Raupenrallye, ist der Apfel hier in 4 Teile geteilt und muss erst einmal zusammengepuzzelt werden. Danach noch die farbigen Scheiben beliebig in den Vertiefungen verteilen – und schon machen sich hier bis zu 4 Raupenfamilien auf den Weg ins Kerngehäuse. Anders als in der „kleinen“ Variante für 2 Spieler gibt es hier einen großen Würfel mit Farben und Symbolen. Die Farben des Würfels entsprechen den Farben der kleinen Scheiben und geben vor, wohin man ziehen kann. Das Kleeblatt ist ein Farbjoker und würfelt man die Raupe, darf man 1 Figur vom Spielfeld nehmen. Und wenn man eine 3er oder 4er Reihe schafft, darf man sogar am Festschmaus teilnehmen.

pr.m: Action Selection, Drafting, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Trade
pr.d:
In “Reactor Rescue” schlüpfen die SpielerInnen in die Rolle von Ingenieuren, deren Raumschiffe auf dem Weg zur Reperatur eines ausfallenden Reaktors in der Stadt Electra eine Panne erlitten haben. Jeder Spieler muss sein eigenes Raumschiff reparieren, indem er echte elektronische Schaltkreise zusammenbaut, bevor er in die Stadt zurückkehren kann. Nur ein Ingenieur wird seine Mission erfüllen.
“Reactor Rescue” ist spielerisch einfach in fünf Minuten zu erlernen und spricht sowohl Familien als auch erfahrene Spieler an.

In diesem Reich gehen Magie und Intrige Hand in Hand. Hilfreiche Wesen und mächtige Artefakte wechseln die Besitzer, bis jemand schließlich seine Bestimmung erfüllt!
Biete in deinem Zug eine deiner Handkarten zur Auktion an. Deine Mitspieler bieten mit Karten aus ihrer Hand. Der Höchst bietende erhält die Karte und ihren Effekt, während du die gebotenen Karten bekommst und so deine Hand für die nächsten Auktionen stärkst. Doch Vorsicht: Wer keine Handkarten mehr hat, scheidet aus - jedes Gebot kann dein letztes sein!

Avoid marriage proposals to win.
A captivating trick-taking game that surprises with a new rule every round. Play as Snow White, the Little Mermaid, Mulan, Little Red Riding Hood, or another beloved princess. Each has a unique ability that can give you the decisive edge.
Adjustable complexity for an easier start.

Als Clanführer baut ihr Schottland wieder auf und versucht, durch geschicktes Platzieren von Landschaftsplättchen die meisten Siegpunkte zu erzielen. Farmen, Energienetze und Siedlungen erzeugen Wertungen, in Siedlungen und an Burgen konkurriert ihr um Mehrheiten und Kontrolle. Der doppelseitige Spielplan bietet mit Schottland und Irland zwei unterschiedliche Varianten. In Schottland führen Kathedralen zu geheimen Aufträgen, während Irland mit öffentlichen Zielen und Boni stärker planbar ist. Das…

Watch your step in the depths of Lindwurm! In the volcanic chasms where burning lava flows, the most wild of emotions mix with the magic of orichalcum and the Fog to give life to the Red Caps. Mischievous, impulsive, eternally hyperactive, and addicted to wild fun, these immortal little imps embody a single, uncontrollable passion: restless children ready to wreak havoc on the battlefield!
After taking a thousand-year "nap" in his Chamber of Dreams, the elven general Nuada has awakened to reclaim the glory of Gae Assail. Flanked by colossal Crucibles of ceramic and obsidian that forge new hordes amidst white flames, this refined Master of Craftsmen struggles to bring a semblance of order to his frenzied troops.

Duell zwischen Fälscherin und Agentin
Begebt euch auf eine packende Verfolgungsjagd rund um den Globus! Spielt entweder Angela Farbank, eine geniale Fälscherin, die um die Welt reist,
um gefälschte Schecks im Wert von 1.000.000 Dollar einzulösen, oder Jessah Hope, eine unnachgiebige FBI-Agentin, die davon träumt, Farbank hinter Gitter
zu bringen. Bluffen und Vorausahnen sind die Schlüsselwörter dieser spannenden Verfolgung. Als Angela reist du um die Welt und trägst deine Bewegungen und falschen Identitäten geheim auf deiner persönlichen Weltkarte ein, um im Falle einer Festnahme zu entkommen.
Als Jessah deckst du Angelas Tarnung auf, indem du sie aufspürst und verhaftest, bevor sie ihren Plan vollenden kann - dabei stehen dir die nahezu unbegrenzten Ressourcen des FBI zur Verfügung, denn…

pr.o: RED NOTICE: A MILLION OR PRISON
pr.d:
Embark in a thrilling chase across the globe! Play as Angela Farbank, a genius counterfeiter traveling the world to cash $1,000,000 in forged checks, or Jessah Hope, an unyielding FBI agent who dreams of putting Farbank behind bars. Bluffing and anticipation are the key words in this gripping pursuit. Will you be able to thwart your opponent's plans and win before they do?
Playing as Angela, you must travel the world and cash counterfeit checks totalling $1,000,000. Use your personal world map to secretly record your movements and your fake identities to escape if you are captured.
As Jessah, blow Angela's cover by locating her, then arrest her before she can carry out her plan. Fortunately, you have the FBI's virtually unlimited resources at your disposal: as the checks are cashed, your…

two games with one deck!
2-7 player party mode. Everyone plays a card simultaneously, then another card simultaneously. Highest sum is discarded, but the lowest sum gets +10 and can steal the win for the round. First player to discard down to 3 cards wins.
1 player solitaire mode. Merge piles to be 1 higher or lower than another pile to discard it. Refill open piles with 1 card. Discard through the whole deck to win! Mathy/puzzly meditative gameplay!

Es gibt nur eine Regel für den Sieg: Besitze die besten Karten!
Hast du am Ende deines Zuges nicht die beste Auslage entsprechend der Vorschrift, hast du verloren. Halte dich an die Vorschrift oder ändere sie! Kannst du mithalten?
Red7 enthält 7 Zahlen, 7 Farben und 7 Vorschriften.
Das reichte aus für 4 Golden-Geek-Nominierungen: BESTES INNOVATIVES, PARTY-, FAMILIEN- UND KARTENSPIEL. CARL CHUDYK und CHRIS CIESLIK entwarfen ein kleines, geniales Spiel! Ihr werdet sofort begeistert sein.

Lass deinen Wald gedeihen

Lass deinen eigenen Wald wachsen, indem du die einzigartigen Fähigkeiten von kleinen und großen Pflanzen geschickt einsetzt und die Effizienz deines Ökosystems immer weiter steigerst. Setzt du auf Pflanzen, die im Schatten weiterwachsen können, sobald du eine andere, größere Pflanze darauflegst, oder nutzt du die starken Effekte im Sonnenlicht?

Reforest ist ein Kartenspiel, bei dem es durchaus knifflig wird. Du baust in einer pyramidenförmigen Auslage ein gesundes und dauerhaftes Wald-Ökosystem auf. Achte beim Ausspielen deiner Pflanzenkarten auf ihre spezifischen Wachstumsbedingungen, synergetischen Effekte und Größen, um eine möglichst effiziente Engine zu entwickeln. Wird es dir gelingen, auf dem begrenzten Raum durch geschicktes Planen eines der Tiere mit…

Regulus High-Fantasy Arena-Sports is a highly tactical skirmish boardgame. To win the game, player must score 10 victory points by: knocking-out opponents, score public objectives or have their characters standing in the Regulus zone, a king of the hill center of the map where points can be scored at the end of three rounds.
The unique initiative system lets players strategize when a character starts their turn. Playing a low numbered initiative card will let a character start early, dishing out some hard hits or eagerly avoid any potential danger.
When a character starts their turn they may do up to two actions, which include: movement, attacks, spells, laying down traps, healing and pushing and pulling your enemy's to spaces they don't want to go. Position your character's just right…

pr.t: Reise ins Unglück - Krimidinner Spiel für 6-8 Personen ab 12 Jahren
pr.o: REISE INS UNGLUECK - KRIMIDINNER SPIEL FUER 6-8 PERSONEN AB 12 JAHREN
pr.d:
WAS IST EIN KRIMI-DINNER SPIEL?
Schlüpft in eure Rollen und begebt euch auf eine spannende Reise quer durch Europa. Ein ungelöstes Verbrechen, knifflige Rätsel und realistische Beweismittel warten darauf, von euch entschlüsselt zu werden. Folgt den Spuren eines rätselhaften Falls, reist von einem europäischen Schauplatz zum nächsten und entdeckt dabei verborgene Geheimnisse und mysteriöse Vorfälle, die ganz Europa in Atem halten.
DER FALL REISE INS UNGLÜCK
Die Koffer sind gepackt, Tickets und Pässe liegen bereit. Eure große Europareise beginnt! Neun Menschen aus neun Ländern, eine Reise quer durch Europa und die Aussicht auf neue Freunde und unvergessliche Abenteuer. Alles scheint perfekt, wäre da nicht Marie. Die Schweizerin liebt Luxus, Geld und alles, was glänzt. Sie lässt andere gerne…

Reiseträume – das Memo-Spiel für Senior:innen mit extragroßen Bildkarten
Reisen zu berühmten Sehenswürdigkeiten und besonderen Orten schaffen Erinnerungen, die ein Leben lang bleiben. Das SingLiesel-Memo „Reiseträume“ zeigt bekannte Sehenswürdigkeiten aus ganz Europa und lädt dazu ein, vergangene Urlaubserlebnisse wiederzuentdecken und neue Reiseziele zu erträumen.
Die extragroßen Bildkarten sind gut zu erkennen und leicht zu greifen. Dadurch eignen sie sich auch für Menschen mit Demenz. Denn vertraute Motive können Erinnerungen wecken und zum Erzählen, Rätseln und gemeinsamen Austausch anregen.
Neben dem klassischen Memo-Spiel lassen sich die Karten vielseitig zum Benennen, Zuordnen und Raten einsetzen. So verbindet „Reiseträume“ Generationen und sorgt für gemeinsame Erfolgserlebnisse –…

pr.d:
Easy to learn, quick to play!
In Restart, you skillfully place your tiles in rows and use special tiles at just the right moment to throw a wrench in your opponents' plans! Success requires a sharp mind, good timing, and a bit of luck to get rid of all your tiles. Who will keep the best overview and collect the fewest penalty points? A varied family game that delights with clever moves and a smart twist!

pr.d:
Revenant is a competitive worker placement game of shifting allegiances, set in the Voidfall universe. Players take on the role of rival admirals coordinating the defense of a fleeing starfleet, and competing to earn influence with the factions that stand to survive the journey.
Across four rounds, players assign crew to ships throughout the fleet, from which they will fight corrupted ships, explore planets in search of resources, upgrade their ship and crew, deploy new vessels, and more. Each ship is affiliated with one of the Great Houses, and each time you assign crew there, you gain influence with that House.
The journey won’t be an easy one. The Voidborn’s corrupted forces will continuously attack the fleet, dealing damage to various ships at the end of every round. You can take your…
Revenant ist ein kompetitives, atmosphärisches Sci-Fi-Strategiespiel über das Überleben einer Raumflotte am Rand der Vernichtung.

pr.d:
In the deepest part of the Enchanted Forest, the shadow of the Evil Queen is longer than ever. Snow White has been enchanted, the victim of a spell that can only be broken by the Queen’s death.
You are one of the Seven Dwarfs. You manage to escape when the Queen’s Henchmen and fearsome Bosses arrive to capture you, but your companions have not been so fortunate. Armed with your axe, your courage and whatever you can gather along the way, you must carve a route forward, defeat her servants and free the other Dwarfs. Each ally rescued will give you strength; each Reward, a new breath of hope.
Your final destination is the Castle. There the Queen awaits you, more powerful than ever. Only by defeating her will you be able to break her spell and free Snow White. Your adventure begins now…

Theme: Building a Maritime Empire
Command your own maritime empire in Rival Seas, a highly interactive strategy game where the oceans are your market and your rivals are ruthless. Chart efficient routes and fulfill the shifting demands of coastal towns to secure quick credits. But true victory requires more than just navigation — it takes corporate warfare. Acquire shares, seize control as CEO, and siphon company wealth into your personal portfolio. Only the savviest entrepreneur will outsmart the competition and claim the ultimate fortune. The sea is calm, but the competition is cutthroat. Do you have what it takes to rule the waves?
Key points:
Dynamic Maritime Economy: Adapt to ever-changing market demands and supply bustling coastal towns for instant profit.

It’s Summertime in Maple Valley and the River Market is open for business! The narrow streets and waterways are bustling with vendors hawking their wares and customers in search of a good bargain. The market is growing, with new businesses opening all the time.
​River Market is the new standalone game set in the cozy world of Creature Comforts, designed by Roberta Taylor and published by KTBG.

River Rats is a cooperative game set aboard a luxurious futuristic riverboat. Defeat the evil River Rats using teamwork, clever hand management, and strategic planning to shift the odds in your favour!
Each round, players add cards from their hand to build the best poker hand, each suit triggering a different ability to help you. At the end of the round, your goal is to collectively craft stronger poker combinations than the River Rats. The loser between your team and the rat will accumulate debts. Who will go bankrupt first?
You can even increase the difficulty with different modes to make an even more rat-tling challenge!
KEY POINTS
• Cooperative Poker where the odds are stacked against you!

• Build the best hand and deduce the River Rat’s cards to gain the upper hand

• Different…

In “River Rivals,” even the most peaceful animals engage in fierce competition in their search for fresh fish: Using their strengths and highly effective gear, two animal clans compete for dominance on the river, and they won’t shy away from paw swipes and claw attacks. “River Rivals,” published by the Vienna-based game publisher Piatnik, is a clever family game for two players ages ten and up, in which every attack from your opponent requires a smart response.

Purple and turquoise fish dart about in the river, while on its banks, lynx, raccoons, and others prepare to set out on their hunt. It’s sure to be exciting, as the two Danish designers, Christian Kudahl and Mads Fløe, have given each animal competitor unique strengths and abilities. Effects such as “Quick Catch” or “Claw Attack”…

Rivolto ist ein Strategiespiel mit vielen Wendungen. Beide Spieler spielen mit dem gleichen Material, aber mit unterschiedlichem Ziel. Die Farbe der Spielfelder ist durch die kleinen Markierscheiben vorgegeben. Sie werden zu Beginn beliebig eingesetzt. Die Spielsteine haben jeweils eine schwarze und eine weiß bedruckte Seite. Legt man diese auf ein freies Spielfeld gilt immer die Seite, die aktuell nach oben zeigt. Je nachdem, ob die Farbe des gerade gelegten Spielsteins der darunter liegenden Farbe des Feldes entspricht oder nicht, werden einige bereits liegende Spielsteine gewendet. Dadurch variiert die Anzahl der Spielsteine pro Farbe ständig und die eigene Taktik wird manchmal ganz schön durcheinander gewirbelt. Wer am Ende die Mehrheit in seine (vorher festgelegten) Sammelfarbe hat,…

Road Master is a tactical board game of modern logistics and truck transportation. As the head of a transport company, players must optimize their routes, manage their cargo crates, and carefully plan their deliveries to outsmart their competitors.
Driven by a tight action-selection mechanic, players must choose wisely each turn from a shifting pool of double-sided action tiles—to load, unload, drive forward, or reverse. With only four actions available per round, every choice demands strict planning and sharp strategy. For a greater challenge, advanced rules introduce lucrative but highly risky perishable and explosive cargo to spice up the game! Will you optimize your loading bay efficiency or brave the danger for a bigger payout? Manage your actions, handle the pressure, and become the…
Expansion : 6 promo cards for the game, each granting one extra action per turn.

Robo Rumble

Robo Rumble is a light strategy robot battle game where players build stronger armies through upgrades, energy management, and dice roll activation. Each robot is tied to a number, and when that number is rolled, its abilities trigger, creating a mix of engine building and combat tension. Players begin with the same base robots, then use energy to buy upgrades that improve health, firepower, and output over time. The last robot army standing wins, making Robo Rumble a fast, competitive choice for game night.

Key Features:
• BUILD A ROBOT ENGINE: Spend energy to buy upgrade cards and strengthen your robot army over the course of the game.

• DICE-ROLL ACTIVATION: Roll two dice to activate the matching robot number and trigger its abilities for energy, life, or damage.

A silent, wordless co-op game for 2 players. Guide two trapped robots out of a hostile factory using secret action cards and a single "BEEP" warning token — talking is forbidden. Five linked campaigns, upgradeable robots, and 31 escape scenarios make every playthrough different. World premiere at Essen Spiel 2026.

With Ear Candy, it's time for your songs to take center stage! The first expansion for Rock Hard: 1977 (which requires the base game to play) lets you use your Life Experiences to compose singles in various styles. Promoting these singles will get them played on the radio and propel you up the charts, giving you an additional way to gain Fame. The expansion also includes two new characters, two new managers, two new types of Candy, and additional cards for each deck. Do you have what it takes to be number one?

Designed by the legendary Jackie Fox (of the 70s rock band The Runaways) and illustrated by Jennifer Giner, Rock Hard: 1977 allows for games for 2 to 5 players, ages 14 and up, in sessions of 45 to 90 minutes. Through worker placement mechanics and events, players will take on the…

Roll the selected dice and try to be the first to beat the symbol on the green Rock-Paper-Scissors die by moving the right card(s) forward!
• Improves your reaction and perception speed.

• Quickly adapt between following the regular-, reversed- and ‘Party’ Rules each time the dice roll!

• Become a master of the game by improving your skills step by step with the 3 different difficulty levels.

Adrift on the open sea, a creaking raft carries a glittering pile of stolen treasure. Gems slide and tumble across the deck as pirates rock the raft to grab the richest prizes… Gather the sparkling loot and load it into your Lifeboats, and make sure to grab as much loot as possible before the Pirate Flag signals the end. When the chaos settles, the pirate who rescued the most valuable treasure wins!

pr.d:
The furniture store is opening its doors – and it’s up to you to hunt down the best pieces! Day after
day, you’ll snag furniture from under each other’s noses, puzzle them onto your trucks, and decorate
your houses. You can shape your home however perfect or chaotic you like. But it’s not just about your own
taste: in the store’s café, new roomies are waiting with their own unique wishes, hoping to move in with you.
After four days, the player who made the most of their living space and managed to be mindful of their roomies’
wishes and basic needs has a good chance of scoring the most points and win this delightful and exciting contest.

Die Hörner im Norden rufen zum Krieg!
Die Zeit der Eroberungen ist gekommen!
Schärft eure Äxte und schickt eure Plündertrupps in die Schlacht, um Außenposten unter eure Kontrolle zu bringen. Ein früher Erfolg mag euch Ruhm versprechen … doch während Raganrök werden die Arsen selbst eingreifen.
Nur wer seine Feinde überlistet, wird am Ende den Sieg erringen!

“Wer meint, wahre Abenteuer spielten sich nur im Kampf gegen Monster oder beim Regieren von Imperien ab, sollte versuchen, das Herz Roxanes zu gewinnen. Als junge Cyranos werben die Spielenden um ihre Gunst, sammeln Zeichen ihrer Zuneigung, beweisen Mut im Duell und formen aus ihren Worten die schönsten Verse. Doch Roxane ist wechselhaft: Ihre Vorlieben für Romantik und Poesie verändern sich im Verlauf der Partie – und nur wer ihre Wünsche erkennt und im richtigen Moment handelt, kann am Ende ihr Herz erobern.”

Roxane ist ein thematisch stark verankertes Kennerspiel für 2–4 Personen. Die Spieler übernehmen die Rolle junger „Cyranos“, die mit mehrfunktionalen Textkarten Verse verfassen, Rosen, Briefe und Fechtmarker sammeln, Roxanes Wünsche erfüllen und sich notfalls in Duellen…

pr.o: ROYAL GAME OF UR -  CARAVAN MODE
pr.m: Dice Rolling, Pick-up and Deliver, Others
pr.d:
Roll the dice and enter a race where strategy, chance, and courage have shaped every move for thousands of years.
Guide your pieces along the ancient path, claim the protection of the rosettes, and send your opponent back to the beginning. Every roll creates a new decision: advance toward victory, protect your position, or take the risk that could change everything.
Once you master the classic game, take on our new Caravan Mode. Turn your checkers into caravans carrying precious Lapis Stones and decide how much cargo you are willing to risk. Deliver 20 stones safely—or capture all 24 stones from your opponent—to claim victory.
Choose your route, protect your treasure, and feel the suspense of an ancient race transformed into a daring journey across Mesopotamia.

Rubik’s Rush
Twelve colored button-keys, three levels, and the clock is ticking: up to four players can compete against each other in Rubik’s Rush to prove whether they can keep their cool under intense time pressure. The rules are simple, but the challenge is not: the game signals whose turn it is to find and press a button that completes a three-in-a-row line (a line of three buttons of the same color).
At first, players only search for horizontal and vertical lines. From round four onward, diagonal lines are added to the mix. Anyone who makes it to the sixth round has to complete two lines. Perhaps it is better to practice in solo mode first before challenging friends to a match?
Ultimately, the lucky winner is the last player left in the game.

You are a movie distributor. Your goal is to produce as many hit movies as possible.
What are your studio's strengths? Collect the right genres and create the biggest movie trends of the season!
Become the ultimate Movie Mogul!!
Players take turns playing cards from their hands to form a row, then acquire the two adjacent cards from that row. Be careful not to let your opponents snatch the cards you want, and steal cards from them to prevent them from taking them. Skillfully collect cards to boost your score.
The game ends after a set number of rounds. The player with the highest final score is the winner.

pr.m: Area Control, Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:
RUMIAN – Shape the Kingdom. Forge your Legend.
Rumian is an action-packed strategy board game for 2–4 players, where exploration, resource management and epic adventure come together in a dynamic ancient kingdom shaped by the players themselves. Every turn presents meaningful choices as you explore new lands, gather resources, construct buildings, craft goods, complete quests and outmaneuver your rivals in the race to become Rumian's next legend.
No two adventures unfold the same way. Specialize as a fearless adventurer, a master builder, a wealthy merchant or a legendary blademaster—or combine different strategies to adapt to an ever-changing kingdom and outmaneuver your rivals.
Every decision shapes the fate of the kingdom and earns you Victory Points through your achievements. When the…

The goal is simple: be the last one standing.
Each player must manage the Revolver tokens and their three Skill tokens. The Skill tokens represent both the player’s abilities and their remaining lives, which they must preserve to stay in the game. This game is not for the faint of heart...
On your turn, either shoot (the stack of tokens has 7 "clicks" and 1 "bang!") or activate one of your 3 skills (which will be turned face down).
Skills can range from passing the turn to another person and reordering the stack of shots to cancelling another skill or making someone shoot twice.
If you reveal a "click" when shooting, you will turn one of your skill tokens face up. If you reveal a "bang!", you will lose one of your face-up skill tokens.
A player will be eliminated if they reveal a "bang!"…

Can your friends read your mind?
S-Tier is a party game where your opinions become the puzzle! Each round, the leader secretly ranks five pictures from S to F according to a random topic. Everyone else tries to figure out exactly how the leader rated them.
Play cooperatively, compete individually, or split into teams depending on your group size. Discuss, debate, and discover just how well you really know each other!

Sam is a sweet little doggy who is fascinated with looking for and finding the objects that the people of her village lose. She’s so good at it that her neighbours come to her and her friends whenever they lose something and can’t find it. Help Sam and her friends to find the objects the people of the village lose.

At the helm of your Corporation, dive into a competitive deck-building game where the quest for power leaves no room for chance! Recruit mercenaries, optimize your choices, and crush the competition to assert your dominance over the world.
Three major paths lead to victory: Corruption, Propaganda, or Hacking. Each approach unlocks unique strategies — whether through manipulation, control, or infiltration — offering a rich and evolving tactical depth.
SAN: ARTEFACT is an expansion for the SAN game. Twelve cards to make the game asymmetrical.

Be the first to come up with a word that matches both the letter tiles on the table and the question being read aloud to score points. Choose between 100 trivia and 100 party questions, flip the hourglass, and let the game begin!
• Age: 14+

• Time: 10+ min

• Players: 2+

Contents:
• 100 party questions

• 100 trivia questions

• 60 letter tiles

• 1 hourglass

• 1 rulesheet

The word game where you have to think fast!
Be the first to come up with a word that matches both the letter tiles on the table and the question being read aloud to score points. Flip the hourglass, and let the game begin!
• Age: 14+

• Time: 10+ min

• Players: 2+

Contents:
• 200 trivia questions

• 60 letter tiles

• 1 hourglass

• 1 rulesheet

GAME OBJECTIVE
Be the first to shout a word that matches the letter tile on the table and the card being read!

SET5 - Around The World is a set-collection card game with intense player interaction, even though it's not explicitly stated in the mechanics or rulebook. Throughout the game, players organically bluff, block, and negotiate to disrupt opponents, distract strategies, and seize every possible advantage. Set 5 transforms simple set collection into a mind game, with a unique feel and mechanics that create an experience unlike any other game.

Attention lead researchers! You can’t reach the stars with flimsy resources. If you're serious about finding alien life, your research station needs a professional overhaul.
Whether you’re scanning nearby stars or analyzing data back home, these upgraded tokens ensure your exploration agency is built for the long haul. After all, if a "gravity anomaly" (also known as your friend accidentally bumping the table) scatters your energy reserves, you might just miss the most important signal in human history.
Improve your mission with these upgraded metal Credits and two-color acrylic Energy tokens.

INCLUDES:
• 30 Acrylic Energy Tokens

• 30 Metal Credits

• 2 Plastic Containers

Spy Team is a team-based trick-taking game for four players, played two against two. Two elite spy agencies, C.A.T. and B.I.R.D., compete to prove which of them is the finest. Success depends on trust and coordination — yet partners are never allowed to discuss their plans.
At the start of each round, players receive a hand of cards that may not be rearranged. Cards can only be played from either end of the hand, and while the card backs show each card's color, its number stays hidden from the other players. Playing one card per trick, players try to coordinate with their partner while reading the opposing team's intentions. Each mission calls for a specific split of tricks between the two teammates — one partner takes exactly 1 trick and the other 5, or 2 and 4, or 3 and 3.
A round ends…

In this shedding game you play “clusters” to get rid of your cards but also draw cards if it is not full. A cluster is an uninterrupted sequence of cards, with multiple cards of the same number playable. Each successive hand must be a stronger cluster, either more cards played or the lowest number must be higher if the same number of cards is played. Be first to shed all your cards!

There are 10 cards each of 1 to 10. 11 starting cards each are dealt, with an emphasis on lower numbers, and deck cards, with an emphasis on higher numbers, will be drawn later. On a turn players may play a “cluster” of cards or pass. However, you draw as many cards as are needed to fill out the cluster into a rectangle. Play successively stronger clusters, until all other players pass and the table is…

You are space enthusiast and artist, looking through your telescope at the universe and drawing what you see as a mural on your wall. You take photos, trace constellations, observe rocket launches, and journal every experience along the way to craft your beautiful artwork.
In Star Gazers, you select tiles and tokens from the universe board that represent a collection of different observations you make through your telescope. Those tiles and tokens are then placed into your mural to create different connection points and features to score a variety of drafted objectives. Create the most beautiful and well-designed mural to celebrate your love of the cosmos!

pr.t: SUPERA — A Wooden Balancing Strategy Game
pr.o: SUPERA — A WOODEN BALANCING STRATEGY GAME
pr.d:
What happens when gravity is no longer where you expect it to be?
SUPERA is a fast-paced competitive strategy game where players race to grow their own tree higher than their opponents on a shared three-dimensional structure. Five different TETRIS-inspired wooden shapes, tilted planes and constantly changing points of balance turn every move into a new spatial challenge.
The rules are simple. The challenge is anything but. Roll the die to determine your shape, find a matching place for your colour and extend your tree. But as the structure grows, familiar ideas of "up" and "down" start to disappear. With nothing reliably horizontal or vertical, players must constantly rediscover gravity, rethink their plans and decide how much risk they are willing to take.
SUPERA combines strategy,…

pr.a: Jim Cartwright, Tyler Parrott, Daniel Schaefer, Jeremy Zwirn
pr.d: The Homeworlds Booster Display contains 24 booster packs for the ninth set of Star Wars: Unlimited, with 15 cards in each pack. Homeworlds focuses on iconic planets, alien cultures, creatures and the forces that defend or invade them, adding new cards and mechanics for deck building.

pr.a: Jim Cartwright, Tyler Parrott, Daniel Schaefer, Jeremy Zwirn
pr.d: The Homeworlds Carbonite Booster Display contains 12 premium booster packs aimed at collectors of Star Wars: Unlimited. It showcases cards from the Homeworlds set in premium treatments while the set itself explores iconic planets, cultures, creatures and armies from across the galaxy.

pr.d: This display contains ready-to-play Homeworlds Spotlight Decks centered on Chewbacca and Grand Moff Tarkin, providing an immediate way to play with cards from Set 9. Homeworlds explores iconic planets, cultures, creatures and defending or invading armies from across the Star Wars galaxy.

Jim Cartwright, Tyler Parrott, Daniel Schaefer, Jeremy Zwirn
pr.d: ICONS 2027 ist ein kompaktes Star-Wars-Unlimited-Mini-Set mit bekannten Figuren und Momenten aus der Star-Wars-Saga und einem bewusst zugänglichen Spielansatz. Dieses englischsprachige Booster-Display enthält Booster mit jeweils neun Karten; in jedem Pack befindet sich unter anderem eine seltene oder legendäre Karte sowie eine Hyperspace-Foil-Karte.

pr.a: Jim Cartwright, Tyler Parrott, Daniel Schaefer, Jeremy Zwirn
pr.d: Die deutschsprachige ICONS-2027-Starter-Box führt Schritt für Schritt in Star Wars: Unlimited ein. Zwei vorkonstruierte Decks mit Darth Vader und Prinzessin Leia bilden den Einstieg; zusätzliche Deckbau-Pakete und Booster erweitern anschließend den Kartenpool und führen an den eigenen Deckbau heran.

Their wings could not be heard in the dark of night, their movements were no more than a fleeting shadow against the starlight.
In this tactical dueling game, you must skillfully wield the strengths and abilities of your Mistwings against one another and think outside the box to conquer your opponent's grove. It is a battle of wits rather than one of brute force, for both sides must make the most of the contested terrain in order to win.
Each player has the same 8 units (Mistwings) of strengths 1-8, which each have their own special ability. Mistwings can only capture others of equal or lesser strength and must be moved through at least one of the 8 rings on the corners of the board beforehand. A player wins the game if they have either managed to move one of their Mistwings into the…

pr.k: 413:SACRED ATLAS TAROT – A JOURNEY THROUGH THE WORLD’S HOLY PLACES
pr.t: Sacred Atlas Tarot – A Journey Through the World’s Holy Places
pr.o: SACRED ATLAS TAROT – A JOURNEY THROUGH THE WORLD’S HOLY PLACES
pr.d:
Sacred Atlas Tarot is a 78-card deck that connects traditional Tarot symbolism with sacred places from around the world.
Each card is paired with a real spiritual, historical or culturally significant location chosen to reflect the meaning and atmosphere of that Tarot archetype. Temples, monasteries, pilgrimage sites, sacred mountains and other remarkable places become part of the visual language of the deck.
The illustrations combine Art Deco-inspired composition with atmospheric landscapes and architectural details, creating a Tarot deck that feels both symbolic and exploratory.
The deck includes all 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana cards and is suitable for Tarot readings, reflection, travel-inspired exploration and collecting.
Includes: 78 illustrated Tarot cards · QR code guidebook

Saga: Vikings vs Anglo-Saxons is a fast-paced strategy game for 2 players built around area control and action management.
Each player takes control of one side, Vikings or Anglo-Saxons, each with unique victory conditions and strategic priorities.
At the heart of the game lies the action tile system. Each round, players select actions that will define their turn — but choices are limited, and timing is everything.
Each round is divided into four phases: selecting tiles, resolving actions, combat, and end of round.
Players will:
– move units and fight for control of regions,
– recruit and manage their forces,
– develop economy through strongholds and resources,
– use special actions to disrupt and outmaneuver the opponent.
Combat is not just about strength, it’s about preparation, hidden…

In 1703, Czar Peter founded a city that was to become Russia’s ‘window to Europe’: Saint Petersburg. It quickly developed into a centre of politics, trade and culture.
In Saint Petersburg, you’ll immerse yourselves in this historic era:
You’ll employ craftsmen, construct magnificent buildings and use the roubles you’ve earned to gain the influence of the nobility.
The classic strategy game in all its new splendour:
This graphically revamped new edition of St Petersburg, first published in 2004, includes the base game as well as the newly compiled expansion ‘Hope for a New Society’.

Gleich denken ist gut - gleich schreiben ist besser!
Bei Same Word Challenge geht es nicht darum, das kreativste oder ausgefallenste Wort zu finden - sondern genau das Wort, auf das auch die anderen kommen.
Inhalt: 80 Begriffskarten (mit je 3 Begriffen), 1 Anleitung

Growing Empire is a fun, quick-paced mini game, featuring some of the mechanics from the base game of Sammu-ramat.
Queen Sammu-ramat was a wife of King Shamshi-Adad V and after he died in 811 BC, she ruled the Neo-Assyrian Empire as its regent for five years until her son Adad-nirari III came of age. She ruled at a time of political uncertainty. You and your friends take the role of Sammu-ramat and her Advisors and try to Grow her Empire and face the challenges together.
12 Event cards from Growing Empire can be used in the base game of Sammu-ramat.

The Ultimate Sandcastle Showdown
It’s a perfect day at the beach, and the friendly competition has begun! Everyone is racing to build the most impressive sandcastle before the tide rolls in. In Sandcastles, you’ll stack sandy towers, line up rows of windows, connect colorful starfish, and decorate your masterpiece with buckets, shells, and shovels. As birds soar across the sky tiles at the top of your castle, your creation slowly comes to life, piece by piece.
Each turn, a tile is revealed and you decide whether to keep it or let it pass to someone else. Once you take a tile, you add it to your castle, carefully placing it to earn the most points by the end of the game. Over 15 quick rounds, your castle fills out piece by piece. Plan ahead, grab the right tiles at the right time, and…

Sand Castles

Sandcastles is a light family tile placement game where players compete to build the most impressive sandcastle on the beach. Each turn, a tile is revealed, and you must decide whether to keep it or let another player take it. Over 15 quick rounds, you will place tiles to create towers, windows, connected starfish, and decorative details for the highest score. With simple rules, charming beach artwork, and clever placement decisions, Sandcastles is a breezy choice for game night.

• Key Features:
BUILD THE BEST SANDCASTLE: Compete to create the most impressive beachside castle before the tide rolls in.

• CLEVER TILE SELECTION: Each turn, decide whether to keep the revealed tile or pass it along, creating simple choices with meaningful strategy.

• SCORE CREATIVE PATTERNS:…
