pr.m: Bag Building, Push your Luck, Tile Placement
Action Selection, Hidden Roles, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d:
Scales of Influence is a modern tarot-based social deduction game for 3-7 players. Light and Shadow sages have disrupted the energetic state of the universe. Given a secret identity, players use the custom, 78-card Traveler’s Tarot deck, Influence tokens, and Energy crystals to alter the outcome of the universe. Energy on the scale will determine if Light or Shadow take over, or if the secret Harmony sage can restore balance.

✦ Alter the game using tarot cards.
✦ Secretly influence the balance of the scales.
✦ Includes custom tarot deck and guidebook.
3-7 Players 45–90 Minutes Ages 14+

Dusk has fallen in the Kalahari and the cries of the Scavengers hover in the air; the Scavengers are hungry and are gathering at the carcass...

From the award-winning designers of Kavango, Scavengers is an addictive card game perfect for group game night. Outmanoeuvre your opponents by using subtle tactics and strategic bidding to win the most food at the carcass. Are you ready to experience the thrill of the Kalahari at night?

Im Familienspiel Schadenfreude wetteifert ihr als intrigante Höflinge um Status und manipuliert das leicht beeinflussbare Gesinde wie den Koch, die Kultistin, die Wächterin, den Henker und den Narren, um euren Rivalen den Sprung von der Burgmauer zu „erleichtern“.
Gewinnt Stiche, indem ihr die zweithöchste Karte spielt, hortet Karten, aber nicht zu viele, und spielt gezielt Karten aus, um eure Kontrahenten auszustechen.
Auf Burg Schadenfreude gewinnt nicht etwa der Mächtigste, sondern die Nummer eins hinter dem Thron. Und häufen eure Kontrahenten zu viele Punkte an, stürzen sie leider von der Burgmauer in ihr Verderben …

Schiffbauer der Nordsee: Redux spielt in den frühen Jahren der Wikingerzeit, etwa um 800 n. Chr. Als Wikingerschiffbauer wetteifern die Spieler darum, die größte Flotte der Nordsee zu bauen. Dazu müssen sie Holz, Wolle und Eisen sammeln und sich fähige Handwerker hinzuholen. Gold ist ein kostbares Gut und muss klug eingesetzt werden. Wie zu erwarten, wimmelt es im Dorf von allerlei Gestalten, übles Gesindel und schlimmer. Hoffentlich stehen sie auf eurer Seite!

Schiffbauer der Nordsee: Redux ist ein völlig neues Spiel. Zwar hat es viele thematische Elemente und Spielziele mit dem Original gemeinsam, doch das eigentliche Spielprinzip wurde von Grund auf neu entwickelt mit dem Ziel, ein Spielerlebnis zu schaffen, das viel besser zu dem passt, was Fans von Garphill Games/Schwerkraft-Verlag…
Erkundet einen neuen Teil der Landkarte! Mit neuen Orten, eigenem Geschichtenbuch und neuen Karten.

pr.a: Klaus-Jürgen Wrede, Ralf zur Linde, Ralph Querfurth
pr.d:
Stamp your way to victory in this clever mix of a memory game and “Connect Four”!
Fill your rows of letters with different stamps and be careful not to pick duplicates. After all, they all look the same from the outside! Whoever has the best memory and cleverly blocks the most sought-after stamps wins and is crowned the Master Snail!

Noch mehr verrückte Schätzfragen für alle Quizfans!
Der Schätzspaß geht in die nächste Runde: Das Schätz it if you can Erweiterungsset bringt 50 neue Fragen voller Überraschungen, Diskussionen und lustiger Schätzmomente ins Spiel. Ob skurrile Fakten, erstaunliche Zahlen oder verrücktes Halbwissen – hier wird gemeinsam gerätselt und geschätzt.
Die neuen Karten ergänzen das Hauptspiel perfekt und sorgen für noch mehr Abwechslung bei jedem Spieleabend. Dank der drei Schwierigkeitsstufen bleibt es spannend – für Gelegenheitsspieler*innen genauso wie für echte Quizprofis.
+ 50 neue Karten für noch mehr Spielspaß
+ neue Schätzfragen aus unterschiedlichsten Themenbereichen
+ mit 3 Schwierigkeitsstufen
+ nur spielbar mit dem Hauptspiel
+ ideal für Spieleabende mit Freund*innen und der Familie

Neue Schätzfragen für kleine Quizprofis!
Mit dem Schätz it JUNIOR Erweiterungsset bekommen neugierige Kinder jede Menge neuen Ratespaß. 50 zusätzliche Fragen laden zum Staunen, Knobeln und gemeinsamen Schätzen ein – kindgerecht, spannend und mit viel Spaß am Mitdenken.
Ob Tierwelt, Technik, Alltag oder verrückte Rekorde: Die abwechslungsreichen Fragen sorgen immer wieder für überraschende Aha-Momente. Dank der drei Schwierigkeitsgrade können Kinder spielerisch Neues entdecken und gemeinsam rätseln.
+ 50 neue Fragen für Schätz it JUNIOR
+ kindgerechter Quiz- und Schätzspaß
+ Themen aus Wissen, Alltag, Natur und Technik
+ mit 3 Schwierigkeitsgraden
+ ideal für Familien, Kindergeburtstage und Spielenachmittage
+ nur spielbar mit dem Hauptspiel

Advent mal anders: Schätzen, duellieren, Spaß haben!

Vergesst Schokolade und anderen Schnickschnack! Dieser Adventskalender steckt voller verrückter Schätzfragen, die euch beide ins Schwitzen bringen. Wer schätzt besser? Wer ist näher dran? Und wer gewinnt am Ende das große Schätz-Duell?
Jeden Tag bis Heiligabend wartet ein neues Duell auf euch: Absurde Fragen, bei denen niemand die Antwort wissen kann … Mit vielen abwechslungsreichen Schätzkategorien bleibt es bis zum 24. Dezember spannend und kurzweilig.
Das Beste daran: Ihr braucht kein Vorwissen, keine Vorbereitung!

• 👾 Ein hungriges Monster, clevere Schätzungen und jede Menge Nervenkitzel!

• 🎲 Kinderleicht zu lernen, rasant zu spielen – monsterstarker Spaß garantiert!

• 👥 Für spannende, spaßige Spielerunden mit Freunden und Familie oder als Geschenk und Mitbringsel.

Bei „Schätz mal! Das Brettspiel“ wird's brenzlig: Ein niedliches, aber sehr hungriges Monster hat es auf euch abgesehen! Nur wer am besten schätzt und der Wahrheit am nächsten kommt, kann dem gefräßigen, kleinen Ungeheuer entkommen. Die anderen? Nun ja ... lecker!

Das beliebte Kultspiel im neuen Design und jetzt in der aufregenden und schnellen Duell-Variante!
Das Kultspiel aus den 80er und 90er Jahren erfreut noch immer die ganze Familie und ist jetzt als schnelle Duell-Variante zurück. 25 Spielfeldkarten, die London darstellen, werden aufrecht als 5x5 Raster zwischen die beiden Spieler hingestellt. Der Scotland Yard Spieler sieht (zunächst) nur die Rückseiten und muss die Stadt erkunden. Mister X kann die Vorderseiten und damit die ganze Stadt sehen. Er befindet sich auf einer der Karten und muss versuchen geschickt vor Scotland Yard zu entkommen.

In einem spannendem Duell führt die wilde Verfolgungsjagd durch ganz London und Scotland Yard muss clever kombinieren um den Verbrecher Mister X zu finden.
Ein Spieler ist Mister X, der andere ist der…

The Tokyo deck is an expansion to Scribble City that introduces multi-shape buildings! Buildings with more than one shape and type expand your possibilities and compound your problems. Maximise your placement bonuses for maximum rewards!

Scribble City is a city-building drawing game for 1 to 4 players that plays in 60 minutes.

The first ever trick-taking deck builder. You take on the role of pirates setting out on a series of three voyages in search of treasure and citrus. Return to Tortuga to hire new crew members, purchase items for your ship including citrus reserves (you can never have too much citrus), or even increase the number of crew that can sail with you to each island increasing your chance at taking even more tricks. But beware, the threat of Scurvy! and other pirates aren't the only dangers lurking across the high seas. The islands may have active event cards for better or worse and they may even have their own mechanics that can either aid or hinder your voyages.

In Seagrass, players take on the role of marine naturalists, exploring the many reefs and colonies of creatures that thrive among these expanding and diverse “rainforests of the sea.”
Seagrass is an approachable strategy game with surprising depth and layered interaction. On your turn, simply expand a colony of aquatic creatures or expand a reef. Your colonies score you more points the bigger they get, and they help you compete for majorities around reefs. Expanding reefs will increase their point value and help you replenish your hand of tiles, but expanding a reef will also make it a more juicy target for your opponents! Playing out multiple tiles of the same type will grant powerful turns, but spreading out your plays will allow you to score the same colonies more times! Decisions are…

pr.m: Dice Placement, Set Collection, Tile Placement

pr.d:
Yorkshire, 1928. After a daring robbery at the police station, the officers set a trap in an elegant mansion. They suspect the thieves will return for their loot… but lurking among the police and the thieves is a spy with an agenda of their own.
Deception, suspicion, and strategy: will you manage to complete your mission without revealing your true identity?

Schlüpft in die Stiefel von Piraten-Kumpanen, die zusammenarbeiten müssen, um ihr Schiff aus gefährlichen Gewässern zu bewegen. In diesem kooperativen Stichspiel erwartet euch eine raue See, auf der euch tückische Stürme und ein monströser Kraken das Leben schwer machen.
Segel ist ein kooperatives Stichspiel für 2 Spieler. Sie versuchen, die Absichten ihres Gegenüber zu erkennen und Karten auszuspielen, deren Kombination ihr Schiff antreibt oder den Kraken besiegt. Das Spiel hat zudem ein Szenarioheft mit 6 Szenarien.

Bei Sensu wollt ihr eure Karten zu traditionellen japanischen Faltfächern arrangieren. Dafür sammelt ihr zunächst Fächer-Karten auf der Hand. Nur wenn ihr Karten mit einem Gesamtwert von genau 15 habt, könnt ihr diese ausspielen. Je nach Kartenkombination dürfen 1 bis 3 Karten eingelöst werden, um einen persönlichen Fächer aufzubauen. Wer zuerst seinen dritten Fächer fertigestellt und zugeklappt hat, gewinnt das Spiel. In der Variante für Fortgeschrittene kommen weitere Regeln und Komponenten zum Einsatz.

For one, two or three bustling days, you will journey through the vibrant city of Seoul, from ancient palaces to modern hotspots. Each day, you’ll visit stunning locations, experience Korean culture (Hallyu), and enjoy delicious food and lively festivals. Plan your itinerary carefully and compete to have the most memorable trip in Seoul!
With unique art by Dasom Yun.
This is a limited German collection of small supplements (which are called "Datapuls" in German) for Shadowrun.
This is the German edition of Shadowrun: Margin Calls, originally published by Catalyst Gab Labs.

Using just basic geometric shapes, build a picture of your secret word while your teammates shout guesses. Two teams build at the same time, racing to get their word first. Simple pieces, surprising creations, and no time to overthink it.

pr.k: 228:SHERLOCK HOLMES – DER FALL DER VERLORENEN TEILE. EIN HOLZPUZZLE MIT KRIMINALFALL
pr.t: Sherlock Holmes – Der Fall der verlorenen Teile. Ein Holzpuzzle mit Kriminalfall
pr.o: SHERLOCK HOLMES – DER FALL DER VERLORENEN TEILE. EIN HOLZPUZZLE MIT KRIMINALFALL
pr.d:
Sherlock Holmes braucht dich – löse das Puzzle des Verbrechens
Während die Sonne über den Dächern von London aufgeht, wartet ein rätselhaftes Verbrechen darauf, endlich aufgeklärt zu werden. Sherlock Holmes muss sich von der Baker Street 221B nach Westminster begeben, um seine Erkenntnisse zu einem höchst merkwürdigen Fall zu präsentieren, denn Scotland Yard fehlt ein wichtiges Detail: Wie genau wurde der Mord begangen?
Dieses Krimi-Puzzle verbindet Puzzlespaß mit kniffligem Escape-Game-Feeling. Zuerst setzt du das hochwertige Holzpuzzle zusammen, danach beginnt die eigentliche Ermittlungsarbeit: Finde die geheimen Teile und rekonstruiere die Tatwaffe, um den Fall zu lösen. Perfekt für Familien, Puzzlefans und Hobby-Detektiv:innen, die Escape Games, Krimispiele und Rätsel lieben!
Inhalt:…

As members of The Baker Street Irregulars, your team must assist Sherlock Holmes in solving Scotland Yard's four baffling cases.
Within a limited number of turns, scour London for clues and try to identify the culprits behind as many of the four crimes as possible! Holmes will evaluate your performance—strive for the highest possible rating!

Prepare the new palace, making a tiered “Hina display” consisting of 14 seats. Position the Shiba dogs in their appropriate places to ensure the perfection of the role and color schemes of each tier. The challenge lies in how to arrange them within the limited number of seats to make the most ornate Hina display and win!
2 draw decks of Shiba dog doll cards are placed face up with 3-5 cards placed between them. These cards are available to draft, and every round the lead player determines if drafting will occur by color or by role. From the player to the left of the lead, players must take all cards of 1 type corresponding to the determined draft rule. Dolls have correct placement based on their roles, but objectives may prioritize color and icons as well. After 1 player fills their mat,…

In Shijin, players face off in a duel between celestial spirits to determine who will become the divine protector of the newborn heir to the Emperor.
The four guardians: Seiryū, the Azure Dragon of the East; Byakko, the White Tiger of the West; Genbu, the Black Tortoise of the North; and Suzaku, the Vermilion Bird of the South, each can claim the role of the Imperial Prince’s tutelary guide.
This abstract strategy game unfolds on a 5×5 board. Each player places their Guardian miniature and four Seal tokens of their color onto the board. A player’s turn is quick and intuitive: move your Guardian or one of your Seals to an adjacent empty space, or perform a special move with a Seal if it is adjacent to your Guardian.
The first player who manages to place all four of their Seals adjacent to…

A fast, clever duel along a beautiful historic road. Step onto Perry Road—a picturesque riverside promenade in Shimoda, Shizuoka. History lingers on these stones, once walked by Commodore Perry during the treaty negotiations that opened Japan to the world. In Shimoda: Perry Road, you serve as a merchant leader in this bustling port town. Your goal? Strategically place shops to attract tourists and bring the promenade to life. Rules learned in under a minute and a playtime of just 15 minutes

Seit im Naturpark plötzlich eine Goldader entdeckt wurde, herrscht pures Goldfieber! Überall funkelt und glitzert es – und die Elstern, Füchse und Waschbären können einfach nicht widerstehen. Sie haben verschiedene Räuberbanden gebildet und sind fest entschlossen, so viel Gold wie möglich zu ergaunern!
Und jede Bande weiß auch, wo man die meisten Nuggets abgreifen kann: im Nest, am Zeltplatz und beim Gebirgsbach. Doch der Wettbewerb unter den Dieben ist hart! Mit List, Täuschung und cleveren Tricks kannst du deine Gegner überrumpeln und dir das meiste Gold sichern. Aber sei auf der Hut: Auch die anderen Tiere schrecken vor nichts zurück!

pr.t: Shit Happens - The World is on fire
pr.o: SHIT HAPPENS - THE WORLD IS ON FIRE
pr.d: Jede unglückliche Situation wird anhand eines „Misery Index“ (Leidenindex) auf einer Skala von 1 bis 100 bewertet (wobei 100 das absolut Schlimmste ist). Die Spieler schätzen dann, wo andere Situationen gemäß ihrem Index platziert sind. Wenn Ihr richtig liegt, behaltet Ihr die Karte. Der erste Spieler, der 10 Karten hat, gewinnt! Perfekt für Partys – Eure Gäste werden sich vor Lachen biegen!
This is the German edition of Shout the Clue, originally published by Blue Orange.

Shrine – Duel of Light combines elegant abstract strategy with a real illuminated game board. Position crystals, blend colors, master powerful abilities, and outplay your rival in a visually stunning tactical duel.

Shrinkopolis: Worksites introduces 4 double-sided Worksite cards that replace players' starting city cards.
During final scoring, a Worksite can count as any one reward card type for objectives. Animal Worksites are even more flexible, counting as any animal type and helping complete animal sets.
The expansion also adds a new once-per-game Relocation action. A player may cover their Worksite with a previously placed card, repositioning part of their city, creating new connections, and gaining resources from newly formed links.
Worksites add new tactical opportunities and greater flexibility when planning and developing your city.
Contents:
4 double-sided Worksite cards
1 rules card

In this strategy game, you will guide the expansion of your family's farm beyond the known boundaries of the forest. As your settlement grows, more people will gather under your banner. You will cultivate the land, build new communities, and shape the future. However, you must proceed with caution. Your expansion may unsettle the spirits that still dwell in the wilderness. The yokai are vigilant, and their mischief can hinder your plans if you fail to recognize their presence. Increase your influence, adapt your strategies, and attract the right people to your settlement to gain victory points.
In Shugendo, each player has their own personal deck of cards. During the game, you will improve your deck by replacing your weaker starting cards with more powerful settler cards. In each round,…

You need to pay a fee to enter this infamous silver mine. Getting in early costs less, but going in later may let you sneak away with everyone else’s payments. What will you do to make sure you get in last? Every turn, the closest miner rolls a single die, while farther miners roll more dice depending on position.
Inside the Box : 1 singLe board, 6 miners, 1 starting player marker, 6 pitfalls, 6 dice, 12 gold nuggets, 50 silver nuggets

pr.d: Similo: Batman is the latest entry in the best-selling series of cooperative deduction games Similo !Help the other players guess 1 Secret Card out of the 12 on display on the table! Play cards from your hand as clues and help the Guessers remove cards from the table. If they remove the Secret Card, you all lose, but if it’s the only one left at the end, you all win!

pr.a: Hjalmar Hach, Pierluca Zizzi, Martino Chiacchiera
pr.d:
Similo: Wonders is a cooperative deduction game where all players work together to identify a secret card using a series of Clues!

This new edition of the critically acclaimed deduction game featues 36 buildings and monuments from all around the world, including ancient wonders and modern marvels, all beautifully illustrated by Naiade. The deck box comes with two different covers (North American and International), but the decks contain the same cards.
The Clue Giver must lead the Guessers to identify one Secret Card by playing other cards from their hand as Clues. There are two kind kinds of Clues: Remove Clues (cards played horizontally, which have something similar to one or more cards the the Guessers should remove) or Keep Clues (cards played vertically, which have something similar…

Sitting Bull, leader of the Hunkpapa Lakota, occupies a key place in history for his role in the Battle of Little Bighorn in 1876, where the Lakota and Cheyenne nations defeated the Seventh Cavalry. Since then, his name has become a symbol of his people’s resistance and the preservation of their traditions.
Experience the daily life of one of the Council Fires, the tribes that make up the Lakota people.
Guided by Sitting Bull, travel the territories in search of game, participate in Lakota traditions and beliefs and witness feats and exploits in the era before the conflict with the US expansion.
The goal will be to accumulate the greatest amount of Prestige Points (PP) at the end of the game. Prestige Points are obtained through the strategic placement of tribe members, the control of the…

SIX SEVEN wOAOw is a simple yet chaotic card game.
Whenever someone plays "SIX","SEVEN",or"SIX SEVEN",it creates a strange reaction that pills everyone in - though no one really knows why.
As the game goes on, players fall into a meaningless but hilarious loop.
Gameplay
Players take turns clockwise until only one has cards remaining. The starting player may play 1 to 3 cards of the same or consecutive points (1–10, max 67). Subsequent players must play the same number of cards with equal or higher value, or pass. When playing a special card, its effect is immediately triggered. If all other players pass after a play, the last player to play wins the round. The winner takes one face-up card from their last play as a reward and may claim a "Six Seven" token if they hold the most (or tied)…

Plan the ultimate day in Singapore!
In Six Sights: Singapore, you are planning a day of sightseeing around 6 must-see sights in Singapore. However, there is only so much time in a day and you must decide on 3 places to visit. Come up with the perfect schedule and be the chosen one amongst your group!​
Each turn, players reveal a card and players play from the highest revealed card to the lowest. On placing the card on a location, activate the abilities on the card.​
The objective of the game is to line up 3 places to visit with the best hand wins. The strength of the 3 places are ranked base on how you will play a poker suit.

Six Sights Singapore is an reimplementation of Graffiti 6, designed by Japanese designer Hiro (H1R0) with brand new components & artwork featuring Singapore famous…

Part of the Garden Trilogy series, which shares the same core system as Aqua Garden, Sky Garden is a mid-weight game where you collect birds and build your very own aviary.
To create the finest aviary in town, there's a whole lot to do! Skillfully direct your staff, release birds into the right environments, and secure income through events and advertising... but most importantly, don't forget about "breeding"!
When a bird pair is nesting and you land on the breeding space, eggs are produced — giving you the chance to earn even more victory points!
How well can you match up your bird pairs and get them breeding?
Compared to its sister title, Aqua Garden, Sky Garden features stronger player interaction, making for a more dynamic gameplay experience.
Swans, toucans, long-tailed tits...…

This expansion pack introduces new Special Bird tokens:
Rock Ptarmigan, Rosy Pelican, Mandarin Duck ♂ and Mandarin Duck ♀.
Additionally, it includes the Kiwi variant rule.
Note: This is an expansion set. "Sky Garden" base game is required to play.

The hot new TCG from veteran designer Richard Garfield!
Each moon brings a new rift in the sky, cracking the earth open to reveal crystals of rare power. It's time for the factions to wield their weapons and claim this treasure. 
From dawn to dusk, strategically deploy your creatures to collect 6 crystals before your rival. Each faction has its own deck and strategies. Yield at the right moments to regain the upper hand and challenge your opponent to raise the stakes of the duel! 
Will you choose the might of Soul Blade, the agility of Moon Dragon, or the trickery of Black Thorn?

The hot new TCG from veteran designer Richard Garfield!
Each moon brings a new rift in the sky, cracking the earth open to reveal crystals of rare power. It's time for the factions to wield their weapons and claim this treasure. 
From dawn to dusk, strategically deploy your creatures to collect 6 crystals before your rival. Each faction has its own deck and strategies. Yield at the right moments to regain the upper hand and challenge your opponent to raise the stakes of the duel! 
Will you choose the cunning of Death Whisper, the ferocity of Sea Raider, or the endurance of Fire Wind?

Build a solarpunk city in the clouds.
In Skyward Republic, two face-up cards per player are dealt into piles for all players to contest. Each player is also dealt two unknown cards. On your turn will you pick a pile of cards that fits your strategy before others do, or flip and place one of your dealt cards in a pile to stay in expanding draft so as to pick a bigger or better pile later? Pick early for likely fewer cards but more control, then reveal your remaining cards and place them in the remaining piles. Or hold out till last pick to likely get more but somewhat random cards, yet gain a wild resource and become the first player.
Players then build cards they can afford to build, each with interconnected scoring abilities. Then attempt to claim powerful benefactors to gain victory…

pr.t: Sleddy Lost Tapes - Creepypasta Horror Escape Game
pr.o: SLEDDY LOST TAPES - CREEPYPASTA HORROR ESCAPE GAME
pr.d:
Sleddy Lost Tapes is an immersive analog horror escape game, an Escape box that mixes puzzles, narrative, and technology to immerse you in a challenging experience so carefully designed that it may be impossible for you to distinguish reality from fiction.

An old children's show has begun resurfacing in the dark corners of the internet. At first glance, it seems innocent, but those who watch it vanish or die under mysterious circumstances. Hundreds of rumors are circulating online: a cursed series, a dangerous cult, a supernatural creature…
As investigators, your mission is to decipher the hidden messages, uncover who is behind these, and stop the sinister deaths before it's too late. Each clue brings you closer to the truth… but also to danger.
Can you solve the mystery and make it out…

pr.k: 372:SLEDDY THE LAST EPISODE - CREEPYPASTA HORROR ESCAPE GAME
pr.t: Sleddy The Last Episode - Creepypasta Horror Escape Game
pr.o: SLEDDY THE LAST EPISODE - CREEPYPASTA HORROR ESCAPE GAME
pr.d:
Sleddy's Last Episode is an immersive analog horror escape game. You will investigate an old lost VHS series, and it will be like facing a real creepypasta.
This is a standalone game, but it is a parallel story to another of our games: Sleddy Lost Tapes. They can be played separately, but playing both enriches the plot.

Navigate the board strategically, equip powerful weapons and equipment, mount trusty steeds, and use action cards wisely to outmaneuver your opponents in tactical showdowns.
Every location offers new opportunities. Every card drawn could change your fate. Every die roll could be your last.

Papa Faulus, the wise village elder, has chosen you.
For the village’s grand feast, he needs the rarest ingredients on the island — but he’s grown too old to gather them himself.
You are the youngest and bravest sloths in the village. Roll. Travel. Gather. The first player to complete three food bundles earns the honor of becoming the feast’s head chef.
But beware: push your luck one roll too far, and you might come back empty-pawed.

Slumdogs: Die schnelle Fantasy-Cyberpunk-Variante.
Spannende Abenteuer in einer dystopischen Zukunft. Maschinen, Magie und Möchtegern-Gangster.
Mit einem einheitlichen Würfelpool-System und schneller Charakter-Erschaffung kann es innerhalb kürzester Zeit losgehen.
Wenig Regeln, viel Spaß.
Slumdogs – das schnelle und unkomplizierte Cyberpunk-Rollenspiel von Seba und Carl.
Was erwartet dich bei Slumdogs?
• Schnelles Cyberpunk-Feeling: Erlebe spannende Abenteuer in einer dystopischen Zukunft, ohne dich durch seitenlange Regeln kämpfen zu müssen.

• Intuitive Würfelmechanik: Nutze Würfelpools aus W6, um deine Fähigkeiten einzusetzen. Einfach zu lernen, schwer zu meistern.

• Fokus auf das Wesentliche: Konzentriere dich auf das Spielgeschehen und deine Entscheidungen, statt auf komplexe…

Small World
500 Teile | 34 × 48 cm
Small World ist eines von 10 neuen Motiven der Sunshine Puzzles Collection, die diesen Herbst erscheinen.
Eine kleine fantasievolle Welt voller Blumen, Pilzhäuser, bunter Blüten und versteckter Details: Small World lädt dazu ein, beim Puzzeln immer wieder neue Elemente zu entdecken. Die kräftige Farbgestaltung und der verspielte Illustrationsstil machen das Motiv zu einem besonderen Blickfang.

Eine Frage – 10 Antworten: Auch bei dieser neuen Edition ändert sich nichts am beliebten Spielmechanismus von „Smart 10“! Allerdings ist das Setting besonders fantasievoll und wandelt auf den Spuren einer sagenhaften Legende: Die zahlreichen Fans von „Der Herr der Ringe“ können dabei in die Welt der Hobbits, Elben und Orks eintauchen und zeigen, wie gut sie Mittelerde und seine Bewohner wirklich kennen. Wer auch über den Einen Ring am besten Bescheid weiß oder am besten zockt, kann bei den 100 neuen Fragen und 1.000 Antwortmöglichkeiten glänzen.

Die eigenständige Edition „Der Herr der Ringe“ erweitert die Reihe rund um das revolutionäre Quizspiel von Piatnik. Ausgezeichnet als „Spiel der Spiele“ in Österreich (2020) sowie als Spiel des Jahres in Schweden und Dänemark (2017/2019),…

Das Themenpaket “90s” bringt viele neue Fragen für das revolutionäre Quizspiel „Smart 10“ und lässt in der Vergangenheit schwelgen. Benötigt wird eine Smartbox aus den Originalspielen der Reihe. Es umfasst popkulturelle Meilensteine aus Film, Fernsehen und Musik, ikonische Persönlichkeiten und Produkte sowie wichtige historische Ereignisse.
Mit der neuen „Smart 10“-Version wird die…

Das Nachfüllset “Neue Fragen 4.0” bringt viele neue Fragen für das revolutionäre Quizspiel „Smart 10“. Benötigt wird eine Smartbox aus den Originalspielen der Reihe. Einfach deren Karten mit den Karten aus einer Erweiterung ersetzen und schon erlebt man viele weitere vergnügliche Spielstunden. Eine Frage – 10 Antworten: Am beliebten Spielmechanismus ändert sich nichts. Die Erweiterung beinhaltet 200 neue Fragen und 2.000 Antworten aus verschiedenen Themengebieten.

Who works with whom? Smart Split replaces counting off, drawing slips of paper, and lengthy discussions when forming groups. Each participant draws a card, the teacher or group leader names a colour, and everyone with the same number in that colour forms a group. The same deck can therefore be used again and again to create different group sizes.
At the same time, Smart Split works as a reusable escape-room decoder. The cards contain several layers of encoded information, including Caesar, Pigpen, and Morse codes. Using the corresponding decoder cards, players can decipher hidden letters and numbers. This allows the deck to be integrated directly into custom escape rooms, puzzle stations, and other game-based activities – without having to create a new decoding system for every puzzle.…

Grizzy needs your help!
Stop the lemmings’ madness and save the day, one card at a time.
Join Grizzy and the Lemmings in this fast-paced observation game! Grizzy just wants to take a nap... but the lemmings are at it again, playing with fireworks! Quick! Help Grizzy stop them with his frying pan before everything blows up!
Who will be the fastest player to win the game?
Quick setup and simple rules for fast-paced gameplay
An accessible game that both kids and adults can enjoy instantly
A mix of observation and reflexes for exciting, action-packed rounds

Smash It ist ein schnelles, lustiges Kartenspiel ab 8 Jahren für Familie, Freunde und Partys. Finde als Erster ein Wort, das mit demselben Buchstaben beginnt wie das Bild auf der Karte. Wer zu langsam ist oder sich vertut, kassiert eine Strafe. Einfach erklärt, sofort gespielt und voller Lacher: Das kompakte Reaktionsspiel sorgt für Stimmung bei Spieleabenden, Geburtstagen, im Urlaub oder unterwegs.
• Inhalt: 110 Spielkarten, 1 Anleitung

• 2-8 Spieler, ab 8 Jahren

• Format: 15 x 10,5 x 2,7 cm

• UVP: 15,99 EUR

Smugglers is a set collection game. In this game you are greedy merchants during the silk road era who want to smuggle illegal goods and other goods that are not allowed through the customs. You can always depend only on legal goods to be safe, but the other merchants will have the chance to smuggle illegal goods which are worth much more!

pr.d:
Willkommen zurück auf Gastropodia: Neue Inseln steigen aus den giftigen Gewässern auf, neue Anführer betreten die Bühne und diesmal wird schweres Gerät aufgefahren. Granaten, Kugeln und Feuer markieren die Schlachtfelder, während Windböen selbst verfehlte Schüsse zur Gefahr machen. Wer dachte, Snails sei schon chaotisch, bekommt hier die nächste Stufe des Schneckenkriegs.

Die Erweiterung wird in das Grundspiel integriert: Neue Bodenplättchen werden nach Rückseiten (Strand, Wiese, Berg) mit den entsprechenden Plättchen des Grundspiels gemischt. Feuer, Beschädigter Boden und Todesgewicht).

pr.d:
Snake Clash – Tile-laying fighting game
Age: 10+ | Players: 2–4 | Playtime: 25 min. | Languages: LT / EN
Snake Clash is a fast-paced tile-laying fighting game for 2 to 4 players, where strategy, cunning, and a bit of luck determine who rules the board. Each player controls a Snake, moving across the gameboard in pursuit of ancient Relics while facing off against rival Snakes. Timing, positioning, and clever tile placement are key – block your opponents, steal their Relics, or set up devastating combos to gain the upper hand.
The game ends when a player completes the Quest by collecting enough Relics and reaching the Altar, or when only one Snake remains alive. Players can enjoy a straightforward game with the basic rules, or dive into Incarnation Mode, which introduces 14 unique Snake…

In an ambitious operation to end the war, the Axis are launching an experimental super carrier across the Atlantic. Find these plans before it can launch, or infiltrate it to bring down this war machine from within!
The new expansion features two brand-new maps along with a host of new mechanics and abilities for both the sniper and the defenders.
Armoured vehicles roll out in the Norman Village!

Infiltrate the ruined Norman Village to find intel on Operation Kraken, but beware of the defenders’ new armoured cars patrolling the area. These armoured vehicles give the defenders lots of exciting options, as driving one lets a defender move faster, search for, and attack the sniper better, while also protecting the defender inside. These vehicles add a significant new threat to the sniper…

Work Together to Make the Slopes a Success! A Major Project for Everyone to Complete Together
The dice placement game where you don’t roll the dice, Snow Planner, now has a cooperative mode!
Snow Planner: New Challenge is an expansion for 1–4 players that adds a cooperative mode to Snow Planner. By working together toward a shared goal, players can experience a whole new kind of challenge and sense of accomplishment.
In cooperative mode, a new type of guest—the Inspectors—arrives at your resort. By satisfying them, you can improve the resort’s reputation and move closer to achieving your shared objective.
The new wooden dog sled piece also allows players to exchange resources with one another. In addition to strategic planning, communication and teamwork become essential to success.
All…

A New Season Arrives at Your Mountain Resort! An Expansion That Brings Even More Depth to the Game
The dice placement game where you don’t roll the dice, Snow Planner, is getting an expansion!
Snow Planner: New Season is an expansion for 1–4 players that adds a wide variety of new elements, including Guest Cards, Event Cards, Talent Cards, and Project Cards, bringing even more strategy and replayability to the base game.
Project Cards have been significantly redesigned, challenging you to take on even more demanding management decisions.
Without drastically changing the rules of the base game, the expansion introduces new tactics and new ways to plan your path to victory.
Snow Planner: New Season offers fresh challenges for experienced players while bringing even greater depth and…

Designed for players who are already familiar with Snowp, this expansion adds more strategic variety and dynamic gameplay while bringing a festive holiday atmosphere to every match.
The Christmas Tree Board adds a new twist to scoring. At the start of each round, 10 bells are placed on the tree. The more bells of a color there are, the more valuable that color becomes, creating new strategic opportunities and exciting comeback moments.
The expansion also introduces Snowman Tokens. If a player fails to collect a bell on their turn, they place a snowman onto the snowfield, where it acts as a blocker and changes future shots.

pr.a: Adrie Drent, Esther Jacobsen, Alexander Kneepkens, Vicky Trouerbach
pr.d:
Helmet on, board strapped in, and off you go! In Snowy Tricks, the fresh snow is ready on the slopes and the competition is underway. As a snowboard instructor, you want to prove that you are the best. Send your students down the mountain, have them perform spectacular tricks, and outsmart your opponents!
Snowy Tricks is a strategic trick-taking game in which you score points by claiming prizes. By choosing the right moment to win, or deliberately lose a trick, you collect the cards you need to meet the requirements of the different prizes. The instructor who uses their students most effectively will collect the most valuable prizes and win the game!

The Friendgrad metro grand opening is here! The celebration must go according to plan, so the K9 Secret Police is sniffing out any sign of dissent. But the Wolf Resistance has other plans — they’ve stolen compromising evidence and must deliver it before escaping the city.
Sobakistan: Land of Dogs is an asymmetric one-vs-many game of hidden movement, deduction, and secret communication. One player takes the role of the Senior Bloodhound, commanding K9 Secret Police squads and hunting the Resistance across the metro. The other players become the Liaison and the Wolves: the Liaison guides the team using carefully chosen word associations, while the Wolves secretly move from station to station, trying to deliver the evidence and escape without revealing their locations.
Will the Wolves…

Solstis returns in a Collector's Edition: fully wooden components, a re-enchanted nighttime universe, and the Firefly expansion included in a luxury presentation box.
In Solstis, players craft their landscape panorama by matching Landscape tiles from their hand with those in the central display. Connect the valley to the peaks to light the bonfires, meet Spirits who shower you with northern lights, and beware of the evil Spirit lurking nearby.
In just 15 minutes, this duel by Bruno Cathala and Corentin Lebrat unfolds with a gentle, crystal-clear tension, accessible for ages 8 and up. This Collector's Edition makes it the definitive release: all 79 landscape tiles are made entirely of wood, the world is repainted in a nighttime theme, from dusk to dawn, by Supacat Axel Mahé, and the…

Solstis: Leuchtkäfer ist eine kleine Erweiterung für das Berg-Duell Solstis von Bruno Cathala und Corentin Lebrat für 2 Personen ab 8 Jahren. Die Erweiterung bringt leuchtende Glühwürmchen in die Berglandschaft und ergänzt das Grundspiel um neue Möglichkeiten für eure Punktejagd. Die Leuchtkäfer lassen sich in die eigene Landschaft integrieren und sorgen für zusätzliche taktische Entscheidungen, ohne den schnellen und zugänglichen Charakter des Grundspiels zu verändern. Dadurch wird das Duell um die wertvollsten Bergteile noch abwechslungsreicher.

pr.d:
Song of the Wildkin is a cooperative adventure for 1 to 4 players. Find your missing mentor, Hammer Wildmane, and safeguard your community from the mysterious forces turning peaceful woodbeasts into frenzied threats.
The campaign unfolds across a series of Chapters, each carrying your party to a distinct region of the world. Your journey begins in the Giggling Glade, a sanctuary of art and song tended by fairies, and will lead you to places few Wildkin ever dream of.
Within a chapter, you will brave the wilds through a variety of Scenarios, featuring unique objectives, challenges, and discoveries. Each scenario takes about 1 hour to play, or you can finish a chapter in a single afternoon.
Chapters culminate in climactic Boss Battles. Defeating these powerful adversaries opens new paths…

Soundcheck challenges your ears—it’s not about song titles, release years, or artists! Read the categories, listen to the songs, and think outside the box—who will figure out the answer the fastest and claim the victory?

Game Overview
At the scrap yard on the outskirts of the city, four eccentric scientists rummage through piles of useless trash, competing to see who is the best rocket designer. The task is not easy, and the materials are limited. Which eccentric researcher will be the first to fly into space in their innovative rocket?
Space Craft is a family game in which 2 to 4 players build crazy rockets. The game is for players aged 10+ and takes around 15min per player.

During their turn, players move their pawns on the scrapyard board to collect scrap tiles. Later, they will use those tiles to craft rocket pieces. By collecting specific rocket elements, players will fulfill contracts and those will grant them additional points by the end of the game.

The game ends after one player completes their…

THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Space Lab ist ein zugängliches Tableau-Building-Kartenspiel von Johannes Goupy und Corentin Lebrat für 1 bis 4 Personen ab 8 Jahren. Ihr holt Crewmitglieder an Bord, stellt ein möglichst harmonisches Team zusammen und führt Weltraum-Projekte durch. Das eigene Space Lab wächst von drei Startmodulen auf eine Station mit zehn Plätzen. Crew-Karten werden an die Module angelegt, passende Farbkombinationen helfen dabei, Missionen erfolgreich abzuschließen und prestigereiche Projekte zu sichern.

Space Qubes is a cooperative sci-fi game for 1–4 players. As the crew of a stranded research vessel, you'll search the damaged ship for vital spare parts, equip yourselves with useful gear, and defend against corrosive slime aliens known as Quantum Biological Entities (Qu.B.Es).
Variable ship layouts, a wide variety of characters and equipment, and 8 exciting scenarios—each introducing new mechanics and objectives—provide high replayability and fresh challenges every time you play.
With easy-to-learn rules, quick setup, and exciting cooperative decision-making, Space Qubes offers an engaging adventure for families and casual gamers alike. Packed in a compact A6-sized box, it's the perfect game to take with you wherever your next adventure leads.

Choose your spaghetti wisely before you slurp it up in this topping dropping game. If your table manners are sloppy, you'll be kicked out of the restaurant!
Use tweezers to pull spaghetti strings from the tin. If removing the string causes a topping to hit the bottom of the tin, you are eliminated!

Speed-Action ist eine Erweiterung für das Grundspiel Affentennis.
Es handelt sich um einen Mechanismus, der die Zeit, die man für einen Schlag hat, durch eine Kugelbahn limitiert. Fängt man den Actionball nicht rechtzeitig, verliert man den Punkt.
Du bist ahnungslos, und die anderen versuchen zu helfen, jedoch ohne sich absprechen zu dürfen: SPELL.

Spicy Pop is a fast-paced card game where ingredients become numbers and every combination matters.
Collect cards from the market and create combinations using exactly two different ingredients: one suit adds positive values while the other subtracts them. Your result must follow the growing numerical sequence, forcing players to carefully plan every turn.
Special Salt cards let you adjust your calculations by ±1, while Pepper cards introduce direct interaction, allowing you to pass trouble to your opponents—or finish a round in spectacular fashion.
End rounds at the perfect moment, manage your hand efficiently, and avoid collecting too much Pop, because the player with the lowest total Pop at the end of the game wins.
Simple rules, quick turns, tactical decisions, and constant player…

As Nature Spirits, you have led a peaceful life in harmony with nature for centuries. But now the tranquillity of your valley is in peril: Invaders came over the mountains during the night, leaving a trail of devastation in their wake. They keep spreading further, destroying the valley. You must do something about it!

Spirits of Valenor is a cooperative adventure by Johannes Krenner and Alexander Pfister, featuring 15 exciting, replayable chapters! On each turn, you must play the frontmost card from your hand, adding new Invader Cards to the five Location cards that form your valley. If you can't place an Invader, they devastate one of the Locations instead. Play Defense cards and use the abilities of your Nature Spirits at the right time to drive away the Invaders before your valley is…

The Counterfeiters expansion adds new ways to bend the rules of Splendor Duel through Counterfeiter cards and paste-gem tokens. New Royal cards provide additional powers and paths to victory, adding more asymmetry and strategic variety to the two-player game.

pr.m: Bag Building, Engine Building, Tile Placement
pr.d:
Becoming the greatest gem artisan is no easy task. Deploy miners to collect gems of different shapes and piece them together into intricate shapes. After a puzzle is completed and delivered you may trade them for new mining sites, losing VPs but opening up new possibilities with access to ever bigger shapes.

Each round players pull miners from their bag and deploy them to mining sites with limited slots and restrictions. For each miner placed you will gain 1 gem, but drawing a miner you cannot place incurs a penalty. Then in turn order players can piece together 1 of their puzzles, deliver a completed puzzle for VPs and rewards, or trade in delivered puzzles for more mining sites until all players pass. The game ends on the round a player reaches 15VPs. VPs from puzzles, mining sites,…

Als einer der drei Monde über Lorakis barst, blickten die unterdrückten Völker furchtsam gen Himmel, um das unheimliche Schauspiel zu betrachten. Zu diesem Zeitpunkt ahnte noch niemand, dass unter dem Splittermond eine neue Ära anbrechen sollte, die sie von den Ketten ihrer Drachlingsherrscher befreien und die Völker von Lorakis in ein neues Zeitalter führen sollte.
Dieser Schnellstarter bietet einen vereinfachten Einstieg in die Splittermond-Regeln, einen Überblick über die Spielwelt Lorakis, 6 vorgefertigte Abenteurer und ein vollständiges Abenteuer, das Ihre Gruppe in das dreigeteilte Reich Zhoujiang führt.

Das einst stolze Phönixreich Zhoujiang wird vom Bürgerkrieg in Atem gehalten. Die meisten der 13 Provinzen des Landes haben sich einer der drei Konfliktparteien angeschlossen, und nur wenige versuchen nach wie vor, neutral zu bleiben. Eine dieser neutralen Provinzen ist die Fangschreckenprovinz im Westen des Reichs, gelegen zwischen den Anhängern Yis im Norden und den Gefolgsleuten General Wus im Süden. Doch auch von jenseits der Grenzen Zhoujiangs droht Gefahr. Berichte über einen Klosterüberfall und ein großes Heer der Barbaren aus der Jogai-Steppe erreichen kurz vor dem Jahreswechsel den Fürstenpalast in Toro.
Das Schicksal der Fangschreckenprovinz steht auf Messers Schneide. Die Abenteurer werden beauftragt, den Geschehnissen auf den Grund zu gehen. Was steckt hinter dem Überfall auf…

Lorakis – ein Kontinent voller Gefahren, Möglichkeiten, vielfältiger Kulturen, sagenumwobener Schätze sowie einer bewegten und reichhaltigen Geschichte. Wir möchten Sie auf Ihren Reisen durch diesen Kontinent begleiten, gemeinsam mit Ihnen zu neuen Abenteuern aufbrechen, neue Regionen und Organisationen kennenlernen, berühmte Personen treffen oder den Spuren bisher unbekannter Kreaturen folgen.
In dieser Ausgabe von Neues aus Lorakis erwarten Sie ein neues Abenteuer und Beschreibungen zweier Örtlichkeiten in Selenia, für die jeweils auch einige Szenariovorschläge für eigene Abenteuer angegeben sind:
Der Turm an der Grenze (Heldengrad 2) führt die Abenteurer im Auftrag des Zirkels der Zinne ins Unreich. Auf der Suche nach einem mächtigen Artefakt müssen sich die Abenteurer mit den Gefahren…

Der Gefallene Fürst ist besiegt. Die Gefahr für Wintholt und den Immersommerwald ist gebannt. Vorerst. Denn die Geschehnisse aus Ein Hauch von Frost haben auch Erkenntnisse zu Tage gefördert, aus denen hervorgeht, dass eine noch viel größere Gefahr droht – für Wintholt, und vielleicht für ganz Dragorea.
Es ist an der Zeit, den Rastlosen zur letzten Ruhe zu betten.
Dieses Buch ist der zweite Teil der Kampagne Das Ende des Sommers, mit der wir das 10-jährige Jubiläum von Splittermond feiern. Der zweite Band enthält die Abenteuer Wissen ist Nacht und Die letzte Rast, in denen die Ereignisse aus dem ersten Band zu einem Ende geführt werden.
In den Tiefen der Reißzahnfeste stoßen die Abenteurer auf Geheimnisse, die niemandem in Lorakis bekannt sind. Aber um die Gefahr endgültig zu bannen,…

The dice game SPLITTER has seamlessly joined our lineup of popular roll-and-write games, such as Qwixx, Qwinto, and Knister. With the new edition, SPLITTER², the unique game mechanics are taken to a whole new level.
The basic principle remains the same: Two dice are rolled, and both numbers must always be entered symmetrically relative to the centerline on your score sheet. Points are awarded only if you succeed in forming chains of adjacent identical numbers. The higher the number, the longer the chain must be to earn the points.
In addition to this original version, the new base game SPLITTER² includes three additional blocks with different variants. Each one provides an exciting extra challenge in its own way. In Variant B, the drawn walls require players to think much more spatially.…

In this thrilling card game, your taverns are haunted! But you’ll use that to your advantage—lure the ghosts in, catch them, and sell them as spooky souvenirs to your guests. But watch out: If there are too many ghosts, your guests will run away without paying! So you’d better send the ghosts on to the neighboring taverns! Which one of you will run the most successful tavern?

Explore a haunted town as ghost hunters after a protective amulet shatters and releases its spirits. Roll dice to investigate buildings, photograph five ghosts or collect three amulet fragments before your rivals.

Spot Me Gaffer! is a spotlight puzzle game set behind the scenes of a dazzling circus. You are the circus’s lighting technician, “Gaffer”, and your job is to follow the boss’s orders and shine the spotlight on the right performers.

Place performer tiles freely on the circus board to create a 4×4 grid. Then, using the cue card, cleverly stack spotlight cards so that only the performers matching the given conditions are visible. When you get the spotlight right, the matching performers score points and are removed from the board, creating new opportunities for the next round.

Read the cue, arrange the spotlight, find the right performers, and make the circus spectacular!

Spotlight Fantasy is the brand new edition of the cooperative game where you and your friends search for hidden wacky characters and funny items. Use your lantern to find pictures hidden in the dark – the more you find, the more steps you take toward the end goal! Manage your lanterns wisely to keep the light from running out, or share them to help friends in need!
Can you find all of your targets before sunset?
The game is played over five rounds. Each player has a different board composed of a transparent layer on top, depicting a different part of the game scene, and a black cardboard background, that makes everything dark and difficult to see.

At the beginning of each round, the hidden picture to search is determined by looking at the card on top of the deck. When everybody is ready,…

Spur Note is a competitive deduction game in which players take on the roles of aquarium keepers searching for a missing penguin.
Players play cards in a trick-taking-like manner while taking notes and gathering information. Using asymmetric information about the card numbers, players deduce the location of the missing penguin and compete to score the most points.
The player with the highest score wins.

Are you ready for a mission in Europe? Dive into the world of Spy Guy and discover just how fascinating the map of Europe can be! Join Spy Guy and Spy Girl on an exciting journey through Europe!
This dynamic board game takes kids and adults alike to Europe’s biggest cities, where tourist treasures, puzzles, and a race against time await you. Split into two teams and see who can find the hidden trophies first-they’re scattered across a map full of details and colorful illustrations. Search for the treasures, choose smart routes, and don’t let your opponents pass you by-every second and every decision counts!

Spyworld is a game for families and larger groups in which the goal is to build a secret base and seize world domination. This innovative game can be played simultaneously by any number of people of all ages.
After years of amassing wealth, you dream of ruling the world. And let’s be honest—you’ve earned it! But your rivals see things differently and want to steal the spotlight from you. Build your secret hideout and set traps to keep your secrets safe and protect your wealth from your fellow players. At the same time, you must uncover their secrets and thwart their plans—but be warned, because their hideouts are also well-protected and full of traps. During the planning phase, you’ll develop your hideout, and during the exploration phase, your agents will strike all at the same time.…

Das verrückte Spiel der bunten Zahlenreihen! Behalte einen kühlen Kopf und sortiere deine Zahlenreihen - aber Achtung vor den Sonderkarten!
• 2-6 Spieler, ab 8 Jahren

• Inhalt: 110 Spielkarten, 1 Anleitung

• Format: 15 x 10,5 x 2,7 cm

• UVP: 15,99 EUR

Green on blue on hot pink – doesn't get much easier, right? The ultimate Stacking Challenge involves stacking up to five small wooden pieces on top of one another in a specified order. It's a wobbly affair that requires more dexteritz from one task to the next! You can tick off each completed task on the enclosed overview sheet.

It's a wobbly affair that requires more dexteritz from one task to the next! You can tick off each completed task on the enclosed overview sheet.

It's a wobbly affair that requires more dexteritz from one task to the next! You can tick off each completed task on the enclosed overview sheet.

Wolf on tiger on bear – nothing could be easier, right? In the Stacking Challenge Nature, up to five small wooden pieces must be stacked on top of one another in a specific order. What starts out innocently requires ever more dexterity with each successive challenge! Each completed task can be checked off directly on the included overview sheet.

Brachiosaurus atop T-Rex atop Velociraptor – nothing could be easier, right? In the Stacking Challenge Jurassic, up to five small wooden pieces must be stacked on top of one another in a specific order. What starts out innocently enough demands ever-increasing dexterity with each successive challenge! Every completed task can be checked off directly on the included overview sheet.

Das neue Partyspiel „Stadt Land Bingo“ vom Wiener Spieleverlag Piatnik kombiniert die beliebten Klas­siker „Stadt Land Fluss“ und „Bingo“ auf eine unterhaltsame Art und Weise miteinander. Das bringt einerseits mehr Spaß und Geschwindigkeit, andererseits bis zu zehn rauchende Köpfe (ab zehn Jahren) ins Spiel. Denn nur wer am schnellsten ein zur aktuellen Kategorie passendes Wort findet, darf den Anfangsbuchstaben davon auf dem eigenen Bingo-Blatt ankreuzen und kommt dem Sieg somit ein Stückchen näher. Mit drei Varianten, zwei Schwierigkeitsstufen und unterschiedlichen Bingo-Mustern auf den Blöcken bleibt das kompakte Spiel mit einfachem Zugang lange attraktiv und sorgt für zahlreiche unbeschwerte Abende mit Freunden oder der Familie.

Quicky, Tricky oder Fully? „Stadt Land Bingo“ hält drei…

In STADT LAND VOLLPFOSTEN Countdown, every second counts: Find as many terms as possible for a given category in one minute. But watch out—the sand of time keeps trickling away unseen! Will you stop early, or will you risk it all and use up every last second?

pr.t: Stadt Land Vollpfosten® Spielblock | Farben Edition
pr.o: STADT LAND VOLLPFOSTEN® SPIELBLOCK | FARBEN EDITION
pr.d: The colorful edition of the cult game STADT LAND VOLLPFOSTEN, featuring all the colors of the rainbow.

Stadt, Land, Tralala – der Spieleklassiker „Stadt, Land, Fluss“ als Kartenspiel
Eine Stadt mit B war gestern! Mehr als 100 abwechslungsreiche Kategorien sorgen für Spielspaß bei Jung und Alt. Dank der immer neuen Kartenkombinationen bleibt es bis zur letzten Runde spannend – ganz ohne Stift und Papier.
Ein Laubbaum, eine Fernsehsendung oder etwas, das giftig ist: Habt ihr die passenden Buchstabenkarten auf der Hand? Hier sind Wissen und Kreativität gefragt. Und vielleicht hilft euch auch ein Joker aus der Klemme.
Ein kurzweiliges Kartenspiel für Familie und Freunde, bei dem eine bekannte Spielidee auf überraschende Kategorien trifft.

Stapel Klötze - Wo kleine Bauleute zu großen Denkern werden!
Baue deine Häuser mit den Bausteinen von unten nach oben. Entdecke räumliches Denken, Logik und Feinmotorik, während du ein Haus baust, das zu der Abbildung in der Herausforderung passt.
48 spannende Aufgaben in verschiendenen Schwierigkeitsstufen

Die Box fügt drei neue Captains aus Star Trek: Lower Decks hinzu und ist sowohl mit dem ursprünglichen Grundspiel als auch mit Unendliche Weiten kompatibel. Captain Carol Freeman nutzt die Crew der U.S.S. Cerritos, William T. Riker bringt zahlreiche humorvolle Effekte ein und Christopher Pike nutzt Reaktionen direkt von der Hand, wodurch längere Aktionsketten möglich werden.

Star Trek: Space Hunt is an intense, real-time hidden movement game for 2 to 4 players driven by the critically acclaimed Captain Sonar system. In the vastness of the cosmos, survival demands flawless coordination, split-second communication, and razor-sharp deduction.
Asymmetric Warfare & Legendary Duos
Divided into two opposing crews, players square off in a high-stakes hunt across the stars:
• Iconic Starships: Take command of legendary vessels pulled straight from the franchise’s storied history. Every ship features entirely unique builds and systems, delivering a deeply tactical, asymmetric gameplay experience.

• Cross-Generational Sagas: Step into the boots of sci-fi history’s greatest pairings. Whether you choose to lead with the brilliant synergy of Captain Kirk and Spock, the…

Star Trek: Captain’s Chair – Unendliche Weiten ist ein eigenständiges, asymmetrisches Deckbauspiel für 1 bis 2 Personen. Sechs neue Captains bringen unterschiedliche strategische Ansätze. In den Zügen werden Handkarten genutzt, Raumschiffe eingesetzt und Ressourcen wie Dilithium und Latinum verwaltet. Diplomatie, Wissenschaft und Erkundung können ebenso zum Sieg führen wie direkte Konfrontation. Ein Solo-Modus ist enthalten.

Das „Star Wars™: Roleplaying Dice Set“ für alle Star Wars-Rollenspielsysteme enthält 14 hochwertige Würfel, die es den Spielern und dem Spielleiter mit ihren individuellen Symbolen erlauben, den Erfolg oder Misserfolg von Aktionen schnell und unkompliziert zu erfassen. Durch das neuartige Würfelpool-Konzept mit Vorteilen und Bedrohungen wird zudem der erzählerische Fluss des Spiels gefördert.

Vincent Dutrait hat auch die Artworks für das Highlight unserer 2026er Events gestaltet: das 2026 Convention Exclusive Produkt! Das diesjährige Pack dreht sich ganz um bekannte Unterwelt- und Kopfgeldjäger-Einheiten. Insgesamt enthält es sechs Alternate-Art-Variantenkarten, von denen jede eine Unterwelt- oder Kopfgeldjäger-Einheit mit einem speziellen „Graustufen"-Design zeigt, das ihr nirgendwo sonst findet.
Bei den abgebildeten Einheiten handelt es sich ausnahmslos um ikonische, namhafte Charaktere aus allen drei Sets des dritten Jahres des Spiels. Aus Gesetzlose Zeiten stammen Boba Fett (2026 Convention Exclusive, 1), Der Mandalorianer (2026 Convention Exclusive, 52) und Cad Bane (2026 Convention Exclusive, 5). Pack your collection and set course for new adventures, with the Star Wars: Unlimited Cards’ Shuttle!
The Cards’ Shuttle is an officially licensed premium storage solution for Star Wars: Unlimited players and collectors. Made to store one complete Star Wars: Unlimited set, it can hold up to 500+ double-sleeved* cards and includes a removable Slide Card Case at the front. This lets players easily identify which set stored inside.
Equipped with Gamegenic’s signature convertible system, the magnetic cover is completely removable and can be securely clipped to the bottom of the box. An added spacer inside allows for easy access to cards.

Two iconic designs in one product!
The STAR WARS™: Unlimited Double-Sided Game Mat encapsulates not one, but two artworks from the game in one product, allowing more flexibility for players. With a simple turn of mat, players can change between the two officially licensed designs. Each side captures the game’s immersive atmosphere and brings it straight to every tabletop. pr.d:
A sunny beach day and surfing cats giving it their all staying cool all the time is no easy feat. Trick after trick, wave after wave, it can start to feel like a routine, so don't hesitate to innovate with new moves, no matter how risky they are.
In Surfin' Cats, you'll pull off tricks to ride the waves at just the right moment. The issue? Your rivals have spotted the same wave. During the game you can spend flow points to upgrade your deck by adding tricks from the market or unlocking a character-specific unique trick. The best wave is coming and you want to tame it like no one else so manage your hand tactically and push your luck to claim the most glorious position when you drop in. Each wave demands more or less paddling to earn the most flow points, but watch out opponents hold cards…

Krimidinner: Survival Island
Euer Flugzeug hat eine Bruchlandung hingelegt und du gehörst zu den glücklichen Überlebenden.
Du bist auf einer einsamen Insel gestrandet und wirst noch einige Zeit hier bleiben müssen. Nun heißt es, erst einmal die Situation analysieren, Verletzten helfen, Essensvorräte sammeln und die anderen Überlebenden kennenlernen.
Nach dem gemeinsamen Countdown
„3, 2, 1 … Bruchlandung!“ beginnt der Kampf ums nackte Dasein: Viel Glück!
Überlebe die Insel!

Whoa — look at all these treats! Quick, squirrels, grab your rakes and rake up your snacks before someone else gets their paws on them!
Sweepers is a fast-paced game of observation, precision, and dexterity where everyone plays at once. Reveal the top card from your deck, find the Stash token that matches both the treat and background color, and use your rake to carefully sweep it off your side of the meadow. Then reveal your next card and keep going — the first player to correctly collect all seven treats wins!
Be quick, but be careful: knock the wrong token off the meadow or grab the wrong treat, and you'll lose precious time fixing your mistake. For a different challenge, switch to Quick Paws, a cooperative mode where everyone works together to collect all their treats before the…

pr.m: Engine Building, Ressource Management, Tile Placement, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Willkommen in „Sweet Lands“, dem Königreich der köstlichen Süßigkeiten! Der ehemalige König ist seiner unersättlichen Liebe zu Süßigkeiten erlegen und hat ein letztes Dekret hinterlassen. Durch dieses königliche Edikt berufen, steht ihr mit euren Mitspieler vor der Herausforderung, die prächtigste Stadt zu errichten – und wenn ihr Erfolg habt, werdet ihr zum neuen Herrscher von Sweet Lands aufsteigen. Sichert euch die Unterstützung verschiedener Stadtbewohner und meistert den harten Wettbewerb, um die reichste und blühendste Stadt der Süßigkeiten zu erschaffen!
„Sweet Lands“ ist ein anspruchsvolles Spiel mit über 200 Karten, 14 einzigartigen Charakteren und 449 Holzmarkern, mit teils sehr besonderen Formen.

The vampire has hidden all the candy! So you set out to find it. Whoever finds the right piece of candy moves one space forward on the path. Who will reach the finish line first?
But be careful—watch out for the black cat!

Der Symbaroum Monsterkodex macht die Siedlungen, Wälder und Täler der Region Davokar gefährlicher als jemals zuvor! Mehr als hundert Kreaturen, Monster und Abscheulichkeiten tummeln sich zwischen diesen Buchdeckeln – manche davon wohlbekannt, andere nur in Märchen und Legenden erwähnt; manche unaufhaltsam hungrig, andere offen für Verhandlungen; manche detailliert präsentiert, andere nur mit kurzen Beschreibungen.
Zusammen mit den Richtlinien, wie du eigene Kreaturen erschaffen kannst, bietet der Inhalt dieses Bestiariums Material für Hunderte Stunden am Spieltisch!
◆ Mehr als dreißig voll beschriebene und illustrierte Kreaturen mit dem Potenzial, im
Mittelpunkt einzigartiger Abenteuer und Herausforderungen in Symbaroum zu stehen.
◆ Ein ganzes Kapitel mit kurzen Beschreibungen und Werten…

Symbiose is a fast-paced, strategic card game where you must join forces with your neighbors to compete with your aquatic counterparts. The goal? Create the most prosperous pond in the region!
In this turn-based game, your goal is to strategically place your cards to maximize your overall score. But be aware, each card score depending of its placement: on the left, you score depending on your left neighbor ; on the right, depending of your right neighbor and in the center depending of your own cards. Choose wisely!

The solar system we live in exists thanks to a miraculous arrangement of planets.
Even for a god, recreating the same miracle twice would be impossible… right?
…Huh? You say it’s easy?
You “gods” must work together to return the scattered planets to their proper order.
The only hint is the involuntary phrase that slips from your lips: “OH MY GOD.”

Du baust Reis an, in der japanischen Präfektur Niigata - dort, wo Schlangen als heilige Wesen gelten und dem Reis beim Wachsen helfen.
Je mehr Schlangen, desto reicher die Ernte. Doch nur wer sie im Zaum hält, bringt die Ernte auch ein.
Tanbo ist ein abstraktes Strategiespiel für zwei Personen mit japanischem Thema. Der Hauptmechanismus ähnelt Mancala, das seit der Antike gespielt wird. In Tanbo hat sich dieses Mancala-Prinzip jedoch zu etwas Ungewöhnlichem und Rätselhaftem weiterentwickelt, mit Elementen von Worker Placement und fest vorgegebener Bewegung.
Das Besondere:

🐍 Mancala-Mechanik mit Worker-Placement-Elementen
🏆 Gewinner des Rakuichi Fresh Dragon Award 2023
🎲 Mehrere saisonale Aufbau-Varianten (Regenzeit/Trockenzeit) für Abwechslung

TAP 10 Inventions: 1875-2025
Who came first, the light bulb or the telephone? The bicycle or the steam engine?
TAP 10 Inventions is a quick timeline card game for the whole table. Draw a card, guess where it fits in history, and place it in your timeline. Guess right and the card stays. Guess wrong and everyone gets to tell you why.
250 inventions, from the escalator to the smartphone. Easy to learn, impossible to stop arguing about.

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Dice Placement, Ressource Management, Set Collection
pr.d:
TATANKA is a strategic board game set on the Great Plains, where each player leads a Native American tribe through the passing of the moons, striving to ensure its prosperity and earn Honor.
Send your people across the land to hunt bison, gather resources and obtain everything your tribe needs to grow. Build Tipis, breed Mustangs, craft sacred objects and perform rites, choosing your own path toward prosperity.
At the heart of the game are the Chekutnak, traditional throwing sticks that you secretly combine to determine the type and strength of your actions. Read your opponents, anticipate their choices and decide how far to send your people: greater distances can offer new opportunities, but every journey takes time, and those who travel far will take longer to return.
Each tribe has its…

Terraces of Kanoa is a tactical tile-laying game where resources and nature intertwine to shape terraces and bring a magnificent landscape to life.
To do so, you must collect resources from the shared area, then strategically place your Landscape tiles to build your own territory. Create terraces and build trees, waterfalls, and houses, placing them harmoniously to maximize your points.
Players freely build and stack tiles, watching their territory quickly evolve in height and relief.
As soon as a terrace is created (when a tile is isolated through stacking), trees, waterfalls, and houses can be built, depending on the type of landscape.
Every action has an immediate and visible impact, making the game intuitive and highly satisfying.

TFTC – an adventurous card game for geocachers!
Are you ready to dive into the exciting world of geocaching? TFTC is a fast-paced and tactical card game where players create geocaches, competing with each other to collect the most points. However, geocachers’ preferences can change quickly, so you have to be attentive to catch the right moment exactly – but if you don’t succeed, you can always slow down your fellow competitors a little.

Passions flamed and power waned. King Henry pursued Anne Boleyn for almost seven years before they were married. Those loyal to Catherine of Aragon did not accept Anne Boleyn, and considered King Henry’s first wife the rightful Queen. Those loyal to Anne Boleyn saw her as the future, the young wife who would surely give the King a son.
The Six of VIII is a trick-taking game played on a timeline. Each Queen has her own suit which is trump during her reign. Players must capture tricks containing crucial courtiers and score the most points. The suits, and the years on the timeline, are proportional to the lengths of the reign of each Queen, with Anne of Cleves being the shortest.

Two rival temporal agencies clash across the great eras of human history, each striving to impose its own timeline at the expense of the other's. Every agent steps through portals to travel from one era to the next, working to correct the anomalies that have slipped onto their path. Only the victor will rewrite history...
In Time Walkers, each player represents a temporal agency. On every turn, you play cards to mark cells on one of the four Era boards that together form the tapestry of time. In doing so, you step through portals, correct anomalies, travel the eras, and draw Rift tokens that earn you victory points. The game ends when a player draws the last Rift token. The player with the most victory points wins the game.

pr.k: 228:TOPP BRICKS ADVENTSKALENDER – 24 WEIHNACHTLICHE SETS AUS MINI-KLEMMBAUSTEINEN
pr.t: TOPP Bricks Adventskalender – 24 weihnachtliche Sets aus Mini-Klemmbausteinen

24 Tage Bauspaß mit weit über 3.000 Teilen!
Dieser Adventskalender für kleine und große Klemmbaustein-Profis bietet jeden Tag ein neues Mini-Set aus bis zu 264 Einzelteilen mit Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen. Aus den insgesamt weit über 3.000 Teilen baust du detailverliebte Weihnachtsmodelle, die nicht nur beim Konstruieren Spaß machen, sondern auch als stilvolle Dekoration dienen.
Das erwartet dich:
• 24 Mini-Klemmbaustein-Sets

• bis zu 264 Einzelteile pro Set − über 3.000 Teile insgesamt!

• farbenfrohe, weihnachtliche Modelle

• mit Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen zu jedem Bausatz

• alle Teile lassen sich beliebig weiter kombinieren

• Altersempfehlung: ab 10 Jahren

Push your luck. Stay natural. Don’t get caught.
A fast, hilarious card game where mischievous langurs test how far they can go… while tourists watch closely.
How mischievous can you get… without getting caught?
Every round, tourists arrive on safari.
And you — a very “normal” langur — try to act natural.
But secretly, you’re pushing your luck.
Play your mischief cards, plan your moves, and hope you don’t get spotted.
Because even if you get caught… you still walk away with some chaos.
How it plays
• Choose 3 cards from your hand and place them face down in order.

• Tourists are revealed one by one.
Each tourist spots different levels of mischief.

• Reveal your cards step by step.

• Stay under the radar and score full points and buy cards to upgrade your deck.
Get caught and score half.…

A game where everyone laughs and has fun, but... what if I cheat a little? In Trampos, cunning borders on cheating, so keep your eyes peeled to see who's sneaking ahead! Be the first to reach the cushion and win the game!
On your turn:
Choose one of the cards in your hand and place it face down to your right.
Everyone together, turn over the played cards.
The person who played the lowest non-repeated card can move their bear.
This way, you'll gradually get closer to the cushion, your goal! The first to reach it will be able to rest all winter!
Play by the rules we are explaining below, but remember...you're allowed to cheat!

At the races, you are both the jockey and the bettor. Follow suit to win the tricks, but place your bets first, because the odds shift with every hand. Ride to win, or ride to lose and cash in on someone else's victory. A trick-taking game with a double role and a delicious amount of second-guessing.

Preorder link : https://forms.gle/bWTuU3vbEiy8XvWg7

A trick-taking game where you must not follow suit. Play your heroes, collect the sets you need, and watch out for the time paradoxes: play two identical heroes and the timeline collapses, cutting the round short for everyone. Easy to teach, sharp to master, and never quite the same twice. Winner of a Seal of Excellence.
Preorder link : https://forms.gle/bWTuU3vbEiy8XvWg7

pr.t: TSUKUYUMI – Leadership cards Wave 2 Expansion (Standee, english)

Tsukuyumi – Leadership Cards Wave 2
The Leadership Cards Wave 2 expand the Standee Edition of Tsukuyumi with the Leadership Cards for factions that have been released over the past few years.
Leadership Cards are included for:
⏳ Chronomasters
☀️ Circle of the Sun
✝️ Dark Crusade

🌊 Reef Collective
⚔️ Sisters of Seven
🎪 Moon Circus
The set contains a total of 21 cards, including the 2-player cards for Dark Crusade.

pr.a: Michael Løhde-Andersen, Morten Baun Møller, Morten Skovhus
pr.m: Dice Rolling, Drafting, Push your Luck
pr.d:
TURBO6 is a fast-paced dice game where every roll can turn the game around, and every card you claim brings you one step closer to victory.
Chase the perfect dice combinations, snatch valuable cards right from under your opponents’ noses, and cash them in for an extra die that can open up even more possibilities in your hunt for those all-important points.
But watch out – luck alone won’t be enough. You’ll need to think fast, choose wisely, and go for the right cards at exactly the right moment.
The balance between luck, strategy, timing, and sometimes a little patience means that no two rounds ever play out the same – and the excitement lasts right up to the final roll. Because you never know when a player might suddenly pull off the ultimate roll: a “TURBO6” – six of a kind with six…

Kooperativ aufbauen. Taktisch gewinnen. Einmal gespielt – immer wieder gewollt. TURM – Das Duell ist das einzige Kartenspiel, das beides kann: gemeinsam bauen und gegeneinander gewinnen. Ein Spielgefühl, das ihr so noch nicht kanntet.
DAS PERFEKTE SPIEL FÜR 2 PERSONEN: Konzipiert als reines Zwei-Spieler- Duell
SCHNELL GELERNT, SCHWER GEMEISTERT: Die Regeln sind in 5 Minuten erklärt – doch die taktische Tiefe begeistert Runde für Runde. Spielzeit 45–60 Minuten, perfekt für entspannte Spieleabende.
DESIGN, DAS BEGEISTERT: Die stabile TURM-Box ist gleichzeitig Spielfeld, Aufbewahrung und Blickfang. Authentische Steinmauer-Optik, hochwertiger Druck und liebevolles mittelalterliches Design – ein Spiel, das man gerne auf den Tisch stellt und gerne im Regal hat.

Locker Pack is a boxed accessory set for Table Buster — a modular board game accessory system designed to expand and organize the playable area around the table.
The pack includes magnetic lockers dedicated to the Table Buster Base. Lockers help build and customize a personal player area, creating dedicated spaces for cards, tokens, components and other game assets.
Thanks to the magnetic mounting system, lockers can be attached, removed and rearranged quickly during setup or between games. This makes it easy to adapt the table layout to different titles, player needs and component-heavy setups.
Locker Pack is designed as a clean and practical expansion for players who want more control, better organization and a more flexible Table Buster setup.
This is not a standalone board game, but a…

Locker Pack Extended is a larger boxed accessory set for Table Buster — a modular board game accessory system designed to expand and organize the playable area around the table.
The pack includes an extended selection of magnetic lockers dedicated to the Table Buster Grand Base, while also being compatible with the standard Table Buster Base. Lockers help build, customize and expand a personal player area, creating dedicated spaces for cards, tokens, components and other game assets.
Thanks to the magnetic mounting system, lockers can be attached, removed and rearranged quickly during setup or between games. This makes it easy to adapt the table layout to different titles, larger games, multi-component setups and individual player needs.
Locker Pack Extended is designed for players who…

Starter Pack Sentinels Duo is a boxed starter set for Table Buster — a modular board game accessory system designed to expand and organize the playable area around the table.
Table Buster helps create extra space for cards, tokens, components and player assets, making games cleaner, more comfortable and easier to manage. It is especially useful on smaller tables, but also works perfectly for larger games where every player needs a clear personal area.
This starter pack is designed as an entry point into the Table Buster system. It gives two players a stable and expandable setup that can later be upgraded with additional bases, docks, lockers and other accessories.
This is not a standalone board game, but a premium accessory set for board gamers who want more space, better organization and…
