Taco vs Burrito: Die ultimative Essensschlacht! In diesem schnellen Partyspiel stehen Hand-Management und taktische Sabotage im Vordergrund. Kreiert den wildesten Taco oder Burrito, indem ihr seltsamste Zutaten auf eure Gerichte klatscht. Verdoppelt euer eigenes Gericht mit Chilisauce oder schickt den anderen den Gesundheitsinspektor auf den Hals mit einem Hygienecheck. Wer am Ende das wertvollste Gericht hat, gewinnt.

pr.a: Corentin Lebrat, Florian Sirieix, Benoit Turpin
pr.d: Let’s head into the next big showdown - this time with heroes and heroines from the legend of King Arthur! In this expansion for Tag Team (which can also be played on its own), you’ll choose from six new, unique fighters: powerful mages, brave knights, or mysterious figures from the world of legend. Assemble your Tag Team of two characters, combine their card decks, and face off against each other in thrilling rounds! Just like in the popular base game, you simultaneously reveal the top card of your battle deck and trigger its effects. But be careful: After each round, you strategically add a new card to any spot in your deck - keeping control over the next exchange of blows. Whoever plans skillfully and lands the decisive blow secures victory!

pr.a: Gricha German, Corentin Lebrat, Florian Sirieix, Benoit Turpin
pr.d:
Tag Team is back with 6 new Fighters inspired by the legends of King Arthur!

Arthurian legends come to life in the Tag Team arena! Play as Morgan, Merlin, The Dragon, Perceval, The Green Knight... and even Excalibur! In Tag Team, we don’t sit around telling stories, though, we FIGHT!
Who will dominate the arena as these legendary characters engage in epic battles?

Tag Team: Arthur’s Legacy is a standalone game featuring 6 new Fighters, all compatible with the game’s existing Fighters.

Tag Team is a cross between a tactical auto battler and a deckbuilder for 2 players, inspired by the greatest classic arcade games, featuring awesome and charismatic Fighters, each with their own fighting styles and signature moves.Build your team of 2 and put together the ultimate synergies by combining…

SNK Legends are making their way to the Tag Team Arena and Essen Spiel is your chance to play the first 4 revealed characters!
Tag Team: SNK Arcade Legends will feature six Fighters, including Terry Bogard and Mai Shiranui from the FATAL FURY series as well as Nakoruru from SAMURAI SHODOWN. The fourth character, also from SAMURAI SHODOWN, will be revealed right before the show. The two remaining characters from THE KING OF FIGHTERS will be revealed one at a time, once per month.
A 7th Fighter will be available exclusively as an online pre-order bonus: Iori Yagami from THE KING OF FIGHTERS, including his Fighter board, 10-card deck, and Draft Card.
Are you ready to relive the golden age of '90s arcade fighting games in the Tag Team arena?
Tag Team is a cross between a tactical auto battler…

English

Maximum fun in minimum time. A game series inspired by Japan’s “Taipa” culture.
“Taipa” is a Japanese abbreviation of “time performance.”
It means getting as much enjoyment and value as possible in as little time as possible.
The Taipa Supremacy series takes the best parts of classic games and turns them into experiences you can enjoy in a much shorter time.
Go all-in in 5 minutes
I want to hit a Royal Straight Flush.
The rules are just like poker.
But here, strong hands come one after another.
Flip a card and try not to grin.
Good luck keeping your poker face.

“All-in!” Just the best parts of Poker.
Look at your cards.
Read your opponents.
Bet your chips.
Bluff.
And when the moment is right, go “All-in!”
The goal isn’t to master every detail of Poker.
Even complete beginners…

Die Mini-Erweiterung Illusionen für Take Time enthält ein neues Kapitel mit vier Uhren, das ihr jederzeit spielen könnt – entweder zwischen zwei Kapiteln aus dem Grundspiel oder im Anschluss an Kapitel 10. Diese Mini-Erweiterung enthält außerdem ein zusätzliches Zeitsprungplättchen, mit dem ihr die Uhren aus dem Grundspiel ein weiteres Mal mit erhöhtem Schwierigkeitsgrad spielen könnt. Ihr könnt das neue Plättchen einsetzen, nachdem ihr die vier Uhren aus dieser Erweiterung gelöst habt.Zum Spielen der Erweiterung wird ein Grundspiel Take Time benötigt.

In the busy streets of the Tang Dynasty, clothes are not just to keep you warm—they show your status and power. As a top tailor, your goal is to make the most beautiful clothes for everyone, from royalty to everyday people. In this game of fashion and competition, you will:
Dye Fabrics: Choose the perfect base colors and add beautiful patterns to make the best cloth.
Complete Orders: Cut the cloth perfectly to make the right clothes for every customer and event.
As you finish more and more clothes, the rich life of the palace and the city will come alive on your table. Who will earn the most fame and become the ultimate "Master Tailor" Pre-order

Tanglung is a tactical duel of quiet competition amidst glowing lanterns. Players move their matchboxes to light up lanterns and jostle for control i n an interplay of positioning, timing, and good fortune where illumination and disruption go hand in hand!

Goal: Be first to win 2 matches

3 Ways to win a match:
1. Light up the last Tanglung
2. The other player cannot move
3. Bump the other player's Matchbox twice

On your turn, choose either:

A ROOSTER ACTION
Move your Matchbox + Place the Fan

A LANTERN ACTION
Move your Matchbox + Bump the other player's Matchbox

After taking an Action,
check if any of the 3 winning conditions is met.

pr.m: Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Modular Board
pr.d:
The stage is set for the largest clash of late-war heavy armour.
The Red Army is spearheaded by the powerful Russian tank corps with units like the T34, SU100 and IS2. Germany pins her hopes on the last of the panzer divisions to stop the Soviet advance. The Wehrmacht fields its fearsome tanks like the Stug III, Nashorn and Tiger II for the upcoming battle.
Tank Clash: Eastern Front is a standalone tactical tank warfare game for 2 players, designed for both newcomers and seasoned strategists. Easy to learn yet rich in tactical choices, it combines its signature checkers-style armour tracking system with dice rolling and hand management for intense skirmish battles.
Built with modularity in mind, Eastern Front is fully compatible with its predecessor, Tank Clash: Western Front. Combine…

Tap 4: the fast-paced, exciting, and thoroughly tactical card game for everyone ages 10 and up. Getting rid of cards from your hand sounds easy? It is! But what if you have to play cards face down? Then it’s time to cross your fingers, grit your teeth, and trust in luck. If the card is higher, the whole stack goes into your hand! That’s definitely not the way to get rid of your cards… Fast-paced rounds and hilarious moments make Tap 4 a fantastic experience you’ll never forget.

Bei Tapple musst du schnell sein! Finde zur ausgerufenen Kategorie ein Wort mit passendem Anfangsbuchstaben, ruf das Wort und drück auf die entsprechende Taste auf dem Tapple-Rad. Buchstabe schon heruntergedrückt? Oh je, du musst dir schnell ein anderes Wort ausdenken, denn die Zeit läuft! Jetzt könnt ihr Tapple fast immer und überall spielen - das handliche Tapple-Rad macht es möglich!

Der weltweite Erfolgstitel ist nun auch als Kartenspiel erhältlich. Findet als Schnellster einen passenden Begriff zur Kategorie und dem aufgedeckten Buchstaben. Die gewonnen Karten bringen dir am Spielende (hoffentlich die meisten) Siegpunkte.

pr.t: Tatort Meer Junior | Alle Jahre wieder
pr.o: TATORT MEER JUNIOR | ALLE JAHRE WIEDER
pr.d: Hi there, I’m Manni, the seagull. I live in the coastal town of Nordersiel, and I need your help solving a crime. Just before Christmas is one of the most important days of the year for the seal sanctuary: the big fundraiser for the baby seals. But the well-filled donation jar has suddenly vanished without a trace. Help me find out who stole the money and where it is, so we can buy food for the seals again!

Ein weiterer Fall unserer Krimidinner-Tatort-Reihe bringt die Spieler nun mitten in eine Ermittlung am Gretenkogel-Ski-Cup.
Eine Lawine erfasst den Favoriten des Skirennens, doch was zunächst wie ein tragischer Unfall erscheint, entpuppt sich bald als ein komplexes Geflecht aus Lügen, Intrigen und schmutzigen Geheimnissen.
Ein eiskalter Fall, der wieder digitale Elemente täuschend echt einbindet und den Spielern eine immersive Ermittlung ermöglicht. Natürlich wieder mit einer Prise Humor unseres beliebten Polizeikommissars “Hecklmeier”.
This is the German edition of Tax the Rich, originally published by Alion.

In Tea & Rum, strive for victory by serving the Crown or by becoming the greatest King of Pirates!
Within 5 rounds, upgrade your resources and carefully place and un-place your workers to fulfill your ambitions.
Will you prove your allegiance to the Crown, or will you join the rebellion and rule the seas? Be careful to keep your intentions hidden: angering the Crown or the people could compromize your chances.
At the end of the game, only two players will win the game… and two will be defeated.

Wer sichert sich die Gunst der Götter – und wer fällt den Plänen der anderen zum Opfer?
In einem Land, in dem auch heute noch die alten Götter herrschen, bringt ihre Macht und Weisheit entweder Wohlstand oder den Ruin. Ihr wurdet jeweils mit dem Bau einer Tempelpyramide beauftragt, die die Farben der Götter tragen soll. Doch nur, wer die eindrucksvollste Pyramide baut, sichert sich die Gunst der Götter.
In Tempel der Fünf baut ihr in drei Runden jeweils eure eigene dreistufige Pyramide.
Zieht Plättchen, behaltet das Beste und gebt die anderen an eure Mitspielenden weiter. Verteilt das Baumaterial dabei weise! Anschließend legt ihr die Plättchen möglichst so an, dass Gruppen derselben Farbe entstehen. Mit diesen Gruppen und euren Priestern könnt ihr euch Segenskarten und damit wertvolle…

pr.d:
Deep in the jungle, a unique adventure awaits: Rumors speak of an ancient temple where valuable treasures lie hidden. But the temple is one big maze! One to four players work together to find their way through the 3D temple - without communicating with each other! Using action cards, they navigate this special maze, move walls, or even rotate the entire temple! Think strategically, plan ahead, and experience the excitement: unique fun for ages eight and up, full of team spirit for the whole family.
Winner of the 2026 Toy Award.

pr.m: Ressource Management, Tile Placement, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Tenpenny Parks is back bigger and better than ever with this gorgeous new Collector’s Edition. Packed with theme-park building strategy, this big box edition contains both expansions (Innovation and Winter Lights & Spooky Nights) as well as the base game and mini-expansion promos. Construct your amusement park in style with deluxe components and luxurious box organizer trays that make setup, breakdown, and organizing all the components convenient, easy, and beautiful.
Tenpenny Parks is a euro-style game of worker placement, polyomino tile placement, and resource management. Featuring the stunning art of Vincent Dutrait, this game has an unstoppable table presence, snappy strategic gameplay, and a unique twist on tile placement. Purchase attractions for your theme park from the market,…

pr.m: Ressource Management, Tile Placement, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Innovation is an expansion for Tenpenny Parks, the worker and tile placement game where you compete to build the best vintage amusement park in town. In this new era of your park, you must lead your fairgrounds into the future with fresh ideas that will draw even more visitors to Fairview.
How will you focus this vision into reality? Hire new Specialists for your park, each with their own ideas and abilities to help you create grand (and lucrative!) ways to score.
Meanwhile, do some science! Advance your new Researcher Worker up the track on the new Innovation board to help pave the way for your pioneering plans.
With all your monumental ideas for development, you’re also going to need more space! Innovations includes all-new player boards with unique asymmetric abilities and layouts. It…

pr.t: Tenpenny Parks: Winter Lights & Spooky Nights
pr.o: TENPENNY PARKS: WINTER LIGHTS & SPOOKY NIGHTS
pr.m: Ressource Management, Tile Placement, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Winter Lights & Spooky Nights is two expansions in one box for Tenpenny Parks, the worker and tile placement game that tasks you with building the best amusement park in town. Play these expansions separately or together, and discover new ways to inspire your park’s seasonal visitors with 12 new attractions, wooden Ghost and Christmas Tree tokens, advancement tracks, and fresh mechanics to challenge your skills.
Trick, or treat? In Spooky Nights, prepare heart-pounding new rides for Halloween! Nothing sells tickets like a fright fest. Haunt your attractions with helpful ghosts, scaring up varied bonuses during the Advertising step. Offer up creepy concessions too, and you’ll give your guests goosebumps like never before.
As autumn ends, deck the halls in your park with Winter Lights.…

pr.m: Area Movement, Dice Placement, Dice Rolling, Modular Board, Push your Luck
pr.d:
Terminator 2: The Board Game is an officially licensed board game from STUDIOCANAL that puts players in the middle of the struggle to prevent Judgment Day.
Players take on the roles of Sarah Connor, John Connor, and the reprogrammed T-800, working together to survive and stop Skynet’s rise. The game can be played cooperatively (1–3 players) against an automated T-1000 opponent, or in a 1-vs-many mode where one player controls the relentless T-1000 hunting the heroes.
The game takes place across modular locations representing Los Angeles. Players move their miniatures between locations to attempt missions, resolve encounters, gather intelligence, and avoid the T-1000. Missions and encounters are resolved through a dice-based system using Combat, Skill, and Persuasion dice. Players roll…

Designed by Eilif Svensson (Trails of Tucana) and Åsmund Svensson, it brilliantly combines simple rules with highly rewarding route-building decisions. With virtually zero setup time, the game begins in seconds but offers meaningful choices from the very first roll.

Each player receives an asymmetric map and sets out to build a network of roads to transport valuable goods:
• Connect the Harvest: Link olives, oranges, and strawberries to their designated markets, or connect matching market pairs for additional progress.

Terravista is a fast and accessible roll-and-write game for 1–6 players, where every line you draw shapes your path to victory. Designed by Eilif Svensson (Trails of Tucana) and Åsmund Svensson, it combines simple rules with rewarding route-building decisions.
Each player receives an asymmetric map and sets out to build roads connecting olives, oranges, and strawberries to their markets, while also linking matching market pairs for additional progress. With virtually no setup time, the game begins in seconds but offers meaningful choices from the very first roll.
Each round, two dice determine which terrain types can be connected, and all players simultaneously draw a road between adjacent spaces on their own map. Completing connections advances players along shared tracks, unlocking…

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Set Collection, Others
pr.d: The Amazing Journey is a globe-trotting game for 2 to 4 travelers. Check which transport vehicles are available in each date, then plan accordingly to make sure you can keep on moving without losing time. Gather Experiences to have an amazing story to tell back home and meet other players at checkpoints: the destination is as important as the memories you made along the way!

pr.k: 413:THE ANTIQUITY TAROT – HISTORICAL TAROT FROM THE 15TH–19TH CENTURIES
pr.t: The Antiquity Tarot – Historical Tarot from the 15th–19th Centuries
pr.o: THE ANTIQUITY TAROT – HISTORICAL TAROT FROM THE 15TH–19TH CENTURIES
pr.d:
The Antiquity Tarot is a 78-card historical Tarot deck inspired by authentic Tarot imagery from the 15th to the 19th centuries.
The deck brings together visual traditions from different periods of Tarot history, including medieval, Renaissance and later European styles. The cards preserve the distinctive character of early Tarot art while presenting the imagery as one cohesive collectible deck.
In addition to the 78 Tarot cards, the set includes 12 collector cards and a guidebook, making it suitable for Tarot reading, historical study and collecting.
A distinctive choice for readers interested in historical Tarot, Renaissance art, antique card design and the visual evolution of Tarot through the centuries.

EVERY DOG HAS ITS BAD DAY.
Save your lowest card for the last trick, for the “winner” of the last trick is the loser of the round and gets penalty cards!
- You must play higher cards than the previous player.
- The highest card of the final trick loses the round and collect penalties.
- Whoever collects 7 types of cards as penalties loses the game.

pr.t: The Beat: Rockstars of the Galaxy
pr.o: THE BEAT: ROCKSTARS OF THE GALAXY
pr.d:
The Beat: Rockstars of the Galaxy is a cooperative limited communication and hand-management game for 2–4 players where you play as an up and coming Alien band and tour the most legendary venues in the galaxy.
By playing card you work together to build the perfect setlist. Every song can end ON POINT, LOUD, or as a FAIL. Communication is limited, so success depends on reading your bandmates, managing your hand and trusting each other's instincts.
Every of its 26 venues introduces a new rule that changes how the game is played. No two venues play alike and mastering each one is the key to completing the interstellar tour. Event Cards add even more variety, ensuring that no two performances ever unfold the same way.
Can your band perform, adapt and improvise to conquer the greatest stages…

pr.k: 961:THE BINDING OF ISAAC FOUR SOULS ULTIMATE COLLECTION
pr.t: The Binding Of Isaac Four Souls Ultimate Collection
pr.o: THE BINDING OF ISAAC FOUR SOULS ULTIMATE COLLECTION
pr.m: Deck Building, Dice Rolling, Push your Luck, Ressource Management, Others
pr.d:
The Binding Of Isaac: Four Souls - Ultimate Collection - Second Edition

The Binding of Isaac: Four Souls Ultimate Collection is the definitive all-in-one experience for fans of the hit card game. Packed inside the impressive Big Boi Box, this collection includes the fully updated base game and two major expansions, delivering over 700 cards of chaotic, combo-driven gameplay. With dozens of characters, a wealth of items and enemies, and the innovative Room Deck, every session feels fresh and unpredictable. Complete with premium tokens, dice, and storage solutions, this is the ultimate way to start or upgrade your Four Souls collection.

Key Features:
• COMPLETE COLLECTION: Includes 2nd Edition base game, Four Souls+ expansion, and Requiem expansion in one premium box

• MASSIVE CARD…

You are a volunteer at a bird sanctuary, cooperating to rehabilitate nervous birds by keeping them calm as they are introduced to the flock. One player is The Handler, posing their hands as necessary to receive each incoming bird and to balance the growing flock.
The rest of the crew? Easy. Draw a card, wait for the Handler's signal, and give 'em the bird. The game ends when the crew takes 3 bird droppings.

The Bird is a silly but challengin dexterity party game that uses fun plastic balancing birds from your childhood. The twist is you must push your luck, posing and reposing your hands, to balance as many birds as you can.

Hole die legendären experimentellen Rollen endlich physisch an deinen Spieltisch! The Carousel erweitert das preisgekrönte Social-Deduction-Meisterwerk Blood on the Clocktower um 72 bisher überwiegend digital verfügbare Charaktere und hebt deine Runden auf ein völlig neues Level an Täuschung, Taktik und Chaos.
Die Highlights auf den Punkt:
• Massive Rollenvielfalt: 72 experimentelle Charaktere (vom Akrobaten bis zum Zauberer) samt zugehörigen Erinnerungsplättchen für unzählige neue Rollenkombinationen.

• Perfekt für Community- & Fan-Skripte: Die physischen Plättchen liefern das notwendige Spielmaterial, um unzählige online verfügbare Fan-Skripte und eigene Custom-Szenarien direkt am Tisch Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen.

• Perfekt organisiert: Enthält 3 hochwertige Token-Boxen, die für…

A mysterious murder has recently occurred. The investigation has stalled, and the world’s top crime analysts have gathered to uncover the truth.
However, there’s a shocking secret: one of them is the culprit of this very crime, and their memory of the crime has been warped. Now, you must all pursue the truth of the case — or recall it.
Perhaps the culprit is you.

pr.t: The Crew - Chase Around the World
pr.o: THE CREW - CHASE AROUND THE WORLD
pr.d: The crew has to get moving to find Charlemagne’s lost treasure. With only a few clues, they follow the trail by ship, sled, and other means across five continents and through dangerous habitats. But the competition never sleeps, so every step must be carefully considered and communicated. Over the course of 25 stages, the crew tries to reach the finish line with as few tasks as possible to avoid giving the time marker too much of a head start. Failure, however, doesn’t end the stage; instead, it eventually forces the crew to take a greater risk to achieve the best result. A varied, cooperative adventure with high replay value and unique challenges awaits two to five players ages ten and up.

pr.m: Area Control, Engine Building, Modular Board, Ressource Management, Set Collection
pr.d: The Dawn of Pangaea is a deeply thematic, medium-weight strategy boardgame for 1-4 players, set in the ancient world of Pangaea. As players, you take on the role of the first spirits, growing trees, performing rituals, and bringing the first creatures to the world. 🌱🌿 The enchanting artwork and carefully crafted wooden components take you on a magical journey of rivalry and harmony. Expand your forest and ascend the sacred mountain — and gain the high blessing of Gaia! 🌟

pr.t: The Dawn of Pangaea - Wild Woods
pr.o: THE DAWN OF PANGAEA - WILD WOODS
pr.m: Area Control, Engine Building, Modular Board, Ressource Management, Set Collection
pr.d: The Wild Woods expansion perfectly complements the gameplay of The Dawn of Pangaea by adding an additional layer of — height! The 24 wooden treetops, 4 player boards and new rules increase the strategic possibilities and depth.

The Edge
Zweiteliges Zubehör, um an der Ecke des Tisches eine Ablage zu haben.
Das Ende des toten Winkels!

Breite 400mm, Tiefe 140mm

The head of the family has passed away, leaving behind a lifetime of treasured collections and real estate. As heirs to the estate, each player secretly considers how to secure the greatest possible inheritance.

Over several rounds, players compete to claim their share of the estate, but each player may claim at most 1 inheritance lot per round. At the end of the game, players score the cards they have collected. The player with the highest total score wins.

Bound by Hope
The Northwest Passage. An elusive sea route along the northern coast of America that's said to link the Pacific and Atlantic oceans. Since the 15th century, expeditions were launched with the dream of discovering it, only to then vanish in the icebergs. This is a cooperative game where you aim to connect 15 cards together while meeting the necessary conditions. But if you veer off course even slighty, your voyage will end in failure. Work together and predict which cards the other players hold, make use of items, and successfully traverse the route that humanity has dreamed of!

pr.m: Engine Building, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Tile Placement, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Follow your dreams and manufacture the greatest board games of all time!
In The Game Makers, players are board game manufacturers racing to build the greatest collection of classic modern board games. Build over 300 real-world games from over 100 real-world publishers. You can build Wingspan, Brass: Birmingham, On Mars, Terraforming Mars, Ark Nova, Twilight Imperium: Fourth Edition, and many more!

pr.a: Michael Rieneck, Jackie Morris, Robert Macfarlane
pr.d: Chirping, rustling, a peek into the nest - a unique habitat for native birds takes shape on the game board. In this family game for two to four players ages ten and up, dice are rolled at the start of each round: White dice grant advantages, while black dice impose restrictions. Next, a bird card is chosen to take birds from the game board into your hand, which can then be used to create new opportunities or placed in your own display. Each bird species possesses one of seven special abilities, such as song, feathers, or migration. Players who skillfully collect symbols or combine multiple birds of the same species earn awards. But be careful: dangers repeatedly put the habitat to the test or steal birds from the display.

Team Poker! Now in a Deluxe Edition with improved and special game components, plus all previously available expansions. It also includes a brand-new expansion—the “Dealer Button.” The notorious “The Gang” is planning a series of heists and must crack three safes before the alarm goes off three times. Perfect coordination and the right positioning within the gang are crucial. Three to ten players ages ten and up can take on this challenge and play poker cooperatively. However, they’re not allowed to discuss their hole cards. An exciting gaming experience based on the familiar principles of poker, featuring poker chips and coolly designed cards.
On the recommendation list for the 2025 Kennerspiel des Jahres award.

The Glasgow Train Robbery is a co-operative game for two players inspired by one of the most infamous crimes in British history. Set in 1960s Scotland, you and your partner take on the roles of two key members of a criminal crew determined to intercept and rob a high-value train — without getting caught.
Over the course of the game, you'll work together to plan the heist, gather the right equipment, mislead the authorities, and finally execute the robbery in a high-stakes finale. Communication is limited, tension is high, and every decision counts. Will you manage to synchronize your actions, stay ahead of the investigation, and escape with the loot? Or will a single misstep derail the whole operation?

pr.m: Auction, Dice Rolling, Drafting, Modular Board, Worker Placement

pr.t: The Happiest Cat in the World
pr.o: THE HAPPIEST CAT IN THE WORLD
pr.d: In The Happiest Cat in the World, players expand their apartments with beds, shelves, toys, snacks and other amenities to create an ideal home for their cats. Tactical tile placement and strong synergies between furnishings help score points and make your feline happier than the neighbours’ cats.

The Jailbreak is a cooperative deduction game where your perspective and clever communication will be needed to carry out your escape.
Work together with your teammates over 44 challenges broken up across 11 pivotal days of your jailbreak. Each day gets more challenging as you take on more risks in planning and executing your escape.
During the game, each player holds a hand of double-sided tools and each tool has a non-overlapping front/back pairing. Your perspective at the table may help you give clever clues to your teammates to help them, with some deduction, play their tools to the right spot and complete the challenge.
Be careful - if you get it wrong you risk being caught by the guards.

When the planet Chimera Prime is invaded by an unknown alien horde, the Human Planetary Sphere deploys the elite F.T.A. soldiers to turn the tide. However, what seemed like a straightforward mission quickly becomes a deadly trap for the battle‑hardened troops. Outnumbered and overwhelmed, only a suicide mission can lead them to victory. If humanity’s last squad manages to eliminate every leader of the invading force, they might escape alive — and stop the alien advance.
The Last Squadron is a card‑management game where the player faces an alien invasion. To defeat the attackers, they must position their soldiers in a way that allows them to eliminate the invading Aliens within the planet. Each Alien defeated grants immediate benefits the player can use right away. The game ends in defeat…

pr.k: 413:THE LUMINOUS ARCANA TAROT – STAINED-GLASS STYLE TAROT DECK
pr.t: The Luminous Arcana Tarot – Stained-Glass Style Tarot Deck
pr.o: THE LUMINOUS ARCANA TAROT – STAINED-GLASS STYLE TAROT DECK
pr.d:
The Luminous Arcana Tarot is a 78-card deck inspired by the radiant beauty of stained-glass art.
Each card combines traditional Tarot symbolism with luminous jewel tones, intricate ornamental details and cathedral-like stained-glass compositions. Deep blues, golds, reds and greens create a glowing, dramatic visual style that gives the deck a distinctive sacred and mystical atmosphere.
The deck includes all 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana cards and is suitable for Tarot readings, reflection and collecting. A QR code provides access to the guidebook.

pr.k: 870:THE MANDALORIAN ADVENTURES – SWORN TO THE CREED EXP.
pr.t: The Mandalorian Adventures – Sworn to the Creed Exp.
pr.o: THE MANDALORIAN ADVENTURES – SWORN TO THE CREED EXP.
pr.d:
Mit der Erweiterung Das ist der Weg gehen die Abenteuer des Mandalorianers im kooperativen Kennerspiel The Mandalorian™: Adventures weiter! Erlebt die aufregendsten Momente aus Staffel 3 der TV-Serie und begleitet Din Djarin und seine Gefährten bei der Rückeroberung ihrer Heimatwelt. Der finstere Moff Gideon wird es euch jedoch nicht leicht machen.Mehr Charaktere, Gegner, Kartentypen und Mechanismen bieten euch neue Strategien, die es zu entdecken und neue Herausforderungen, die es zu meistern gilt. Arbeitet zusammen, bekämpft Gegner und trefft schwierige Entscheidungen, um das Missionsziel zu erfüllen. Entdeckt mit jeder Partie neue Regeln, Spielmaterialien und Varianten!

Kein eigenständiges Grundspiel. Zum Spielen wird das Grundspiel The Mandalorian: Adventures benötigt.

Head to the Foxtrot Bar for the perfect cocktail experience: gather ingredients, serve guests, and expand your own bar. The Mix combines worker placement, engine building, and cocktail flair into a clever competition for reputation and experience. The player who scores the most points earns the title of best mixologist and wins.

pr.m: Action Selection, Engine Building, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:
The Mix is a strategic cocktail-crafting board game for 1–4 players, where every decision behind the bar matters.
Collect ingredients, master techniques, choose the right glasses, and craft the perfect cocktails to satisfy demanding customers. Build your reputation, create powerful combos, and adapt your strategy as new opportunities appear each round.
With elegant engine-building, tactical card play, and a unique bartending theme, The Mix offers meaningful decisions, high replayability, and beautiful premium production.
Launching at SPIEL Essen 2026.

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Area Movement, Auction
pr.d:
ONCE WE WERE SAILORS WHO TRAVELED THE STARS.
PATHETIC. PURPOSELESS.
THEN WE FOUND THE HOLY PLANET AND THE MONOLITH WAS HERE, WAITING FOR US ALL ALONG.
In The Monolith, 3-4 players take on the roles of shaman, leading their warriors in battle against each other, all for the pleasure of the monolith that holds them in thrall.
Each round, players take turns spending hearts to complete actions. These actions allow them to recruit and move warriors, move their shaman and activate any shaman powers, or bid hearts on powerful divination cards
When a player thinks they’ve taken the actions they need for the round, they dump their remaining hearts into the monolith. The sooner they feed their hearts to the monolith, the more actions they will have during combat, but do it too soon, and risk…

In this asymmetrical trick-taking game, there are two roles: the Phantom and his muse, Christine. The Phantom tries to compose the perfect melody; Christine tries to prevent exactly that and thus free herself from the Phantom’s grip. The player who has taken the most tricks after two rounds wins.

The Plank das spannende Push-your-Luck Würfelspiel, bei dem es darum geht „Letzter“ zu werden.
Meuterei !
Meuterer haben dein Schiff übernommen und schicken dich und deine getreuen Matrosen über die Planke. Bei jedem Zug versucht ihr, euch so wenig wie möglich zu bewegen. Doch je näher ihr dem Ende der Planke kommt, desto geschickter müsst ihr würfeln und Eure Münzen einsetzen, um immer niedrigere Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
Sammelt Münzen, um zusätzliche Würfe zu erhalten oder Würfel zu ignorieren, oder sammelt Schwerter, um die anderen Piraten näher an den Rand der Planke zu drängen.
Der Pirat, der als Letztes auf der Planke steht, wird verschont, darf auf das Schiff zurückkehren und gewinnt das Spiel

Can you and your team escape the infamous Filipino haunted house?
In this one-of-a-kind dynamic co-operative adventure game, you and your team attempt to escape the Purple House by flipping over doors in the correct sequence. Luckily, you are able to mark the doors with red paint to remember them - but will your teammates understand your markings? And will you be able to avoid the White Lady?

The Queen’s Dilemma is a competitive narrative legacy game where you shape the fate of the Kingdom of Ankist across a web of branching storylines. Play as one of six unique nobles, govern your lands, and navigate moral and political conflicts defined by clashing ideologies. Your choices will define not just the kingdom’s destiny, but your own.
Branching narrative: Shape a unique story through your Council’s choices.
Play your own character: Choose from six nobles, each with personal goals and secret storylines.
Evolving legacy system: Past decisions leave lasting marks on future events.
New political paradigms: Balance ideologies like Tradition vs Progress and Order vs Liberty.
Territory management: Expand, construct, and govern your lands.
Mystery boxes: Unlock secret legacy content that…

The Queen's Dilemma ist die Fortsetzung von The King's Dilemma, dem preisgekrönten (und für das Kennerspiel des Jahres nominierten) interaktiven narrativen Legacy-Spiel.

The Queen's Dilemma spielt hundert Jahre nach den dramatischen Ereignissen des ersten Spiels und baut auf dem revolutionären Dilemma-Kartensystem auf. Es bietet eine brandneue Geschichte, verbessert die bestehenden Legacy-Mechanismen und fügt viele neue exklusive Funktionen hinzu. Mit dem enthaltenen Age of Disorder Pack enthält das Spiel eine Erweiterung, die den Übergang von The King’s Dilemma zu The Queen’s Dilemma spielerisch erzählt und euch erste wichtige Entscheidungen abverlangt.

Nehmt euren Platz im Rat der Königin ein und wählt aus sechs einzigartigen Charakteren eure eigene Rolle aus. Ihr erlebt die…

Lay your cards, snap a photo, and the Quickening happens: your army comes alive!
The Quickening is an app-powered boardgame autobattler: 2 players, 10 minutes. (Spoiler alert: nobody plays just one game!)
You place your unit cards on the battlefield, snap one photo with your phone, and the app awakens your army: every unit marches, shoots, and recharges on its own, exactly where you dropped it.
Every unit has its own brain. Swordsmen chase the nearest enemy. Archers stop and shoot, as long as they can see one. Knights are fast and hungry for the enemy backline, tanks form a slow stubborn wall, catapults lob boulders over everything, and hunters deploy behind enemy lines. The juggernaut shoves your own troops aside on its way to a fortress. Drop a healer where the wounded will be, or a…

The Rainbow Fish and friends collect colorful scales but they don’t keep them all. They give some away, earning glittering scales in return. As the fish grow more vibrant, the first player to collect all the scales for their Rainbow Fish wins this beautifully shimmering game of sharing.

The Republic's Struggle is a thematic game with card engine for 2 players, set during the historical events that took place in Spain after the resignation to the throne of King Alfonso XIII, and the proclamation of the II Spanish Republic, in 1931. With the creation of the new regime, the struggle for power between the different social, political and ideological sectors increased, which gave rise to continuous changes of political power, alterations of the public order, armed uprisings and violent acts, carried out by the numerous ideological factions of the moment; which culminated in 1936, in a failed military uprising. The failure of this coup d'état originated the Spanish Civil War.
The game represents all the events of this turbulent period in the history of Spain, which led to a…

In Robotland, one of the twenty resident robots has had enough and has made its escape. Together with the remaining robots and your fellow players, can you figure out which one ran away before it is too late?
The aim of the game is to reveal the Runaway Robot. To do so, players take turns playing Robot tiles to figure out each other’s hidden Robots, trying to reveal as much information as possible. If you know each other’s robots, you will figure out the missing robot - but will you do so before you run out of clues?

5 Missions, 5 Codes, 0 Words
Do you dare to take on the ultimate heist? In the Safe, you and your team face the greatest challenge of your careers: cracking five heavily secured safes. But there’s a catch… Communication is strictly forbidden! Without saying a single word, you must work together flawlessly to decipher the hidden codes. How do you become a master safecracker?
Play cards in the correct order — ascending or descending — to gradually discover which number is missing for each color. Do you have the nerves of steel it takes? Every successful mission brings you closer to victory, but beware: the challenge keeps growing! After every cracked safe, the game becomes harder: certain colors become mandatory, some rows may only increase or decrease, and sometimes only even or odd…

Graves are not always silent…
A cemetery on a hill in Illinois. A strange notebook locked away in a drawer. Recently appointed as the caretaker, you inherit it, and within its pages, you uncover the secrets gathered by your predecessor, Warden Keene. Mysteries abound, and your only clues lie in the epitaphs etched into each gravestone. They tell the story of the small town through the final traces of its residents, now resting six feet.
•

• 11 mysteries, about 20 minutes each

• A mysterious but not sinister atmosphere!

Shapeless figures crawled across the ground in the darkness. The air was heavy and putrid with the stench of the marsh beneath them. They were searching for something. Something whose form they could take on. They found the Imperial Expedition. Though long since decayed, a part of their abilities still lingered within their lifeless bodies. A headless sergeant accustomed to giving orders, a ruthless fighter, a guardsman and, above all, their greed for gold!
Pre-release at our booth 1C215.

Das berühmte Online-Spiel erwacht auf deinem Spieltischzum Leben! Erschaffe deinen eigenen Sim, baue dein Traumleben auf und erfülle deine Lebensziele – genau wieim Videospiel, nur diesmal ganz ohne Bildschirm. Planeclever, triff wichtige Entscheidungen und werde der erfolgreichste Sim im Spiel!​ Nun auch auf Deutsch erhältlich!

The circus is in town! In this deck-building game, the traveling circus whisks you away to an enchanting world full of unique performers. Each round, players choose both the city where their circus will perform next and a new attraction. For each performance, they must also set a minimum number of performers, which earns points when met. Then the show begins! To do this, one to six players lay their cards end-to-end using the domino principle to form long, high-scoring chains. This tactical card game for ages 10 and up is full of wondrous and exciting twists: Who will score the most points and put on the best circus show?

pr.t: The Travels of Isabella Lucy Bird
pr.o: THE TRAVELS OF ISABELLA LUCY BIRD
pr.d:
Travel across Japan as it was 150 years ago!
The Travels of Isabella Lucy Bird is a roll-and-write game that retraces the journeys of Isabella Lucy Bird, the real-life British explorer.
Players draft dice to choose their actions, tracing their travel routes across a map of old Japan while completing journal cards. Higher-value dice allow more powerful actions, but using the dice of each color in ascending order earns a large bonus at the end of the game. Players must therefore think carefully about which dice to use, and in what order.
As they travel, players deepen their knowledge of nature, culture, and faith, gathering materials to complete their journals and score points. In addition, when a town they have actually visited matches the town on a completed journal card, they earn extra…

pr.k: 372:THE TREASURE MAP OF THE RED KRAKEN
pr.t: The Treasure Map of the Red Kraken
pr.o: THE TREASURE MAP OF THE RED KRAKEN
pr.d:
The Treasure Map of the Red Kraken is the world’s first Escape Map, so you can enjoy an immersive and challenging experience by unrolling a real treasure map. You will need to solve puzzles and riddles to advance the story, using different assets such as a pop-up version of your pirate ship, while also navigating our digital world.

Immerse yourself in this epic adventure to find the gratest pirate treasure in history, The treasure of the Red Kraken. the fate of the world may change depending on who finds it, you must make sure it is you.

Tief im Wald sammeln die Eichhörnchen fleißig Eicheln für ihren Wintervorrat. Doch der alte Schatzbaum ist unberechenbar – wenn man die Eicheln hineinwirft, landen sie manchmal an unerwarteten Plätzen! Du brauchst nur etwas Strategie und eine Prise Glück, um die meisten Eicheln zu sammeln, bevor der Winter kommt!

The Trial is a social deduction game with secret identities. Players are either on the good side or bad side. You all are in a court trying to support your case by putting either good or bad evidence in the case file. After each round, if the number of the good evidence cards inside the file is more than the bad evidence cards, the good side players will win the round, and vice versa. After 5 rounds whichever team has won the most rounds will win the game, but watch out, since the judge can stop any player from playing for 1 round if he suspected you to be with the bad team!

pr.a: Luca Piva, Andrea Certo and Michele Mingardi
pr.m: Area Control, Ressource Management, Set Collection, Others
pr.d:
ITA (Eng in PDF)
A game for Collectors, created by
Collectors.
The Way We Collect is a simultaneous
auction and set collection game where
players secretly bid coins, manage a limited
3×3 shelf, and trigger combos by matching
the characteristics of their toys. And the
box itself? It’s part of the collection — every
copy is unique.
You are a minimalist but ambitious collector. Rare
fins go ast, shel space is tight, an ee auction
is a gamble. Will you overpay to complete the perfect
collection — or let it slip into someone else’s hands?

pr.m: Dice Placement, Ressource Management, Worker Placement
pr.d:
Expand the strategic possibilities of The White Castle! This expansion, which requires the base game to play, includes Time Passage Track tiles, which add new rewards; Daimyo Gift tokens, with objectives that can provide points at the end of the game; and the Privilege card deck, which grants permanent bonuses during the game.
The White Castle Boeki can be enjoyed with both the base game and Matcha, the first expansion for The White Castle. Among the new features added by Boeki are the 20 Privilege cards, which players can obtain as they advance along the new Time Passage Track. These cards grant special bonuses that alter certain requirements, such as dice rolls or the costs of certain actions.
Another new feature is the Daimyo Gift tokens, which are taken at the beginning of the game…

pr.t: The Witcher: Pfad des Schicksals Ronin
pr.o: THE WITCHER: PFAD DES SCHICKSALS RONIN
pr.d:
Im Kennerspiel The Witcher: Pfad des Schicksals Ronin spielt ihr als die Ronin-Versionen von Geralt, Ciri, Yennefer, Rittersporn, Vesemir, Triss oder Yuki Onna und nutzt ihre Spezialfertigkeiten sowie einzigartigen Karten, um furchtlos den Pfad des Schicksals zu beschreiten.
Es ist ein kompetitives Spiel, in dem ihr euer Tableau mit Karten aufbaut. Ihr übernehmt jeweils die Rolle von einem Charakter aus einer einzigartigen alternativen Version des Witcher-Universums und schmiedet zerbrechliche Allianzen. Spielt Karten aus und nutzt Spezialeffekte, um Symbole zu sammeln, die eure Entscheidungen repräsentieren. Ihr seid zwar Mitglieder ein und desselben Teams, dennoch werdet ihr gegeneinander antreten, um euren Namen in den Geschichtsbüchern zu verewigen.
The Witcher: Pfad des Schicksals…

Theokratia ist ein Würfel-Drafting-Zivilisationsspiel, bei dem jeder Spieler die Aktion der 4 Völker manipulieren kann, die die Insel bewohnen. So versuchen sie, sie zum Expandieren, Bauen und Kämpfen zu bewegen. Durch diese Aktionen werden sich die Zivilisationen entwickeln und die Götter anbeten, die ihnen zusagen. Das Alien (Spieler), das die meiste Anbetung erfahren hat, gewinnt das Spiel.

pr.t: Thessaloniki: Handel im Zeitalter der Tetrarchie
pr.o: THESSALONIKI: HANDEL IM ZEITALTER DER TETRARCHIE
pr.d:
Werde zum einflussreichsten Händler des Römischen Reiches!
Thessaloniki entführt dich in das geschäftige Handelszentrum des 4. Jahrhunderts, als die gleichnamige Hafenstadt unter der Tetrarchie zu den bedeutendsten Wirtschaftszentren des Römischen Reiches zählte. Zwischen belebten Märkten, einlaufenden Handelsschiffen und politischen Intrigen kämpfst du als einflussreicher Patrizier um Reichtum, Ansehen und die Gunst der Mächtigen.
Als ehrgeiziger Kaufmann handelst du mit wertvollen Waren wie Getreide, Öl, Wein und Fleisch, erfüllst lukrative Aufträge und knüpfst Handelsbeziehungen zu verbündeten Städten. Dabei gilt es, den richtigen Zeitpunkt für Verkäufe zu finden und deine Lieferungen an die profitabelsten Ziele zu senden, um den größtmöglichen Gewinn zu erzielen.
Doch wirtschaftlicher…

Third Crusade – Battle Stories is a fast-paced mini board game that captures the tactical excitement of the original Third Crusade. Build the battlefield, gather your forces, and outsmart your opponent in strategic battles for control of the Holy Land. Play head-to-head or in teams, carefully positioning your troops and planning every move to secure victory. Easy to learn, quick to play, and packed with meaningful decisions, it's the perfect strategy game for history fans and board gamers alike.
Compatible with Third Crusade: Includes new components that add Archers to battles in the base game.

Three Sisters Harvest Edition packs all the decisions and fun of a full gaming experience into an efficient and innovative package. Use your garden, yard, apiary and shed or visit the farmer’s market while you grow corn, beans, pumpkins, perennials and more. Three Sisters Harvest Edition features the award-winning gameplay of the original edition, along with a twelve chapter campaign mode that includes new content, gameplay and components. The new content can also be used as expansion modules for endless replayability.

Three Sisters Harvest Edition is a fully standalone new edition of Three Sisters

Throne of Lies: Tactics, Tension and Magical Rivalries
In the sparkling yet dangerous world of the Fae, six realms vie for influence at the royal court: Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, Sun and Moon. But their power struggles are not fought on battlefields. Instead, they play out through secret exchanges and cunning intrigues!
Who among you will see through the schemes of the others and turn them to your own advantage? Round by round, the balance of power among the Fae shifts. In the end, only one thing matters: scoring the most points with your cards and securing your dominance.
• Magical card game for ages 8 and up: Dive into the fascinating world of the Fae

• Tactical fun for 3 to 6 players: Clever exchanges and unexpected events keep the tension high until the very end

• Compact…

pr.a: Noah Cohen,Rob Daviau,Justin D. Jacobson,Justin Kemppainen
pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Dice Placement, Dice Rolling, Modular Board
pr.d:
Get In, Loser, We’re Going Shooting!
The critically acclaimed Thunder Road is getting a new chassis and a fresh coat of paint. Thunder Road: Ignition is an all-new, standalone base game set in the world of post-apocalyptic racing. It uses the same core system with tweaks to game play and components to streamline play for an easier and quicker point-of-entry, all in a smaller box and cheaper price point.
The new version features four new car crew colors and half-sized road boards – now with curves! Also included are new commands, terrain, and damage effects.
Ignition offers a great opportunity to bring new players into the world of Thunder Road – perfect for families and casual players – while also providing a host of new content for existing fans.

pr.k: 757:THUNDER ROAD VENDETTA: WILLKOMMEN IN DER WRACKEDRALE
pr.t: Thunder Road Vendetta: Willkommen in der Wrackedrale
pr.o: THUNDER ROAD VENDETTA: WILLKOMMEN IN DER WRACKEDRALE
pr.a: Brian Neff, Justin D. Jacobson, Noah Cohen, Rob Daviau
pr.m: Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Push your Luck
pr.d:
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Thunder Road Vendetta: Willkommen in der Wrackedrale erweitert Thunder Road Vendetta: Maximum Chrome um einen neuen Arena-Modus. Statt nur auf einer langen Straße um den Sieg zu fahren, kämpft ihr in Arenen um Chrom und Ruhm. Gegner werden gerammt, ausgeschaltet oder durch Manöver überlistet. Hexfelder ermöglichen andere Bewegungen und bieten Extras wie Ballonplättchen und Superwaffen. Turbo Tina verändert über Gebote die Regeln der nächsten Runde.

Compete to ride the most waves and claim glory. You decide whether to go all in or back off in time. Here, pushing your luck is part of the game. If you want to conquer Tiburón Beach, surf the waves wisely—but beware of the surfer shark. Will you be the one to master the waves and grab the best boards?

Thousands of spectators, several tense rounds, two pairs of gloves and just one winner! It’s time to prove who is the best boxer in the world. The judges are already in their places, the coaches are giving you their final tips – the first round is about to begin!
This is your moment of boxing glory!
Land powerful punches, throw your opponent off balance with nimble dodges and effectively parry your opponent’s blows to claim the world championship title!
How to play?
This is a one-on-one card game based on deck-building mechanics. By playing cards, you’ll aim to reduce your opponent’s stamina so that by the end of the round you have more stamina points than they do, thereby winning the round. The player who wins the most rounds is the winner!
Contents:
2 pawns with stands
28 basic action…

Time of Your Life is a pick and pass card tableau building game. Players play cards into their tableau that represent their life's timeline as an age. Once a card is placed it must be positioned according to the card's age on the card from left (younger) to right (older).
Players score points by each card having an objective which looks at all other cards or cards to its left or right. Objectives include looking for various icons on other cards, specific cards in various decades and so on!

Stellt euch den verrücktesten Challenges! Mal im Team – mal ganz allein. Von superleicht bis richtig abgefahren! Doch Achtung: Jede Sekunde zählt! Füttert den sprechenden Timer mit euren Scheinen, denn für jeden Dollar bekommt ihr eine Sekunde Spielzeit. Clever haushalten ist Pflicht – Wechselgeld gibt’s nicht! Schafft ihr es, zusammen 5 Challenges erfolgreich zu meistern? Oder legt ihr noch eine Schippe drauf und zeigt, dass mehr in euch steckt? Timer füttern und starten – Jetzt heißt es TIME TO SCHEIN!
Ratet, lacht und bezwingt die Sanduhr in dieser blitzschnellen Version des legendären Partyspiels Time's Up!

pr.t: Timeless Journeys: The Italian Grand Tour
pr.o: TIMELESS JOURNEYS: THE ITALIAN GRAND TOUR
pr.m: Action Selection, Area Movement, Drafting, Ressource Management, Set Collection
pr.d: Timeless Journeys is a medium-weight strategy game about undertaking a Grand Tour through 18th- and 19th-century Italy. Play cards to travel between eight cities, explore renowned sights, meet locals and celebrated travelers, and gather ideas, friendships, and discoveries for your Travel Journals. Combine cards of the same category to trigger powerful action chains, then acquire new Advanced Action cards from a shared market to expand your possibilities. Each journey presents a fresh puzzle of route planning, timing, resource management, and set collection as you compete to create the most memorable Grand Tour.

Build a civilization that withstands the test of time! In Timespan, you shape human history by playing cards representing historic persons, legendary buildings, and groundbreaking technologies into your personal timeframe. But history never stands still: as time marches forward, older accomplishments are naturally pushed into your graveyard to make room for the new.
The Three Tracks of Progress
Drive your empire forward across three distinct avenues of development:
• Culture: Unlock awe-inspiring wonders and expand your growing population.

• Science: Discover unique, game-changing technologies.

• Exploration: Advance your ship, plane, or spacecraft to secure exotic luxury resources.

Structure of a Round
Every round in Timespan demands clever tactical planning through four smooth…

pr.d:
A streamlined, peaceful civilization game where you play from stone age to space age in 90 minutes .

Recruit historical persons, create inventions, explore, and make your own history.

Timespan | Board Game | BoardGameGeek
Tinctura ist ein atmosphärisches Planungs- und Strategiespiel, in dem ihr als Apotheker:innen eure Arbeitstage clever einteilt, Arzneien herstellt und Patient:innen versorgt.

pr.m: Area Movement, Dice Rolling, Modular Board
pr.d: Cause mayhem, frame your friends, and avoid the Human! Tiny Toe Beans: Ultimate Mischief is a fast-paced strategy game where 2–4 mischievous cats explore a modular mansion, play room-specific Mischief cards, pull pranks on their rivals, and compete to cause the most chaos.

Das beliebte Kartenspiel in einer neuen Dimension. Nach dem erfolgreichen Kartenspiel geht es jetzt auf den Spielplan! Gemeinsam legt ihr eure Plättchen, um die abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben zu erfüllen. Doch der Platz wird schnell knapp – also heißt es: clever sta peln und in die Höhe bauen! Schade nur, dass ihr nicht über eure Plättchen sprechen dürft… Da hilft nur gutes Teamwork und ein bisschen Mut zur Lücke, bevor euch die Plättchen ausgehen. Könnt ihr aufeinander bauen?

pr.m: Action Selection, Area Control, Area Movement, Auction, Bag Building, Deck Building, Dice Placement, Dice Rolling, Drafting, Dungeon Crawler, Engine Building, Escape Game, Flip'n'Write, Hidden Roles, Modular Board, Pick-up and Deliver, Push your Luck, Ressource Management, Roll'n'Write, Set Collection, Tile Placement, Trade, Traitor, Trick taking, Worker Placement, Others
pr.d:
Die Tisch-Erweiterung

Diese Teile hängst du an einer schmalen Seite deines #HAPPYLUZA´s ein und legst eine deiner Deckplatten drauf!
Somit hast schön viel Platz für die Spielanleitung, Snacks oder sonstigigen Kram, den man sowieso immer irgendwo hinlegen muss.

Du kannst diese Erweiterung aber auch als Master-Platz verwenden!

Der riesen Vorteil ist, dass der ganze Spielekeller-Bereich frei bleibt und zu benutzen ist.
Einfach in die vorhandene Reling einhängen und schon bist du fertig.

Das Ganze ist mit 5 kg belastbar.

Um eine schmale Seite zu verlängern, bekommst zwei Stück dieser Einhängevorrichtung!

In Toby, you’ll step into the paws of a student at the School for Sniffers, ready to take the final exam. Your goal? To correctly match smells to characters… but without being able to communicate with the others! A cooperative deduction game where intuition, teamwork, and a dash of luck will make the difference between passing with flying colors and a spectacular failure.
Think the Same Way… Without Telling Each Other
Each round, all players receive a secret clue and must match it to one of the characters in the game by choosing the “Scent” card they associate with that character. The catch? You can’t talk or give any hints. So you’ll have to rely on your ability to “think like the others,” hoping to reach the same conclusions without coordinating with each other.
Deduction, intuition,…
Build your house brick by brick using the die! But beware of the wolf who huffs and puffs and could blow it all down!

pr.m: Deck Building, Engine Building, Worker Placement
pr.d:
In Tofu Shifu: Masters of Spices, your tofu shop will welcome traveling merchants from distant lands. With their arrival, you can begin developing all-new recipes, unlock spices upgrade paths, and roll out corresponding signature dishes. New locations will open up on the town’s western outskirts, and you may even spot magpies bringing good tidings.
Then, you may also choose to play as a shopkeeper who possesses extraordinary skills but is bound by special restrictions—taking on even greater business challenges!

The farm is in a mess! Tom needs your help to gather the animals into the pens before the wolves scare them away.
Watch the cards, find trios or pairs—but don’t make a mistake or you’ll end up in the watering trough!

A perfect game for preschoolers!

pr.t: Too Many Bones – Aus der Tiefe
pr.o: TOO MANY BONES – AUS DER TIEFE
pr.d:
THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Too Many Bones – Aus der Tiefe ist ein eigenständiges kooperatives Würfel-Abenteuer für 1 bis 2 Personen ab 12 Jahren von Adam Carlson und Josh J. Carlson. Ihr schlüpft in die Rolle von Gearlocs und stellt euch auf einer gefährlichen Reise durch Daelore zahlreichen Fieslingen, Begegnungen und mächtigen Tyrannen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen taktische Kämpfe, bei denen ihr eure Würfel gezielt einsetzt, neue Fähigkeiten freischaltet und euren Charakter im Laufe des Abenteuers weiterentwickelt. Die Kombination aus Dice-Building, Charakterentwicklung, taktischen Gefechten und zahlreichen Begegnungen sorgt für ein umfangreiches Abenteuer, das sich auch mit…

THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Too Many Bones – Laborratten ist eine Gearloc-Erweiterung und führt den ersten Multi-Gearloc der Reihe ein. Slank, Gerbil, Flan und Helix bilden gemeinsam eine Gruppe und teilen sich einen Pool aus 16 Fertigkeitswürfeln. Das Wechseln des passenden Charakters mit der passenden Ausrüstung schafft einen neuen taktischen Ansatz. Die Erweiterung enthält Charaktermatten, zahlreiche Würfel und Chips sowie einen Würfelhalter und benötigt das Grundspiel.

THIS GAME BY FROSTED GAMES IS ONLY AVAILABLE IN GERMAN LANGUAGE. For other language versions, please check the APP for availabilty at SPIEL26.

Too Many Bones: Riffle ist eine exklusive Gearloc-Erweiterung für Too Many Bones. Riffle ist ein Meister der Illusion und des Glücksspiels und ersetzt einen Teil seiner Skill-Würfel durch ein eigens illustriertes 52-Karten-Pokerdeck. Im Kampf zieht und spielt er Pokerhände und Kartenkombinationen, um starke Effekte auszulösen, Mitstreitende zu unterstützen oder Gegner zu behindern. Neben Würfeln wird dadurch das Kartendeck manipuliert und im richtigen Moment das passende Blatt ausgespielt.

Weniger ist mehr – zumindest bei diesem turbulenten Partyspiel! In Too Much Info gilt es, einen Begriff so zu erklären, dass ihn möglichst viele, aber eben nicht alle erraten. Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht! Wer zu viel verrät, geht genauso leer aus wie jemand, dessen Hinweise niemand versteht. So entsteht ein herrlich chaotischer Mix aus Kreativität, Taktik und jeder Menge Gelächter.
+ originelles Ratespiel mit überraschendem Twist: Nicht alle sollen die Lösung kennen
+ 1.000 Begriffe aus 5 Kategorien sorgen für jede Menge Abwechslung
+ einfache Regeln und schneller Spieleinstieg für spontane Spielrunden
+ ideal für größere Gruppen mit bis zu 16 Personen
+ perfekt für Partys, Familienfeiern und Spieleabende mit Freund*innen

Players team up to organize their number cards into a shared pile—sometimes in ascending, sometimes in descending order. Can you master the timing, or will you be stuck with your numbers forever? Action cards spice up the game and might save you at the last second.

pr.a: Brad Ross & Ulco Toy and Game Co.
pr.d: Eure Aufgabe bei Top it ist es, passende Begriffe zu bestimmten Themen zu finden. Diese müssen mit einem der im 3x3-Raster ausliegenden Buchstaben beginnen. Pro Begriff dürft ihr einen eurer Kegel auf das entsprechende Buchstabenplättchen stellen. Ihr spielt gleichzeitig und könnt eure Kegel auch „on top" anderer Kegel setzen, also obendrauf stapeln, wenn ihr einen anderen Begriff mit demselben Anfangsbuchstaben nennen könnt. Für jeden platzierten Kegel bekommt ihr 1 Punkt. Nur der oberste Kegel einer Farbe kann aber eine wertvolle 3er-Reihe bilden. Wer von euch zuerst 50 Punkte erreicht, ist top und gewinnt das Spiel.

Rein in die Backstube! Schaut genau und setzt eure Tortenteile übereinander. Könnt ihr gleichfarbige Streifen verbinden? Für cleveres Anlegen malt ihr Zuckerwürfel auf eurem Block farbig aus und ergattert Siegpunkte. So gewinnt ihr mit Augenmaß und Törtchenglück die zuckersüße Spielrunde.
Die Kompaktversion zum Kinderspiel des Jahres 2025
Spielprinzip basiert auf dem Originalspiel
Weniger Zucker, aber trotzdem genauso spannend

The Torii Valley is renowned for the delicacy and harmony of its landscapes.
Each year, artists from all over the world gather there to paint it, yet none has managed to capture all of its poetry.
Your goal: to create the most beautiful painting ever made of the Torii Valley.

pr.m: Area Movement, Modular Board, Tile Placement
pr.d:
Tornado Splash - by Moyuki Adisawa
Dive into the ultimate water sports showdown!
You’re a rising star taking the scene by storm and leaving your competitors far behind. After a string of breathtaking victories, you’ve secured one of the coveted spots in the “Tornado Splash” World Championship race—a high-profile event where only the fastest and best racers compete.
Will you ride the wave to victory or sink beneath the spray?
Buckle up, hit the gas, and make the water splash!
​
Play your cards, accelerate through the turns, and race down the straights!
Whoever masters this best wins “Tornado Splash”!
​​
2–5 players – Ages 6 and up – Playing time: 20–40 minutes

In the Character Skill Mini Expansion, each character is given a unique skill, allowing players to enjoy a race that differs slightly from the base game rules.
Replace the 6 Character Cards with the 6 Character Cards+, then set up the game as usual.
Character Skills are abilities that each player may use once per game.

Toshi – Build Your City. Become a Master Planner of the Sengoku Period!
Welcome to Japan during the Sengoku period! In this strategic tile placement game, you create your own Japanese city. With each tile, you add nagaya, or row houses, mise, or shops, teien, or gardens, kōba, or workshops, and many other buildings. Every building comes at a cost and offers unique advantages. By combining them cleverly, you can increase your wealth and help your city flourish. Since everyone plays at the same time, the pace stays fast and the tension builds with every turn.
• Strategic tile placement game for everyone: Ages 8 and up, ideal for families and groups of friends
• Japanese flair: An authentic atmosphere with immersive illustrations
• For 1 to 4 players: Simultaneous play means little waiting…

The City of Kanashī is calling!
As urban designers, the mayor is asking you to build to new green district of the city. They will retain the services of the designer that will most show their know-how and will grow the most plants and trees around the district’s important buildings.

Toshi Tōshi is an area control game with a trick-taking mechanism in which you need to win or lose tricks at the right moment. You play only ONE hand of 10 cards, so make them count!
The winner of the trick decides which buildings are constructed in which sectors. On the other hand, the non-winners will place Nature tokens around the buildings to increase their influence.
At the end of the game, the player that has the most tokens connected to a building will win that building.

The alien invasion has begun, and humans are in a rush to escape Earth before it’s too late! The only problem is that aliens are disguised as humans! Our only hope is to weed out the aliens via the power of … multiple choice questions!
While the aliens know how to blend in and look like us, they don’t quite understand human culture. These questions are carefully crafted to help expose the space invaders. All you have to do is answer like any normal human would. It’s that easy! It’s only the fate of humanity at stake … Don’t sweat it!
In Totally Human, players are given hidden identities (human or alien) and must answer three multiple-choice questions as "human-like" as possible, but aliens don't understand human culture completely and face restrictions on how they can respond.
The humans’…

pr.t: Totem - The Spirits' RPG | Ghost Pack
pr.o: TOTEM - THE SPIRITS' RPG | GHOST PACK
pr.m: Area Movement, Dungeon Crawler, Escape Game
pr.d:
Totem – The Spirits’ RPG by Officina Meningi won four major honors at the 2024 NDU Awards — Game of the Year, Best Setting, Best Mechanics, and Best Art. It was later shortlisted for Best RPG at the 2026 UK Games Expo Judge’s Choice Awards and received a nomination at the 2026 ENNIE Awards, widely regarded as the “Oscars” of tabletop role-playing games.

Totem - The Spirits' RPG is a Narrative Map-Making Horror Role-Playing Game with simple rules inspired by classics of the Ghost Story genre.

The game will guide your group of Seekers along a chilling voyage through the uncanny in search of contact with entities populating other planes of reality. You’ll explore haunted houses, exorcize demons, pry into the will of otherworldly entities with the Spirit Board, and even cross the threshold…

pr.k: 428:TOTEM - THE SPIRITS' RPG | TALES FROM THE DARK
pr.t: Totem - The Spirits' RPG | Tales from the Dark
pr.o: TOTEM - THE SPIRITS' RPG | TALES FROM THE DARK
